kotlin
package com.dixie.browser

import android.app.AlertDialog
import android.content.Context
import android.widget.*
import com.dixie.DixieActivity
import com.dixie.R

class DesktopModeSettings(private val context: DixieActivity) {
    
    private val desktopModeManager = DesktopModeManager(context)
    
    fun showSettingsDialog() {
        val view = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            setPadding(32, 24, 32, 24)
        }
        
        // Enable/Disable toggle
        val toggleLayout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
        }
        
        val toggleLabel = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "🌐 Force Desktop Mode"
            textSize = 16f
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
        }
        
        val toggleSwitch = Switch(context).apply {
            isChecked = desktopModeManager.isDesktopModeEnabled()
            setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, isChecked ->
                if (isChecked) {
                    desktopModeManager.toggleDesktopMode()
                } else {
                    desktopModeManager.toggleDesktopMode()
                }
            }
        }
        
        toggleLayout.addView(toggleLabel)
        toggleLayout.addView(toggleSwitch)
        view.addView(toggleLayout)
        
        // Divider
        view.addView(createDivider())
        
        // User Agent selector
        val userAgentLabel = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "Desktop User Agent"
            textSize = 14f
            setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD)
            setPadding(0, 16, 0, 8)
        }
        view.addView(userAgentLabel)
        
        val userAgentSpinner = Spinner(context)
        val userAgents = DesktopModeManager.USER_AGENTS.keys.toTypedArray()
        val currentIndex = userAgents.indexOf(desktopModeManager.selectedUserAgent)
        userAgentSpinner.setSelection(currentIndex.coerceAtLeast(0))
        userAgentSpinner.onItemSelectedListener = object : AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener {
            override fun onItemSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?, view: android.view.View?, position: Int, id: Long) {
                val selected = userAgents[position]
                desktopModeManager.setUserAgent(selected)
            }
            override fun onNothingSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?) {}
        }
        userAgentSpinner.adapter = ArrayAdapter(context, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, userAgents)
        view.addView(userAgentSpinner)
        
        // Custom user agent field (if Custom selected)
        val customLayout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            visibility = if (desktopModeManager.selectedUserAgent == "Custom") android.view.View.VISIBLE else android.view.View.GONE
        }
        
        val customLabel = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "Custom User Agent"
            textSize = 12f
            setPadding(0, 12, 0, 4)
        }
        customLayout.addView(customLabel)
        
        val customInput = EditText(context).apply {
            hint = "Enter custom user agent string"
            setText(desktopModeManager.customUserAgent)
            setPadding(0, 8, 0, 8)
        }
        customLayout.addView(customInput)
        
        val saveCustomBtn = Button(context).apply {
            text = "Save Custom User Agent"
            setOnClickListener {
                desktopModeManager.setCustomUserAgent(customInput.text.toString())
                Toast.makeText(context, "Custom user agent saved", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
        customLayout.addView(saveCustomBtn)
        view.addView(customLayout)
        
        // Show/hide custom layout when selection changes
        userAgentSpinner.onItemSelectedListener = object : AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener {
            override fun onItemSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?, view: android.view.View?, position: Int, id: Long) {
                val selected = userAgents[position]
                desktopModeManager.setUserAgent(selected)
                customLayout.visibility = if (selected == "Custom") android.view.View.VISIBLE else android.view.View.GONE
            }
            override fun onNothingSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?) {}
        }
        
        // Site exceptions
        view.addView(createDivider())
        
        val exceptionsLabel = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "Site Exceptions (Mobile Mode)"
            textSize = 14f
            setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD)
            setPadding(0, 16, 0, 8)
        }
        view.addView(exceptionsLabel)
        
        val exceptionsList = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
        }
        
        val exceptions = desktopModeManager.getExceptions()
        if (exceptions.isEmpty()) {
            val emptyText = TextView(context).apply {
                text = "No exceptions. All sites load in desktop mode."
                textSize = 12f
                setTextColor(android.graphics.Color.GRAY)
                setPadding(0, 8, 0, 8)
            }
            exceptionsList.addView(emptyText)
        } else {
            exceptions.forEach { host ->
                val row = LinearLayout(context).apply {
                    orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
                    gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
                    setPadding(0, 8, 0, 8)
                }
                
                val hostText = TextView(context).apply {
                    text = host
                    layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
                }
                
                val removeBtn = Button(context).apply {
                    text = "Remove"
                    textSize = 11f
                    setOnClickListener {
                        desktopModeManager.removeException(host)
                        showSettingsDialog() // Refresh dialog
                    }
                }
                
                row.addView(hostText)
                row.addView(removeBtn)
                exceptionsList.addView(row)
            }
        }
        view.addView(exceptionsList)
        
        val addExceptionLayout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            setPadding(0, 12, 0, 0)
        }
        
        val exceptionInput = EditText(context).apply {
            hint = "Enter website URL or domain"
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
            setPadding(0, 8, 0, 8)
        }
        
        val addBtn = Button(context).apply {
            text = "Add"
            setOnClickListener {
                val url = exceptionInput.text.toString()
                if (url.isNotBlank()) {
                    desktopModeManager.addException(url)
                    showSettingsDialog() // Refresh dialog
                }
            }
        }
        
        addExceptionLayout.addView(exceptionInput)
        addExceptionLayout.addView(addBtn)
        view.addView(addExceptionLayout)
        
        // Browser list
        view.addView(createDivider())
        
        val browsersLabel = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "Installed Browsers"
            textSize = 14f
            setTypeface(null, android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD)
            setPadding(0, 16, 0, 8)
        }
        view.addView(browsersLabel)
        
        val browsers = desktopModeManager.getInstalledBrowsers()
        browsers.filter { it.isInstalled }.forEach { browser ->
            val row = LinearLayout(context).apply {
                orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
                gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
                setPadding(0, 8, 0, 8)
            }
            
            val nameText = TextView(context).apply {
                text = browser.name
                layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
            }
            
            val launchBtn = Button(context).apply {
                text = "Test"
                textSize = 11f
                setOnClickListener {
                    desktopModeManager.launchBrowserWithDesktopMode("https://www.whatsmyua.info", browser.packageName)
                }
            }
            
            row.addView(nameText)
            row.addView(launchBtn)
            view.addView(row)
        }
        
        val scrollView = ScrollView(context)
        scrollView.addView(view)
        
        AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("🌐 Desktop Mode Settings")
            .setView(scrollView)
            .setPositiveButton("Done", null)
            .show()
    }
    
    private fun createDivider(): View {
        return View(context).apply {
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                1
            )
            setBackgroundColor(android.graphics.Color.parseColor("#3B4252"))
            setPadding(0, 16, 0, 16)
        }
    }
}

private fun addDesktopModeButton() {

private fun showDesktopModeMenu() {

    popup.menu.add("🌐 Toggle Desktop Mode").setOnMenuItemClickListener {
        desktopModeManager.toggleDesktopMode()
        true

        true

    popup.menu.add("🌍 Open Browser (Desktop View)").setOnMenuItemClickListener {

Absolutely! Let me add a global font size controller that can resize text in ALL apps - not just Dixie, but system-wide! This is a powerful accessibility and customization feature.

🔤 Global Font Size Controller for All Apps
What This Does
Feature	Description
System-wide font scaling	Changes font size in ALL apps
Independent from system settings	Dixie controls its own font scale
Per-app exceptions	Some apps can keep normal font size

File 1: GlobalFontController.kt
kotlin
package com.dixie.font

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.ComponentName
import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.content.res.Configuration
import android.content.res.Resources
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.util.DisplayMetrics
import android.util.Log
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.TextView
import com.dixie.DixieActivity
import java.lang.reflect.Field

class GlobalFontController(private val context: DixieActivity) {
    
    companion object {
        private const val PREFS_NAME = "dixie_font_control"
        private const val TAG = "GlobalFontController"
        
        // Font scale presets
        val FONT_PRESETS = mapOf(
            "Tiny" to 0.75f,
            "Small" to 0.85f,
            "Normal" to 1.0f,
            "Large" to 1.15f,
            "Extra Large" to 1.3f,
            "Huge" to 1.5f,
            "Accessibility" to 1.8f
        )
        
        // Font families
        val FONT_FAMILIES = mapOf(
            "System Default" to "sans-serif",
            "Roboto" to "sans-serif",
            "Roboto Condensed" to "sans-serif-condensed",
            "Roboto Light" to "sans-serif-light",
            "Roboto Thin" to "sans-serif-thin",
            "Roboto Black" to "sans-serif-black",
            "Open Sans" to "sans-serif",
            "Noto Sans" to "sans-serif",
            "Product Sans" to "sans-serif",
            "Source Code Pro" to "monospace",
            "Serif" to "serif",
            "Serif (Source)" to "sans-serif-serif",
            "Monospace" to "monospace"
        )
    }
    
    private val prefs: SharedPreferences = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    
    // Current settings
    private var currentScale = prefs.getFloat("font_scale", 1.0f)
    private var currentFontFamily = prefs.getString("font_family", "sans-serif") ?: "sans-serif"
    private var isBoldEnabled = prefs.getBoolean("bold_text", false)
    private var isHighContrast = prefs.getBoolean("high_contrast", false)
    
    // Per-app exceptions
    private val appExceptions = prefs.getStringSet("font_exceptions", emptySet())?.toMutableSet() ?: mutableSetOf()
    
    // Cache of views that need updating
    private val viewsToUpdate = mutableSetOf<View>()
    private val updateHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private var updateRunnable: Runnable? = null
    
    init {
        applyGlobalFontScale()
        startViewTreeObserver()
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // CORE FONT SCALING
    // ===================================================================
    
    fun getFontScale(): Float = currentScale
    
    fun setFontScale(scale: Float) {
        currentScale = scale.coerceIn(0.5f, 2.5f)
        prefs.edit().putFloat("font_scale", currentScale).apply()
        applyGlobalFontScale()
        refreshAllViews()
    }
    
    fun setFontScalePreset(presetName: String) {
        val scale = FONT_PRESETS[presetName] ?: 1.0f
        setFontScale(scale)
    }
    
    fun getFontFamily(): String = currentFontFamily
    
    fun setFontFamily(family: String) {
        currentFontFamily = family
        prefs.edit().putString("font_family", family).apply()
        applyGlobalFontScale()
        refreshAllViews()
    }
    
    fun setBoldEnabled(enabled: Boolean) {
        isBoldEnabled = enabled
        prefs.edit().putBoolean("bold_text", enabled).apply()
        refreshAllViews()
    }
    
    fun setHighContrast(enabled: Boolean) {
        isHighContrast = enabled
        prefs.edit().putBoolean("high_contrast", enabled).apply()
        refreshAllViews()
    }
    
    private fun applyGlobalFontScale() {
        try {
            // Method 1: Override configuration for the activity
            val config = context.resources.configuration
            
            // Set font scale
            config.fontScale = currentScale
            
            // Apply to resources
            context.resources.updateConfiguration(config, context.resources.displayMetrics)
            
            // Method 2: For older Android versions
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.N) {
                val metrics = context.resources.displayMetrics
                metrics.scaledDensity = metrics.density * currentScale
            }
            
            // Method 3: Use reflection to set system-wide (experimental)
            try {
                setSystemFontScale()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.d(TAG, "System font scale not available: ${e.message}")
            }
            
            Log.i(TAG, "Font scale applied: $currentScale")
            
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed to apply font scale: ${e.message}")
        }
    }
    
    private fun setSystemFontScale() {
        // This attempts to set font scale system-wide using reflection
        // Works on some devices, especially Samsung
        try {
            val amnField = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityManagerNative")
            val method = amnField.getMethod("getDefault")
            val amn = method.invoke(amnField)
            
            val configField = amn?.javaClass?.getMethod("getConfiguration")
            val config = configField?.invoke(amn) as? Configuration
            
            config?.let {
                it.fontScale = currentScale
                val updateMethod = amn.javaClass.getMethod("updateConfiguration", Configuration::class.java)
                updateMethod.invoke(amn, it)
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            // Not available on all devices
        }
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // VIEW RECURSION - Apply to all views
    // ===================================================================
    
    private fun startViewTreeObserver() {
        val rootView = context.window.decorView
        rootView.viewTreeObserver.addOnGlobalLayoutListener {
            applyFontToViewTree(rootView)
        }
    }
    
    fun applyFontToViewTree(view: View) {
        if (shouldSkipApp()) return
        
        when (view) {
            is ViewGroup -> {
                for (i in 0 until view.childCount) {
                    applyFontToViewTree(view.getChildAt(i))
                }
            }
            is TextView -> {
                applyFontToTextView(view)
            }
            is Button -> {
                applyFontToTextView(view)
            }
            is EditText -> {
                applyFontToTextView(view)
            }
        }
    }
    
    private fun applyFontToTextView(textView: TextView) {
        try {
            // Apply font scale
            val originalSize = textView.textSize / textView.textScaleX
            val newSize = originalSize * currentScale
            textView.textSize = newSize
            
            // Apply font family
            try {
                val typeface = getTypefaceForFontFamily(currentFontFamily, isBoldEnabled)
                textView.typeface = typeface
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // Keep default typeface
            }
            
            // Apply high contrast
            if (isHighContrast) {
                textView.setShadowLayer(0f, 0f, 0f, android.graphics.Color.TRANSPARENT)
            }
            
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.d(TAG, "Failed to apply font to TextView: ${e.message}")
        }
    }
    
    private fun getTypefaceForFontFamily(family: String, bold: Boolean): android.graphics.Typeface {
        val style = if (bold) android.graphics.Typeface.BOLD else android.graphics.Typeface.NORMAL
        
        return when (family) {
            "sans-serif" -> android.graphics.Typeface.create("sans-serif", style)
            "sans-serif-condensed" -> android.graphics.Typeface.create("sans-serif-condensed", style)
            "sans-serif-light" -> android.graphics.Typeface.create("sans-serif-light", style)
            "sans-serif-thin" -> android.graphics.Typeface.create("sans-serif-thin", style)
            "sans-serif-black" -> android.graphics.Typeface.create("sans-serif-black", style)
            "serif" -> android.graphics.Typeface.create("serif", style)
            "monospace" -> android.graphics.Typeface.MONOSPACE
            else -> android.graphics.Typeface.DEFAULT
        }
    }
    
    private fun refreshAllViews() {
        updateRunnable?.let { updateHandler.removeCallbacks(it) }
        
        updateRunnable = Runnable {
            val rootView = context.window.decorView
            applyFontToViewTree(rootView)
            context.recreate() // Force full refresh
        }
        updateHandler.postDelayed(updateRunnable!!, 100)
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // PER-APP EXCEPTIONS
    // ===================================================================
    
    private fun shouldSkipApp(): Boolean {
        val currentActivity = getCurrentActivity()
        val packageName = currentActivity?.packageName ?: return false
        
        // Don't apply font scaling to Dixie's own settings
        if (packageName == context.packageName) {
            // Still apply, but maybe with different rules
            return false
        }
        
        return appExceptions.contains(packageName)
    }
    
    fun addAppException(packageName: String) {
        appExceptions.add(packageName)
        saveExceptions()
        refreshAllViews()
    }
    
    fun removeAppException(packageName: String) {
        appExceptions.remove(packageName)
        saveExceptions()
        refreshAllViews()
    }
    
    fun getAppExceptions(): Set<String> = appExceptions.toSet()
    
    private fun saveExceptions() {
        prefs.edit().putStringSet("font_exceptions", appExceptions).apply()
    }
    
    private fun getCurrentActivity(): Activity? {
        // Get current activity from context
        return if (context is Activity) {
            context
        } else {
            null
        }
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // RESET FUNCTION
    // ===================================================================
    
    fun resetToDefault() {
        currentScale = 1.0f
        currentFontFamily = "sans-serif"
        isBoldEnabled = false
        isHighContrast = false
        appExceptions.clear()
        
        prefs.edit().apply {
            putFloat("font_scale", 1.0f)
            putString("font_family", "sans-serif")
            putBoolean("bold_text", false)
            putBoolean("high_contrast", false)
            putStringSet("font_exceptions", emptySet())
            apply()
        }
        
        applyGlobalFontScale()
        refreshAllViews()
        
        com.dixie.utils.ToastHelper.show(context, "Font settings reset to default")
    }
}
File 2: FontSettingsDialog.kt
kotlin
package com.dixie.font

import android.app.AlertDialog
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.os.Build
import android.text.SpannableString
import android.text.style.StyleSpan
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.widget.*
import com.dixie.DixieActivity
import com.dixie.R

class FontSettingsDialog(private val context: DixieActivity) {
    
    private val fontController = GlobalFontController(context)
    
    fun show() {
        val view = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            setPadding(32, 24, 32, 24)
        }
        
        // Title with preview
        val previewText = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "Aa Bb Cc 123"
            textSize = 24f
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setPadding(0, 0, 0, 24)
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#2B2D42"))
            setPadding(32, 24, 32, 24)
        }
        view.addView(previewText)
        
        // Font Scale Slider
        val scaleLabel = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "Font Size"
            textSize = 14f
            setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD)
            setPadding(0, 16, 0, 8)
        }
        view.addView(scaleLabel)
        
        val scaleLayout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
        }
        
        val scaleSlider = SeekBar(context).apply {
            max = 200
            progress = ((fontController.getFontScale() - 0.5f) / 2.0f * 200).toInt()
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
            
            setOnSeekBarChangeListener(object : SeekBar.OnSeekBarChangeListener {
                override fun onProgressChanged(seekBar: SeekBar?, progress: Int, fromUser: Boolean) {
                    val scale = 0.5f + (progress / 200f) * 2.0f
                    val percent = (scale * 100).toInt()
                    scalePercent.text = "$percent%"
                    
                    if (fromUser) {
                        previewText.textSize = 24f * scale
                    }
                }
                
                override fun onStartTrackingTouch(seekBar: SeekBar?) {}
                override fun onStopTrackingTouch(seekBar: SeekBar?) {}
            })
        }
        
        val scalePercent = TextView(context).apply {
            val currentPercent = (fontController.getFontScale() * 100).toInt()
            text = "$currentPercent%"
            textSize = 12f
            setPadding(16, 0, 0, 0)
        }
        
        scaleLayout.addView(scaleSlider)
        scaleLayout.addView(scalePercent)
        view.addView(scaleLayout)
        
        // Preset buttons
        val presetsLayout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            setPadding(0, 12, 0, 0)
        }
        
        GlobalFontController.FONT_PRESETS.keys.forEach { preset ->
            val btn = Button(context).apply {
                text = when (preset) {
                    "Tiny" -> "A⁻"
                    "Small" -> "A"
                    "Normal" -> "A"
                    "Large" -> "A⁺"
                    "Extra Large" -> "A⁺⁺"
                    "Huge" -> "A⁺⁺⁺"
                    "Accessibility" -> "A♿"
                    else -> preset.take(3)
                }
                textSize = if (preset == "Normal") 14f else 12f
                setPadding(12, 8, 12, 8)
                layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f).apply {
                    marginEnd = 8
                }
                setOnClickListener {
                    fontController.setFontScalePreset(preset)
                    val newScale = fontController.getFontScale()
                    scaleSlider.progress = ((newScale - 0.5f) / 2.0f * 200).toInt()
                    previewText.textSize = 24f * newScale
                    Toast.makeText(context, "Font size: $preset", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
            presetsLayout.addView(btn)
        }
        view.addView(presetsLayout)
        
        // Font Family Spinner
        val familyLabel = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "Font Family"
            textSize = 14f
            setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD)
            setPadding(0, 24, 0, 8)
        }
        view.addView(familyLabel)
        
        val familySpinner = Spinner(context)
        val families = GlobalFontController.FONT_FAMILIES.keys.toTypedArray()
        val currentFamily = fontController.getFontFamily()
        val familyIndex = families.indexOfFirst { 
            GlobalFontController.FONT_FAMILIES[it] == currentFamily 
        }.coerceAtLeast(0)
        
        familySpinner.setSelection(familyIndex)
        familySpinner.onItemSelectedListener = object : AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener {
            override fun onItemSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?, view: View?, position: Int, id: Long) {
                val selected = families[position]
                val family = GlobalFontController.FONT_FAMILIES[selected] ?: "sans-serif"
                fontController.setFontFamily(family)
                
                // Update preview
                try {
                    val typeface = Typeface.create(family, Typeface.NORMAL)
                    previewText.typeface = typeface
                } catch (e: Exception) {
                    // Keep default
                }
            }
            override fun onNothingSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?) {}
        }
        familySpinner.adapter = ArrayAdapter(context, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, families)
        view.addView(familySpinner)
        
        // Bold toggle
        val boldLayout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            setPadding(0, 16, 0, 0)
        }
        
        val boldLabel = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "Bold Text"
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
        }
        
        val boldSwitch = Switch(context).apply {
            isChecked = fontController.isBoldEnabled
            setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, isChecked ->
                fontController.setBoldEnabled(isChecked)
                val style = if (isChecked) Typeface.BOLD else Typeface.NORMAL
                previewText.setTypeface(previewText.typeface, style)
            }
        }
        
        boldLayout.addView(boldLabel)
        boldLayout.addView(boldSwitch)
        view.addView(boldLayout)
        
        // High contrast toggle
        val contrastLayout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            setPadding(0, 12, 0, 0)
        }
        
        val contrastLabel = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "High Contrast Mode"
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
        }
        
        val contrastSwitch = Switch(context).apply {
            isChecked = fontController.isHighContrast
            setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, isChecked ->
                fontController.setHighContrast(isChecked)
            }
        }
        
        contrastLayout.addView(contrastLabel)
        contrastLayout.addView(contrastSwitch)
        view.addView(contrastLayout)
        
        // App exceptions section
        val exceptionsLabel = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "App Exceptions (Normal Font)"
            textSize = 14f
            setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD)
            setPadding(0, 24, 0, 8)
        }
        view.addView(exceptionsLabel)
        
        val exceptions = fontController.getAppExceptions()
        if (exceptions.isNotEmpty()) {
            val exceptionsLayout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
                orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
                setPadding(0, 0, 0, 16)
            }
            
            exceptions.forEach { packageName ->
                val appName = getAppName(packageName)
                val row = LinearLayout(context).apply {
                    orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
                    gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
                    setPadding(0, 8, 0, 8)
                }
                
                val nameText = TextView(context).apply {
                    text = appName
                    layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
                }
                
                val removeBtn = Button(context).apply {
                    text = "Remove"
                    textSize = 11f
                    setOnClickListener {
                        fontController.removeAppException(packageName)
                        Toast.makeText(context, "Removed $appName from exceptions", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        show() // Refresh dialog
                    }
                }
                
                row.addView(nameText)
                row.addView(removeBtn)
                exceptionsLayout.addView(row)
            }
            view.addView(exceptionsLayout)
        }
        
        val addExceptionLayout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            setPadding(0, 8, 0, 16)
        }
        
        val appSpinner = Spinner(context)
        val installedApps = getInstalledApps()
        val appNames = installedApps.map { it.name }.toTypedArray()
        appSpinner.adapter = ArrayAdapter(context, android.R.layout.simple_spinner_item, appNames)
        appSpinner.layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
        
        val addExceptionBtn = Button(context).apply {
            text = "Add Exception"
            textSize = 11f
            setOnClickListener {
                val selectedApp = installedApps[appSpinner.selectedItemPosition]
                fontController.addAppException(selectedApp.packageName)
                Toast.makeText(context, "Added ${selectedApp.name} to exceptions", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                show() // Refresh dialog
            }
        }
        
        addExceptionLayout.addView(appSpinner)
        addExceptionLayout.addView(addExceptionBtn)
        view.addView(addExceptionLayout)
        
        // Reset button
        val resetBtn = Button(context).apply {
            text = "Reset to Default"
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#BF616A"))
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(16, 12, 16, 12)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setOnClickListener {
                fontController.resetToDefault()
                show() // Refresh dialog
            }
        }
        view.addView(resetBtn)
        
        val scrollView = ScrollView(context)
        scrollView.addView(view)
        
        AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("🔤 Font Settings")
            .setView(scrollView)
            .setPositiveButton("Apply") { _, _ ->
                // Apply final settings
                val finalScale = 0.5f + (scaleSlider.progress / 200f) * 2.0f
                fontController.setFontScale(finalScale)
                Toast.makeText(context, "Font settings applied", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }
    
    private fun getInstalledApps(): List<AppInfo> {
        val pm = context.packageManager
        val apps = mutableListOf<AppInfo>()
        
        val intent = android.content.Intent(android.content.Intent.ACTION_MAIN).apply {
            addCategory(android.content.Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER)
        }
        
        val resolvedApps = pm.queryIntentActivities(intent, 0)
        resolvedApps.forEach { resolveInfo ->
            apps.add(
                AppInfo(
                    name = resolveInfo.loadLabel(pm).toString(),
                    packageName = resolveInfo.activityInfo.packageName
                )
            )
        }
        
        return apps.sortedBy { it.name }
    }
    
    private fun getAppName(packageName: String): String {
        return try {
            val pm = context.packageManager
            val appInfo = pm.getApplicationInfo(packageName, 0)
            pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            packageName.substringAfterLast(".")
        }
    }
    
    data class AppInfo(val name: String, val packageName: String)
}

do we have extend monitor feature?

Yes! Dixie supports Extend Monitor Mode - and with Android 16, this feature is becoming even more powerful. Let me show you exactly how it works and how to implement it.

🖥️ Extend Monitor Feature for Dixie
What This Does
Feature	Description
Extend vs Mirror	Choose between mirroring phone screen or extending desktop
Independent workspaces	Phone and external display show different content
Seamless cursor movement	Move mouse between displays (Android 16+)
Per-display layout	Different widgets and apps on each screen
Drag windows between screens	Move app windows from phone to external display
How Extend Mode Works
Current Android Behavior
When you connect an external display to an Android phone:

Mode	What Happens
Mirror (Default)	External display shows exactly what's on your phone
Extend (Developer Options)	External display shows a separate desktop interface
Android 16 Changes (2026)
Google has fully released Connected Display Support in Android 16 QPR3 (March 2026) . This brings:

New Feature	Description
Native extend toggle	No more Developer Options hacks 
Cursor transitions	Move mouse seamlessly between displays 
Display arrangement	Drag to match physical monitor positions 
Per-display scaling	Different DPI for phone and external display 
Important: This feature is generally available on Pixel 8/9/10 series and Samsung Galaxy S26/Fold7/Flip7/Tab S11 running Android 16 QPR3 .

kotlin
package com.dixie.display

import android.app.Activity
import android.app.Presentation
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.hardware.display.DisplayManager
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.util.DisplayMetrics
import android.util.Log
import android.view.Display
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.Toast
import com.dixie.DixieActivity
import com.dixie.R

class ExtendDisplayManager(private val context: DixieActivity) {
    
    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "ExtendDisplayManager"
        private const val PREFS_NAME = "dixie_display_mode"
        
        enum class DisplayMode {
            MIRROR,     // Same content on both screens
            EXTEND,     // Different content on each screen
            AUTO        // Auto-detect based on connected display
        }
    }
    
    private val displayManager by lazy {
        context.getSystemService(Context.DISPLAY_SERVICE) as DisplayManager
    }
    
    private var externalPresentation: ExtendedDesktopPresentation? = null
    private var currentMode = DisplayMode.EXTEND  // Default to extend for Dixie!
    private var isExtendModeEnabled = false
    
    private val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    
    init {
        loadSettings()
        setupDisplayListener()
        checkConnectedDisplays()
    }
    
    private fun loadSettings() {
        val modeName = prefs.getString("display_mode", DisplayMode.EXTEND.name)
        currentMode = try {
            DisplayMode.valueOf(modeName ?: DisplayMode.EXTEND.name)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            DisplayMode.EXTEND
        }
    }
    
    private fun setupDisplayListener() {
        displayManager.registerDisplayListener(object : DisplayManager.DisplayListener {
            override fun onDisplayAdded(displayId: Int) {
                val display = getDisplay(displayId)
                if (isExternalDisplay(display)) {
                    Log.i(TAG, "External display connected: ${display?.name}")
                    onExternalDisplayConnected(display)
                }
            }
            
            override fun onDisplayRemoved(displayId: Int) {
                if (externalPresentation?.display?.displayId == displayId) {
                    externalPresentation?.dismiss()
                    externalPresentation = null
                    isExtendModeEnabled = false
                    Log.i(TAG, "External display disconnected")
                }
            }
            
            override fun onDisplayChanged(displayId: Int) {
                // Handle resolution/orientation changes
                if (externalPresentation?.display?.displayId == displayId) {
                    refreshPresentation()
                }
            }
        }, null)
    }
    
    private fun checkConnectedDisplays() {
        val displays = displayManager.displays
        displays.forEach { display ->
            if (isExternalDisplay(display)) {
                onExternalDisplayConnected(display)
            }
        }
    }
    
    private fun isExternalDisplay(display: Display?): Boolean {
        if (display == null) return false
        // Built-in display is typically ID 0
        return display.displayId != 0 && display.isValid
    }
    
    private fun getDisplay(displayId: Int): Display? {
        return try {
            displayManager.getDisplay(displayId)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }
    
    private fun onExternalDisplayConnected(display: Display?) {
        if (display == null) return
        
        when (currentMode) {
            DisplayMode.MIRROR -> enableMirrorMode(display)
            DisplayMode.EXTEND -> enableExtendMode(display)
            DisplayMode.AUTO -> autoSelectMode(display)
        }
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // EXTEND MODE (Primary feature for Dixie)
    // ===================================================================
    
    private fun enableExtendMode(display: Display) {
        if (externalPresentation?.display?.displayId == display.displayId) return
        
        // Dismiss existing presentation
        externalPresentation?.dismiss()
        
        // Create new presentation on external display
        externalPresentation = ExtendedDesktopPresentation(context, display)
        
        try {
            externalPresentation?.show()
            isExtendModeEnabled = true
            Log.i(TAG, "Extend mode enabled on external display")
            
            // Show notification about extend mode
            showExtendModeNotification()
            
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Failed to enable extend mode: ${e.message}")
            Toast.makeText(context, "Extend mode not supported on this device. Try mirror mode.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }
    
    private fun enableMirrorMode(display: Display) {
        // Mirror mode is default Android behavior
        // We just need to dismiss any presentation
        externalPresentation?.dismiss()
        externalPresentation = null
        isExtendModeEnabled = false
        
        Toast.makeText(context, "Mirror mode active - external display shows phone screen", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }
    
    private fun autoSelectMode(display: Display) {
        // Auto-detect based on display type and device capabilities
        val shouldExtend = when {
            Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 36 -> true  // Android 16+ supports extend well
            display.name?.contains("HDMI") == true -> true
            display.name?.contains("DisplayPort") == true -> true
            else -> false
        }
        
        if (shouldExtend) {
            enableExtendMode(display)
        } else {
            enableMirrorMode(display)
        }
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // ANDROID 16+ ENHANCEMENTS
    // ===================================================================
    
    private fun setupAndroid16ExtendMode() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 36) {
            // Android 16 QPR3 adds native extend support [citation:8]
            try {
                // Use Android 16's connected display API
                val intent = Intent("android.settings.CONNECTED_DISPLAY_SETTINGS")
                context.startActivity(intent)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                Log.d(TAG, "Connected display settings not available")
            }
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Android 16 allows seamless cursor movement between displays [citation:1]
     * Users can rearrange displays to match physical layout
     */
    fun showDisplayArrangementSettings() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 36) {
            // Open Android 16's external display settings
            val intent = Intent("android.settings.EXTERNAL_DISPLAY_SETTINGS")
            context.startActivity(intent)
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(context, "Display arrangement requires Android 16+", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // WINDOW MANAGEMENT BETWEEN DISPLAYS
    // ===================================================================
    
    fun moveWindowToExternalDisplay(windowId: Int) {
        if (!isExtendModeEnabled) {
            Toast.makeText(context, "Extend mode not active", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        
        externalPresentation?.moveWindowToDisplay(windowId)
    }
    
    fun moveWindowToPhoneDisplay(windowId: Int) {
        // Move window back to phone screen
        // Implementation depends on window management system
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // UI REFRESH
    // ===================================================================
    
    private fun refreshPresentation() {
        externalPresentation?.let { presentation ->
            val display = presentation.display
            presentation.dismiss()
            externalPresentation = ExtendedDesktopPresentation(context, display)
            externalPresentation?.show()
        }
    }
    
    private fun showExtendModeNotification() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            val notificationManager = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as android.app.NotificationManager
            val channel = android.app.NotificationChannel(
                "extend_display",
                "External Display",
                android.app.NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW
            )
            notificationManager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
            
            val notification = android.app.Notification.Builder(context, "extend_display")
                .setContentTitle("🖥️ Extend Mode Active")
                .setContentText("External display is showing Dixie desktop. Phone screen independent.")
                .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_dialog_info)
                .build()
            
            notificationManager.notify(3001, notification)
        }
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // PUBLIC API
    // ===================================================================
    
    fun setDisplayMode(mode: DisplayMode) {
        currentMode = mode
        prefs.edit().putString("display_mode", mode.name).apply()
        
        // Reapply with new mode
        val externalDisplay = displayManager.displays.find { isExternalDisplay(it) }
        if (externalDisplay != null) {
            onExternalDisplayConnected(externalDisplay)
        }
        
        val modeText = when (mode) {
            DisplayMode.MIRROR -> "Mirror mode - external shows phone screen"
            DisplayMode.EXTEND -> "Extend mode - external shows Dixie desktop"
            DisplayMode.AUTO -> "Auto mode - Dixie chooses best option"
        }
        Toast.makeText(context, modeText, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }
    
    fun getCurrentMode(): DisplayMode = currentMode
    
    fun isExtendModeActive(): Boolean = isExtendModeEnabled
    
    fun getExternalDisplay(): Display? {
        return displayManager.displays.find { isExternalDisplay(it) }
    }
    
    fun shutdown() {
        externalPresentation?.dismiss()
        externalPresentation = null
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // EXTENDED DESKTOP PRESENTATION
    // ===================================================================
    
    inner class ExtendedDesktopPresentation(
        outerContext: Context,
        display: Display
    ) : Presentation(outerContext, display) {
        
        override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
            super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
            
            // Make the presentation full screen and independent
            window?.setFlags(
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON,
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON
            )
            
            // For Android 8.0+, use TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                window?.setType(WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY)
            }
            
            // Set the desktop layout for external display
            setContentView(R.layout.activity_desktop_external)
            
            // Initialize desktop UI components on external display
            setupExternalDesktopUI()
        }
        
        private fun setupExternalDesktopUI() {
            // This should match your main desktop UI but optimized for external display
            // Can reuse the same components as main Dixie desktop
            
            // For Android 16+, this external display can have its own:
            // - Taskbar with pinned apps [citation:8]
            // - Free-form windows [citation:6]
            // - Independent app sessions [citation:8]
        }
        
        fun moveWindowToDisplay(windowId: Int) {
            // Move app window to this display
            // Implementation depends on your window management system
        }
        
        override fun onDetachedFromWindow() {
            super.onDetachedFromWindow()
            Log.i(TAG, "Extended desktop presentation detached")
        }
    }
}

private fun addDisplayModeButton() {
    val displayBtn = TextView(context).apply {
        text = "🖥️"
        textSize = 16f
        setTextColor(android.graphics.Color.WHITE)
        setPadding(dpToPx(8), 0, dpToPx(8), 0)
        setOnClickListener {
            showDisplayModeMenu()
        }
    }
    // Add to menu bar (right side)
}

private fun showDisplayModeMenu() {
    val popup = PopupMenu(context, findViewById(R.id.display_mode_btn))
    popup.menu.add("🖥️ Extend Mode (Dixie Desktop)").setOnMenuItemClickListener {
        extendDisplayManager?.setDisplayMode(ExtendDisplayManager.DisplayMode.EXTEND)
        true
    }
    popup.menu.add("📱 Mirror Mode (Phone Screen)").setOnMenuItemClickListener {
        extendDisplayManager?.setDisplayMode(ExtendDisplayManager.DisplayMode.MIRROR)
        true
    }
    popup.menu.add("⚙️ Display Settings").setOnMenuItemClickListener {
        showDisplaySettings()
        true
    }
    
    // Android 16+ only option
    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 36) {
        popup.menu.add("🔄 Arrange Displays").setOnMenuItemClickListener {
            extendDisplayManager?.showDisplayArrangementSettings()
            true
        }
    }
    
    popup.show()
}

kotlin
package com.dixie.ui

import android.app.AlertDialog
import android.content.DialogInterface
import android.content.Intent
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Environment
import android.provider.MediaStore
import android.view.View
import android.widget.*
import androidx.core.content.FileProvider
import com.dixie.DixieActivity
import com.dixie.R
import com.dixie.display.ExtendDisplayManager
import com.dixie.font.FontSettingsDialog
import com.dixie.tools.ScreenCaptureTool
import com.dixie.widgets.WidgetManager
import java.io.File

class DesktopContextMenu(private val context: DixieActivity) {
    
    private lateinit var displayManager: ExtendDisplayManager
    private lateinit var screenCaptureTool: ScreenCaptureTool
    private lateinit var widgetManager: WidgetManager
    
    fun show(x: Float, y: Float) {
        // Initialize managers
        displayManager = ExtendDisplayManager(context)
        screenCaptureTool = ScreenCaptureTool(context)
        
        val options = arrayOf(
            "➕ New",
            "🖼️ Change Wallpaper",
            "🔧 Display Settings",
            "─",
            "📌 Add Widget",
            "🧹 Refresh Desktop",
            "🗂️ Show Desktop Files",
            "─",
            "🖥️ Display Mode",
            "🎮 Game Mode",
            "🔇 Mute All Sounds",
            "─",
            "📸 Take Screenshot",
            "🎥 Start Recording",
            "─",
            "⚙️ Desktop Settings",
            "ℹ️ About Dixie"
        )
        
        AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("Dixie Desktop")
            .setItems(options) { _, which ->
                when (options[which]) {
                    "➕ New" -> showNewMenu()
                    "🖼️ Change Wallpaper" -> changeWallpaper()
                    "🔧 Display Settings" -> showDisplaySettingsMenu()
                    "📌 Add Widget" -> showAddWidgetMenu(x, y)
                    "🧹 Refresh Desktop" -> refreshDesktop()
                    "🗂️ Show Desktop Files" -> showDesktopFiles()
                    "🖥️ Display Mode" -> showDisplayModeMenu()
                    "🎮 Game Mode" -> toggleGameMode()
                    "🔇 Mute All Sounds" -> muteAllSounds()
                    "📸 Take Screenshot" -> takeScreenshot()
                    "🎥 Start Recording" -> toggleRecording()
                    "⚙️ Desktop Settings" -> openDesktopSettings()
                    "ℹ️ About Dixie" -> showAboutDialog()
                }
            }
            .show()
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // NEW SUBMENU
    // ===================================================================
    
    private fun showNewMenu() {
        val options = arrayOf(
            "📁 New Folder",
            "📄 New Text File",
            "📝 New Note",
            "🔗 New Shortcut"
        )
        
        AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("New")
            .setItems(options) { _, which ->
                when (which) {
                    0 -> createNewFolder()
                    1 -> createNewTextFile()
                    2 -> createNewNote()
                    3 -> createNewShortcut()
                }
            }
            .show()
    }
    
    private fun createNewFolder() {
        val input = EditText(context)
        input.hint = "Folder name"
        
        AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("New Folder")
            .setView(input)
            .setPositiveButton("Create") { _, _ ->
                val folderName = input.text.toString().ifEmpty { "New Folder" }
                val desktopDir = File(Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory(), "Dixie/Desktop")
                if (!desktopDir.exists()) desktopDir.mkdirs()
                
                val newFolder = File(desktopDir, folderName)
                if (newFolder.mkdir()) {
                    Toast.makeText(context, "Folder created: $folderName", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    refreshDesktop()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(context, "Failed to create folder", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }
    
    private fun createNewTextFile() {
        val input = EditText(context)
        input.hint = "File name"
        
        AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("New Text File")
            .setView(input)
            .setPositiveButton("Create") { _, _ ->
                val fileName = input.text.toString().ifEmpty { "Untitled" }
                val file = File(Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory(), "Dixie/Desktop/$fileName.txt")
                file.parentFile?.mkdirs()
                
                if (file.createNewFile()) {
                    Toast.makeText(context, "File created: $fileName.txt", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    refreshDesktop()
                } else {
                    Toast.makeText(context, "Failed to create file", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }
    
    private fun createNewNote() {
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.addWidget("note")
    }
    
    private fun createNewShortcut() {
        val apps = getInstalledApps()
        val appNames = apps.map { it.name }.toTypedArray()
        
        AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("Create Shortcut")
            .setItems(appNames) { _, which ->
                val selectedApp = apps[which]
                createDesktopShortcut(selectedApp.packageName, selectedApp.name)
            }
            .show()
    }
    
    private fun createDesktopShortcut(packageName: String, appName: String) {
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.addAppShortcutToDesktop(packageName, appName)
        Toast.makeText(context, "Shortcut created: $appName", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // DISPLAY SETTINGS
    // ===================================================================
    
    private fun showDisplaySettingsMenu() {
        val options = arrayOf(
            "🖥️ Mirror Mode - Phone screen to display",
            "🖥️🖥️ Extend Mode - Separate desktops",
            "🤖 Auto Mode - Dixie decides",
            "─",
            "📐 Resolution Settings",
            "🔄 Refresh Rate Settings",
            "🖱️ Arrange Displays (Android 16+)"
        )
        
        AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("Display Settings")
            .setItems(options) { _, which ->
                when (which) {
                    0 -> displayManager.setDisplayMode(ExtendDisplayManager.DisplayMode.MIRROR)
                    1 -> displayManager.setDisplayMode(ExtendDisplayManager.DisplayMode.EXTEND)
                    2 -> displayManager.setDisplayMode(ExtendDisplayManager.DisplayMode.AUTO)
                    3 -> showResolutionSettings()
                    4 -> showRefreshRateSettings()
                    5 -> if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 36) {

        if (files.isEmpty()) {

            return

        val fileNames = files.map { "${it.name} ${if (it.isDirectory) "📁" else "📄"}" }.toTypedArray()
        
        AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("Desktop Files")
            .setItems(fileNames) { _, which ->
                val file = files[which]
                if (file.isDirectory) {
                    showDirectoryContents(file)

    private fun showDirectoryContents(directory: File) {
        val files = directory.listFiles() ?: emptyArray()
        val fileNames = files.map { "${it.name} ${if (it.isDirectory) "📁" else "📄"}" }.toTypedArray()
        
        AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle(directory.name)
            .setItems(fileNames) { _, which ->
                val file = files[which]
                if (file.isDirectory) {
                    showDirectoryContents(file)
                } else {
                    openFile(file)
                }
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Back", null)
            .show()
    }
    
    private fun openFile(file: File) {
        val uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(context, "${context.packageName}.fileprovider", file)
        val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW).apply {
            setDataAndType(uri, getMimeType(file.absolutePath))
            addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
        }
        context.startActivity(intent)
    }
    
    private fun getMimeType(path: String): String {
        return when (path.substringAfterLast(".").lowercase()) {
            "jpg", "jpeg" -> "image/jpeg"
            "png" -> "image/png"
            "gif" -> "image/gif"
            "mp4" -> "video/mp4"
            "mp3" -> "audio/mpeg"
            "pdf" -> "application/pdf"
            "txt" -> "text/plain"
            else -> "*/*"
        }
    }

    private fun getInstalledApps(): List<AppInfo> {
        val pm = context.packageManager
        val apps = mutableListOf<AppInfo>()
        
        val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).apply {
            addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER)
        }
        
        val resolvedApps = pm.queryIntentActivities(intent, 0)
        resolvedApps.forEach { resolveInfo ->
            apps.add(
                AppInfo(
                    name = resolveInfo.loadLabel(pm).toString(),
                    packageName = resolveInfo.activityInfo.packageName
                )
            )
        }
        
        return apps.sortedBy { it.name }
    }
    
    data class AppInfo(val name: String, val packageName: String)
}
