kotlin
package com.dixie.windows

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Rect
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import com.dixie.DixieActivity
import com.dixie.ui.FloatingAppWindow

class TilingWindowManager(private val context: DixieActivity) {
    
    companion object {
        private const val PREFS_NAME = "dixie_tiling"
        private const val SNAP_DELAY = 200L
        
        enum class TilingLayout {
            TWO_BY_TWO,      // 2x2 grid (4 windows)
            THREE_BY_THREE,  // 3x3 grid (9 windows, max 8)
            FOUR_BY_TWO,     // 4x2 grid (8 windows)
            TWO_BY_FOUR,     // 2x4 grid (8 windows)
            FOUR_BY_FOUR,    // 4x4 grid (16 windows, max 8 visible)
            CUSTOM           // User-defined rows/columns
        }
        
        data class TileInfo(
            val row: Int,
            val col: Int,
            val x: Int,
            val y: Int,
            val width: Int,
            val height: Int
        )
    }
    
    private var currentLayout = TilingLayout.FOUR_BY_TWO  // 8 windows default
    private var customRows = 4
    private var customCols = 2
    private var isTilingMode = false
    private var tiledWindows = mutableMapOf<String, TileInfo>()
    private var dividerSize = 8  // pixels between windows
    
    private val snapHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private var pendingSnapWindow: FloatingAppWindow? = null
    private var pendingSnapPosition: String? = null
    
    private val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    
    init {
        loadSettings()
        setupSnapDetection()
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // TILING LAYOUTS
    // ===================================================================
    
    fun applyTilingLayout(layout: TilingLayout, windows: List<FloatingAppWindow>) {
        currentLayout = layout
        saveSettings()
        
        val tiles = calculateTiles(windows.size)
        
        windows.forEachIndexed { index, window ->
            if (index < tiles.size) {
                val tile = tiles[index]
                window.setBounds(tile.x, tile.y, tile.width, tile.height)
                tiledWindows[window.getWindowId()] = tile
            }
        }
        
        context.showToast("Applied ${getLayoutName(layout)} layout")
    }
    
    fun applyCustomTiling(rows: Int, cols: Int, windows: List<FloatingAppWindow>) {
        customRows = rows.coerceIn(1, 8)
        customCols = cols.coerceIn(1, 8)
        currentLayout = TilingLayout.CUSTOM
        saveSettings()
        
        val maxWindows = rows * cols
        val windowsToTile = windows.take(maxWindows)
        val tileWidth = (getScreenWidth() / cols) - dividerSize
        val tileHeight = (getScreenHeight() / rows) - dividerSize
        
        windowsToTile.forEachIndexed { index, window ->
            val row = index / cols
            val col = index % cols
            val x = col * (tileWidth + dividerSize)
            val y = row * (tileHeight + dividerSize)
            
            window.setBounds(x, y, tileWidth, tileHeight)
            tiledWindows[window.getWindowId()] = TileInfo(row, col, x, y, tileWidth, tileHeight)
        }
    }
    
    private fun calculateTiles(windowCount: Int): List<TileInfo> {
        return when (currentLayout) {
            TilingLayout.TWO_BY_TWO -> calculateTwoByTwo(windowCount)
            TilingLayout.THREE_BY_THREE -> calculateThreeByThree(windowCount)
            TilingLayout.FOUR_BY_TWO -> calculateFourByTwo(windowCount)
            TilingLayout.TWO_BY_FOUR -> calculateTwoByFour(windowCount)
            TilingLayout.FOUR_BY_FOUR -> calculateFourByFour(windowCount)
            TilingLayout.CUSTOM -> calculateCustomTiles(windowCount)
        }
    }
    
    private fun calculateTwoByTwo(windowCount: Int): List<TileInfo> {
        val tiles = mutableListOf<TileInfo>()
        val rows = 2
        val cols = 2
        val tileWidth = getScreenWidth() / cols
        val tileHeight = getScreenHeight() / rows
        
        for (row in 0 until rows) {
            for (col in 0 until cols) {
                val index = row * cols + col
                if (index < windowCount) {
                    tiles.add(TileInfo(
                        row = row,
                        col = col,
                        x = col * tileWidth,
                        y = row * tileHeight,
                        width = tileWidth,
                        height = tileHeight
                    ))
                }
            }
        }
        return tiles
    }
    
    private fun calculateFourByTwo(windowCount: Int): List<TileInfo> {
        val tiles = mutableListOf<TileInfo>()
        val rows = 4
        val cols = 2
        val tileWidth = getScreenWidth() / cols
        val tileHeight = getScreenHeight() / rows
        
        for (row in 0 until rows) {
            for (col in 0 until cols) {
                val index = row * cols + col
                if (index < windowCount) {
                    tiles.add(TileInfo(
                        row = row,
                        col = col,
                        x = col * tileWidth,
                        y = row * tileHeight,
                        width = tileWidth,
                        height = tileHeight
                    ))
                }
            }
        }
        return tiles
    }
    
    private fun calculateTwoByFour(windowCount: Int): List<TileInfo> {
        val tiles = mutableListOf<TileInfo>()
        val rows = 2
        val cols = 4
        val tileWidth = getScreenWidth() / cols
        val tileHeight = getScreenHeight() / rows
        
        for (row in 0 until rows) {
            for (col in 0 until cols) {
                val index = row * cols + col
                if (index < windowCount) {
                    tiles.add(TileInfo(
                        row = row,
                        col = col,
                        x = col * tileWidth,
                        y = row * tileHeight,
                        width = tileWidth,
                        height = tileHeight
                    ))
                }
            }
        }
        return tiles
    }
    
    private fun calculateThreeByThree(windowCount: Int): List<TileInfo> {
        val tiles = mutableListOf<TileInfo>()
        val rows = 3
        val cols = 3
        val tileWidth = getScreenWidth() / cols
        val tileHeight = getScreenHeight() / rows
        
        for (row in 0 until rows) {
            for (col in 0 until cols) {
                val index = row * cols + col
                if (index < windowCount) {
                    tiles.add(TileInfo(
                        row = row,
                        col = col,
                        x = col * tileWidth,
                        y = row * tileHeight,
                        width = tileWidth,
                        height = tileHeight
                    ))
                }
            }
        }
        return tiles
    }
    
    private fun calculateFourByFour(windowCount: Int): List<TileInfo> {
        val tiles = mutableListOf<TileInfo>()
        val rows = 4
        val cols = 4
        val tileWidth = getScreenWidth() / cols
        val tileHeight = getScreenHeight() / rows
        
        for (row in 0 until rows) {
            for (col in 0 until cols) {
                val index = row * cols + col
                if (index < windowCount) {
                    tiles.add(TileInfo(
                        row = row,
                        col = col,
                        x = col * tileWidth,
                        y = row * tileHeight,
                        width = tileWidth,
                        height = tileHeight
                    ))
                }
            }
        }
        return tiles
    }
    
    private fun calculateCustomTiles(windowCount: Int): List<TileInfo> {
        val tiles = mutableListOf<TileInfo>()
        val tileWidth = (getScreenWidth() / customCols) - dividerSize
        val tileHeight = (getScreenHeight() / customRows) - dividerSize
        val maxWindows = customRows * customCols
        val windowsToTile = minOf(windowCount, maxWindows)
        
        for (i in 0 until windowsToTile) {
            val row = i / customCols
            val col = i % customCols
            val x = col * (tileWidth + dividerSize)
            val y = row * (tileHeight + dividerSize)
            
            tiles.add(TileInfo(
                row = row,
                col = col,
                x = x,
                y = y,
                width = tileWidth,
                height = tileHeight
            ))
        }
        return tiles
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // DRAG TO TILE (Smart snapping)
    // ===================================================================
    
    private fun setupSnapDetection() {
        // This will be called when a window is being dragged
        // If user drags to edge, show preview and snap on release
    }
    
    fun onWindowDrag(window: FloatingAppWindow, x: Int, y: Int, width: Int, height: Int) {
        val snapZone = detectSnapZone(x, y, width, height)
        
        if (snapZone != null) {
            pendingSnapWindow = window
            pendingSnapPosition = snapZone
            showSnapPreview(snapZone)
        } else {
            pendingSnapWindow = null
            pendingSnapPosition = null
            hideSnapPreview()
        }
    }
    
    fun onWindowDragEnd(window: FloatingAppWindow) {
        if (pendingSnapWindow == window && pendingSnapPosition != null) {
            snapWindowToPosition(window, pendingSnapPosition!!)
        }
        pendingSnapWindow = null
        pendingSnapPosition = null
        hideSnapPreview()
    }
    
    private fun detectSnapZone(x: Int, y: Int, width: Int, height: Int): String? {
        val screenWidth = getScreenWidth()
        val screenHeight = getScreenHeight()
        val threshold = 100
        
        return when {
            // Corners (quarter screen)
            x < threshold && y < threshold -> "top_left"
            x > screenWidth - width - threshold && y < threshold -> "top_right"
            x < threshold && y > screenHeight - height - threshold -> "bottom_left"
            x > screenWidth - width - threshold && y > screenHeight - height - threshold -> "bottom_right"
            
            // Edges (half screen)
            x < threshold -> "left"
            x > screenWidth - width - threshold -> "right"
            y < threshold -> "top"
            y > screenHeight - height - threshold -> "bottom"
            
            else -> null
        }
    }
    
    private fun snapWindowToPosition(window: FloatingAppWindow, position: String) {
        val screenWidth = getScreenWidth()
        val screenHeight = getScreenHeight()
        
        when (position) {
            "top_left" -> window.setBounds(0, 0, screenWidth / 2, screenHeight / 2)
            "top_right" -> window.setBounds(screenWidth / 2, 0, screenWidth / 2, screenHeight / 2)
            "bottom_left" -> window.setBounds(0, screenHeight / 2, screenWidth / 2, screenHeight / 2)
            "bottom_right" -> window.setBounds(screenWidth / 2, screenHeight / 2, screenWidth / 2, screenHeight / 2)
            "left" -> window.setBounds(0, 0, screenWidth / 2, screenHeight)
            "right" -> window.setBounds(screenWidth / 2, 0, screenWidth / 2, screenHeight)
            "top" -> window.setBounds(0, 0, screenWidth, screenHeight / 2)
            "bottom" -> window.setBounds(0, screenHeight / 2, screenWidth, screenHeight / 2)
        }
    }
    
    private fun showSnapPreview(zone: String) {
        // Show visual preview of where window will snap
        context.sendBroadcast(android.content.Intent("com.dixie.SHOW_SNAP_PREVIEW").apply {
            putExtra("zone", zone)
        })
    }
    
    private fun hideSnapPreview() {
        context.sendBroadcast(android.content.Intent("com.dixie.HIDE_SNAP_PREVIEW"))
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // WINDOW MANAGEMENT
    // ===================================================================
    
    fun tileAllWindows(windows: List<FloatingAppWindow>) {
        if (windows.isEmpty()) return
        
        when (currentLayout) {
            TilingLayout.TWO_BY_TWO -> {
                val toTile = windows.take(4)
                val tiles = calculateTwoByTwo(toTile.size)
                toTile.forEachIndexed { i, window ->
                    tiles.getOrNull(i)?.let { tile ->
                        window.setBounds(tile.x, tile.y, tile.width, tile.height)
                    }
                }
                context.showToast("Tiled ${toTile.size} windows in 2x2 grid")
            }
            TilingLayout.FOUR_BY_TWO -> {
                val toTile = windows.take(8)
                val tiles = calculateFourByTwo(toTile.size)
                toTile.forEachIndexed { i, window ->
                    tiles.getOrNull(i)?.let { tile ->
                        window.setBounds(tile.x, tile.y, tile.width, tile.height)
                    }
                }
                context.showToast("Tiled ${toTile.size} windows in 4x2 grid")
            }
            TilingLayout.TWO_BY_FOUR -> {
                val toTile = windows.take(8)
                val tiles = calculateTwoByFour(toTile.size)
                toTile.forEachIndexed { i, window ->
                    tiles.getOrNull(i)?.let { tile ->
                        window.setBounds(tile.x, tile.y, tile.width, tile.height)
                    }
                }
                context.showToast("Tiled ${toTile.size} windows in 2x4 grid")
            }
            TilingLayout.THREE_BY_THREE -> {
                val toTile = windows.take(9)
                val tiles = calculateThreeByThree(toTile.size)
                toTile.forEachIndexed { i, window ->
                    tiles.getOrNull(i)?.let { tile ->
                        window.setBounds(tile.x, tile.y, tile.width, tile.height)
                    }
                }
                context.showToast("Tiled ${toTile.size} windows in 3x3 grid")
            }
            else -> {
                // Custom or other layouts
                val toTile = windows.take(customRows * customCols)
                applyCustomTiling(customRows, customCols, toTile)
            }
        }
    }
    
    fun untileAllWindows(windows: List<FloatingAppWindow>) {
        windows.forEach { window ->
            // Restore to previous positions or default cascade
            val defaultX = 100 + (windows.indexOf(window) * 30)
            val defaultY = 100 + (windows.indexOf(window) * 30)
            window.setBounds(defaultX, defaultY, 600, 400)
        }
        tiledWindows.clear()
        context.showToast("Windows untiled")
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // QUICK TILE KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS
    // ===================================================================
    
    fun quickTileLeft(window: FloatingAppWindow) {
        val screenWidth = getScreenWidth()
        window.setBounds(0, 0, screenWidth / 2, getScreenHeight())
    }
    
    fun quickTileRight(window: FloatingAppWindow) {
        val screenWidth = getScreenWidth()
        window.setBounds(screenWidth / 2, 0, screenWidth / 2, getScreenHeight())
    }
    
    fun quickTileTop(window: FloatingAppWindow) {
        window.setBounds(0, 0, getScreenWidth(), getScreenHeight() / 2)
    }
    
    fun quickTileBottom(window: FloatingAppWindow) {
        window.setBounds(0, getScreenHeight() / 2, getScreenWidth(), getScreenHeight() / 2)
    }
    
    fun quickTileCornerTopLeft(window: FloatingAppWindow) {
        window.setBounds(0, 0, getScreenWidth() / 2, getScreenHeight() / 2)
    }
    
    fun quickTileCornerTopRight(window: FloatingAppWindow) {
        window.setBounds(getScreenWidth() / 2, 0, getScreenWidth() / 2, getScreenHeight() / 2)
    }
    
    fun quickTileCornerBottomLeft(window: FloatingAppWindow) {
        window.setBounds(0, getScreenHeight() / 2, getScreenWidth() / 2, getScreenHeight() / 2)
    }
    
    fun quickTileCornerBottomRight(window: FloatingAppWindow) {
        window.setBounds(getScreenWidth() / 2, getScreenHeight() / 2, getScreenWidth() / 2, getScreenHeight() / 2)
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // TILING MENU
    // ===================================================================
    
    fun showTilingMenu(windows: List<FloatingAppWindow>) {
        val options = mutableListOf<String>()
        
        options.add("📐 Tile Windows")
        options.add("├─ 2x2 Grid (4 windows)")
        options.add("├─ 4x2 Grid (8 windows)")
        options.add("├─ 2x4 Grid (8 windows)")
        options.add("├─ 3x3 Grid (9 windows)")
        options.add("├─ 4x4 Grid (16 windows)")
        options.add("├─ Custom Grid...")
        options.add("")
        options.add("🪟 Quick Tile Current Window")
        options.add("├─ ⊞ Win + ← → Snap Left/Right")
        options.add("├─ ⊞ Win + ↑ ↓ Snap Top/Bottom")
        options.add("├─ ⊞ Win + Shift + ← → Corner Snaps")
        options.add("")
        options.add("🚫 Untile All Windows")
        
        android.app.AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("🪟 Window Tiling")
            .setItems(options.toTypedArray()) { _, which ->
                when (which) {
                    1 -> tileAllWindows(windows.take(4))
                    2 -> tileAllWindows(windows.take(8))
                    3 -> tileAllWindows(windows.take(8))
                    4 -> tileAllWindows(windows.take(9))
                    5 -> tileAllWindows(windows.take(16))
                    6 -> showCustomGridDialog(windows)
                    11 -> untileAllWindows(windows)
                }
            }
            .show()
    }
    
    private fun showCustomGridDialog(windows: List<FloatingAppWindow>) {
        val layout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            setPadding(32, 24, 32, 24)
        }
        
        val rowsLayout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
        }
        rowsLayout.addView(TextView(context).apply { text = "Rows: "; layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 0.3f) })
        val rowsInput = EditText(context).apply {
            hint = "1-8"
            inputType = android.text.InputType.TYPE_CLASS_NUMBER
            setText("4")
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 0.7f)
        }
        rowsLayout.addView(rowsInput)
        layout.addView(rowsLayout)
        
        val colsLayout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            setPadding(0, 16, 0, 0)
        }
        colsLayout.addView(TextView(context).apply { text = "Cols: "; layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 0.3f) })
        val colsInput = EditText(context).apply {
            hint = "1-8"
            inputType = android.text.InputType.TYPE_CLASS_NUMBER
            setText("2")
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 0.7f)
        }
        colsLayout.addView(colsInput)
        layout.addView(colsLayout)
        
        android.app.AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("Custom Grid Size")
            .setView(layout)
            .setPositiveButton("Apply") { _, _ ->
                val rows = rowsInput.text.toString().toIntOrNull()?.coerceIn(1, 8) ?: 4
                val cols = colsInput.text.toString().toIntOrNull()?.coerceIn(1, 8) ?: 2
                applyCustomTiling(rows, cols, windows)
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }
    
    // ===================================================================
    // UTILITIES
    // ===================================================================
    
    private fun getScreenWidth(): Int = context.resources.displayMetrics.widthPixels
    
    private fun getScreenHeight(): Int = context.resources.displayMetrics.heightPixels
    
    private fun getLayoutName(layout: TilingLayout): String {
        return when (layout) {
            TilingLayout.TWO_BY_TWO -> "2x2 Grid"
            TilingLayout.THREE_BY_THREE -> "3x3 Grid"
            TilingLayout.FOUR_BY_TWO -> "4x2 Grid"
            TilingLayout.TWO_BY_FOUR -> "2x4 Grid"
            TilingLayout.FOUR_BY_FOUR -> "4x4 Grid"
            TilingLayout.CUSTOM -> "Custom Grid"
        }
    }
    
    private fun loadSettings() {
        val layoutName = prefs.getString("tiling_layout", TilingLayout.FOUR_BY_TWO.name)
        currentLayout = try {
            TilingLayout.valueOf(layoutName ?: TilingLayout.FOUR_BY_TWO.name)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            TilingLayout.FOUR_BY_TWO
        }
        customRows = prefs.getInt("custom_rows", 4)
        customCols = prefs.getInt("custom_cols", 2)
        dividerSize = prefs.getInt("divider_size", 8)
    }
    
    private fun saveSettings() {
        prefs.edit().apply {
            putString("tiling_layout", currentLayout.name)
            putInt("custom_rows", customRows)
            putInt("custom_cols", customCols)
            putInt("divider_size", dividerSize)
            apply()
        }
    }
    
    fun setDividerSize(size: Int) {
        dividerSize = size.coerceIn(2, 20)
        saveSettings()
    }
}

📝 PART 2: How to Create Folders and Files on Windows (Detailed Guide)
Step 2.1: Create the Main Project Folder
text
1. Open File Explorer (Windows + E)
2. Navigate to C:\
3. Right-click in empty space → New → Folder
4. Name it: DiXie
5. Press Enter
Step 2.2: Create Subfolders (Method 1 - Using File Explorer)
text
Inside C:\DiXie\, create these folders:

1. Open C:\DiXie
2. Right-click → New → Folder → name: app
3. Inside app → New → Folder → name: src
4. Inside src → New → Folder → name: main
5. Inside main → New → Folder → name: java
6. Inside main → New → Folder → name: res

Then create the java package structure:
1. Inside java → New → Folder → name: com
2. Inside com → New → Folder → name: dixi
3. Inside dixi → New → Folder → name: launcher
4. Inside launcher → New → Folder → name: widgets

Then create res subfolders:
1. Inside res → New → Folder → name: layout
2. Inside res → New → Folder → name: drawable
3. Inside res → New → Folder → name: values
4. Inside res → New → Folder → name: xml
5. Inside res → New → Folder → name: raw
Step 2.3: Create Files (Method 1 - Using Notepad)
text
For EACH file:

1. Open Notepad (Windows + R → type "notepad" → Enter)
2. Copy the code I'll provide below
3. Paste into Notepad
4. File → Save As
5. Navigate to the correct folder
6. Change "Save as type" to "All Files (*.*)"
7. Type the EXACT filename (including .kt or .xml extension)
8. Click Save

IMPORTANT: Always use "All Files (*.*)" or Notepad will add .txt to the end!

File 3.3: App Level build.gradle
Location: C:\DiXie\app\build.gradle

groovy
plugins {
    id 'com.android.application'
    id 'org.jetbrains.kotlin.android'
}

android {
    namespace 'com.dixi.launcher'
    compileSdk 34

    defaultConfig {
        applicationId "com.dixi.launcher"
        minSdk 26
        targetSdk 34
        versionCode 1
        versionName "1.0"

        testInstrumentationRunner "androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner"
    }

    buildTypes {
        release {
            minifyEnabled false
            proguardFiles getDefaultProguardFile('proguard-android-optimize.txt'), 'proguard-rules.pro'
        }
    }
    
    compileOptions {
        sourceCompatibility JavaVersion.VERSION_1_8
        targetCompatibility JavaVersion.VERSION_1_8
    }
    
    kotlinOptions {
        jvmTarget = '1.8'
    }
    
    buildFeatures {
        viewBinding true
    }
}

dependencies {
    implementation 'androidx.core:core-ktx:1.12.0'
    implementation 'androidx.appcompat:appcompat:1.6.1'
    implementation 'com.google.android.material:material:1.11.0'
    implementation 'androidx.constraintlayout:constraintlayout:2.1.4'
    implementation 'androidx.recyclerview:recyclerview:1.3.2'
    implementation 'androidx.cardview:cardview:1.0.0'
    
    // Coroutines
    implementation 'org.jetbrains.kotlinx:kotlinx-coroutines-android:1.7.3'
    
    // Gson for JSON parsing
    implementation 'com.google.code.gson:gson:2.10.1'
    
    // OkHttp for networking
    implementation 'com.squareup.okhttp3:okhttp:4.12.0'
    
    // Glide for images
    implementation 'com.github.bumptech.glide:glide:4.16.0'
    
    // Media3 for video wallpaper
    implementation 'androidx.media3:media3-exoplayer:1.2.0'
    implementation 'androidx.media3:media3-ui:1.2.0'
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat

class DixieActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    
    companion object {
        private const val PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE = 1001
    }
    
    private lateinit var rootView: android.widget.FrameLayout
    
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        
        // Full screen immersive
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS
        )
        
        rootView = android.widget.FrameLayout(this).apply {
            setBackgroundColor(android.graphics.Color.parseColor("#1A1A2E"))
        }
        setContentView(rootView)
        
        checkPermissions()
        setupWelcomeMessage()
    }
    
    private fun checkPermissions() {
        val permissions = mutableListOf<String>()
        
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
            if (!Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
                permissions.add(android.Manifest.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW)
            }
        }
        
        if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            permissions.add(android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
        }
        
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
            if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, android.Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
                != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                permissions.add(android.Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
            }
        }
        
        if (permissions.isNotEmpty()) {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, permissions.toTypedArray(), PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE)
        } else {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }
    
    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(
        requestCode: Int,
        permissions: Array<out String>,
        grantResults: IntArray
    ) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE) {
            if (grantResults.all { it == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED }) {
                onPermissionsGranted()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Some permissions denied. DiXie may not work properly.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                onPermissionsGranted() // Continue anyway
            }
        }
    }
    
    private fun onPermissionsGranted() {
        showWelcomeMessage()
        initializeDesktop()
    }
    
    private fun setupWelcomeMessage() {
        val welcomeText = android.widget.TextView(this).apply {
            text = "◇ DiXie ◇\nDesktop + X factor + Friendly\n\n\"DeX + Bixby. One app.\""
            textSize = 24f
            setTextColor(android.graphics.Color.parseColor("#FF6B35"))
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER
            layoutParams = android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
            )
        }
        rootView.addView(welcomeText)
    }
    
    private fun showWelcomeMessage() {
        Toast.makeText(this, "✨ Welcome to DiXie! ✨", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed({
            Toast.makeText(this, "Desktop mode + Voice commands for ANY Android phone", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }, 2000)
    }
    
    private fun initializeDesktop() {
        // Desktop initialization will go here
        // This is where we'll add all the UI components
    }
}

package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import com.dixi.launcher.display.ExtendDisplayManager
import com.dixi.launcher.font.GlobalFontController
import com.dixi.launcher.theme.ThemeManager
import com.dixi.launcher.voice.VoiceCommandService
import com.dixi.launcher.voice.VoiceTriggerManager
import com.dixi.launcher.widgets.WidgetManager
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class DixieActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    companion object {
        private const val PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE = 1001
        private const val TAG = "DixieActivity"
    }

    // Core components
    private lateinit var rootContainer: android.widget.FrameLayout
    private lateinit var freeCanvas: FreeCanvasView
    private lateinit var dock: MacOSDock
    private lateinit var menuBar: MenuBarView
    private lateinit var workspaceManager: WorkspaceManager
    private lateinit var gestureOverlay: GestureOverlayView
    private lateinit var widgetManager: WidgetManager
    private lateinit var themeManager: ThemeManager
    private lateinit var fontController: GlobalFontController
    private lateinit var voiceCommandService: VoiceCommandService
    private lateinit var voiceTriggerManager: VoiceTriggerManager
    private lateinit var extendDisplayManager: ExtendDisplayManager
    private lateinit var windowManager: com.dixi.launcher.windows.FloatingWindowManager

    // State
    private var isDesktopInitialized = false
    private var isVoiceEnabled = false

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)

        // Full screen immersive mode
        enableImmersiveMode()

        // Initialize root container
        rootContainer = android.widget.FrameLayout(this).apply {
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#1A1A2E"))
            layoutParams = android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
            )
        }
        setContentView(rootContainer)

        // Initialize managers
        initializeManagers()

        // Check and request permissions
        checkPermissions()

        // Show splash/welcome
        showWelcomeSequence()

        // Setup display detection
        setupDisplayDetection()
    }

    private fun enableImmersiveMode() {
        window.decorView.systemUiVisibility = (
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE or
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN or
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_FULLSCREEN or
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
        )
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS
        )
    }

    private fun initializeManagers() {
        themeManager = ThemeManager(this)
        fontController = GlobalFontController(this)
        widgetManager = WidgetManager(this)
        workspaceManager = WorkspaceManager(this, rootContainer)
        extendDisplayManager = ExtendDisplayManager(this)
        windowManager = com.dixi.launcher.windows.FloatingWindowManager(this)
    }

    private fun checkPermissions() {
        val permissionsNeeded = mutableListOf<String>()

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
            if (!Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
                permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW)
            }
        }

        if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
        }

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
            if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, android.Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
                != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
            }
        }

        if (permissionsNeeded.isNotEmpty()) {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, permissionsNeeded.toTypedArray(), PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE)
        } else {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(
        requestCode: Int,
        permissions: Array<out String>,
        grantResults: IntArray
    ) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE) {
            if (grantResults.isNotEmpty() && grantResults.all { it == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED }) {
                onPermissionsGranted()
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Some permissions denied. DiXie may have limited functionality.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                onPermissionsGranted() // Continue with limited functionality
            }
        }
    }

    private fun onPermissionsGranted() {

        setupVoiceCommands()
        setupDisplayManager()
        isDesktopInitialized = true

    private fun showWelcomeSequence() {
        val welcomeText = android.widget.TextView(this).apply {

            textSize = 28f
            setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FF6B35"))
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER
            alpha = 0f
            layoutParams = android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
            )
        }
        rootContainer.addView(welcomeText)

        welcomeText.animate()
            .alpha(1f)
            .setDuration(1000)
            .withEndAction {
                welcomeText.animate()
                    .alpha(0f)
                    .setDuration(800)
                    .setStartDelay(1500)
                    .withEndAction {
                        rootContainer.removeView(welcomeText)
                    }
                    .start()
            }
            .start()
    }

    private fun initializeDesktopUI() {
        // Create free canvas for widgets (no grid!)
        freeCanvas = FreeCanvasView(this)
        freeCanvas.layoutParams = android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
        )
        rootContainer.addView(freeCanvas)

        // Create macOS Dock
        dock = MacOSDock(this)
        val dockParams = android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            dpToPx(72)
        ).apply {
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.BOTTOM
            bottomMargin = dpToPx(8)
        }
        rootContainer.addView(dock, dockParams)

        // Create Menu Bar
        menuBar = MenuBarView(this)
        val menuParams = android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            dpToPx(32)
        ).apply {
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.TOP
        }
        rootContainer.addView(menuBar, menuParams)

        // Setup dock apps
        setupDockApps()

        // Setup menu bar items
        setupMenuBar()

        // Load saved widgets
        widgetManager.loadWidgets(freeCanvas)

        // Setup workspace manager
        workspaceManager.initialize(freeCanvas)

        // Setup gesture overlay
        gestureOverlay = GestureOverlayView(this, object : GestureOverlayView.GestureCallback {
            override fun onThreeFingerSwipeLeft() {
                workspaceManager.previousWorkspace()
                showGestureToast("← Workspace ${workspaceManager.getCurrentWorkspace() + 1}")
            }

            override fun onThreeFingerSwipeRight() {
                workspaceManager.nextWorkspace()
                showGestureToast("Workspace ${workspaceManager.getCurrentWorkspace() + 1} →")
            }

            override fun onThreeFingerSwipeUp() {
                workspaceManager.showWorkspaceExpose()
                showGestureToast("Mission Control")
            }

            override fun onThreeFingerSwipeDown() {
                showGestureToast("App Exposé")
            }

            override fun onFourFingerSwipeLeft() {
                windowManager.cycleWindows()
                showGestureToast("← Switch App")
            }

            override fun onFourFingerSwipeRight() {
                windowManager.cycleWindows()
                showGestureToast("Switch App →")
            }

            override fun onFourFingerSwipeUp() {
                hideAllWindows()
                showGestureToast("Show Desktop")
            }

            override fun onFourFingerSwipeDown() {
                restoreWindows()
                showGestureToast("Restore Windows")
            }

            override fun onPinchIn() {
                freeCanvas.zoomOut()
                showGestureToast("Zoom Out")
            }

            override fun onPinchOut() {
                freeCanvas.zoomIn()
                showGestureToast("Zoom In")
            }

            override fun onTwoFingerTap() {
                showDesktopContextMenu()
            }

            override fun onThreeFingerTap() {
                if (!isVoiceEnabled) {

                } else {
                    voiceCommandService.startListening()
                }
            }

            override fun onFourFingerTap() {
                openTerminal()
            }
        })
        rootContainer.addView(gestureOverlay)

        Toast.makeText(this, "✨ DiXie is ready! Long-press desktop for options.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    private fun setupDockApps() {
        dock.addApp("🌐", "Chrome") { launchApp("com.android.chrome") }
        dock.addApp("📧", "Gmail") { launchApp("com.google.android.gm") }
        dock.addApp("🎵", "Music") { launchApp("com.spotify.music") }
        dock.addApp("📁", "Files") { openFileManager() }
        dock.addApp("💬", "Messages") { launchApp("com.google.android.apps.messaging") }
        dock.addApp("⚙️", "Settings") { startActivity(Intent(android.provider.Settings.ACTION_SETTINGS)) }
        dock.addApp("🎤", "Voice") { toggleVoiceAssistant() }
        dock.addApp("🖥️", "Display") { showDisplaySettings() }
    }

    private fun setupMenuBar() {
        menuBar.addAppMenuItem("Finder") { openFileManager() }
        menuBar.addAppMenuItem("File") { showFileMenu() }
        menuBar.addAppMenuItem("Edit") { showEditMenu() }
        menuBar.addAppMenuItem("View") { showViewMenu() }
        menuBar.addAppMenuItem("Window") { showWindowMenu() }
        menuBar.addAppMenuItem("Help") { showHelpMenu() }
    }

    private fun setupVoiceCommands() {
        voiceCommandService = VoiceCommandService(this)
        voiceTriggerManager = VoiceTriggerManager(this) {
            voiceCommandService.startListening()
            showVoiceIndicator(true)
        }

        voiceCommandService.setCommandCallback { event ->
            runOnUiThread {
                when {
                    event.startsWith("wake:") -> {
                        val msg = event.substringAfter(":")
                        Toast.makeText(this, msg, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        showVoiceIndicator(true)
                    }
                    event.startsWith("command:") -> {
                        val cmd = event.substringAfter(":")
                        showVoiceCommand(cmd)
                        showVoiceIndicator(false)
                    }
                    event.startsWith("error:") -> {
                        val err = event.substringAfter(":")
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Voice error: $err", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        showVoiceIndicator(false)
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun setupDisplayManager() {
        extendDisplayManager.initialize()
    }

    private fun setupDisplayDetection() {
        // Auto-detect external displays
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            delay(1000)
            extendDisplayManager.checkConnectedDisplays()
        }
    }

    // ===================================================================
    // APP LAUNCHING
    // ===================================================================

    private fun launchApp(packageName: String) {
        try {
            val intent = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
            if (intent != null) {
                // Launch in floating window
                windowManager.launchAppInFloatingWindow(packageName, getAppName(packageName))
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "App not found", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Cannot launch app: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun getAppName(packageName: String): String {
        return try {
            val appInfo = packageManager.getApplicationInfo(packageName, 0)
            packageManager.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            packageName.substringAfterLast(".")
        }
    }

    private fun openFileManager() {
        Toast.makeText(this, "File manager coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    private fun toggleVoiceAssistant() {
        if (isVoiceEnabled) {
            voiceCommandService.stopListening()
            isVoiceEnabled = false
            Toast.makeText(this, "Voice assistant disabled", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        } else {
            enableVoiceAssistant()

        voiceCommandService.startListening()
        isVoiceEnabled = true
        Toast.makeText(this, "🎤 Voice assistant enabled. Say 'Hey DiXie'", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
    }

                "🎤 Voice Settings" -> showVoiceSettings()
                "⚙️ Desktop Settings" -> openSettings()
            }
            true

        menu.show()

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.animation.ValueAnimator
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.*
import android.view.*
import android.widget.*
import java.util.*
import kotlin.math.*

class FreeCanvasView(context: Context) : View(context) {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "FreeCanvasView"
        private const val ZOOM_MIN = 0.5f
        private const val ZOOM_MAX = 2.0f
        private const val GRID_SIZE = 50
    }

    // Widget management
    private val widgets = mutableListOf<WidgetData>()
    private val widgetViews = mutableMapOf<String, View>()

    // Zoom and pan
    private var scaleFactor = 1.0f
    private var panX = 0f
    private var panY = 0f
    private var startScale = 1.0f
    private var startPanX = 0f
    private var startPanY = 0f

    // Touch handling
    private var activeDragWidget: WidgetData? = null
    private var activeResizeWidget: WidgetData? = null
    private var isPanning = false
    private var isPinching = false
    private var lastTouchX = 0f
    private var lastTouchY = 0f
    private var initialTouchX = 0f
    private var initialTouchY = 0f
    private var initialWidgetX = 0f
    private var initialWidgetY = 0f
    private var initialWidgetWidth = 0f
    private var initialWidgetHeight = 0f
    private var initialPinchDistance = 0f

    // Edit mode
    private var isEditMode = false

    // Listeners
    private var dragListener: ((WidgetData, Float, Float) -> Unit)? = null
    private var deleteListener: ((WidgetData) -> Unit)? = null
    private var resizeListener: ((WidgetData, Float, Float) -> Unit)? = null

    // Paint for drawing
    private val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
    private val gridPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        color = Color.parseColor("#20FFFFFF")
        strokeWidth = 1f
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
    }
    private val editModePaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        color = Color.parseColor("#33FF0000")
        style = Paint.Style.FILL
    }
    private val textPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        color = Color.WHITE
        textSize = 24f
    }

    data class WidgetData(
        val id: String,
        val type: String,
        var x: Float,
        var y: Float,
        var width: Float,
        var height: Float,
        val config: MutableMap<String, Any>
    )

    init {
        setupTouchHandling()
        setupLongPress()
    }

    private fun setupTouchHandling() {
        setOnTouchListener { _, event ->
            when (event.actionMasked) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    val x = (event.x - panX) / scaleFactor
                    val y = (event.y - panY) / scaleFactor
                    
                    // Check if touching a widget
                    val tappedWidget = findWidgetAt(x, y)
                    
                    if (tappedWidget != null) {
                        // Check resize handle
                        val isResizeHandle = isInResizeHandle(tappedWidget, x, y)
                        if (isResizeHandle) {
                            startResizing(tappedWidget, event.x, event.y)
                        } else {
                            startDragging(tappedWidget, event.x, event.y)
                        }
                    } else {
                        startPanning(event.x, event.y)
                    }
                    true
                }

                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                    when {
                        activeDragWidget != null -> dragWidget(event.x, event.y)
                        activeResizeWidget != null -> resizeWidget(event.x, event.y)
                        isPanning && event.pointerCount == 1 -> pan(event.x, event.y)
                        event.pointerCount >= 2 -> handlePinch(event)
                    }
                    true
                }

                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP -> {
                    endDragging()
                    endResizing()
                    endPanning()
                    endPinch()
                    saveWidgetLayout()
                    true
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun findWidgetAt(x: Float, y: Float): WidgetData? {
        return widgets.findLast { widget ->
            x in widget.x..(widget.x + widget.width) &&
            y in widget.y..(widget.y + widget.height)
        }
    }

    private fun isInResizeHandle(widget: WidgetData, x: Float, y: Float): Boolean {
        val handleSize = 30f
        return x >= (widget.x + widget.width - handleSize) &&
               y >= (widget.y + widget.height - handleSize)
    }

    private fun startDragging(widget: WidgetData, touchX: Float, touchY: Float) {
        activeDragWidget = widget
        initialWidgetX = widget.x
        initialWidgetY = widget.y
        initialTouchX = (touchX - panX) / scaleFactor
        initialTouchY = (touchY - panY) / scaleFactor
        bringWidgetToFront(widget)
    }

    private fun dragWidget(touchX: Float, touchY: Float) {
        activeDragWidget?.let { widget ->
            val newX = (touchX - panX) / scaleFactor - initialTouchX + initialWidgetX
            val newY = (touchY - panY) / scaleFactor - initialTouchY + initialWidgetY
            
            widget.x = newX.coerceIn(0f, width.toFloat() - widget.width)
            widget.y = newY.coerceIn(0f, height.toFloat() - widget.height)
            
            updateWidgetPosition(widget)
            dragListener?.invoke(widget, widget.x, widget.y)
            invalidate()
        }
    }

    private fun endDragging() {
        activeDragWidget = null
    }

    private fun startResizing(widget: WidgetData, touchX: Float, touchY: Float) {
        activeResizeWidget = widget
        initialWidgetWidth = widget.width
        initialWidgetHeight = widget.height
        initialTouchX = (touchX - panX) / scaleFactor
        initialTouchY = (touchY - panY) / scaleFactor
    }

    private fun resizeWidget(touchX: Float, touchY: Float) {
        activeResizeWidget?.let { widget ->
            val newWidth = (touchX - panX) / scaleFactor - initialTouchX + initialWidgetWidth
            val newHeight = (touchY - panY) / scaleFactor - initialTouchY + initialWidgetHeight
            
            widget.width = newWidth.coerceIn(100f, 800f)
            widget.height = newHeight.coerceIn(100f, 600f)
            
            updateWidgetSize(widget)
            resizeListener?.invoke(widget, widget.width, widget.height)
            invalidate()
        }
    }

    private fun endResizing() {
        activeResizeWidget = null
    }

    private fun startPanning(touchX: Float, touchY: Float) {
        isPanning = true
        startPanX = panX
        startPanY = panY
        lastTouchX = touchX
        lastTouchY = touchY
    }

    private fun pan(touchX: Float, touchY: Float) {
        val dx = touchX - lastTouchX
        val dy = touchY - lastTouchY
        panX = (startPanX + dx).coerceIn(-width * (scaleFactor - 1), 0f)
        panY = (startPanY + dy).coerceIn(-height * (scaleFactor - 1), 0f)
        invalidate()
    }

    private fun endPanning() {
        isPanning = false
    }

    private fun handlePinch(event: MotionEvent) {
        if (event.pointerCount < 2) return
        
        when (event.actionMasked) {
            MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN -> {
                startPinch(event)
            }
            MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                if (isPinching) {
                    val currentDistance = getPinchDistance(event)
                    val scaleDelta = currentDistance / initialPinchDistance
                    val newScale = (startScale * scaleDelta).coerceIn(ZOOM_MIN, ZOOM_MAX)
                    scaleFactor = newScale
                    invalidate()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun startPinch(event: MotionEvent) {
        isPinching = true
        startScale = scaleFactor
        initialPinchDistance = getPinchDistance(event)
    }

    private fun endPinch() {
        isPinching = false
    }

    private fun getPinchDistance(event: MotionEvent): Float {
        val x1 = event.getX(0)
        val y1 = event.getY(0)
        val x2 = event.getX(1)
        val y2 = event.getY(1)
        return sqrt((x2 - x1).pow(2) + (y2 - y1).pow(2))
    }

    private fun setupLongPress() {
        setOnLongClickListener {
            isEditMode = !isEditMode
            showEditModeToast()
            invalidate()
            true
        }
    }

    private fun bringWidgetToFront(widget: WidgetData) {
        val index = widgets.indexOf(widget)
        if (index != -1 && index != widgets.size - 1) {
            widgets.removeAt(index)
            widgets.add(widget)
            val view = widgetViews[widget.id]
            view?.bringToFront()
        }
    }

    private fun updateWidgetPosition(widget: WidgetData) {
        val view = widgetViews[widget.id]
        view?.let {
            it.x = widget.x * scaleFactor + panX
            it.y = widget.y * scaleFactor + panY
        }
    }

    private fun updateWidgetSize(widget: WidgetData) {
        val view = widgetViews[widget.id]
        view?.layoutParams?.width = (widget.width * scaleFactor).toInt()
        view?.layoutParams?.height = (widget.height * scaleFactor).toInt()
        view?.requestLayout()
        updateWidgetPosition(widget)
    }

    fun addWidget(widget: WidgetData, widgetView: View) {
        widgets.add(widget)
        widgetViews[widget.id] = widgetView
        
        // Apply scaling and positioning
        widgetView.layoutParams = android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            (widget.width * scaleFactor).toInt(),
            (widget.height * scaleFactor).toInt()
        )
        widgetView.x = widget.x * scaleFactor + panX
        widgetView.y = widget.y * scaleFactor + panY
        
        (parent as? android.view.ViewGroup)?.addView(widgetView)
        invalidate()
        
        // Animate appearance
        widgetView.alpha = 0f
        widgetView.animate()
            .alpha(1f)
            .setDuration(200)
            .start()
    }

    fun removeWidget(widgetId: String) {
        val view = widgetViews[widgetId]
        view?.let { (it.parent as? android.view.ViewGroup)?.removeView(it) }
        widgetViews.remove(widgetId)
        widgets.removeAll { it.id == widgetId }
        invalidate()
    }

    fun getAllWidgets(): List<WidgetData> = widgets.toList()

    fun setOnWidgetDragListener(listener: (WidgetData, Float, Float) -> Unit) {
        dragListener = listener
    }

    fun setOnWidgetDeleteListener(listener: (WidgetData) -> Unit) {
        deleteListener = listener
    }

    fun setOnWidgetResizeListener(listener: (WidgetData, Float, Float) -> Unit) {
        resizeListener = listener
    }

        val message = if (isEditMode) {
            "✏️ EDIT MODE - Tap widgets to delete"
        } else {
            "Edit mode OFF"
        }
        Toast.makeText(context, message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    private fun saveWidgetLayout() {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("dixie_widgets", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val gson = com.google.gson.Gson()
        val json = gson.toJson(widgets)
        prefs.edit().putString("widgets", json).apply()
    }

        val json = prefs.getString("widgets", "[]") ?: "[]"
        val gson = com.google.gson.Gson()

        val loadedWidgets: List<WidgetData> = gson.fromJson(json, type)
        loadedWidgets.forEach { widget ->
            // Recreate widget view based on type
            // This would call into WidgetManager
        }

    fun refresh() {
        invalidate()
        widgetViews.values.forEach { it.invalidate() }
    }

    fun zoomIn() {
        scaleFactor = (scaleFactor * 1.1f).coerceAtMost(ZOOM_MAX)
        applyZoomToWidgets()
        invalidate()
    }

    fun zoomOut() {
        scaleFactor = (scaleFactor / 1.1f).coerceAtLeast(ZOOM_MIN)
        applyZoomToWidgets()
        invalidate()
    }

    private fun applyZoomToWidgets() {
        widgets.forEach { widget ->
            val view = widgetViews[widget.id]
            view?.layoutParams?.width = (widget.width * scaleFactor).toInt()
            view?.layoutParams?.height = (widget.height * scaleFactor).toInt()
            view?.requestLayout()
            view?.x = widget.x * scaleFactor + panX
            view?.y = widget.y * scaleFactor + panY
        }
    }

    override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas)
        
        // Save canvas state
        canvas.save()
        canvas.scale(scaleFactor, scaleFactor, panX, panY)
        canvas.translate(panX / scaleFactor, panY / scaleFactor)
        
        // Draw grid (only in edit mode or when zoomed out)
        if (isEditMode || scaleFactor < 0.8f) {
            drawGrid(canvas)
        }
        
        // Draw edit mode indicator
        if (isEditMode) {
            canvas.drawRect(0f, 0f, width.toFloat(), 50f, editModePaint)
            canvas.drawText("✏️ EDIT MODE - Tap widgets to delete", 20f, 35f, textPaint)
        }
        
        canvas.restore()
    }

    private fun drawGrid(canvas: Canvas) {
        val startX = (-panX / scaleFactor).toInt()
        val startY = (-panY / scaleFactor).toInt()
        val endX = startX + (width / scaleFactor).toInt()
        val endY = startY + (height / scaleFactor).toInt()
        
        for (x in startX..endX step GRID_SIZE) {
            canvas.drawLine(x.toFloat(), startY.toFloat(), x.toFloat(), endY.toFloat(), gridPaint)
        }
        
        for (y in startY..endY step GRID_SIZE) {
            canvas.drawLine(startX.toFloat(), y.toFloat(), endX.toFloat(), y.toFloat(), gridPaint)
        }
    }
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.animation.ValueAnimator
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.view.*
import android.view.animation.AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator
import android.widget.*

class MacOSDock(context: Context) : LinearLayout(context) {

    companion object {
        private const val DOCK_HEIGHT_DP = 72
        private const val ICON_SIZE_DP = 56
        private const val ICON_MAGNIFIED_SIZE_DP = 80
        private const val MAGNIFICATION_DURATION = 150L
    }

    private val dockItems = mutableListOf<DockItem>()
    private val animators = mutableMapOf<View, ValueAnimator>()
    private var isCompactMode = false

    data class DockItem(
        val icon: String,
        val label: String,
        val onClick: () -> Unit
    )

    init {
        orientation = HORIZONTAL
        gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8))
        setBackgroundResource(android.R.drawable.editbox_background)
        elevation = dpToPx(8).toFloat()
        
        // Set background with blur effect
        background = GradientDrawable().apply {
            setColor(Color.parseColor("#CC1A1A2E"))
            cornerRadius = dpToPx(36).toFloat()
        }
        
        setupMagnificationEffect()
    }

    private fun setupMagnificationEffect() {
        setOnTouchListener(object : View.OnTouchListener {
            private var hoverView: View? = null
            private var hoverAnimator: ValueAnimator? = null

            override fun onTouch(v: View?, event: MotionEvent?): Boolean {
                when (event?.action) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                        for (i in 0 until childCount) {
                            val child = getChildAt(i)
                            val location = IntArray(2)
                            child.getLocationOnScreen(location)
                            val childRect = android.graphics.Rect(
                                location[0],
                                location[1],
                                location[0] + child.width,
                                location[1] + child.height
                            )
                            
                            if (childRect.contains(event.rawX.toInt(), event.rawY.toInt())) {
                                if (hoverView != child) {
                                    hoverView?.let { animateIconScale(it, false) }
                                    hoverView = child
                                    animateIconScale(child, true)
                                }
                                return true
                            }
                        }
                        hoverView?.let { 
                            animateIconScale(it, false)
                            hoverView = null
                        }
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                        hoverView?.let {
                            animateIconScale(it, false)
                            hoverView = null
                        }
                    }
                }
                return false
            }
        })
    }

    private fun animateIconScale(view: View, magnify: Boolean) {
        val targetScale = if (magnify) {
            ICON_MAGNIFIED_SIZE_DP.toFloat() / ICON_SIZE_DP
        } else {
            1.0f
        }
        
        val animator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(view.scaleX, targetScale).apply {
            duration = MAGNIFICATION_DURATION
            interpolator = AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator()
            addUpdateListener {
                val scale = it.animatedValue as Float
                view.scaleX = scale
                view.scaleY = scale
                view.elevation = if (magnify) dpToPx(16).toFloat() else dpToPx(4).toFloat()
            }
            start()
        }
        
        animators[view]?.cancel()
        animators[view] = animator
    }

    fun addApp(icon: String, label: String, onClick: () -> Unit) {
        val container = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = VERTICAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setPadding(dpToPx(8), dpToPx(4), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(4))
            setOnClickListener { onClick() }
        }
        
        val iconView = TextView(context).apply {
            text = icon
            textSize = (if (isCompactMode) 28f else 32f)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setPadding(dpToPx(12), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(12), dpToPx(8))
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(dpToPx(ICON_SIZE_DP), dpToPx(ICON_SIZE_DP))
        }
        
        val labelView = TextView(context).apply {
            text = label
            textSize = 10f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            visibility = GONE
            alpha = 0f
        }
        
        container.addView(iconView)
        container.addView(labelView)
        
        // Show label on hover
        container.setOnHoverListener { _, event ->
            when (event.action) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_ENTER -> {
                    labelView.visibility = VISIBLE
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(1f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .start()
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_EXIT -> {
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(0f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .withEndAction {
                            labelView.visibility = GONE
                        }
                        .start()
                }
            }
            false
        }
        
        addView(container)
        dockItems.add(DockItem(icon, label, onClick))
    }

    fun removeApp(label: String) {
        val index = dockItems.indexOfFirst { it.label == label }
        if (index != -1) {
            removeViewAt(index)
            dockItems.removeAt(index)
        }
    }

    fun setCompactMode(compact: Boolean) {
        isCompactMode = compact
        val textSize = if (compact) 24f else 32f
        for (i in 0 until childCount) {
            val container = getChildAt(i) as? LinearLayout
            val iconView = container?.getChildAt(0) as? TextView
            iconView?.textSize = textSize
        }
    }

    fun clear() {
        removeAllViews()
        dockItems.clear()
    }

    fun getDockItems(): List<DockItem> = dockItems.toList()

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color

import android.view.Gravity

import android.widget.*
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.*

class MenuBarView(context: Context) : LinearLayout(context) {

    companion object {
        private const val MENU_BAR_HEIGHT_DP = 32
    }

    private val leftSection = LinearLayout(context)
    private val rightSection = LinearLayout(context)
    private val clockView = TextView(context)
    private val batteryView = TextView(context)
    private val wifiView = TextView(context)
    private val notificationBadge = TextView(context)
    
    private val menuItems = mutableMapOf<String, MutableList<MenuItem>>()
    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private lateinit var timeRunnable: Runnable

    data class MenuItem(val label: String, val action: () -> Unit)

    init {
        orientation = HORIZONTAL
        gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
        setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#CC1A1A2E"))
        setPadding(dpToPx(16), 0, dpToPx(16), 0)
        
        setupSections()
        setupClock()
        setupSystemIndicators()
        setupNotificationIcon()
        setupAppMenu()
    }

    private fun setupSections() {
        leftSection.layoutParams = LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 1f)
        rightSection.layoutParams = LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 1f)
        rightSection.gravity = Gravity.END
        
        addView(leftSection)
        addView(rightSection)
    }

    private fun setupClock() {
        clockView.apply {
            textSize = 13f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(12), 0, 0, 0)
        }
        rightSection.addView(clockView)
        
        timeRunnable = object : Runnable {
            override fun run() {
                val sdf = SimpleDateFormat("EEE MMM d  h:mm a", Locale.getDefault())
                clockView.text = sdf.format(Date())
                handler.postDelayed(this, 1000)
            }
        }
        handler.post(timeRunnable)
    }

    private fun setupSystemIndicators() {
        // Battery indicator
        batteryView.apply {
            text = "🔋 87%"
            textSize = 12f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(12), 0, 0, 0)
        }
        rightSection.addView(batteryView)
        
        // WiFi indicator
        wifiView.apply {
            text = "📶"
            textSize = 14f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(8), 0, 0, 0)
        }
        rightSection.addView(wifiView)
        
        updateBatteryLevel()
    }

    private fun updateBatteryLevel() {
        // Battery level would be updated via BroadcastReceiver
        // Simplified for now
    }

    private fun setupNotificationIcon() {
        val container = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            setPadding(dpToPx(8), 0, dpToPx(8), 0)
        }
        
        val notificationIcon = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "🔔"
            textSize = 16f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setOnClickListener {
                showNotificationTray()
            }
        }
        
        notificationBadge.apply {
            text = ""
            textSize = 10f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#BF616A"))
            setPadding(dpToPx(4), dpToPx(2), dpToPx(4), dpToPx(2))
            visibility = GONE
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(
                LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
            ).apply {
                marginStart = dpToPx(-8)
                marginTop = dpToPx(-8)
            }
        }
        
        container.addView(notificationIcon)
        container.addView(notificationBadge)
        rightSection.addView(container)
    }

    private fun setupAppMenu() {
        // Apple logo
        val appleLogo = TextView(context).apply {
            text = ""
            textSize = 18f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(16), 0, dpToPx(16), 0)
            setOnClickListener { showAppleMenu() }
        }
        leftSection.addView(appleLogo)
        
        // Default menu items
        val defaultItems = listOf("Finder", "File", "Edit", "View", "Window", "Help")
        defaultItems.forEach { item ->
            val menuItem = TextView(context).apply {
                text = item
                textSize = 13f
                setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                setPadding(dpToPx(12), 0, dpToPx(12), 0)
                setOnClickListener { showMenuItem(item) }
            }
            leftSection.addView(menuItem)
            menuItems[item] = mutableListOf()
        }
    }

    fun addAppMenuItem(label: String, action: () -> Unit) {
        val menuItem = TextView(context).apply {
            text = label
            textSize = 13f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(12), 0, dpToPx(12), 0)
            setOnClickListener { action() }
        }
        leftSection.addView(menuItem)
    }

    fun addSubMenuItem(parent: String, label: String, action: () -> Unit) {
        menuItems.getOrPut(parent) { mutableListOf() }.add(MenuItem(label, action))
    }

    private fun showAppleMenu() {
        val popup = PopupMenu(context, leftSection.getChildAt(0))
        popup.menu.add("About DiXie")
        popup.menu.add("System Settings")
        popup.menu.add("App Store")
        popup.menu.add("Recent Items")
        popup.menu.add("Force Quit...")
        popup.menu.add("Sleep")
        popup.menu.add("Restart...")
        popup.menu.add("Shut Down...")
        popup.menu.add("Lock Screen")
        popup.setOnMenuItemClickListener { item ->
            when (item.title) {
                "About DiXie" -> showAboutDialog()
                "System Settings" -> openSystemSettings()
                "Lock Screen" -> lockScreen()
                "Shut Down..." -> showShutdownDialog()
                else -> Toast.makeText(context, "${item.title} coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
            true
        }
        popup.show()
    }

    private fun showMenuItem(menuName: String) {
        val items = menuItems[menuName] ?: emptyList()
        if (items.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(context, "$menuName menu coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        
        val popup = PopupMenu(context, leftSection)
        items.forEach { item ->
            popup.menu.add(item.label).setOnMenuItemClickListener {
                item.action()
                true
            }
        }
        popup.show()
    }

    private fun showNotificationTray() {
        Toast.makeText(context, "Notification tray coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    private fun showAboutDialog() {
        android.app.AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("About DiXie")
            .setMessage("""
                DiXie v1.0
                
                Desktop + X factor + Friendly
                
                "DeX + Bixby. One app."
                
                Desktop mode and voice commands
                for ANY Android phone.
                
                © 2024 DiXie
            """.trimIndent())
            .setPositiveButton("OK", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun openSystemSettings() {
        val intent = android.content.Intent(android.provider.Settings.ACTION_SETTINGS)
        context.startActivity(intent)
    }

    private fun lockScreen() {
        val devicePolicyManager = context.getSystemService(Context.DEVICE_POLICY_SERVICE) as android.app.admin.DevicePolicyManager
        devicePolicyManager.lockNow()
    }

    private fun showShutdownDialog() {
        android.app.AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("Shut Down DiXie?")
            .setMessage("This will exit the launcher and return to your phone's home screen.")
            .setPositiveButton("Shut Down") { _, _ ->
                android.os.Process.killProcess(android.os.Process.myPid())
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    fun updateNotificationBadge(count: Int) {
        if (count > 0) {
            notificationBadge.text = if (count > 99) "99+" else count.toString()
            notificationBadge.visibility = VISIBLE
        } else {
            notificationBadge.visibility = GONE
        }
    }

    fun updateBatteryIcon(percentage: Int, isCharging: Boolean) {
        val icon = when {
            isCharging -> "⚡"
            percentage > 90 -> "🔋"
            percentage > 50 -> "🔋"
            percentage > 20 -> "🔋"
            else -> "🪫"
        }
        batteryView.text = "$icon $percentage%"
    }

    fun addRightView(view: View) {
        rightSection.addView(view, rightSection.childCount - 1)
    }

    fun removeRightView(view: View) {
        rightSection.removeView(view)
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}
