kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.animation.ValueAnimator
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color
import android.view.View
import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.HorizontalScrollView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.viewpager2.widget.ViewPager2
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView

class WorkspaceManager(private val context: Context, private val container: FrameLayout) {

    companion object {
        private const val WORKSPACE_COUNT = 5
        private const val ANIMATION_DURATION = 300L
    }

    private lateinit var viewPager: ViewPager2
    private lateinit var indicatorContainer: LinearLayout
    private val workspaces = mutableListOf<Workspace>()
    private var currentWorkspace = 0
    private var freeCanvas: FreeCanvasView? = null

    data class Workspace(
        val id: Int,
        val container: FrameLayout,
        val name: String,
        val backgroundColor: Int
    )

    fun initialize(canvas: FreeCanvasView) {
        this.freeCanvas = canvas
        setupViewPager()
        setupIndicator()
        createWorkspaces()
        setupAnimations()
    }

    private fun setupViewPager() {
        viewPager = ViewPager2(context).apply {
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
            )
            offscreenPageLimit = WORKSPACE_COUNT
            registerOnPageChangeCallback(object : ViewPager2.OnPageChangeCallback() {
                override fun onPageSelected(position: Int) {
                    currentWorkspace = position
                    updateIndicator(position)
                    onWorkspaceChanged(position)
                }
            })
        }
        container.addView(viewPager, 0)
    }

    private fun setupIndicator() {
        indicatorContainer = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                dpToPx(32)
            ).apply {
                gravity = android.view.Gravity.BOTTOM or android.view.Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
                bottomMargin = dpToPx(80)
            }
        }
        container.addView(indicatorContainer)
    }

    private fun createWorkspaces() {
        val workspaceColors = listOf(
            Color.parseColor("#1E1E2E"),
            Color.parseColor("#2E1E2E"),
            Color.parseColor("#1E2E2E"),
            Color.parseColor("#2E2E1E"),
            Color.parseColor("#2E1E1E")
        )

        val workspaceNames = listOf("Work", "Code", "Media", "Social", "Custom")

        for (i in 0 until WORKSPACE_COUNT) {
            val workspaceContainer = FrameLayout(context).apply {
                setBackgroundColor(workspaceColors[i % workspaceColors.size])
                id = View.generateViewId()
            }

            workspaces.add(Workspace(
                id = i,
                container = workspaceContainer,
                name = workspaceNames[i],
                backgroundColor = workspaceColors[i]
            ))

            // Add indicator dot
            val dot = TextView(context).apply {
                text = "●"
                textSize = 12f
                setTextColor(if (i == 0) Color.WHITE else Color.parseColor("#80FFFFFF"))
                setPadding(dpToPx(8), 0, dpToPx(8), 0)
            }
            indicatorContainer.addView(dot)
        }

        viewPager.adapter = WorkspaceAdapter(workspaces.map { it.container })
    }

    private fun setupAnimations() {
        // Add page transition animation
        viewPager.setPageTransformer { page, position ->
            val absPosition = Math.abs(position)
            page.alpha = 1 - absPosition * 0.3f
            page.scaleX = 1 - absPosition * 0.1f
            page.scaleY = 1 - absPosition * 0.1f
        }
    }

    private fun onWorkspaceChanged(position: Int) {
        // Update free canvas to show correct widgets for this workspace
        freeCanvas?.refresh()
        
        // Announce workspace change (accessibility)
        announceForAccessibility("Workspace ${position + 1}: ${workspaces[position].name}")
    }

    private fun updateIndicator(position: Int) {
        for (i in 0 until indicatorContainer.childCount) {
            val dot = indicatorContainer.getChildAt(i) as TextView
            dot.setTextColor(if (i == position) Color.WHITE else Color.parseColor("#80FFFFFF"))
        }
    }

    fun switchToWorkspace(index: Int, animated: Boolean = true) {
        if (index in 0 until WORKSPACE_COUNT) {
            if (animated) {
                viewPager.setCurrentItem(index, true)
                animateWorkspaceTransition(currentWorkspace, index)
            } else {
                viewPager.setCurrentItem(index, false)
            }
        }
    }

    fun nextWorkspace() {
        val next = (currentWorkspace + 1) % WORKSPACE_COUNT
        switchToWorkspace(next)
    }

    fun previousWorkspace() {
        val prev = (currentWorkspace - 1 + WORKSPACE_COUNT) % WORKSPACE_COUNT
        switchToWorkspace(prev)
    }

    private fun animateWorkspaceTransition(from: Int, to: Int) {
        val animator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 1f).apply {
            duration = ANIMATION_DURATION
            interpolator = DecelerateInterpolator()
            addUpdateListener {
                val progress = it.animatedValue as Float
                // Additional transition effects can be added here
            }
            start()
        }
    }

    fun getCurrentWorkspace(): Int = currentWorkspace

    fun getWorkspace(index: Int): Workspace = workspaces[index]

    fun getAllWorkspaces(): List<Workspace> = workspaces.toList()

    fun showWorkspaceExpose() {
        // Create expose overlay showing all workspaces
        val exposeOverlay = FrameLayout(context).apply {
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#CC000000"))
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
            )
            setOnClickListener { (parent as? FrameLayout)?.removeView(this) }
        }

        val grid = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER
        }

        workspaces.forEachIndexed { index, workspace ->
            val preview = createWorkspacePreview(workspace, index)
            grid.addView(preview)
        }

        exposeOverlay.addView(grid)
        container.addView(exposeOverlay)
    }

    private fun createWorkspacePreview(workspace: Workspace, index: Int): View {
        val preview = FrameLayout(context).apply {
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                dpToPx(300),
                dpToPx(200)
            ).apply {
                marginEnd = dpToPx(16)
                marginStart = dpToPx(16)
                bottomMargin = dpToPx(16)
            }
            setBackgroundColor(workspace.backgroundColor)
            
            val label = TextView(context).apply {
                text = "${workspace.name} Desktop"
                textSize = 14f
                setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(16), 0, 0)
            }
            addView(label)
            
            val number = TextView(context).apply {
                text = "${index + 1}"
                textSize = 48f
                setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#33FFFFFF"))
                gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER
            }
            addView(number)
            
            setOnClickListener {
                switchToWorkspace(index)
                (parent as? FrameLayout)?.let { (it.parent as? FrameLayout)?.removeView(it) }
            }
        }
        
        return preview
    }

    fun renameWorkspace(index: Int, newName: String) {
        if (index in workspaces.indices) {
            workspaces[index] = workspaces[index].copy(name = newName)
        }
    }

    fun setWorkspaceWallpaper(index: Int, color: Int) {
        if (index in workspaces.indices) {
            workspaces[index].container.setBackgroundColor(color)
        }
    }

    inner class WorkspaceAdapter(private val workspaceList: List<FrameLayout>) :
        RecyclerView.Adapter<WorkspaceAdapter.WorkspaceViewHolder>() {

        override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): WorkspaceViewHolder {
            val container = FrameLayout(parent.context)
            return WorkspaceViewHolder(container)
        }

        override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: WorkspaceViewHolder, position: Int) {
            val workspace = workspaceList[position]
            // Remove existing views and add the workspace container
            holder.container.removeAllViews()
            holder.container.addView(workspace)
        }

        override fun getItemCount(): Int = workspaceList.size

        inner class WorkspaceViewHolder(val container: FrameLayout) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(container)
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * context.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.*
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import kotlin.math.*

class GestureOverlayView(context: Context, private val callback: GestureCallback) : View(context) {

    interface GestureCallback {
        fun onThreeFingerSwipeLeft()
        fun onThreeFingerSwipeRight()
        fun onThreeFingerSwipeUp()
        fun onThreeFingerSwipeDown()
        fun onFourFingerSwipeLeft()
        fun onFourFingerSwipeRight()
        fun onFourFingerSwipeUp()
        fun onFourFingerSwipeDown()
        fun onPinchIn()
        fun onPinchOut()
        fun onRotate(angle: Float)
        fun onTwoFingerTap()
        fun onThreeFingerTap()
        fun onFourFingerTap()
    }

    companion object {
        private const val SWIPE_THRESHOLD = 150f
        private const val PINCH_THRESHOLD = 0.1f
        private const val TAP_TIMEOUT = 300L
    }

    private val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
        color = Color.parseColor("#88C0D0")
        style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        strokeWidth = 4f
    }

    private var initialPointerCount = 0
    private var gestureStartTime = 0L
    
    // Multi-touch tracking
    private val touchPoints = mutableMapOf<Int, PointF>()

    private var threeFingerStartX = 0f
    private var threeFingerStartY = 0f
    private var fourFingerStartX = 0f
    private var fourFingerStartY = 0f
    private var threeFingerActive = false
    private var fourFingerActive = false

    private var initialPinchDistance = 0f
    private var currentScale = 1f

    private var initialAngle = 0f

    override fun onTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean {

                val pointerId = event.getPointerId(pointerIndex)
                touchPoints[pointerId] = PointF(event.getX(pointerIndex), event.getY(pointerIndex))
                
                when (event.pointerCount) {
                    3 -> startThreeFingerGesture(event)
                    4 -> startFourFingerGesture(event)
                    2 -> startPinchOrRotate(event)
                }
            }
            
            MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                when (event.pointerCount) {
                    3 -> trackThreeFingerGesture(event)
                    4 -> trackFourFingerGesture(event)
                    2 -> trackPinchOrRotate(event)
                }
            }
            
            MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP -> {
                val pointerCount = event.pointerCount
                val timeDelta = System.currentTimeMillis() - gestureStartTime

                    pointerCount == 2 && timeDelta < TAP_TIMEOUT -> handleTap(2)
                    pointerCount == 3 && timeDelta < TAP_TIMEOUT -> handleTap(3)
                    pointerCount == 4 && timeDelta < TAP_TIMEOUT -> handleTap(4)
                }
                
                val pointerId = event.getPointerId(event.actionIndex)
                touchPoints.remove(pointerId)

                    isPinching = false
                    isRotating = false

    private fun startThreeFingerGesture(event: MotionEvent) {
        threeFingerActive = true
        var sumX = 0f
        var sumY = 0f
        for (i in 0 until min(3, event.pointerCount)) {
            sumX += event.getX(i)
            sumY += event.getY(i)
        }
        threeFingerStartX = sumX / 3
        threeFingerStartY = sumY / 3
        gestureStartTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
    }

    private fun trackThreeFingerGesture(event: MotionEvent) {
        if (!threeFingerActive) return
        
        var sumX = 0f
        var sumY = 0f
        for (i in 0 until min(3, event.pointerCount)) {
            sumX += event.getX(i)
            sumY += event.getY(i)
        }
        val currentX = sumX / 3
        val currentY = sumY / 3
        
        val deltaX = currentX - threeFingerStartX
        val deltaY = currentY - threeFingerStartY
        
        if (abs(deltaX) > SWIPE_THRESHOLD || abs(deltaY) > SWIPE_THRESHOLD) {
            if (abs(deltaX) > abs(deltaY)) {
                if (deltaX > 0) callback.onThreeFingerSwipeRight()
                else callback.onThreeFingerSwipeLeft()
            } else {
                if (deltaY > 0) callback.onThreeFingerSwipeDown()
                else callback.onThreeFingerSwipeUp()
            }
            threeFingerActive = false
        }
    }

    private fun startFourFingerGesture(event: MotionEvent) {
        fourFingerActive = true
        var sumX = 0f
        var sumY = 0f
        for (i in 0 until min(4, event.pointerCount)) {
            sumX += event.getX(i)
            sumY += event.getY(i)
        }
        fourFingerStartX = sumX / 4
        fourFingerStartY = sumY / 4
        gestureStartTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
    }

    private fun trackFourFingerGesture(event: MotionEvent) {
        if (!fourFingerActive) return
        
        var sumX = 0f
        var sumY = 0f
        for (i in 0 until min(4, event.pointerCount)) {
            sumX += event.getX(i)
            sumY += event.getY(i)
        }
        val currentX = sumX / 4
        val currentY = sumY / 4
        
        val deltaX = currentX - fourFingerStartX
        val deltaY = currentY - fourFingerStartY
        
        if (abs(deltaX) > SWIPE_THRESHOLD || abs(deltaY) > SWIPE_THRESHOLD) {
            if (abs(deltaX) > abs(deltaY)) {
                if (deltaX > 0) callback.onFourFingerSwipeRight()
                else callback.onFourFingerSwipeLeft()
            } else {
                if (deltaY > 0) callback.onFourFingerSwipeDown()
                else callback.onFourFingerSwipeUp()
            }
            fourFingerActive = false
        }
    }

    private fun startPinchOrRotate(event: MotionEvent) {
        if (event.pointerCount < 2) return
        
        val x1 = event.getX(0)
        val y1 = event.getY(0)
        val x2 = event.getX(1)
        val y2 = event.getY(1)
        
        initialPinchDistance = sqrt((x2 - x1).pow(2) + (y2 - y1).pow(2))
        initialAngle = atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1)
        currentScale = 1f
    }

    private fun trackPinchOrRotate(event: MotionEvent) {
        if (event.pointerCount < 2) return
        
        val x1 = event.getX(0)
        val y1 = event.getY(0)
        val x2 = event.getX(1)
        val y2 = event.getY(1)
        
        val currentDistance = sqrt((x2 - x1).pow(2) + (y2 - y1).pow(2))
        val scaleDelta = currentDistance / initialPinchDistance
        
        if (abs(scaleDelta - 1f) > PINCH_THRESHOLD) {
            if (scaleDelta > 1f) callback.onPinchOut()
            else callback.onPinchIn()
        }
        
        val currentAngle = atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1)
        val angleDelta = currentAngle - initialAngle
        if (abs(angleDelta) > 0.1f) {
            callback.onRotate(Math.toDegrees(angleDelta.toDouble()).toFloat())
        }
    }

    private fun handleTap(pointerCount: Int) {
        when (pointerCount) {
            2 -> callback.onTwoFingerTap()
            3 -> callback.onThreeFingerTap()
            4 -> callback.onFourFingerTap()
        }
    }

    override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas)
        
        // Draw touch indicators for debugging
        if (touchPoints.isNotEmpty()) {
            touchPoints.values.forEach { point ->
                canvas.drawCircle(point.x, point.y, 30f, paint)
                canvas.drawCircle(point.x, point.y, 10f, paint)
            }
        }
    }

package com.dixi.launcher

import android.animation.ValueAnimator
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.graphics.*
import android.graphics.drawable.BitmapDrawable
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.view.*
import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator
import android.widget.*
import com.dixi.launcher.R

class FloatingAppWindow(
    private val context: Context,
    private val packageName: String,
    private val appName: String,
    private val appIcon: Bitmap?
) {

    companion object {
        private val activeWindows = mutableListOf<FloatingAppWindow>()
        
        fun getAllWindows(): List<FloatingAppWindow> = activeWindows.toList()
        
        fun closeAll() {
            activeWindows.forEach { it.close() }
            activeWindows.clear()
        }
        
        fun findWindowByPackage(packageName: String): FloatingAppWindow? {
            return activeWindows.find { it.packageName == packageName }
        }
    }

    private var windowManager: WindowManager
    private lateinit var rootView: FrameLayout
    private lateinit var titleBar: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var contentContainer: FrameLayout
    private lateinit var resizeHandle: View
    
    private var params: WindowManager.LayoutParams
    private var isDragging = false
    private var isResizing = false
    private var isMaximized = false
    private var isMinimized = false
    
    private var lastX = 0f
    private var lastY = 0f
    private var lastTouchX = 0f
    private var lastTouchY = 0f
    private var startWidth = 0
    private var startHeight = 0
    private var startX = 0
    private var startY = 0
    
    private var originalWidth = 0
    private var originalHeight = 0
    private var originalX = 0
    private var originalY = 0
    
    private val windowId = System.identityHashCode(this).toString()

    init {
        windowManager = context.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager
        
        val displayMetrics = context.resources.displayMetrics
        val defaultWidth = (displayMetrics.widthPixels * 0.6).toInt()
        val defaultHeight = (displayMetrics.heightPixels * 0.7).toInt()
        
        params = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
            defaultWidth,
            defaultHeight,
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY
            else
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_PHONE,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN or
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS,
            PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
        ).apply {
            gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
            x = 100
            y = 100
            softInputMode = WindowManager.LayoutParams.SOFT_INPUT_ADJUST_RESIZE
        }
        
        originalWidth = defaultWidth
        originalHeight = defaultHeight
        originalX = params.x
        originalY = params.y
        
        setupWindowContent()
        launchApp()
        
        activeWindows.add(this)
    }

    private fun setupWindowContent() {
        rootView = FrameLayout(context).apply {
            outlineProvider = ViewOutlineProvider.BACKGROUND
            clipToOutline = true
            elevation = 32f
            setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.window_background)
        }
        
        val mainContainer = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
            )
        }
        
        titleBar = createTitleBar()
        mainContainer.addView(titleBar)
        
        contentContainer = FrameLayout(context).apply {
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                0,
                1f
            )
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#1E1E2E"))
            
            // Add placeholder content
            val placeholder = createPlaceholderContent()
            addView(placeholder)
        }
        mainContainer.addView(contentContainer)
        
        resizeHandle = createResizeHandle()
        mainContainer.addView(resizeHandle)
        
        rootView.addView(mainContainer)
        windowManager.addView(rootView, params)
    }

    private fun createPlaceholderContent(): LinearLayout {
        return LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            
            val iconView = ImageView(context).apply {
                if (appIcon != null) {
                    setImageBitmap(appIcon)
                } else {
                    setImageResource(android.R.drawable.sym_def_app_icon)
                }
                layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(64, 64)
            }
            
            val nameView = TextView(context).apply {
                text = appName
                textSize = 16f
                setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
                setPadding(0, 16, 0, 0)
            }
            
            val infoView = TextView(context).apply {
                text = "App launched in floating window"
                textSize = 12f
                setTextColor(Color.GRAY)
                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
                setPadding(0, 8, 0, 0)
            }
            
            addView(iconView)
            addView(nameView)
            addView(infoView)
        }
    }

    private fun createTitleBar(): LinearLayout {
        val titleBar = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#3B4252"))
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                dpToPx(48)
            )
            
            setOnTouchListener { _, event ->
                when (event.action) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                        if (!isMaximized) {
                            lastX = params.x.toFloat()
                            lastY = params.y.toFloat()
                            lastTouchX = event.rawX
                            lastTouchY = event.rawY
                            isDragging = true
                        }
                        true
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                        if (isDragging && !isMaximized) {
                            val dx = event.rawX - lastTouchX
                            val dy = event.rawY - lastTouchY
                            params.x = (lastX + dx).toInt()
                            params.y = (lastY + dy).toInt()
                            applyEdgeSnapping()
                            windowManager.updateViewLayout(rootView, params)
                        }
                        true
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                        isDragging = false
                        true
                    }
                    else -> false
                }
            }
        }
        
        // App icon in title bar
        val iconView = ImageView(context).apply {
            if (appIcon != null) {
                setImageBitmap(appIcon)
            } else {
                setImageResource(android.R.drawable.sym_def_app_icon)
            }
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dpToPx(32), dpToPx(32)).apply {
                marginEnd = dpToPx(8)
                leftMargin = dpToPx(12)
            }
        }
        titleBar.addView(iconView)
        
        // App name
        val titleView = TextView(context).apply {
            text = appName
            textSize = 14f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
        }
        titleBar.addView(titleView)
        
        // Minimize button
        val minimizeBtn = createTitleBarButton("─") { minimize() }
        titleBar.addView(minimizeBtn)
        
        // Maximize button
        val maximizeBtn = createTitleBarButton("□") { toggleMaximize() }
        titleBar.addView(maximizeBtn)
        
        // PiP button
        val pipBtn = createTitleBarButton("⊞") { enterPictureInPicture() }
        pipBtn.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#5E81AC"))
        titleBar.addView(pipBtn)
        
        // Close button
        val closeBtn = createTitleBarButton("✕") { close() }
        closeBtn.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#BF616A"))
        titleBar.addView(closeBtn)
        
        return titleBar
    }

    private fun createTitleBarButton(text: String, onClick: () -> Unit): Button {
        return Button(context).apply {
            this.text = text
            textSize = 14f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#4C566A"))
            setPadding(dpToPx(12), 0, dpToPx(12), 0)
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
            )
            setOnClickListener { onClick() }
        }
    }

    private fun createResizeHandle(): View {
        return View(context).apply {
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dpToPx(24), dpToPx(24))
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#5E81AC"))
            
            setOnTouchListener { _, event ->
                when (event.action) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                        if (!isMaximized) {
                            isResizing = true
                            startWidth = params.width
                            startHeight = params.height
                            startX = event.rawX.toInt()
                            startY = event.rawY.toInt()
                        }
                        true
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                        if (isResizing) {
                            val dx = event.rawX.toInt() - startX
                            val dy = event.rawY.toInt() - startY
                            val newWidth = (startWidth + dx).coerceIn(dpToPx(200), dpToPx(800))
                            val newHeight = (startHeight + dy).coerceIn(dpToPx(150), dpToPx(600))
                            params.width = newWidth
                            params.height = newHeight
                            windowManager.updateViewLayout(rootView, params)
                        }
                        true
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                        isResizing = false
                        true
                    }
                    else -> false
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun applyEdgeSnapping() {
        val displayMetrics = context.resources.displayMetrics
        val screenWidth = displayMetrics.widthPixels
        val screenHeight = displayMetrics.heightPixels
        val snapDistance = 50
        
        if (params.x < snapDistance) params.x = 0
        if (params.x + params.width > screenWidth - snapDistance) params.x = screenWidth - params.width
        if (params.y < snapDistance) params.y = 0
        if (params.y + params.height > screenHeight - snapDistance) params.y = screenHeight - params.height
    }

    private fun launchApp() {
        try {
            val intent = context.packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
            if (intent != null) {
                intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
                intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_MULTIPLE_TASK)
                context.startActivity(intent)
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }

    private fun minimize() {
        if (isMinimized) {
            params.width = originalWidth
            params.height = originalHeight
            params.x = originalX
            params.y = originalY
            isMinimized = false
            rootView.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        } else {
            originalWidth = params.width
            originalHeight = params.height
            originalX = params.x
            originalY = params.y
            params.width = dpToPx(80)
            params.height = dpToPx(80)
            params.x = (context.resources.displayMetrics.widthPixels - dpToPx(80)) / 2
            params.y = context.resources.displayMetrics.heightPixels - dpToPx(100)
            isMinimized = true
        }
        windowManager.updateViewLayout(rootView, params)
    }

    private fun toggleMaximize() {
        if (isMaximized) {
            params.width = originalWidth
            params.height = originalHeight
            params.x = originalX
            params.y = originalY
            isMaximized = false
        } else {
            originalWidth = params.width
            originalHeight = params.height
            originalX = params.x
            originalY = params.y
            val displayMetrics = context.resources.displayMetrics
            params.width = displayMetrics.widthPixels
            params.height = displayMetrics.heightPixels - dpToPx(80)
            params.x = 0
            params.y = 0
            isMaximized = true
        }
        windowManager.updateViewLayout(rootView, params)
    }

    private fun enterPictureInPicture() {
        close()
        // Launch PiP mode - will be handled by UniversalPipWindow
    }

    fun close() {
        try {
            windowManager.removeView(rootView)
            activeWindows.remove(this)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }

    fun bringToFront() {
        try {
            windowManager.removeView(rootView)
            windowManager.addView(rootView, params)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }

    fun setBounds(x: Int, y: Int, width: Int, height: Int) {
        params.x = x
        params.y = y
        params.width = width
        params.height = height
        windowManager.updateViewLayout(rootView, params)
    }

    fun getWindowId(): String = windowId
    fun getPackageName(): String = packageName
    fun getAppName(): String = appName

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * context.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

package com.dixi.launcher.windows

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.drawable.BitmapDrawable
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable
import com.dixi.launcher.FloatingAppWindow

class FloatingWindowManager(private val context: Context) {

    private val windows = mutableListOf<FloatingAppWindow>()
    private var hiddenWindows = mutableListOf<FloatingAppWindow>()

    fun launchAppInFloatingWindow(packageName: String, appName: String) {
        val existingWindow = FloatingAppWindow.findWindowByPackage(packageName)
        if (existingWindow != null) {
            existingWindow.bringToFront()
            return
        }
        
        val appIcon = getAppIcon(packageName)
        val window = FloatingAppWindow(context, packageName, appName, appIcon)
        windows.add(window)
    }

    private fun getAppIcon(packageName: String): Bitmap? {
        return try {
            val appInfo = context.packageManager.getApplicationInfo(packageName, 0)
            val icon = context.packageManager.getApplicationIcon(appInfo)
            drawableToBitmap(icon)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            null
        }
    }

    private fun drawableToBitmap(drawable: Drawable): Bitmap? {
        if (drawable is BitmapDrawable) {
            return drawable.bitmap
        }
        
        val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(
            drawable.intrinsicWidth.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 100,
            drawable.intrinsicHeight.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: 100,
            Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888
        )
        val canvas = android.graphics.Canvas(bitmap)
        drawable.setBounds(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)
        drawable.draw(canvas)
        return bitmap
    }

    fun closeWindow(window: FloatingAppWindow) {
        window.close()
        windows.remove(window)
    }

    fun closeAllWindows() {
        windows.forEach { it.close() }
        windows.clear()
    }

    fun hideAllWindows() {
        hiddenWindows.clear()
        hiddenWindows.addAll(windows)
        windows.forEach { it.close() }
        windows.clear()
    }

    fun restoreAllWindows() {
        hiddenWindows.forEach { window ->
            window.bringToFront()
            windows.add(window)
        }
        hiddenWindows.clear()
    }

    fun cycleWindows() {
        if (windows.isEmpty()) return
        
        val currentWindow = windows.lastOrNull()
        currentWindow?.bringToFront()
    }

    fun getWindows(): List<FloatingAppWindow> = windows.toList()
}

class UniversalPipWindow(
    private val context: Context,

    private val appIcon: Bitmap?,
    private val isVideoApp: Boolean = false
) {

    companion object {
        private val activePipWindows = mutableListOf<UniversalPipWindow>()
        private var currentAudioFocusWindow: UniversalPipWindow? = null

        fun getAllPipWindows(): List<UniversalPipWindow> = activePipWindows.toList()
        fun getPipCount(): Int = activePipWindows.size

        fun closeAll() {
            activePipWindows.forEach { it.close() }
            activePipWindows.clear()
            currentAudioFocusWindow = null
        }

        fun findPipWindow(packageName: String): UniversalPipWindow? {
            return activePipWindows.find { it.packageName == packageName }
        }

        fun setAudioFocus(window: UniversalPipWindow) {
            activePipWindows.forEach { pip ->
                if (pip == window) {
                    pip.grantAudioFocus()
                } else {
                    pip.revokeAudioFocus()
                }
            }
            currentAudioFocusWindow = window
        }

        fun arrangePipWindows() {
            val displayMetrics = activePipWindows.firstOrNull()?.context?.resources?.displayMetrics ?: return
            val screenWidth = displayMetrics.widthPixels
            val count = activePipWindows.size
            val windowWidth = 320
            val windowHeight = 240
            val padding = 20

            when (count) {
                1 -> {
                    activePipWindows[0].setPosition(screenWidth - windowWidth - padding, 100)
                }
                2 -> {
                    activePipWindows[0].setPosition(screenWidth - windowWidth - padding, 100)
                    activePipWindows[1].setPosition(screenWidth - windowWidth - padding, 100 + windowHeight + padding)
                }
                else -> {
                    activePipWindows.forEachIndexed { index, pip ->
                        pip.setPosition(
                            screenWidth - windowWidth - padding,
                            100 + (index * (windowHeight + padding))
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private var startWidth = 0
    private var startHeight = 0
    
    private var pipWidth = 320
    private var pipHeight = 240
    
    private val hideTitleBarHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private var isPinching = false
    private var initialPinchDistance = 0f
    
    private val audioManager = context.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE) as AudioManager
    private val audioFocusListener = AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener { focusChange ->
        when (focusChange) {
            AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS -> {
                if (hasAudioFocus()) revokeAudioFocus()
            }
            AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN -> {
                if (currentAudioFocusWindow == this) isMuted = false
            }
        }
    }

    init {
        windowManager = context.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager
        
        val displayMetrics = context.resources.displayMetrics
        pipWidth = (displayMetrics.widthPixels * 0.25).toInt().coerceIn(240, 400)
        pipHeight = (pipWidth * 0.75).toInt()
        
        params = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
            pipWidth,
            pipHeight,
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY
            else
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_PHONE,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN,
            PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
        ).apply {
            gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
            x = displayMetrics.widthPixels - pipWidth - 20
            y = 100
        }
        
        setupPipWindow()
        launchAppInPipMode()
        
        if (activePipWindows.isEmpty()) {
            isMuted = false
            setAudioFocus(this)
        }
        
        activePipWindows.add(this)
        arrangePipWindows()
        startBorderAnimation()
    }

    private fun setupPipWindow() {
        rootView = object : FrameLayout(context) {
            private val borderPaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG).apply {
                style = Paint.Style.STROKE
                strokeWidth = 3f
                color = Color.parseColor("#00FF00")
            }
            private var glowAlpha = 0f

            override fun dispatchDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
                super.dispatchDraw(canvas)
                if (hasAudioFocus()) {
                    borderPaint.alpha = (glowAlpha * 255).toInt()
                    canvas.drawRoundRect(0f, 0f, width.toFloat(), height.toFloat(), 12f, 12f, borderPaint)
                }
            }

            fun setBorderGlow(alpha: Float) {
                glowAlpha = alpha
                invalidate()
            }
        }
        
        rootView.outlineProvider = ViewOutlineProvider.BACKGROUND
        rootView.clipToOutline = true
        rootView.elevation = 32f
        rootView.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.pip_background)
        
        pipContainer = FrameLayout(context).apply {
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
            )
        }
        
        val contentView = createPlaceholderContent()
        pipContainer.addView(contentView)
        
        titleBar = createTitleBar()
        pipContainer.addView(titleBar)
        
        if (isVideoApp) {
            videoControls = createVideoControls()
            pipContainer.addView(videoControls)
        }
        
        resizeHandle = createResizeHandle()
        pipContainer.addView(resizeHandle)
        
        rootView.addView(pipContainer)
        windowManager.addView(rootView, params)
        startTitleBarAutoHideTimer()
        setupTouchHandling()
    }

    private fun startBorderAnimation() {
        val borderAnimator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 1f).apply {
            duration = 500
            repeatCount = ValueAnimator.INFINITE
            repeatMode = ValueAnimator.REVERSE
            interpolator = AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator()
            addUpdateListener {
                val alpha = it.animatedValue as Float
                (rootView as? FrameLayout)?.setBorderGlow(alpha * 0.8f + 0.2f)
            }
            start()
        }
        if (!hasAudioFocus()) borderAnimator.cancel()
    }

    private fun createPlaceholderContent(): LinearLayout {
        return LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            
            val iconView = ImageView(context).apply {
                if (appIcon != null) setImageBitmap(appIcon)
                else setImageResource(android.R.drawable.sym_def_app_icon)
                layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(64, 64)
            }
            
            val nameView = TextView(context).apply {
                text = appName
                textSize = 14f
                setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
                setPadding(0, 12, 0, 0)
            }
            
            addView(iconView)
            addView(nameView)
        }
    }

    private fun createTitleBar(): LinearLayout {
        val titleBar = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#80000000"))
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                dpToPx(32)
            ).apply { gravity = Gravity.TOP }
            
            setOnTouchListener { _, event ->
                when (event.action) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                        lastX = params.x.toFloat()
                        lastY = params.y.toFloat()
                        lastTouchX = event.rawX
                        lastTouchY = event.rawY
                        isDragging = true
                        showTitleBarTemporarily()
                        true
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                        if (isDragging && !isMaximized) {
                            val dx = event.rawX - lastTouchX
                            val dy = event.rawY - lastTouchY
                            params.x = (lastX + dx).toInt()
                            params.y = (lastY + dy).toInt()
                            val displayMetrics = context.resources.displayMetrics
                            params.x = params.x.coerceIn(0, displayMetrics.widthPixels - params.width)
                            params.y = params.y.coerceIn(0, displayMetrics.heightPixels - params.height)
                            windowManager.updateViewLayout(rootView, params)
                        }
                        true
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                        isDragging = false
                        true
                    }
                    else -> false
                }
            }
        }
        
        val smallIcon = ImageView(context).apply {
            if (appIcon != null) setImageBitmap(Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(appIcon, 20, 20, true))
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dpToPx(20), dpToPx(20)).apply {
                marginEnd = dpToPx(8)
                leftMargin = dpToPx(8)
            }
        }
        titleBar.addView(smallIcon)
        
        val titleView = TextView(context).apply {
            text = appName
            textSize = 11f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
        }
        titleBar.addView(titleView)
        
        val audioStatus = TextView(context).apply {
            text = if (hasAudioFocus()) "● LIVE" else "○ MUTED"
            textSize = 9f
            setTextColor(if (hasAudioFocus()) Color.parseColor("#A3BE8C") else Color.parseColor("#BF616A"))
            setPadding(dpToPx(8), 0, dpToPx(8), 0)
        }
        titleBar.addView(audioStatus)
        
        val expandBtn = createTitleBarButton("⤢") { expandToNormalWindow() }
        titleBar.addView(expandBtn)
        
        val closeBtn = createTitleBarButton("✕") { close() }
        closeBtn.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#BF616A"))
        titleBar.addView(closeBtn)
        
        return titleBar
    }

    private fun createTitleBarButton(text: String, onClick: () -> Unit): Button {
        return Button(context).apply {
            this.text = text
            textSize = 11f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#4C566A"))
            setPadding(dpToPx(8), 0, dpToPx(8), 0)
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
            )
            setOnClickListener { onClick() }
        }
    }

    private fun createVideoControls(): LinearLayout {
        val controls = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                dpToPx(40)
            ).apply { gravity = Gravity.BOTTOM }
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#80000000"))
        }
        
        val playPauseBtn = ImageButton(context).apply {
            setImageResource(android.R.drawable.ic_media_play)
            setColorFilter(Color.WHITE)
            background = null
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dpToPx(32), dpToPx(32))
            setOnClickListener { togglePlayPause() }
        }
        
        val prevBtn = ImageButton(context).apply {
            setImageResource(android.R.drawable.ic_media_previous)
            setColorFilter(Color.WHITE)
            background = null
            setOnClickListener { previousTrack() }
        }
        
        val nextBtn = ImageButton(context).apply {
            setImageResource(android.R.drawable.ic_media_next)
            setColorFilter(Color.WHITE)
            background = null
            setOnClickListener { nextTrack() }
        }
        
        controls.addView(prevBtn)
        controls.addView(playPauseBtn)
        controls.addView(nextBtn)
        return controls
    }

    private fun createResizeHandle(): View {
        return View(context).apply {
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(dpToPx(24), dpToPx(24)).apply {
                gravity = Gravity.BOTTOM or Gravity.END
            }
            setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.resize_handle)
            
            setOnTouchListener { _, event ->
                when (event.action) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                        isResizing = true
                        startWidth = params.width
                        startHeight = params.height
                        startX = event.rawX.toInt()
                        startY = event.rawY.toInt()
                        showTitleBarTemporarily()
                        true
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                        if (isResizing) {
                            val dx = event.rawX.toInt() - startX
                            val dy = event.rawY.toInt() - startY
                            val newWidth = (startWidth + dx).coerceIn(200, 600)
                            val newHeight = (startHeight + dy).coerceIn(150, 450)
                            params.width = newWidth
                            params.height = newHeight
                            windowManager.updateViewLayout(rootView, params)
                        }
                        true
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                        isResizing = false
                        true
                    }
                    else -> false
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun setupTouchHandling() {
        rootView.setOnTouchListener { _, event ->
            when (event.action) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                    val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
                    val singleTapRunnable = Runnable { requestAudioFocus() }
                    handler.postDelayed(singleTapRunnable, 100)
                    
                    if (event.pointerCount >= 2) {
                        handler.removeCallbacks(singleTapRunnable)
                        handlePinchStart(event)
                    }
                    true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                    if (event.pointerCount >= 2 && isPinching) handlePinchMove(event)
                    true
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP -> {
                    if (event.pointerCount < 2) isPinching = false
                    true
                }
                else -> false
            }
        }
    }

    private fun handlePinchStart(event: MotionEvent) {
        if (event.pointerCount >= 2) {
            val x1 = event.getX(0)
            val y1 = event.getY(0)
            val x2 = event.getX(1)
            val y2 = event.getY(1)
            initialPinchDistance = sqrt((x2 - x1).pow(2) + (y2 - y1).pow(2))
            isPinching = true
            showTitleBarTemporarily()
        }
    }

    private fun handlePinchMove(event: MotionEvent) {
        if (isPinching && event.pointerCount >= 2) {
            val x1 = event.getX(0)
            val y1 = event.getY(0)
            val x2 = event.getX(1)
            val y2 = event.getY(1)
            val currentDistance = sqrt((x2 - x1).pow(2) + (y2 - y1).pow(2))
            val scale = currentDistance / initialPinchDistance
            val newWidth = (pipWidth * scale).toInt().coerceIn(200, 600)
            val newHeight = (newWidth * 0.75).toInt()
            params.width = newWidth
            params.height = newHeight
            windowManager.updateViewLayout(rootView, params)
            pipWidth = newWidth
            pipHeight = newHeight
        }
    }

    private fun requestAudioFocus() {
        if (hasAudioFocus()) return
        val result = audioManager.requestAudioFocus(
            audioFocusListener,
            AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC,
            AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK
        )
        if (result == AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_REQUEST_GRANTED) setAudioFocus(this)
    }

    fun grantAudioFocus() {
        isMuted = false
        updateAudioBorder()
        unmuteAppAudio()
    }

    fun revokeAudioFocus() {
        isMuted = true
        updateAudioBorder()
        muteAppAudio()
    }

    fun hasAudioFocus(): Boolean = !isMuted && (currentAudioFocusWindow == this)

    private fun updateAudioBorder() {
        if (hasAudioFocus()) {
            startBorderAnimation()
        }
    }

    private fun muteAppAudio() {
        try { audioManager.setStreamMute(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, true) } catch (e: Exception) {}
    }

    private fun unmuteAppAudio() {
        try { audioManager.setStreamMute(AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, false) } catch (e: Exception) {}
    }

    private fun showTitleBarTemporarily() {
        hideTitleBarHandler.removeCallbacksAndMessages(null)
        titleBar.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        hideTitleBarHandler.postDelayed({
            titleBar.visibility = View.GONE
        }, 2000)
    }

    private fun startTitleBarAutoHideTimer() {
        hideTitleBarHandler.postDelayed({
            titleBar.visibility = View.GONE
        }, 2000)
    }

    private fun launchAppInPipMode() {
        try {
            val intent = context.packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
            intent?.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK or Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_MULTIPLE_TASK)
            context.startActivity(intent)
        } catch (e: Exception) {}
    }

    private fun expandToNormalWindow() {
        close()
        FloatingAppWindow(context, packageName, appName, appIcon)
    }

    private fun togglePlayPause() {
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.LOLLIPOP) {
                val mediaSessionManager = context.getSystemService(Context.MEDIA_SESSION_SERVICE) as android.media.session.MediaSessionManager
                val controllers = mediaSessionManager.getActiveSessions(null)
                controllers.firstOrNull()?.transportControls?.play()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {}
    }

    private fun previousTrack() {
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.LOLLIPOP) {
                val mediaSessionManager = context.getSystemService(Context.MEDIA_SESSION_SERVICE) as android.media.session.MediaSessionManager
                val controllers = mediaSessionManager.getActiveSessions(null)
                controllers.firstOrNull()?.transportControls?.skipToPrevious()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {}
    }

    private fun nextTrack() {
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.LOLLIPOP) {
                val mediaSessionManager = context.getSystemService(Context.MEDIA_SESSION_SERVICE) as android.media.session.MediaSessionManager
                val controllers = mediaSessionManager.getActiveSessions(null)
                controllers.firstOrNull()?.transportControls?.skipToNext()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {}
    }

    fun close() {
        try {
            audioManager.abandonAudioFocus(audioFocusListener)
            windowManager.removeView(rootView)
            activePipWindows.remove(this)
            if (currentAudioFocusWindow == this) currentAudioFocusWindow = null
        } catch (e: Exception) {}
    }

    fun bringToFront() {
        try {
            windowManager.removeView(rootView)
            windowManager.addView(rootView, params)
            showTitleBarTemporarily()
        } catch (e: Exception) {}
    }

    fun setPosition(x: Int, y: Int) {
        params.x = x
        params.y = y
        windowManager.updateViewLayout(rootView, params)
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * context.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

package com.dixi.launcher

import android.app.Notification

import android.service.notification.NotificationListenerService
import android.service.notification.StatusBarNotification
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View

import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.*
import androidx.core.app.NotificationManagerCompat

import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.dixi.launcher.R
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat

class DeXNotificationListener : NotificationListenerService() {
    companion object {
        var instance: DeXNotificationListener? = null
        var onNotificationUpdate: ((List<NotificationItem>) -> Unit)? = null
    }

    override fun onCreate() { instance = this }
    override fun onNotificationPosted(sbn: StatusBarNotification?) { sbn?.let { sendNotificationUpdate() } }
    override fun onNotificationRemoved(sbn: StatusBarNotification?) { sendNotificationUpdate() }

    private fun sendNotificationUpdate() {
        val notifications = activeNotifications.map { sbn ->
            NotificationItem(
                id = sbn.id,
                packageName = sbn.packageName,
                appName = getAppName(sbn.packageName),
                title = getNotificationTitle(sbn.notification),
                text = getNotificationText(sbn.notification),
                timestamp = sbn.postTime,
                icon = getAppIcon(sbn.packageName),
                isOngoing = (sbn.notification.flags and Notification.FLAG_ONGOING_EVENT) != 0
            )
        }.filter { !it.isOngoing }
        onNotificationUpdate?.invoke(notifications)
    }

    private fun getAppName(packageName: String): String {
        return try {
            val appInfo = packageManager.getApplicationInfo(packageName, 0)
            packageManager.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString()
        } catch (e: Exception) { packageName.substringAfterLast(".") }
    }

    private fun getNotificationTitle(notification: Notification): String {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.KITKAT_WATCH) {
            val extras = notification.extras
            return extras.getString(Notification.EXTRA_TITLE) ?:
                   extras.getString(Notification.EXTRA_TITLE_BIG) ?: "Notification"
        }
        return "Notification"
    }

    private fun getNotificationText(notification: Notification): String {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.KITKAT_WATCH) {
            val extras = notification.extras
            return extras.getString(Notification.EXTRA_TEXT) ?:
                   extras.getString(Notification.EXTRA_BIG_TEXT) ?: "Tap to view"
        }
        return "Tap to view"
    }

    private fun getAppIcon(packageName: String): Bitmap? {
        return try {
            val appInfo = packageManager.getApplicationInfo(packageName, 0)
            BitmapFactory.decodeResource(packageManager.getResourcesForApplication(appInfo), appInfo.icon)
        } catch (e: Exception) { null }
    }

    override fun onDestroy() { instance = null }
}

data class NotificationItem(
    val id: Int,
    val packageName: String,
    val appName: String,
    val title: String,
    val text: String,
    val timestamp: Long,
    val icon: Bitmap?,
    val isOngoing: Boolean
)

data class NotificationGroup(
    val packageName: String,
    val appName: String,
    val appIcon: Bitmap?,
    val notifications: MutableList<NotificationItem>,
    var isExpanded: Boolean = true
) {
    val latestTimestamp: Long get() = notifications.maxOfOrNull { it.timestamp } ?: 0
    val count: Int get() = notifications.size
}

class NotificationTray(context: Context) : LinearLayout(context) {

    private lateinit var recyclerView: RecyclerView
    private lateinit var clearAllBtn: TextView
    private lateinit var dndBtn: TextView
    private lateinit var settingsBtn: TextView
    private lateinit var emptyStateView: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var groupByAppToggle: TextView
    
    private val notificationGroups = mutableListOf<NotificationGroup>()
    private lateinit var adapter: NotificationGroupAdapter
    private var groupByApp = true
    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())

    init {
        orientation = VERTICAL
        setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#2E3440"))
        elevation = 40f
        setupViews()
        setupNotificationListener()
    }

    private fun setupViews() {
        val headerLayout = createHeader()
        addView(headerLayout)
        createEmptyState()
        createRecyclerView()
        createFooter()
        checkNotificationPermission()
    }

    private fun createHeader(): LinearLayout {
        val header = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#3B4252"))
        }

        val topRow = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            setPadding(24, 16, 24, 16)
        }

        val title = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "🔔 Notification Center"
            textSize = 18f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD)
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
        }
        topRow.addView(title)

        dndBtn = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "🔕"
            textSize = 18f
            setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#88C0D0"))
            setPadding(16, 0, 16, 0)
            setOnClickListener { toggleDoNotDisturb() }
        }
        topRow.addView(dndBtn)

        settingsBtn = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "⚙️"
            textSize = 16f
            setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#88C0D0"))
            setPadding(16, 0, 16, 0)
            setOnClickListener { openNotificationSettings() }
        }
        topRow.addView(settingsBtn)

        clearAllBtn = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "Clear All"
            textSize = 12f
            setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#BF616A"))
            setOnClickListener { clearAllNotifications() }
        }
        topRow.addView(clearAllBtn)
        header.addView(topRow)

        val controlRow = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            setPadding(24, 0, 24, 12)
        }

        groupByAppToggle = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "📁 Group by App"
            textSize = 11f
            setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#A3BE8C"))
            setPadding(0, 0, 16, 0)
            setOnClickListener { toggleGrouping() }
        }
        controlRow.addView(groupByAppToggle)

        val expandAllBtn = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "Expand All"
            textSize = 11f
            setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#88C0D0"))
            setPadding(16, 0, 16, 0)
            setOnClickListener { expandAllGroups() }
        }
        controlRow.addView(expandAllBtn)

        val collapseAllBtn = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "Collapse All"
            textSize = 11f
            setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#88C0D0"))
            setOnClickListener { collapseAllGroups() }
        }
        controlRow.addView(collapseAllBtn)
        header.addView(controlRow)

        return header
    }

    private fun createEmptyState() {
        emptyStateView = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setPadding(32, 64, 32, 64)
            visibility = GONE
        }
        val emptyIcon = TextView(context).apply { text = "🔔"; textSize = 48f; gravity = Gravity.CENTER }
        val emptyText = TextView(context).apply { text = "No Notifications\n\nAll caught up!"; textSize = 14f; setTextColor(Color.GRAY); gravity = Gravity.CENTER }
        emptyStateView.addView(emptyIcon)
        emptyStateView.addView(emptyText)
        addView(emptyStateView)
    }

    private fun createRecyclerView() {
        recyclerView = RecyclerView(context).apply {
            layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(context)
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 500)
            setPadding(0, 8, 0, 8)
        }
        adapter = NotificationGroupAdapter(notificationGroups,
            { group, notification -> openNotificationInFloatingWindow(notification) },
            { group -> toggleGroup(group) },
            { group -> clearGroup(group) }
        )
        recyclerView.adapter = adapter
        addView(recyclerView)
    }

    private fun createFooter() {
        val footerLayout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setPadding(24, 12, 24, 12)
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#3B4252"))
        }
        val infoText = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "Notifications require permission. Tap ⚙️ to enable."
            textSize = 10f
            setTextColor(Color.GRAY)
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f)
        }
        val grantBtn = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "Grant Permission"
            textSize = 11f
            setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#A3BE8C"))
            setOnClickListener { requestNotificationPermission() }
        }
        footerLayout.addView(infoText)
        footerLayout.addView(grantBtn)
        addView(footerLayout)
    }

    private fun setupNotificationListener() {
        DeXNotificationListener.onNotificationUpdate = { newNotifications ->
            (context as? android.app.Activity)?.runOnUiThread { updateNotifications(newNotifications) }
        }
    }

    private fun updateNotifications(notifications: List<NotificationItem>) {
        if (groupByApp) {
            val groupMap = mutableMapOf<String, NotificationGroup>()
            notifications.forEach { notification ->
                val group = groupMap.getOrPut(notification.packageName) {
                    NotificationGroup(notification.packageName, notification.appName, notification.icon, mutableListOf())
                }
                group.notifications.add(notification)
            }
            notificationGroups.clear()
            notificationGroups.addAll(groupMap.values.sortedByDescending { it.latestTimestamp })
        } else {
            notificationGroups.clear()
            notifications.forEach { notification ->
                notificationGroups.add(NotificationGroup(notification.packageName, notification.appName, notification.icon, mutableListOf(notification)))
            }
        }

        if (notificationGroups.isEmpty()) {
            recyclerView.visibility = GONE
            emptyStateView.visibility = VISIBLE
        } else {
            recyclerView.visibility = VISIBLE
            emptyStateView.visibility = GONE
        }
        adapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.updateNotificationBadge(notificationGroups.sumOf { it.count })
    }

    private fun toggleGrouping() {
        groupByApp = !groupByApp
        groupByAppToggle.text = if (groupByApp) "📁 Group by App" else "📄 Flat View"
        DeXNotificationListener.instance?.let { }
    }

    private fun expandAllGroups() { notificationGroups.forEach { it.isExpanded = true }; adapter.notifyDataSetChanged() }
    private fun collapseAllGroups() { notificationGroups.forEach { it.isExpanded = false }; adapter.notifyDataSetChanged() }
    private fun toggleGroup(group: NotificationGroup) { group.isExpanded = !group.isExpanded; adapter.notifyDataSetChanged() }

    private fun clearGroup(group: NotificationGroup) {
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
                val notificationManager = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as android.app.NotificationManager
                group.notifications.forEach { notificationManager.cancel(it.packageName, it.id) }
            }
            notificationGroups.remove(group)
            adapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
            if (notificationGroups.isEmpty()) updateNotifications(emptyList())
        } catch (e: Exception) { }
    }

    private fun openNotificationInFloatingWindow(notification: NotificationItem) {
        clearNotification(notification)
        try {
            val floatingWindow = FloatingAppWindow(context, notification.packageName, notification.appName, notification.icon)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            try {
                val intent = context.packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(notification.packageName)
                intent?.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)
                context.startActivity(intent)
            } catch (e2: Exception) { }
        }
        (parent as? ViewGroup)?.let { parentView ->
            val windowManager = context.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager
            windowManager.removeView(parentView as? View ?: this)
        }
    }

    private fun clearNotification(notification: NotificationItem) {
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
                val notificationManager = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as android.app.NotificationManager
                notificationManager.cancel(notification.packageName, notification.id)
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) { }
    }

    private fun clearAllNotifications() {
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
                val notificationManager = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as android.app.NotificationManager
                notificationGroups.forEach { group ->
                    group.notifications.forEach { notificationManager.cancel(it.packageName, it.id) }
                }
            }
            notificationGroups.clear()
            adapter.notifyDataSetChanged()
            updateNotifications(emptyList())
        } catch (e: Exception) { }
    }

    private fun toggleDoNotDisturb() {
        val isEnabled = dndBtn.text == "🔕"
        dndBtn.text = if (isEnabled) "🔔" else "🔕"
        dndBtn.setTextColor(if (isEnabled) Color.parseColor("#A3BE8C") else Color.parseColor("#BF616A"))
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
            val notificationManager = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as android.app.NotificationManager
            notificationManager.setInterruptionFilter(if (isEnabled) android.app.NotificationManager.INTERRUPTION_FILTER_ALL else android.app.NotificationManager.INTERRUPTION_FILTER_NONE)
        }
    }

    private fun openNotificationSettings() {
        context.startActivity(Intent("android.settings.ACTION_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SETTINGS"))
    }

    private fun requestNotificationPermission() {
        context.startActivity(Intent("android.settings.ACTION_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SETTINGS"))
    }

    private fun checkNotificationPermission() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
            val enabled = NotificationManagerCompat.getEnabledListenerPackages(context).contains(context.packageName)
            val footer = getChildAt(2) as LinearLayout
            val infoText = footer.getChildAt(0) as TextView
            infoText.text = if (enabled) "✅ Notifications enabled - Grouped by app" else "⚠️ Notification access required. Tap 'Grant Permission'"
        }
    }
}

class NotificationGroupAdapter(
    private val groups: List<NotificationGroup>,
    private val onNotificationClick: (NotificationGroup, NotificationItem) -> Unit,
    private val onGroupClick: (NotificationGroup) -> Unit,
    private val onClearGroup: (NotificationGroup) -> Unit
) : RecyclerView.Adapter<RecyclerView.ViewHolder>() {

    companion object { private const val TYPE_GROUP_HEADER = 0; private const val TYPE_NOTIFICATION = 1 }

    override fun getItemViewType(position: Int): Int {
        var currentPos = 0
        groups.forEach { group ->
            if (position == currentPos) return TYPE_GROUP_HEADER
            currentPos++
            if (group.isExpanded && position < currentPos + group.notifications.size) return TYPE_NOTIFICATION
            if (group.isExpanded) currentPos += group.notifications.size
        }
        return TYPE_GROUP_HEADER
    }

    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): RecyclerView.ViewHolder {
        return if (viewType == TYPE_GROUP_HEADER) {
            val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context).inflate(R.layout.notification_group_header, parent, false)
            GroupHeaderViewHolder(view)
        } else {
            val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context).inflate(R.layout.notification_item, parent, false)
            NotificationViewHolder(view)
        }
    }

    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: RecyclerView.ViewHolder, position: Int) {
        var currentPos = 0
        groups.forEach { group ->
            when (holder) {
                is GroupHeaderViewHolder -> {
                    if (position == currentPos) { holder.bind(group) { onGroupClick(group) } { onClearGroup(group) }; return }
                    currentPos++
                }
                is NotificationViewHolder -> {
                    if (group.isExpanded && position in (currentPos + 1)..(currentPos + group.notifications.size)) {
                        val notification = group.notifications[position - currentPos - 1]
                        holder.bind(notification, group) { onNotificationClick(group, notification) }
                        return
                    }
                    if (group.isExpanded) currentPos += group.notifications.size
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun getItemCount(): Int {
        var count = 0
        groups.forEach { group ->
            count++
            if (group.isExpanded) count += group.notifications.size
        }
        return count
    }

    class GroupHeaderViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        private val iconView: ImageView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.group_icon)
        private val nameView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.group_name)
        private val countView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.group_count)
        private val timeView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.group_time)
        private val expandIcon: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.expand_icon)
        private val clearBtn: ImageButton = itemView.findViewById(R.id.clear_group)
        val timeFormat = SimpleDateFormat("h:mm a", Locale.getDefault())

        fun bind(group: NotificationGroup, onGroupClick: (NotificationGroup) -> Unit, onClearGroup: (NotificationGroup) -> Unit) {
            iconView.setImageDrawable(if (group.appIcon != null) android.graphics.drawable.BitmapDrawable(itemView.resources, group.appIcon) else itemView.context.getDrawable(android.R.drawable.ic_dialog_info))
            nameView.text = group.appName
            countView.text = "(${group.count})"
            timeView.text = timeFormat.format(Date(group.latestTimestamp))
            expandIcon.text = if (group.isExpanded) "▼" else "▶"
            itemView.setOnClickListener { onGroupClick(group) }
            clearBtn.setOnClickListener { onClearGroup(group) }
        }
    }

    class NotificationViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
        private val iconView: ImageView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.notification_icon)
        private val titleView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.notification_title)
        private val messageView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.notification_message)
        private val timeView: TextView = itemView.findViewById(R.id.notification_time)
        private val clearBtn: ImageButton = itemView.findViewById(R.id.notification_clear)
        val timeFormat = SimpleDateFormat("h:mm a", Locale.getDefault())

        fun bind(notification: NotificationItem, group: NotificationGroup, onClick: () -> Unit) {
            iconView.setImageDrawable(if (group.appIcon != null) android.graphics.drawable.BitmapDrawable(itemView.resources, group.appIcon) else itemView.context.getDrawable(android.R.drawable.ic_dialog_info))
            titleView.text = notification.title
            messageView.text = notification.text
            timeView.text = timeFormat.format(Date(notification.timestamp))
            itemView.setOnClickListener { onClick() }
            clearBtn.setOnClickListener {
                try {
                    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
                        val notificationManager = itemView.context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as android.app.NotificationManager
                        notificationManager.cancel(notification.packageName, notification.id)
                        group.notifications.remove(notification)
                        itemView.visibility = View.GONE
                    }
                } catch (e: Exception) { }
            }
        }
    }
}

class TerminalEmulator(context: Context) : FrameLayout(context) {

            layoutParams = LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT)

        commands["windows"] = { args ->

  3-finger swipe left/right  - Switch workspaces
  3-finger swipe up/down     - Mission Control / Show all windows

  4-finger swipe up/down     - Show desktop

  2-finger tap               - Open context menu
