    private fun setupSystemShell() {
        try {
            process = Runtime.getRuntime().exec(arrayOf("/system/bin/sh"))
            outputStream = process?.outputStream
            inputStream = process?.inputStream
            
            executor.submit {
                val reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(inputStream))
                var line: String?
                while (reader.readLine().also { line = it } != null) {
                    val finalLine = line
                    post { appendToTerminal("$finalLine\n") }
                }
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            appendToTerminal("Warning: System shell not available. Using built-in commands only.\n")
        }
    }
    
    private fun executeCommand(input: String) {
        val trimmed = input.trim()
        if (trimmed.isEmpty()) {
            appendToTerminal("$ ")
            return
        }
        
        history.add(trimmed)
        historyIndex = -1
        appendToTerminal("$trimmed\n")
        
        val parts = trimmed.split("\\s+".toRegex())
        val command = parts[0].lowercase()
        val args = parts.drop(1).toTypedArray()
        
        val output = if (commands.containsKey(command)) {
            commands[command]?.invoke(args) ?: "Command not found"
        } else {
            executeSystemCommand(trimmed)
        }
        
        if (output.isNotEmpty()) appendToTerminal("$output\n")
        appendToTerminal("$ ")
    }
    
    private fun executeSystemCommand(command: String): String {
        return try {
            val runtime = Runtime.getRuntime()
            val process = runtime.exec(arrayOf("/system/bin/sh", "-c", command))
            val reader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(process.inputStream))
            val errorReader = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(process.errorStream))
            val output = reader.readLines().joinToString("\n")
            val error = errorReader.readLines().joinToString("\n")
            process.waitFor()
            if (error.isNotEmpty()) "Error: $error" else output
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            "Command failed: ${e.message}"
        }
    }
    
    private fun appendToTerminal(text: String) {
        post {
            val spannable = SpannableStringBuilder(terminalView.text)
            spannable.append(text)
            terminalView.setText(spannable)
            scrollView.post { scrollView.fullScroll(View.FOCUS_DOWN) }
        }
    }
    
    private fun showKeyboard() {
        val imm = context.getSystemService(Context.INPUT_METHOD_SERVICE) as android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager
        imm.showSoftInput(inputLine, android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager.SHOW_IMPLICIT)
    }
    
    fun close() {
        process?.destroy()
        outputStream?.close()
        inputStream?.close()
    }
    
    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()

class FinderView(context: Context) : FrameLayout(context) {

            })
        }
        contentLayout.addView(searchView)

        val viewTypeBar = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.END
            setPadding(dpToPx(8), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(8))
        }
        viewTypes.forEachIndexed { index, type ->
            val button = Button(context).apply {
                text = type
                textSize = 12f
                setPadding(dpToPx(12), dpToPx(4), dpToPx(12), dpToPx(4))
                setOnClickListener { currentViewType = index; fileAdapter.setViewType(index) }
            }
            viewTypeBar.addView(button)
        }
        contentLayout.addView(viewTypeBar)

        recyclerView = RecyclerView(context).apply {
            layoutManager = GridLayoutManager(context, 4)
            adapter = FileAdapter().also { fileAdapter = it }
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 0, 1f)
        }
        contentLayout.addView(recyclerView)

        splitLayout.addView(contentLayout)
        mainLayout.addView(splitLayout)

        val statusBar = createStatusBar()
        mainLayout.addView(statusBar)

        addView(mainLayout)
    }

    private fun createToolbar(): LinearLayout {
        return LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8))
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#3B4252"))

            val backBtn = Button(context).apply { text = "←"; setOnClickListener { goBack() } }
            addView(backBtn)

            addView(View(context).apply { layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dpToPx(16), 1) })

            val iconViewBtn = Button(context).apply { text = "⊞"; setOnClickListener { fileAdapter.setViewType(0) } }
            addView(iconViewBtn)

            val listViewBtn = Button(context).apply { text = "☰"; setOnClickListener { fileAdapter.setViewType(1) } }
            addView(listViewBtn)

            addView(View(context).apply { layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, 1, 1f) })

            val newFolderBtn = Button(context).apply { text = "📁 New Folder"; setOnClickListener { createNewFolder() } }
            addView(newFolderBtn)

            val copyBtn = Button(context).apply { text = "📋 Copy"; setOnClickListener { copySelectedFiles() } }
            addView(copyBtn)

            val pasteBtn = Button(context).apply { text = "📌 Paste"; setOnClickListener { pasteFiles() } }
            addView(pasteBtn)

            val deleteBtn = Button(context).apply { text = "🗑 Delete"; setOnClickListener { deleteSelectedFiles() } }
            addView(deleteBtn)
        }
    }

    private fun createSidebar(): LinearLayout {
        return LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dpToPx(200), LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT)
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#2E3440"))
            setPadding(dpToPx(8), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(16))

            addView(createSidebarSection("Favorites"))
            addSidebarItem("🏠 Desktop", Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory().absolutePath + "/Desktop")
            addSidebarItem("📄 Documents", Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory().absolutePath + "/Documents")
            addSidebarItem("📥 Downloads", Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory().absolutePath + "/Download")
            addSidebarItem("🖼 Pictures", Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory().absolutePath + "/Pictures")
            addSidebarItem("🎵 Music", Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory().absolutePath + "/Music")
            addSidebarItem("🎬 Videos", Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory().absolutePath + "/Movies")

            addView(createSidebarSection("Devices"))
            addSidebarItem("📱 Internal Storage", Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory().absolutePath)
            addSidebarItem("💾 SD Card", "/storage/emulated/0")
        }
    }

    private fun createSidebarSection(title: String): TextView {
        return TextView(context).apply {
            text = title
            textSize = 12f
            setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#88C0D0"))
            setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD)
            setPadding(dpToPx(8), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(8))
        }
    }

    private fun addSidebarItem(name: String, path: String) {
        val item = TextView(context).apply {
            text = name
            textSize = 14f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(24), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(8))
            setOnClickListener { loadDirectory(File(path)) }
        }
        addView(item)
    }

    private fun createStatusBar(): LinearLayout {
        return LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(4), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(4))
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#3B4252"))
            
            val itemCount = TextView(context).apply { text = "${fileAdapter.itemCount} items"; textSize = 12f; setTextColor(Color.WHITE) }
            addView(itemCount)
            
            addView(View(context).apply { layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, 1, 1f) })
            
            val freeSpace = TextView(context).apply { text = getFreeSpace(); textSize = 12f; setTextColor(Color.WHITE) }
            addView(freeSpace)
        }
    }

    private fun loadDirectory(directory: File) {
        if (!directory.exists() || !directory.isDirectory) return
        currentDirectory = directory
        updatePathBar()
        
        val files = directory.listFiles()?.sortedWith(
            compareByDescending<File> { it.isDirectory }.thenBy { it.name?.lowercase() }
        ) ?: emptyList()
        
        fileAdapter.setFiles(files)
    }

    private fun updatePathBar() {
        pathBar.removeAllViews()
        var path = currentDirectory
        val segments = mutableListOf<File>()
        while (path.parentFile != null) {
            segments.add(0, path)
            path = path.parentFile!!
        }
        segments.add(0, path)
        
        segments.forEach { dir ->
            val button = Button(context).apply { text = dir.name; textSize = 12f; setOnClickListener { loadDirectory(dir) } }
            pathBar.addView(button)
            val separator = TextView(context).apply { text = "›"; textSize = 14f; setPadding(dpToPx(4), 0, dpToPx(4), 0) }
            pathBar.addView(separator)
        }
        if (pathBar.childCount > 0) pathBar.removeViewAt(pathBar.childCount - 1)
    }

    private fun searchFiles(query: String) {
        Thread {
            val results = currentDirectory.walk().maxDepth(3)
                .filter { it.name.contains(query, ignoreCase = true) }
                .take(100)
                .toList()
            post { fileAdapter.setFiles(results) }
        }.start()
    }

    private fun createNewFolder() {
        val editText = EditText(context)
        android.app.AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("New Folder")
            .setView(editText)
            .setPositiveButton("Create") { _, _ ->
                val folderName = editText.text.toString()
                val newFolder = File(currentDirectory, folderName)
                if (newFolder.mkdir()) loadDirectory(currentDirectory)
                else Toast.makeText(context, "Failed to create folder", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun copySelectedFiles() {
        clipboard.clear()
        clipboard.addAll(fileAdapter.getSelectedFiles())
        cutMode = false
        Toast.makeText(context, "Copied ${clipboard.size} items", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    private fun pasteFiles() {
        if (clipboard.isEmpty()) return
        Thread {
            clipboard.forEach { file ->
                val dest = File(currentDirectory, file.name)
                if (cutMode) file.renameTo(dest) else file.copyTo(dest, overwrite = true)
            }
            post {
                loadDirectory(currentDirectory)
                if (cutMode) clipboard.clear()
                Toast.makeText(context, "Pasted ${clipboard.size} items", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }.start()
    }

    private fun deleteSelectedFiles() {
        val selected = fileAdapter.getSelectedFiles()
        android.app.AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("Delete ${selected.size} items?")
            .setMessage("This action cannot be undone")
            .setPositiveButton("Delete") { _, _ ->
                Thread { selected.forEach { it.deleteRecursively() }; post { loadDirectory(currentDirectory) } }.start()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun goBack() { currentDirectory.parentFile?.let { loadDirectory(it) } }

    private fun getFreeSpace(): String {
        val stat = StatFs(currentDirectory.absolutePath)
        val bytesAvailable = stat.blockSizeLong * stat.availableBlocksLong
        return "Free: ${bytesAvailable / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)} GB"
    }

    inner class FileAdapter : RecyclerView.Adapter<FileAdapter.ViewHolder>() {
        private var files = listOf<File>()
        private var viewType = 0
        private val selectedPositions = mutableSetOf<Int>()

        fun setFiles(newFiles: List<File>) { files = newFiles; selectedPositions.clear(); notifyDataSetChanged() }
        fun setViewType(type: Int) { viewType = type; (recyclerView.layoutManager as GridLayoutManager).spanCount = if (type == 1) 1 else 4; notifyDataSetChanged() }
        fun getSelectedFiles(): List<File> = selectedPositions.map { files[it] }

        override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): ViewHolder {
            val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context).inflate(android.R.layout.simple_list_item_2, parent, false)
            return ViewHolder(view)
        }

        override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: ViewHolder, position: Int) {
            val file = files[position]
            holder.text1.text = "${if (file.isDirectory) "📁" else "📄"} ${file.name}"
            holder.text2.text = if (file.isFile) formatFileSize(file.length()) else "${file.listFiles()?.size ?: 0} items"
            holder.itemView.setBackgroundColor(if (selectedPositions.contains(position)) Color.parseColor("#4C566A") else Color.TRANSPARENT)
            holder.itemView.setOnClickListener { if (file.isDirectory) loadDirectory(file) else openFile(file) }
            holder.itemView.setOnLongClickListener { if (selectedPositions.contains(position)) selectedPositions.remove(position) else selectedPositions.add(position); notifyItemChanged(position); true }
        }

        override fun getItemCount() = files.size
        inner class ViewHolder(itemView: View) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(itemView) {
            val text1: TextView = itemView.findViewById(android.R.id.text1)
            val text2: TextView = itemView.findViewById(android.R.id.text2)
        }
    }

    private fun openFile(file: File) {
        val uri = FileProvider.getUriForFile(context, "${context.packageName}.fileprovider", file)
        val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW).apply {
            setDataAndType(uri, getMimeType(file.absolutePath))
            addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION)
        }
        context.startActivity(intent)
    }

    private fun getMimeType(path: String): String = when (path.substringAfterLast(".").lowercase()) {
        "jpg", "jpeg" -> "image/jpeg"
        "png" -> "image/png"
        "gif" -> "image/gif"
        "mp4" -> "video/mp4"
        "mp3" -> "audio/mpeg"
        "pdf" -> "application/pdf"
        "apk" -> "application/vnd.android.package-archive"
        else -> "*/*"
    }

    private fun formatFileSize(size: Long): String = when {
        size < 1024 -> "$size B"
        size < 1024 * 1024 -> "${size / 1024} KB"
        size < 1024 * 1024 * 1024 -> "${size / (1024 * 1024)} MB"
        else -> "${size / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)} GB"
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

package com.dixi.launcher.voice

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.speech.RecognitionListener
import android.speech.RecognizerIntent
import android.speech.SpeechRecognizer
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.dixi.launcher.DixieActivity
import java.util.*

class VoiceCommandService(private val context: Context) {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "VoiceCommandService"
        private val wakeWords = listOf("hey dixie", "okay dixie", "hello dixie", "dixie", "hey dexi", "computer", "assistant")
        
        private val appCommands = mapOf(
            "chrome" to "com.android.chrome",
            "browser" to "com.android.chrome",
            "youtube" to "com.google.android.youtube",
            "settings" to "com.android.settings",
            "calculator" to "com.android.calculator2",
            "calendar" to "com.google.android.calendar",
            "gmail" to "com.google.android.gm",
            "spotify" to "com.spotify.music",
            "netflix" to "com.netflix.mediaclient",
            "messages" to "com.google.android.apps.messaging",
            "phone" to "com.android.dialer",
            "camera" to "com.android.camera",
            "photos" to "com.google.android.apps.photos",
            "maps" to "com.google.android.apps.maps",
            "drive" to "com.google.android.apps.docs",
            "whatsapp" to "com.whatsapp",
            "telegram" to "org.telegram.messenger",
            "discord" to "com.discord",
            "twitch" to "tv.twitch.android.app",
            "reddit" to "com.reddit.frontpage",
            "twitter" to "com.twitter.android",
            "instagram" to "com.instagram.android",
            "facebook" to "com.facebook.katana"
        )
    }

    private var speechRecognizer: SpeechRecognizer? = null
    private var isListening = false
    private var commandCallback: ((String) -> Unit)? = null
    private var wakeWordDetected = false
    private val mainHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private var isContinuousListening = true

    init {
        initSpeechRecognizer()
    }

    private fun initSpeechRecognizer() {
        if (!checkPermission()) return
        
        speechRecognizer = SpeechRecognizer.createSpeechRecognizer(context)
        speechRecognizer?.setRecognitionListener(object : RecognitionListener {
            override fun onReadyForSpeech(params: Bundle?) { commandCallback?.invoke("ready") }
            override fun onBeginningOfSpeech() { commandCallback?.invoke("listening") }
            override fun onRmsChanged(rmsdB: Float) { commandCallback?.invoke("volume:$rmsdB") }
            override fun onBufferReceived(buffer: ByteArray?) {}
            override fun onEndOfSpeech() { commandCallback?.invoke("processing") }
            
            override fun onError(error: Int) {
                val errorMessage = when (error) {
                    SpeechRecognizer.ERROR_AUDIO -> "Audio recording error"
                    SpeechRecognizer.ERROR_CLIENT -> "Client error"
                    SpeechRecognizer.ERROR_INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS -> "Permission denied"
                    SpeechRecognizer.ERROR_NETWORK -> "Network error"
                    SpeechRecognizer.ERROR_NETWORK_TIMEOUT -> "Network timeout"
                    SpeechRecognizer.ERROR_NO_MATCH -> "No command recognized"
                    SpeechRecognizer.ERROR_RECOGNIZER_BUSY -> "Recognizer busy"
                    SpeechRecognizer.ERROR_SERVER -> "Server error"
                    SpeechRecognizer.ERROR_SPEECH_TIMEOUT -> "No speech detected"
                    else -> "Unknown error"
                }
                commandCallback?.invoke("error:$errorMessage")
                if (isContinuousListening) startListening()
            }
            
            override fun onResults(results: Bundle?) {
                val matches = results?.getStringArrayList(SpeechRecognizer.RESULTS_RECOGNITION)
                if (!matches.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                    val command = matches[0].lowercase()
                    processCommand(command)
                }
                if (isContinuousListening) startListening()
            }
            
            override fun onPartialResults(partialResults: Bundle?) {}
            override fun onEvent(eventType: Int, params: Bundle?) {}
        })
    }

    fun startListening() {
        if (!checkPermission()) return
        if (isListening) return
        
        val intent = Intent(RecognizerIntent.ACTION_RECOGNIZE_SPEECH).apply {
            putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_LANGUAGE_MODEL, RecognizerIntent.LANGUAGE_MODEL_FREE_FORM)
            putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_LANGUAGE, Locale.getDefault())
            putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_PARTIAL_RESULTS, true)
            putExtra(RecognizerIntent.EXTRA_MAX_RESULTS, 1)
        }
        
        speechRecognizer?.startListening(intent)
        isListening = true
    }

    fun stopListening() {
        speechRecognizer?.stopListening()
        isListening = false
        wakeWordDetected = false
    }

    fun setCommandCallback(callback: (String) -> Unit) { commandCallback = callback }
    fun setContinuousListening(enabled: Boolean) { isContinuousListening = enabled }

    private fun processCommand(command: String) {
        if (!wakeWordDetected) {
            if (wakeWords.any { command.contains(it) }) {
                wakeWordDetected = true
                commandCallback?.invoke("wake:🎤 Listening...")
                Toast.makeText(context, "🎤 DiXie listening...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                return
            }
            return
        }
        
        wakeWordDetected = false
        executeCommand(command)
        commandCallback?.invoke("command:$command")
    }

    private fun executeCommand(command: String) {
        val desktop = context as? DixieActivity ?: return
        
        when {
            command.contains("open") || command.contains("launch") || command.contains("start") -> {
                val appName = command.substringAfter("open")
                    .substringAfter("launch")
                    .substringAfter("start")
                    .trim()
                launchApp(appName, desktop)
            }
            command.contains("close") && (command.contains("window") || command.contains("app")) -> {
                desktop.closeCurrentFloatingWindow(); speak("Window closed")
            }
            command.contains("maximize") -> { desktop.maximizeCurrentWindow(); speak("Maximized") }
            command.contains("minimize") -> { desktop.minimizeCurrentWindow(); speak("Minimized") }
            command.contains("snap left") -> { desktop.snapWindowToLeft(); speak("Snapped left") }
            command.contains("snap right") -> { desktop.snapWindowToRight(); speak("Snapped right") }
            
            command.contains("desktop 1") || command.contains("go to desktop one") -> { desktop.switchToWorkspace(0); speak("Desktop one") }
            command.contains("desktop 2") || command.contains("go to desktop two") -> { desktop.switchToWorkspace(1); speak("Desktop two") }
            command.contains("desktop 3") || command.contains("go to desktop three") -> { desktop.switchToWorkspace(2); speak("Desktop three") }
            command.contains("desktop 4") || command.contains("go to desktop four") -> { desktop.switchToWorkspace(3); speak("Desktop four") }
            command.contains("desktop 5") || command.contains("go to desktop five") -> { desktop.switchToWorkspace(4); speak("Desktop five") }
            command.contains("next workspace") || command.contains("next desktop") -> { desktop.nextWorkspace(); speak("Next workspace") }
            command.contains("previous workspace") || command.contains("previous desktop") -> { desktop.previousWorkspace(); speak("Previous workspace") }
            command.contains("mission control") || command.contains("show all windows") -> { desktop.showMissionControl(); speak("Mission Control") }
            
            command.contains("play") && !command.contains("pause") -> { desktop.playMedia(); speak("Playing") }
            command.contains("pause") -> { desktop.pauseMedia(); speak("Paused") }
            command.contains("next") || command.contains("skip") -> { desktop.nextTrack(); speak("Next track") }
            command.contains("previous") || command.contains("back") -> { desktop.previousTrack(); speak("Previous track") }
            command.contains("volume up") -> { desktop.volumeUp(); speak("Volume up") }
            command.contains("volume down") -> { desktop.volumeDown(); speak("Volume down") }
            command.contains("mute") -> { desktop.mute(); speak("Muted") }
            
            command.contains("add clock") -> { desktop.addWidget("clock"); speak("Clock widget added") }
            command.contains("add weather") -> { desktop.addWidget("weather"); speak("Weather widget added") }
            command.contains("add calendar") -> { desktop.addWidget("calendar"); speak("Calendar widget added") }
            command.contains("add note") -> { desktop.addWidget("note"); speak("Note widget added") }
            command.contains("refresh widgets") -> { desktop.refreshAllWidgets(); speak("Widgets refreshed") }
            
            command.contains("screenshot") -> { desktop.takeScreenshot(); speak("Screenshot taken") }
            command.contains("lock screen") -> { desktop.lockScreen(); speak("Screen locked") }
            command.contains("shutdown") || command.contains("turn off") -> { desktop.shutdown(); speak("Shutting down") }
            command.contains("restart") -> { desktop.restart(); speak("Restarting") }
            
            command.contains("search for") -> { val query = command.substringAfter("search for").trim(); desktop.searchWeb(query); speak("Searching for $query") }
            command.contains("google") -> { val query = command.substringAfter("google").trim(); desktop.googleSearch(query); speak("Googling $query") }
            
            command.contains("help") || command.contains("what can I say") -> { showHelp(desktop) }
            else -> speak("Command not recognized. Say 'help' for commands.")
        }
    }

    private fun launchApp(appName: String, desktop: DixieActivity) {
        val packageName = appCommands[appName]
        if (packageName != null) {
            desktop.launchAppByPackage(packageName)
            speak("Opening $appName")
        } else {
            val app = desktop.findAppByName(appName)
            if (app != null) {
                desktop.launchApp(app)
                speak("Opening ${app.name}")
            } else {
                speak("Could not find app: $appName")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun speak(text: String) {
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.speak(text)
    }

    private fun showHelp(desktop: DixieActivity) {
        val helpText = """
            DiXie Voice Commands:
            
            📱 Apps: "Open Chrome", "Open YouTube", "Open Settings"
            🪟 Windows: "Close window", "Maximize", "Minimize", "Snap left/right"
            🖥️ Desktop: "Go to desktop 2", "Next workspace", "Mission Control"
            🎵 Media: "Play/Pause", "Next/Previous track", "Volume up/down", "Mute"
            🔧 System: "Take screenshot", "Lock screen", "Search for [query]"
            
            Say "Hey DiXie" to wake me up!
        """.trimIndent()
        Toast.makeText(context, helpText, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
    }

    private fun checkPermission(): Boolean {
        return ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
    }

    fun destroy() {
        stopListening()
        speechRecognizer?.destroy()
    }
}

package com.dixi.launcher.voice

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.PixelFormat
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import com.dixi.launcher.DixieActivity
import com.dixi.launcher.R

class VoiceTriggerManager(private val context: Context, private val onTrigger: () -> Unit) {

    private var floatingButton: View? = null
    private var windowManager: WindowManager
    private var isListeningMode = false
    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())

    init {
        windowManager = context.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager
    }

    fun showFloatingMicrophone() {
        if (floatingButton != null) return
        
        floatingButton = createFloatingButton()
        
        val params = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
            dpToPx(56), dpToPx(56),
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY
            else
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_PHONE,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE,
            PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
        ).apply {
            gravity = Gravity.BOTTOM or Gravity.END
            x = dpToPx(16)
            y = dpToPx(16)
        }
        
        windowManager.addView(floatingButton, params)
        
        handler.postDelayed({
            if (floatingButton != null && !isListeningMode) hideFloatingMicrophone()
        }, 5000)
    }

    private fun createFloatingButton(): View {
        return FrameLayout(context).apply {
            layoutParams = ViewGroup.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT)
            setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.voice_button_background)
            elevation = 16f
            
            val icon = TextView(context).apply {
                text = "🎤"
                textSize = 28f
                gravity = Gravity.CENTER
                layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT)
            }
            addView(icon)
            
            setOnClickListener { triggerVoice() }
            setOnLongClickListener { showTriggerMenu(); true }
        }
    }

    fun hideFloatingMicrophone() {
        floatingButton?.let { windowManager.removeView(it); floatingButton = null }
    }

    fun showPushToTalkButton() {
        val button = Button(context).apply {
            text = "🎤 Hold to speak"
            textSize = 16f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#5E81AC"))
            setPadding(dpToPx(24), dpToPx(12), dpToPx(24), dpToPx(12))
            
            setOnTouchListener { _, event ->
                when (event.action) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                        isListeningMode = true
                        text = "🎤 Listening... Release to stop"
                        setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#A3BE8C"))
                        onTrigger()
                        true
                    }
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                        isListeningMode = false
                        text = "🎤 Hold to speak"
                        setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#5E81AC"))
                        true
                    }
                    else -> false
                }
            }
        }
        
        val params = WindowManager.LayoutParams(

                    3 -> openVoiceSettings()

    private fun showListeningAnimation() {

            textSize = 14f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#80000000"))
            setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8))
        }
        
        val params = WindowManager.LayoutParams(

            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
                WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY

            PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT
        ).apply {

        }
        
        windowManager.addView(animationView, params)
        handler.postDelayed({ windowManager.removeView(animationView) }, 2000)

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * context.resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()

package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.Context
import android.os.BatteryManager
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.os.PowerManager
import android.util.Log
import com.dixi.launcher.DixieActivity

class BatteryOptimizer(private val context: DixieActivity) {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "BatteryOptimizer"
        
        enum class PowerProfile {
            MAXIMUM_SAVINGS,  // Extreme battery save
            BALANCED,         // Default - good balance
            PERFORMANCE,      // Maximum performance
            CHARGING         // Plugged in - full power
        }
        
        enum class WidgetRefreshRate {
            REAL_TIME,    // As fast as possible
            NORMAL,       // Standard intervals
            REDUCED,      // Longer intervals
            SUSPENDED     // Only on manual refresh
        }
    }

    private var currentProfile = PowerProfile.BALANCED
    private var isCharging = false
    private var batteryLevel = 100
    
    private val batteryManager by lazy {
        context.getSystemService(Context.BATTERY_SERVICE) as BatteryManager
    }
    
    private val powerManager by lazy {
        context.getSystemService(Context.POWER_SERVICE) as PowerManager
    }
    
    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private var batteryMonitorRunnable: Runnable? = null

    init {
        startBatteryMonitoring()
    }

    private fun startBatteryMonitoring() {
        batteryMonitorRunnable = object : Runnable {
            override fun run() {
                updateBatteryStatus()
                adjustPowerProfile()
                handler.postDelayed(this, 30000)
            }
        }
        handler.post(batteryMonitorRunnable!!)
    }

    private fun updateBatteryStatus() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
            isCharging = batteryManager.isCharging
            batteryLevel = batteryManager.getIntProperty(BatteryManager.BATTERY_PROPERTY_CAPACITY)
        }
        Log.d(TAG, "Battery: $batteryLevel%, Charging: $isCharging")
    }

    private fun adjustPowerProfile() {
        val newProfile = when {
            isCharging -> PowerProfile.PERFORMANCE
            batteryLevel < 15 -> PowerProfile.MAXIMUM_SAVINGS
            batteryLevel < 30 -> PowerProfile.BALANCED
            else -> PowerProfile.BALANCED
        }
        
        if (newProfile != currentProfile) {
            currentProfile = newProfile
            applyPowerProfile()
        }
    }

    private fun applyPowerProfile() {
        Log.i(TAG, "Applying power profile: $currentProfile")
        
        when (currentProfile) {
            PowerProfile.MAXIMUM_SAVINGS -> applyMaximumSavings()
            PowerProfile.BALANCED -> applyBalanced()
            PowerProfile.PERFORMANCE -> applyPerformance()
            PowerProfile.CHARGING -> applyPerformance()
        }
        
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.onPowerProfileChanged(currentProfile)
    }

    private fun applyMaximumSavings() {
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.setWidgetRefreshRate(WidgetRefreshRate.SUSPENDED)
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.disableAnimations()
        reduceDisplayRefreshRate()
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.disableVoiceWakeWord()
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.disableLiveWallpaper()
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.setMaxPipWindows(2)
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.setAnimationsEnabled(false)
        showBatterySaverNotification("Maximum battery saving mode active. Some features limited.")
    }

    private fun applyBalanced() {
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.setWidgetRefreshRate(WidgetRefreshRate.NORMAL)
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.setAnimationsEnabled(true)
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.setAnimationScale(0.5f)
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.setMaxPipWindows(4)
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.setVoiceWakeWordMode("battery_smart")
        restoreExternalDisplayBrightness()
    }

    private fun applyPerformance() {
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.setWidgetRefreshRate(WidgetRefreshRate.REAL_TIME)
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.setAnimationsEnabled(true)
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.setAnimationScale(1.0f)
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.setMaxPipWindows(8)
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.setVoiceWakeWordMode("always_on")
        maximizeExternalDisplayBrightness()
    }

    private fun reduceDisplayRefreshRate() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            (context as? DixieActivity)?.getExternalDisplay()?.refreshRate = 30f
        }
    }

    private fun restoreExternalDisplayBrightness() {
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.setDisplayBrightness(1.0f)
    }

    private fun maximizeExternalDisplayBrightness() {
        (context as? DixieActivity)?.setDisplayBrightness(1.0f)
    }

    private fun showBatterySaverNotification(message: String) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            val notificationManager = context.getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as android.app.NotificationManager
            val channel = android.app.NotificationChannel("battery_saver", "Battery Saver", android.app.NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW)
            notificationManager.createNotificationChannel(channel)
            
            val notification = android.app.Notification.Builder(context, "battery_saver")
                .setContentTitle("🔋 Battery Saver Active")
                .setContentText(message)
                .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_dialog_info)
                .setPriority(android.app.Notification.PRIORITY_LOW)
                .build()
            notificationManager.notify(5001, notification)
        }
    }

    fun getCurrentProfile(): PowerProfile = currentProfile
    fun getBatteryLevel(): Int = batteryLevel
    fun isDeviceCharging(): Boolean = isCharging
    
    fun setManualProfile(profile: PowerProfile) {
        currentProfile = profile
        applyPowerProfile()
    }
    
    fun shutdown() { handler.removeCallbacks(batteryMonitorRunnable!!) }
}

package com.dixi.launcher.theme

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Build
import android.view.WindowManager
import com.dixi.launcher.DixieActivity

class ThemeManager(private val context: DixieActivity) {

    companion object {
        const val THEME_DARK = "dark"
        const val THEME_LIGHT = "light"
        const val THEME_AUTO = "auto"
        
        val COLOR_SCHEMES = mapOf(
            "Nord" to mapOf(
                "bg" to "#2E3440", "surface" to "#3B4252", "primary" to "#88C0D0",
                "secondary" to "#81A1C1", "accent" to "#A3BE8C", "text" to "#ECEFF4",
                "text_secondary" to "#D8DEE9"
            ),
            "Catppuccin" to mapOf(
                "bg" to "#1E1E2E", "surface" to "#313244", "primary" to "#89B4FA",
                "secondary" to "#B4BEFE", "accent" to "#A6E3A1", "text" to "#CDD6F4",
                "text_secondary" to "#BAC2DE"
            ),
            "Dracula" to mapOf(
                "bg" to "#282A36", "surface" to "#44475A", "primary" to "#BD93F9",
                "secondary" to "#FFB86C", "accent" to "#50FA7B", "text" to "#F8F8F2",
                "text_secondary" to "#F1FA8C"
            ),
            "Tokyo Night" to mapOf(
                "bg" to "#1A1B26", "surface" to "#24283B", "primary" to "#7AA2F7",
                "secondary" to "#BB9AF7", "accent" to "#9ECE6A", "text" to "#C0CAF5",
                "text_secondary" to "#A9B1D6"
            )
        )
        
        val ICON_PACKS = mapOf("Default" to null, "Numix Circle" to "numix.circle", "Linebit" to "linebit.lite", "Whicons" to "whicons")
        val FONTS = mapOf("System Default" to null, "SF Pro" to "SF-Pro.ttf", "Inter" to "Inter.ttf")
    }

    private val prefs: SharedPreferences = context.getSharedPreferences("dixie_theme", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    private var currentTheme = THEME_DARK
    private var currentColorScheme = "Nord"
    private var currentIconPack: String? = null
    private var currentOpacity = 0.85f
    private var isBlurEnabled = true
    private var isAnimationsEnabled = true

    init { loadSettings(); applyTheme() }

    private fun loadSettings() {
        currentTheme = prefs.getString("theme", THEME_DARK) ?: THEME_DARK
        currentColorScheme = prefs.getString("color_scheme", "Nord") ?: "Nord"
        currentIconPack = prefs.getString("icon_pack", null)
        currentOpacity = prefs.getFloat("opacity", 0.85f)
        isBlurEnabled = prefs.getBoolean("blur_enabled", true)
        isAnimationsEnabled = prefs.getBoolean("animations_enabled", true)
    }

    fun applyTheme() {
        val colors = COLOR_SCHEMES[currentColorScheme] ?: COLOR_SCHEMES["Nord"]!!
        
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.LOLLIPOP) {
            context.window.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_DRAWS_SYSTEM_BAR_BACKGROUNDS)
            context.window.statusBarColor = Color.parseColor(colors["bg"])
            context.window.navigationBarColor = Color.parseColor(colors["bg"])
        }
        
        val rootView = context.window.decorView.rootView
        rootView.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor(colors["bg"]))
        
        if (currentOpacity < 1.0f) rootView.alpha = currentOpacity
        
        if (isBlurEnabled && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
            context.window.setBackgroundBlurRadius(32)
        }
        
        if (!isAnimationsEnabled) context.window.setWindowAnimations(0)
        
        context.sendBroadcast(android.content.Intent("com.dixie.THEME_CHANGED"))
    }

    fun setTheme(theme: String) { currentTheme = theme; prefs.edit().putString("theme", theme).apply(); applyTheme() }
    fun setColorScheme(scheme: String) { currentColorScheme = scheme; prefs.edit().putString("color_scheme", scheme).apply(); applyTheme() }
    fun setIconPack(packageName: String?) { currentIconPack = packageName; prefs.edit().putString("icon_pack", packageName).apply(); context.sendBroadcast(android.content.Intent("com.dixie.ICON_PACK_CHANGED")) }
    fun setOpacity(opacity: Float) { currentOpacity = opacity.coerceIn(0.5f, 1.0f); prefs.edit().putFloat("opacity", currentOpacity).apply(); applyTheme() }
    fun setBlurEnabled(enabled: Boolean) { isBlurEnabled = enabled; prefs.edit().putBoolean("blur_enabled", enabled).apply(); applyTheme() }
    fun getCurrentColors(): Map<String, String> = COLOR_SCHEMES[currentColorScheme] ?: COLOR_SCHEMES["Nord"]!!
    fun getAccentColor(): String = getCurrentColors()["accent"] ?: "#A3BE8C"
    fun getPrimaryColor(): String = getCurrentColors()["primary"] ?: "#88C0D0"
    fun getBackgroundColor(): String = getCurrentColors()["bg"] ?: "#2E3440"
}

package com.dixi.launcher.security

import android.app.Activity
import android.app.admin.DevicePolicyManager
import android.content.ComponentName
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.hardware.biometrics.BiometricManager
import android.hardware.biometrics.BiometricPrompt
import android.os.Build
import android.os.CancellationSignal
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.dixi.launcher.DixieActivity
import java.util.concurrent.Executor
import java.util.concurrent.Executors

class SecurityManager(private val context: DixieActivity) {

    companion object {
        private const val PREFS_NAME = "dixie_security"
        private const val LOCK_TIMEOUT = 60000L
    }

    private val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    private var isLocked = false
    private var lastInteractionTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
    private var cancellationSignal: CancellationSignal? = null
    private val executor: Executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
    
    private val lockedApps = mutableSetOf<String>()
    private val hiddenApps = mutableSetOf<String>()
    private var isIncognito = false

    init {
        loadLockedApps()
        loadHiddenApps()
        startIdleMonitor()
    }

    fun lockApp(packageName: String) { lockedApps.add(packageName); saveLockedApps(); Toast.makeText(context, "App locked: $packageName", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show() }
    fun unlockApp(packageName: String) { lockedApps.remove(packageName); saveLockedApps(); Toast.makeText(context, "App unlocked: $packageName", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show() }
    fun isAppLocked(packageName: String): Boolean = lockedApps.contains(packageName)

    fun authenticateForApp(packageName: String, onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        if (!lockedApps.contains(packageName)) { onSuccess(); return }
        showBiometricPrompt("Unlock $packageName", onSuccess)
    }

    fun hideApp(packageName: String) { hiddenApps.add(packageName); saveHiddenApps(); context.sendBroadcast(Intent("com.dixie.APPS_HIDDEN")) }
    fun unhideApp(packageName: String) { hiddenApps.remove(packageName); saveHiddenApps(); context.sendBroadcast(Intent("com.dixie.APPS_UNHIDDEN")) }
    fun isAppHidden(packageName: String): Boolean = hiddenApps.contains(packageName)

    fun enableIncognitoMode() {
        isIncognito = true
        clearRecentApps()
        Toast.makeText(context, "Incognito mode enabled", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    fun disableIncognitoMode() { isIncognito = false; Toast.makeText(context, "Incognito mode disabled", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show() }
    fun isIncognitoMode(): Boolean = isIncognito

    private fun clearRecentApps() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.LOLLIPOP) {
            val activityManager = context.getSystemService(Context.ACTIVITY_SERVICE) as android.app.ActivityManager
            activityManager.appTasks.forEach { it.finishAndRemoveTask() }
        }
    }

    private fun showBiometricPrompt(title: String, onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
            val biometricManager = BiometricManager.from(context)
            when (biometricManager.canAuthenticate(BiometricManager.Authenticators.BIOMETRIC_STRONG)) {
                BiometricManager.BIOMETRIC_SUCCESS -> {
                    val prompt = BiometricPrompt.Builder(context)
                        .setTitle(title)
                        .setSubtitle("Verify your identity")
                        .setNegativeButton("Cancel", executor) { _, _ -> Toast.makeText(context, "Authentication cancelled", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show() }
                        .build()
                    cancellationSignal = CancellationSignal()
                    prompt.authenticate(cancellationSignal, executor, object : BiometricPrompt.AuthenticationCallback() {
                        override fun onAuthenticationSucceeded(result: BiometricPrompt.AuthenticationResult) { onSuccess() }
                        override fun onAuthenticationFailed() { Toast.makeText(context, "Authentication failed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show() }
                    })
                }
                else -> { Toast.makeText(context, "Biometric authentication not available", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show(); onSuccess() }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun startIdleMonitor() {
        Thread {
            while (true) {
                Thread.sleep(1000)
                val timeout = prefs.getLong("auto_lock_timeout", LOCK_TIMEOUT)
                if (timeout > 0 && System.currentTimeMillis() - lastInteractionTime > timeout && !isLocked) {
                    lockScreen()
                }
            }
        }.start()
    }

    fun recordInteraction() { lastInteractionTime = System.currentTimeMillis(); if (isLocked) unlockScreen() }
    private fun lockScreen() { isLocked = true; context.startActivity(Intent(context, LockScreenActivity::class.java).addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)) }
    private fun unlockScreen() { isLocked = false }

    private fun loadLockedApps() { val set = prefs.getStringSet("locked_apps", emptySet()); lockedApps.addAll(set ?: emptySet()) }
    private fun saveLockedApps() { prefs.edit().putStringSet("locked_apps", lockedApps).apply() }
    private fun loadHiddenApps() { val set = prefs.getStringSet("hidden_apps", emptySet()); hiddenApps.addAll(set ?: emptySet()) }
    private fun saveHiddenApps() { prefs.edit().putStringSet("hidden_apps", hiddenApps).apply() }
}

class DixieAdminReceiver : android.app.admin.DeviceAdminReceiver() {
    override fun onEnabled(context: Context, intent: Intent) { super.onEnabled(context, intent); Toast.makeText(context, "DiXie admin enabled", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show() }
    override fun onDisabled(context: Context, intent: Intent) { super.onDisabled(context, intent); Toast.makeText(context, "DiXie admin disabled", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show() }
}

class LockScreenActivity : Activity() {
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(TextView(this).apply { text = "🔒 DiXie Locked\n\nTap to unlock"; textSize = 24f; gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER; setOnClickListener { finish() } })
    }
}

package com.dixi.launcher.backup

import android.content.Context
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Environment
import android.util.Log
import com.dixi.launcher.DixieActivity
import com.google.gson.Gson
import com.google.gson.GsonBuilder
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import okhttp3.*
import okhttp3.MediaType.Companion.toMediaType
import okhttp3.RequestBody.Companion.toRequestBody
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.*
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.*
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

class BackupManager(private val context: DixieActivity) {

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "BackupManager"
        private const val BACKUP_FOLDER = "DiXieBackups"
        private const val AUTO_BACKUP_INTERVAL = 86400000L
        private const val CLOUD_API_URL = "https://api.dixie.app/backup"
    }

    private val gson = GsonBuilder().setPrettyPrinting().create()
    private val scope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO + Job())
    private val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("dixie_backup", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    private var lastBackupTime = prefs.getLong("last_backup", 0)

    data class BackupData(
        val version: Int = 1,
        val timestamp: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        val deviceName: String = android.os.Build.MODEL,
        val androidVersion: String = android.os.Build.VERSION.RELEASE,
        val widgets: List<WidgetData> = emptyList(),
        val widgetPositions: Map<String, Position> = emptyMap(),
        val workspaces: List<WorkspaceData> = emptyList(),
        val dockApps: List<String> = emptyList(),
        val desktopWallpaper: String? = null,
        val theme: String = "Nord",
        val pinnedApps: List<String> = emptyList(),
        val hiddenApps: List<String> = emptyList(),
        val lockedApps: List<String> = emptyList()
    )

    data class WidgetData(val id: String, val type: String, val config: Map<String, Any>)
    data class Position(val x: Float, val y: Float, val width: Float, val height: Float)
    data class WorkspaceData(val id: Int, val name: String, val widgets: List<String>)

    fun createBackup(callback: (Boolean, File?) -> Unit) {
        scope.launch {
            try {
                val backupData = collectBackupData()
                val json = gson.toJson(backupData)
                val backupFile = saveToFile(json)
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { lastBackupTime = System.currentTimeMillis(); prefs.edit().putLong("last_backup", lastBackupTime).apply(); callback(true, backupFile) }
            } catch (e: Exception) { Log.e(TAG, "Backup failed: ${e.message}"); withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { callback(false, null) } }
        }
    }

    fun restoreBackup(uri: Uri, callback: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
        scope.launch {
            try {
                val json = readFromUri(uri)
                val backupData = gson.fromJson(json, BackupData::class.java)
                restoreBackupData(backupData)
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { callback(true) }
            } catch (e: Exception) { Log.e(TAG, "Restore failed: ${e.message}"); withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { callback(false) } }
        }
    }

    fun listBackups(): List<File> {
        val backupDir = File(context.getExternalFilesDir(null), BACKUP_FOLDER)
        return if (backupDir.exists()) backupDir.listFiles()?.filter { it.extension == "json" }?.sortedByDescending { it.lastModified() } ?: emptyList() else emptyList()
    }

    fun deleteBackup(file: File): Boolean = file.delete()

    private fun collectBackupData(): BackupData {
        val dixie = context as? DixieActivity
        return BackupData(
            widgets = dixie?.getAllWidgets() ?: emptyList(),
            widgetPositions = dixie?.getWidgetPositions() ?: emptyMap(),
            workspaces = dixie?.getWorkspaces() ?: emptyList(),
            dockApps = dixie?.getDockApps() ?: emptyList(),
            desktopWallpaper = dixie?.getCurrentWallpaperPath(),
            theme = dixie?.getCurrentTheme() ?: "Nord",
            pinnedApps = dixie?.getPinnedApps() ?: emptyList(),
            hiddenApps = dixie?.getHiddenApps() ?: emptyList(),
            lockedApps = dixie?.getLockedApps() ?: emptyList()
        )
    }

    private fun restoreBackupData(data: BackupData) {
        val dixie = context as? DixieActivity
        dixie?.restoreWidgets(data.widgets, data.widgetPositions)
        dixie?.restoreWorkspaces(data.workspaces)
        dixie?.restoreDockApps(data.dockApps)
        data.desktopWallpaper?.let { dixie?.setDesktopWallpaper(it) }
        dixie?.applyTheme(data.theme)
        dixie?.restoreAppVisibility(data.hiddenApps, data.lockedApps)
        dixie?.pinApps(data.pinnedApps)
    }

    private fun saveToFile(json: String): File {
        val backupDir = File(context.getExternalFilesDir(null), BACKUP_FOLDER)
        if (!backupDir.exists()) backupDir.mkdirs()
        val timestamp = SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date())
        val backupFile = File(backupDir, "dixie_backup_$timestamp.json")
        backupFile.writeText(json)
        return backupFile
    }

    private fun readFromUri(uri: Uri): String = context.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.bufferedReader()?.readText() ?: ""

    fun startAutoBackup() {
        val enabled = prefs.getBoolean("auto_backup", true)
        if (!enabled) return
        scope.launch {
            while (true) {
                delay(AUTO_BACKUP_INTERVAL)
                if (System.currentTimeMillis() - lastBackupTime >= AUTO_BACKUP_INTERVAL) createBackup { success, _ -> if (success) Log.i(TAG, "Auto-backup completed") }
            }
        }
    }

    fun syncToCloud(apiKey: String, callback: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
        scope.launch {
            try {
                val backupData = collectBackupData()
                val json = gson.toJson(backupData)
                val client = OkHttpClient.Builder().connectTimeout(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS).writeTimeout(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS).readTimeout(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS).build()
                val body = json.toRequestBody("application/json".toMediaType())
                val request = Request.Builder().url("$CLOUD_API_URL/sync").addHeader("X-API-Key", apiKey).post(body).build()
                val response = client.newCall(request).execute()
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { callback(response.isSuccessful) }
            } catch (e: Exception) { Log.e(TAG, "Cloud sync failed: ${e.message}"); withContext(Dispatchers.Main) { callback(false) } }
        }
    }
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher.tools

import android.app.Activity
import android.content.ContentValues
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.PixelFormat
import android.hardware.display.DisplayManager
import android.hardware.display.VirtualDisplay
import android.media.ImageReader
import android.media.MediaRecorder
import android.media.projection.MediaProjection
import android.media.projection.MediaProjectionManager
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Environment
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.provider.MediaStore
import android.util.DisplayMetrics
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.Toast
import com.dixi.launcher.DixieActivity
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.*

class ScreenCaptureTool(private val context: DixieActivity) {

    companion object {
        private const val REQUEST_CODE_SCREENSHOT = 1001
        private const val REQUEST_CODE_RECORDING = 1002
        private const val SCREENSHOT_DELAY = 500L
    }

    private var mediaProjection: MediaProjection? = null
    private var mediaProjectionManager: MediaProjectionManager? = null
    private var virtualDisplay: VirtualDisplay? = null
    private var imageReader: ImageReader? = null
    private var mediaRecorder: MediaRecorder? = null
    private var isRecording = false
    private var recordingFilePath: String? = null
    private val screenshotHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())

    init {
        mediaProjectionManager = context.getSystemService(Context.MEDIA_PROJECTION_SERVICE) as MediaProjectionManager
    }

    fun takeScreenshot() {
        val permissionIntent = mediaProjectionManager?.createScreenCaptureIntent()
        context.startActivityForResult(permissionIntent, REQUEST_CODE_SCREENSHOT)
    }

    fun handleScreenshotResult(resultCode: Int, data: Intent) {
        if (resultCode == Activity.RESULT_OK) {
            mediaProjection = mediaProjectionManager?.getMediaProjection(resultCode, data)
            screenshotHandler.postDelayed({ captureScreenshot() }, SCREENSHOT_DELAY)
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(context, "Screenshot permission denied", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun captureScreenshot() {
        val metrics = DisplayMetrics()
        val windowManager = context.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager
        windowManager.defaultDisplay.getRealMetrics(metrics)
        
        val width = metrics.widthPixels
        val height = metrics.heightPixels
        val density = metrics.densityDpi
        
        imageReader = ImageReader.newInstance(width, height, PixelFormat.RGBA_8888, 2)
        
        virtualDisplay = mediaProjection?.createVirtualDisplay(
            "ScreenshotDisplay", width, height, density,
            DisplayManager.VIRTUAL_DISPLAY_FLAG_AUTO_MIRROR,
            imageReader?.surface, null, null
        )
        
        imageReader?.setOnImageAvailableListener({ reader ->
            val image = reader.acquireLatestImage()
            if (image != null) {
                val planes = image.planes
                val buffer = planes[0].buffer
                val bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888)
                bitmap.copyPixelsFromBuffer(buffer)
                saveScreenshot(bitmap)
                image.close()
                virtualDisplay?.release()
                imageReader?.close()
                mediaProjection?.stop()
            }
        }, screenshotHandler)
    }

    private fun saveScreenshot(bitmap: Bitmap) {
        try {
            val timestamp = SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date())
            val filename = "DiXie_Screenshot_$timestamp.png"
            
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
                val contentValues = ContentValues().apply {
                    put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME, filename)
                    put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.MIME_TYPE, "image/png")
                    put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH, Environment.DIRECTORY_PICTURES + "/DiXie")
                }
                val uri = context.contentResolver.insert(MediaStore.Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, contentValues)
                uri?.let { context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(it)?.use { outputStream -> bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, outputStream) } }
            } else {
                val picturesDir = Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_PICTURES)
                val dixieDir = File(picturesDir, "DiXie")
                if (!dixieDir.exists()) dixieDir.mkdirs()
                val imageFile = File(dixieDir, filename)
                FileOutputStream(imageFile).use { outputStream -> bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, outputStream) }
                context.sendBroadcast(Intent(Intent.ACTION_MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE, Uri.fromFile(imageFile)))
            }
            Toast.makeText(context, "Screenshot saved", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            showScreenshotPreview(bitmap)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(context, "Failed to save screenshot: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun showScreenshotPreview(bitmap: Bitmap) {
        android.app.AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("Screenshot captured")
            .setMessage("What would you like to do?")
            .setPositiveButton("Share") { _, _ -> shareScreenshot(bitmap) }
            .setNegativeButton("Delete") { _, _ -> }
            .setNeutralButton("Save", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun shareScreenshot(bitmap: Bitmap) {
        val uri = saveToTempFile(bitmap)
        uri?.let {
            val shareIntent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_SEND).apply { type = "image/png"; putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_STREAM, it) }
            context.startActivity(Intent.createChooser(shareIntent, "Share screenshot"))
        }
    }

    private fun saveToTempFile(bitmap: Bitmap): Uri? {
        val tempFile = File(context.cacheDir, "temp_screenshot.png")
        FileOutputStream(tempFile).use { outputStream -> bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, outputStream) }
        return androidx.core.content.FileProvider.getUriForFile(context, "${context.packageName}.fileprovider", tempFile)
    }

    fun startRecording() {
        if (isRecording) { stopRecording(); return }
        val permissionIntent = mediaProjectionManager?.createScreenCaptureIntent()
        context.startActivityForResult(permissionIntent, REQUEST_CODE_RECORDING)
    }

    fun handleRecordingResult(resultCode: Int, data: Intent) {
        if (resultCode == Activity.RESULT_OK) {
            mediaProjection = mediaProjectionManager?.getMediaProjection(resultCode, data)
            setupMediaRecorder()
            startRecordingInternal()
        } else {
            Toast.makeText(context, "Recording permission denied", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun setupMediaRecorder() {
        val timestamp = SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss", Locale.getDefault()).format(Date())
        recordingFilePath = "${context.getExternalFilesDir(null)}/DiXie_Recording_$timestamp.mp4"
        
        mediaRecorder = MediaRecorder().apply {
            setAudioSource(MediaRecorder.AudioSource.MIC)
            setVideoSource(MediaRecorder.VideoSource.SURFACE)
            setOutputFormat(MediaRecorder.OutputFormat.MPEG_4)
            setOutputFile(recordingFilePath)
            setVideoEncoder(MediaRecorder.VideoEncoder.H264)
            setAudioEncoder(MediaRecorder.AudioEncoder.AAC)
            setVideoSize(1080, 1920)
            setVideoFrameRate(30)
            setVideoEncodingBitRate(5000000)
            prepare()
        }
    }

    private fun startRecordingInternal() {
        val metrics = DisplayMetrics()
        val windowManager = context.getSystemService(Context.WINDOW_SERVICE) as WindowManager
        windowManager.defaultDisplay.getRealMetrics(metrics)
        
        val width = metrics.widthPixels
        val height = metrics.heightPixels
        val density = metrics.densityDpi
        
        mediaRecorder?.let { recorder ->
            virtualDisplay = mediaProjection?.createVirtualDisplay(
                "RecordingDisplay", width, height, density,
                DisplayManager.VIRTUAL_DISPLAY_FLAG_AUTO_MIRROR,
                recorder.surface, null, null
            )
            recorder.start()
            isRecording = true
            Toast.makeText(context, "Recording started", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            showRecordingIndicator()
        }
    }

    fun stopRecording() {
        mediaRecorder?.apply { stop(); reset() }
        virtualDisplay?.release()
        mediaProjection?.stop()
        isRecording = false
        
        recordingFilePath?.let { path ->
            val file = File(path)
            if (file.exists()) {
                Toast.makeText(context, "Recording saved: ${file.name}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
                    val contentValues = ContentValues().apply {
                        put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.DISPLAY_NAME, file.name)
                        put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.MIME_TYPE, "video/mp4")
                        put(MediaStore.MediaColumns.RELATIVE_PATH, Environment.DIRECTORY_MOVIES + "/DiXie")
                    }
                    context.contentResolver.insert(MediaStore.Video.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, contentValues)
                }
            }
        }
        hideRecordingIndicator()
    }

    private fun showRecordingIndicator() { context.sendBroadcast(Intent("com.dixie.RECORDING_STARTED")) }
    private fun hideRecordingIndicator() { context.sendBroadcast(Intent("com.dixie.RECORDING_STOPPED")) }
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher.clipboard

import android.content.ClipData
import android.content.ClipboardManager
import android.content.Context
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.widget.Toast
import com.dixi.launcher.DixieActivity
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import okhttp3.*
import okhttp3.MediaType.Companion.toMediaType
import okhttp3.RequestBody.Companion.toRequestBody
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

class ClipboardSync(private val context: DixieActivity) {

    companion object {
        private const val PREFS_NAME = "dixie_clipboard"
        private const val HISTORY_SIZE = 50
    }

    private val clipboardManager by lazy { context.getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as ClipboardManager }
    private val clipboardHistory = mutableListOf<ClipboardEntry>()
    private val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    private val scope = CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO + Job())
    private var isSyncing = false
    private var currentDeviceId = prefs.getString("device_id", null) ?: UUID.randomUUID().toString()

    data class ClipboardEntry(val text: String, val timestamp: Long, val sourceDevice: String, val isFavorite: Boolean = false)

    init {
        loadHistory()
        startClipboardListener()
        prefs.edit().putString("device_id", currentDeviceId).apply()
    }

    private fun startClipboardListener() {
        clipboardManager.addPrimaryClipChangedListener(object : ClipboardManager.OnPrimaryClipChangedListener {
            override fun onPrimaryClipChanged() {
                val clip = clipboardManager.primaryClip
                if (clip != null && clip.itemCount > 0) {
                    val text = clip.getItemAt(0).text?.toString() ?: return
                    if (text.isNotBlank()) {
                        addToHistory(text, currentDeviceId)
                        syncToOtherDevices(text)
                    }
                }
            }
        })
    }

    private fun addToHistory(text: String, sourceDevice: String) {
        val entry = ClipboardEntry(text, System.currentTimeMillis(), sourceDevice)
        clipboardHistory.add(0, entry)
        while (clipboardHistory.size > HISTORY_SIZE) clipboardHistory.removeAt(clipboardHistory.size - 1)
        saveHistory()
        if (sourceDevice != currentDeviceId) {
            Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post { Toast.makeText(context, "📋 Copied from $sourceDevice", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show() }
        }
    }

    fun getClipboardHistory(): List<ClipboardEntry> = clipboardHistory.toList()
    
    fun copyFromHistory(entry: ClipboardEntry) {
        clipboardManager.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("Copied from history", entry.text))
        Toast.makeText(context, "Copied to clipboard", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    fun pinToFavorites(entry: ClipboardEntry) {
        val index = clipboardHistory.indexOf(entry)
        if (index != -1) { clipboardHistory[index] = entry.copy(isFavorite = true); saveHistory(); Toast.makeText(context, "Pinned to favorites", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show() }
    }

    fun clearHistory() { clipboardHistory.clear(); saveHistory(); Toast.makeText(context, "Clipboard history cleared", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show() }

    private fun saveHistory() {
        val json = com.google.gson.Gson().toJson(clipboardHistory)
        prefs.edit().putString("clipboard_history", json).apply()
    }

    private fun loadHistory() {
        val json = prefs.getString("clipboard_history", "[]") ?: "[]"
        val type = object : com.google.gson.reflect.TypeToken<List<ClipboardEntry>>() {}.type
        val loaded = com.google.gson.Gson().fromJson<List<ClipboardEntry>>(json, type)
        clipboardHistory.clear()
        clipboardHistory.addAll(loaded)
    }

    private fun syncToOtherDevices(text: String) {
        if (!isSyncing) return
        scope.launch {
            try {
                val json = JSONObject().apply { put("text", text); put("device_id", currentDeviceId); put("timestamp", System.currentTimeMillis()) }
                val client = OkHttpClient.Builder().connectTimeout(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS).build()
                val body = json.toString().toRequestBody("application/json".toMediaType())
                val request = Request.Builder().url("https://api.dixie.app/clipboard/sync").post(body).build()
                client.newCall(request).execute()
            } catch (e: Exception) { }
        }
    }

    fun enableCloudSync(apiKey: String) {
        isSyncing = true
        prefs.edit().putBoolean("cloud_sync_enabled", true).putString("cloud_api_key", apiKey).apply()
        Toast.makeText(context, "Cloud clipboard sync enabled", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    fun disableCloudSync() { isSyncing = false; prefs.edit().putBoolean("cloud_sync_enabled", false).apply(); Toast.makeText(context, "Cloud clipboard sync disabled", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show() }
}

package com.dixi.launcher.gaming

import android.content.Context
import android.media.AudioManager
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.os.PowerManager
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.Toast
import com.dixi.launcher.DixieActivity

class GameModeManager(private val context: DixieActivity) {

    companion object {
        private const val PREFS_NAME = "dixie_gaming"
        
        data class GameProfile(
            val packageName: String,
            val name: String,
            val performanceMode: PerformanceMode,
            val notificationsBlocked: Boolean,
            val customMapping: CustomMapping? = null
        )
        
        enum class PerformanceMode { BALANCED, PERFORMANCE, BATTERY }
        data class CustomMapping(val touchMappings: List<TouchMapping> = emptyList(), val controllerMappings: List<ControllerMapping> = emptyList())
        data class TouchMapping(val touchX: Float, val touchY: Float, val action: String)
        data class ControllerMapping(val button: Int, val action: String)
    }

    private val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    private var isGameModeActive = false
    private var currentGameProfile: GameProfile? = null
    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    
    private var fpsCounterRunnable: Runnable? = null
    private var currentFps = 0
    private var frameCount = 0
    
    private val audioManager by lazy { context.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE) as AudioManager }
    private val powerManager by lazy { context.getSystemService(Context.POWER_SERVICE) as PowerManager }

    fun detectGame(packageName: String): Boolean {
        val gamePackages = prefs.getStringSet("detected_games", emptySet()) ?: emptySet()
        return gamePackages.contains(packageName)
    }

    fun addGame(packageName: String, name: String) {
        val games = prefs.getStringSet("detected_games", mutableSetOf())?.toMutableSet() ?: mutableSetOf()
        games.add(packageName)
        prefs.edit().putStringSet("detected_games", games).apply()
        val profile = GameProfile(packageName, name, PerformanceMode.PERFORMANCE, true)
        saveGameProfile(profile)
    }

    private fun saveGameProfile(profile: GameProfile) {
        val json = com.google.gson.Gson().toJson(profile)
        prefs.edit().putString("game_${profile.packageName}", json).apply()
    }

    fun getGameProfile(packageName: String): GameProfile? {
        val json = prefs.getString("game_${packageName}", null) ?: return null
        return com.google.gson.Gson().fromJson(json, GameProfile::class.java)
    }

    fun enableGameMode(gameProfile: GameProfile) {
        isGameModeActive = true
        currentGameProfile = gameProfile
        
        when (gameProfile.performanceMode) {
            PerformanceMode.PERFORMANCE -> enablePerformanceMode()
            PerformanceMode.BATTERY -> enableBatteryMode()
            PerformanceMode.BALANCED -> enableBalancedMode()
        }
        
        if (gameProfile.notificationsBlocked) blockNotifications()
        gameProfile.customMapping?.let { applyControllerMapping(it) }
        startFpsCounter()
        showGameModeIndicator()
        audioManager.setParameters("game_mode=true")
        Toast.makeText(context, "🎮 Game Mode Enabled: ${gameProfile.name}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    fun disableGameMode() {
        isGameModeActive = false
        currentGameProfile = null
        disablePerformanceMode()
        unblockNotifications()
        stopFpsCounter()
        hideGameModeIndicator()
        audioManager.setParameters("game_mode=false")
        Toast.makeText(context, "🎮 Game Mode Disabled", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    private fun enablePerformanceMode() {
        context.window.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON)
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.N) context.window.setColorMode(WindowManager.LayoutParams.COLOR_MODE_HDR)
    }

    private fun enableBalancedMode() { context.window.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON) }
    private fun enableBatteryMode() { context.window.clearFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON) }
    private fun disablePerformanceMode() { context.window.clearFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON) }
    private fun blockNotifications() { context.sendBroadcast(android.content.Intent("com.dixie.DISABLE_NOTIFICATIONS")) }
    private fun unblockNotifications() { context.sendBroadcast(android.content.Intent("com.dixie.ENABLE_NOTIFICATIONS")) }

    private fun startFpsCounter() {
        frameCount = 0
        currentFps = 0
        fpsCounterRunnable = object : Runnable {
            override fun run() {
                currentFps = frameCount
                frameCount = 0
                updateFpsDisplay()
                handler.postDelayed(this, 1000)
            }
        }
        handler.post(fpsCounterRunnable!!)
    }

    private fun stopFpsCounter() { fpsCounterRunnable?.let { handler.removeCallbacks(it) }; fpsCounterRunnable = null }
    fun recordFrame() { if (isGameModeActive) frameCount++ }
    
    private fun updateFpsDisplay() {
        val intent = android.content.Intent("com.dixie.FPS_UPDATE")
        intent.putExtra("fps", currentFps)
        context.sendBroadcast(intent)
    }

    private fun applyControllerMapping(mapping: GameProfile.CustomMapping) { Toast.makeText(context, "Controller mapping applied", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show() }
    private fun showGameModeIndicator() { context.sendBroadcast(android.content.Intent("com.dixie.GAME_MODE_ON")) }
    private fun hideGameModeIndicator() { context.sendBroadcast(android.content.Intent("com.dixie.GAME_MODE_OFF")) }
}
