class PhoneControlView(context: Context) : LinearLayout(context) {

    private var onTouchpadClickListener: (() -> Unit)? = null
    private var onScreenOffClickListener: (() -> Unit)? = null
    private var onNotificationClickListener: (() -> Unit)? = null
    private var onMediaControlListener: ((String) -> Unit)? = null

    init {
        orientation = VERTICAL
        setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#1E1E2E"))
        setPadding(dpToPx(24), dpToPx(24), dpToPx(24), dpToPx(24))
        setupUI()
    }

    private fun setupUI() {
        addView(TextView(context).apply { text = "DiXie Controller"; textSize = 18f; setTextColor(Color.WHITE); setTypeface(null, Typeface.BOLD); gravity = Gravity.CENTER; setPadding(0, 0, 0, dpToPx(24)) })
        addView(TextView(context).apply { text = "📺 External Display Active"; textSize = 14f; setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#A3BE8C")); gravity = Gravity.CENTER; setPadding(0, 0, 0, dpToPx(16)) })
        val gridLayout = GridLayout(context).apply { rowCount = 3; columnCount = 2; setPadding(0, 0, 0, dpToPx(16)) }
        gridLayout.addView(createQuickActionButton("🖱️", "Touchpad Mode") { onTouchpadClickListener?.invoke() })
        gridLayout.addView(createQuickActionButton("🔋", "Screen Off") { onScreenOffClickListener?.invoke() })
        gridLayout.addView(createQuickActionButton("🔔", "Notifications") { onNotificationClickListener?.invoke() })
        gridLayout.addView(createQuickActionButton("⚙️", "Settings") { })
        addView(gridLayout)
        addView(TextView(context).apply { text = "🎵 Media Controls"; textSize = 14f; setTextColor(Color.WHITE); setPadding(0, dpToPx(8), 0, dpToPx(8)) })
        val mediaControls = LinearLayout(context).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL; gravity = Gravity.CENTER }
        mediaControls.addView(createMediaButton("⏮️") { onMediaControlListener?.invoke("previous") })
        mediaControls.addView(createMediaButton("▶️/⏸️") { onMediaControlListener?.invoke("play_pause") })
        mediaControls.addView(createMediaButton("⏭️") { onMediaControlListener?.invoke("next") })
        addView(mediaControls)
        addView(TextView(context).apply { text = "Now playing: Nothing"; textSize = 12f; setTextColor(Color.GRAY); gravity = Gravity.CENTER; setPadding(0, dpToPx(16), 0, 0) })
        val statusLayout = LinearLayout(context).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL; setPadding(0, dpToPx(24), 0, 0) }
        statusLayout.addView(TextView(context).apply { text = "🔋 87%"; textSize = 12f; setTextColor(Color.GRAY); layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f) })
        statusLayout.addView(TextView(context).apply { text = android.text.format.DateFormat.format("h:mm a", System.currentTimeMillis()); textSize = 12f; setTextColor(Color.GRAY); gravity = Gravity.END; layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f) })
        addView(statusLayout)
    }

    private fun createQuickActionButton(icon: String, text: String, onClick: () -> Unit): LinearLayout = LinearLayout(context).apply {
        orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL; gravity = Gravity.CENTER; setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(12), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(12)); layoutParams = GridLayout.LayoutParams().apply { width = 0; height = LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT; columnSpec = GridLayout.spec(GridLayout.UNDEFINED, 1f); setMargins(dpToPx(8), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(8)) }; setBackgroundResource(android.R.drawable.editbox_background); setOnClickListener { onClick() }
        addView(TextView(context).apply { text = icon; textSize = 32f; gravity = Gravity.CENTER })
        addView(TextView(context).apply { text = text; textSize = 11f; setTextColor(Color.WHITE); gravity = Gravity.CENTER })
    }

    private fun createMediaButton(icon: String, onClick: () -> Unit): Button = Button(context).apply {
        text = icon; textSize = 24f; setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#3B4252")); setTextColor(Color.WHITE); setPadding(dpToPx(24), dpToPx(12), dpToPx(24), dpToPx(12)); layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f).apply { marginEnd = dpToPx(8); marginStart = dpToPx(8) }; setOnClickListener { onClick() }
    }

    fun setOnTouchpadClickListener(listener: () -> Unit) { onTouchpadClickListener = listener }
    fun setOnScreenOffClickListener(listener: () -> Unit) { onScreenOffClickListener = listener }
    fun setOnNotificationClickListener(listener: () -> Unit) { onNotificationClickListener = listener }
    fun setOnMediaControlListener(listener: (String) -> Unit) { onMediaControlListener = listener }
    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher.xodos

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Environment
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.core.content.FileProvider
import com.dixi.launcher.DixieActivity
import java.io.File

class XoDosManager(private val context: DixieActivity) {

    companion object {
        private const val XODOS_PACKAGE = "com.xodios.xodos"
        private const val XODOS_PACKAGE_ALT = "io.xodios.xodos"
        private const val WINDOWS_APPS_DIR = "/sdcard/WindowsApps/"
        private const val PREFS_NAME = "xodos_prefs"
        
        var onXoDosStatusChanged: ((Boolean, String?) -> Unit)? = null
    }

    private val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    private var cachedStatus: Boolean? = null
    private var cachedVersion: String? = null

    fun isXoDosInstalled(useCache: Boolean = true): Boolean {
        if (useCache && cachedStatus != null) return cachedStatus!!
        val status = try { context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(XODOS_PACKAGE, 0); true } catch (e: Exception) { try { context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(XODOS_PACKAGE_ALT, 0); true } catch (e2: Exception) { false } }
        cachedStatus = status
        saveStatus(status)
        if (status) { cachedVersion = getXoDosVersion(); onXoDosStatusChanged?.invoke(true, cachedVersion) } else onXoDosStatusChanged?.invoke(false, null)
        return status
    }

    fun getXoDosVersion(): String? = try { context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(XODOS_PACKAGE, 0).versionName } catch (e: Exception) { try { context.packageManager.getPackageInfo(XODOS_PACKAGE_ALT, 0).versionName } catch (e2: Exception) { null } }
    private fun saveStatus(installed: Boolean) { prefs.edit().putBoolean(KEY_XODOS_STATUS, installed).apply { if (installed) putString(KEY_XODOS_VERSION, getXoDosVersion()); putLong(KEY_LAST_CHECK, System.currentTimeMillis()) } }

    fun promptInstallation(callback: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null) {
        android.app.AlertDialog.Builder(context).setTitle("🎮 Windows App Support").setMessage("XoDos lets you run Windows apps and games on your device.\n\n• Play PC games on your phone\n• Run Windows applications\n• Full Linux desktop included\n\nSize: ~1.9GB").setItems(arrayOf("📥 Download XoDos (Recommended)", "🌐 Open XoDos GitHub Page", "📦 I already have XoDos APK", "⏭️ Remind me later", "❌ Don't ask again")) { _, which -> when (which) { 0 -> downloadAndInstallXoDos(callback); 1 -> openGitHubPage(); 2 -> promptForExistingApk(callback); 3 -> remindLater(); 4 -> neverAskAgain() } }.show()
    }

    private fun downloadAndInstallXoDos(callback: ((Boolean) -> Unit)?) { val pd = android.app.ProgressDialog(context).apply { setTitle("📦 Preparing XoDos"); setMessage("Fetching latest version..."); setProgressStyle(android.app.ProgressDialog.STYLE_HORIZONTAL); setCancelable(false); show() }; XoDosDownloader(context).download { success, apkFile -> pd.dismiss(); if (success && apkFile != null) installApk(apkFile, callback) else { Toast.makeText(context, "Download failed. Please try again.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show(); callback?.invoke(false) } } }
    private fun installApk(apkFile: File, callback: ((Boolean) -> Unit)?) { try { val uri = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.N) FileProvider.getUriForFile(context, "${context.packageName}.fileprovider", apkFile) else Uri.fromFile(apkFile); context.startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW).apply { setDataAndType(uri, "application/vnd.android.package-archive"); addFlags(Intent.FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION); addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK) }); monitorInstallation(callback) } catch (e: Exception) { Toast.makeText(context, "Cannot open installer: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show(); callback?.invoke(false) } }
    private fun monitorInstallation(callback: ((Boolean) -> Unit)?) { val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()); var attempts = 0; handler.postDelayed(object : Runnable { override fun run() { attempts++; if (isXoDosInstalled(false)) { onXoDosInstalled(); callback?.invoke(true); Toast.makeText(context, "✅ XoDos installed successfully!", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show() } else if (attempts < 60) handler.postDelayed(this, 2000) else callback?.invoke(false) } }, 5000) }
    private fun promptForExistingApk(callback: ((Boolean) -> Unit)?) { val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT).apply { addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE); type = "application/vnd.android.package-archive" }; (context as? DixieActivity)?.startActivityForResult(intent, 1001) }
    private fun openGitHubPage() { context.startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse("https://github.com/Muyideen-Zakariya/XoDos/releases"))) }
    private fun remindLater() { Toast.makeText(context, "You can install XoDos anytime from Settings → Windows Apps", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show() }
    private fun neverAskAgain() { prefs.edit().putBoolean("skip_xodos_prompt", true).apply(); Toast.makeText(context, "XoDos prompt disabled. Enable in Settings to re-enable.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show() }
    private fun onXoDosInstalled() { createWindowsAppsDirectory(); refreshUI(); showPostInstallationGuide() }
    private fun createWindowsAppsDirectory() { File(WINDOWS_APPS_DIR).mkdirs() }
    private fun refreshUI() { (context as? DixieActivity)?.refreshWindowsFeatures(); context.sendBroadcast(Intent("com.dixie.XODOS_INSTALLED")) }
    private fun showPostInstallationGuide() { android.app.AlertDialog.Builder(context).setTitle("🎉 XoDos is Ready!").setMessage("To run Windows apps:\n\n1. Place .exe files in:\n   /sdcard/WindowsApps/\n\n2. Open the Windows app menu from your dock\n\n3. Tap any .exe to run it!").setPositiveButton("Got it!") { _, _ -> (context as? DixieActivity)?.showWindowsAppsMenu() }.setNeutralButton("Later", null).show() }
    fun launchWindowsApp(exePath: String): Boolean { if (!isXoDosInstalled()) { promptInstallation(); return false }; return try { context.startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW).apply { setDataAndType(Uri.fromFile(File(exePath)), "application/x-ms-dos-executable"); setPackage(XODOS_PACKAGE); addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK) }); true } catch (e: Exception) { try { context.startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW).apply { setDataAndType(Uri.fromFile(File(exePath)), "application/x-ms-dos-executable"); setPackage(XODOS_PACKAGE_ALT); addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK) }); true } catch (e2: Exception) { Toast.makeText(context, "Cannot launch app. XoDos may need to be opened once first.", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show(); false } } }
    fun launchXoDosDirectly() { if (!isXoDosInstalled()) { promptInstallation(); return }; try { context.startActivity(context.packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(XODOS_PACKAGE) ?: context.packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(XODOS_PACKAGE_ALT)) } catch (e: Exception) { Toast.makeText(context, "Cannot open XoDos", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show() } }
    fun scanForWindowsApps(): List<WindowsAppInfo> { val apps = mutableListOf<WindowsAppInfo>(); val dir = File(WINDOWS_APPS_DIR); if (!dir.exists() || !isXoDosInstalled()) return emptyList(); dir.listFiles()?.filter { it.extension.equals("exe", ignoreCase = true) }?.forEach { apps.add(WindowsAppInfo(it.nameWithoutExtension, it.absolutePath, it.length(), it.lastModified())) }; dir.listFiles()?.filter { it.isDirectory }?.forEach { subDir -> subDir.listFiles()?.filter { it.extension.equals("exe", ignoreCase = true) }?.forEach { apps.add(WindowsAppInfo("${subDir.name} - ${it.nameWithoutExtension}", it.absolutePath, it.length(), it.lastModified())) } }; return apps.sortedBy { it.name } }
    data class WindowsAppInfo(val name: String, val path: String, val size: Long, val lastModified: Long)
    companion object { private const val KEY_XODOS_STATUS = "xodos_installed_status"; private const val KEY_XODOS_VERSION = "xodos_version"; private const val KEY_LAST_CHECK = "last_check_time" }
}

class XoDosDownloader(private val context: Context) {
    fun download(callback: (Boolean, File?) -> Unit) { Thread { try { val conn = java.net.URL("https://api.github.com/repos/Muyideen-Zakariya/XoDos/releases/latest").openConnection() as java.net.HttpURLConnection; val response = conn.inputStream.bufferedReader().readText(); val match = Regex("\"browser_download_url\":\"([^\"]+\\.apk)\"").find(response); val url = match?.groupValues?.get(1) ?: "https://github.com/Muyideen-Zakariya/XoDos/releases/download/v5.9.0/XoDos-v5.9.0.apk"; downloadFile(url, callback) } catch (e: Exception) { callback(false, null) } }.start() }
    private fun downloadFile(url: String, callback: (Boolean, File?) -> Unit) { try { val outputFile = File(Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS), "XoDos_installer.apk"); val conn = java.net.URL(url).openConnection() as java.net.HttpURLConnection; conn.inputStream.use { input -> outputFile.outputStream().use { output -> input.copyTo(output) } }; callback(true, outputFile) } catch (e: Exception) { callback(false, null) } }
}

Step 2: Create MacOSDock.kt
Location: C:\DiXie\app\src\main\java\com\dixi\launcher\MacOSDock.kt

Create file: Right-click on com.dixi.launcher → New → Kotlin Class → Name: MacOSDock

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.animation.ValueAnimator
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.view.animation.AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat

class MacOSDock(context: Context) : LinearLayout(context) {

    private val dockItems = mutableListOf<DockItem>()
    private val animators = mutableMapOf<View, ValueAnimator>()

    data class DockItem(
        val icon: Int,
        val label: String,
        val onClick: () -> Unit
    )

    init {
        orientation = HORIZONTAL
        gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8))
        setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.dock_background)
        elevation = dpToPx(8).toFloat()
        
        setupMagnificationEffect()
    }

    private fun setupMagnificationEffect() {
        setOnTouchListener(object : View.OnTouchListener {
            private var hoverView: View? = null

            override fun onTouch(v: View?, event: MotionEvent?): Boolean {
                when (event?.action) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                        for (i in 0 until childCount) {
                            val child = getChildAt(i)
                            val location = IntArray(2)
                            child.getLocationOnScreen(location)
                            val childRect = android.graphics.Rect(
                                location[0],
                                location[1],
                                location[0] + child.width,
                                location[1] + child.height
                            )
                            
                            if (childRect.contains(event.rawX.toInt(), event.rawY.toInt())) {
                                if (hoverView != child) {
                                    hoverView?.let { animateIconScale(it, false) }
                                    hoverView = child
                                    animateIconScale(child, true)
                                }
                                return true
                            }
                        }
                        hoverView?.let { 
                            animateIconScale(it, false)
                            hoverView = null
                        }
                    }
                }
                return false
            }
        })
    }

    private fun animateIconScale(view: View, magnify: Boolean) {
        val targetScale = if (magnify) 1.3f else 1.0f
        
        val animator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(view.scaleX, targetScale).apply {
            duration = 150
            interpolator = AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator()
            addUpdateListener {
                val scale = it.animatedValue as Float
                view.scaleX = scale
                view.scaleY = scale
                view.elevation = if (magnify) dpToPx(16).toFloat() else dpToPx(4).toFloat()
            }
            start()
        }
        
        animators[view]?.cancel()
        animators[view] = animator
    }

    fun addApp(iconRes: Int, label: String, onClick: () -> Unit) {
        val container = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setPadding(dpToPx(8), dpToPx(4), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(4))
            setOnClickListener { onClick() }
        }
        
        val iconView = ImageView(context).apply {
            setImageResource(iconRes)
            setColorFilter(Color.WHITE)
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(dpToPx(48), dpToPx(48))
        }
        
        val labelView = TextView(context).apply {
            text = label
            textSize = 10f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            visibility = GONE
            alpha = 0f
        }
        
        container.addView(iconView)
        container.addView(labelView)
        
        // Show label on hover
        container.setOnHoverListener { _, event ->
            when (event.action) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_ENTER -> {
                    labelView.visibility = VISIBLE
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(1f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .start()
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_EXIT -> {
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(0f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .withEndAction {
                            labelView.visibility = GONE
                        }
                        .start()
                }
            }
            false
        }
        
        addView(container)
        dockItems.add(DockItem(iconRes, label, onClick))
    }

    fun clear() {
        removeAllViews()
        dockItems.clear()
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}
Step 3: Update DixieActivity.kt
Location: C:\DiXie\app\src\main\java\com\dixi\launcher\DixieActivity.kt

Replace the entire file:

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat

class DixieActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    companion object {
        private const val PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE = 1001
    }

    private lateinit var rootContainer: FrameLayout
    private lateinit var dock: MacOSDock

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        
        // Full screen immersive mode
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS
        )
        
        // Create root container
        rootContainer = FrameLayout(this)
        rootContainer.setBackgroundColor(android.graphics.Color.parseColor("#1A1A2E"))
        setContentView(rootContainer)
        
        checkPermissions()
    }

    private fun checkPermissions() {
        val permissionsNeeded = mutableListOf<String>()

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
            if (!Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
                permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW)
            }
        }

        if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
        }

        if (permissionsNeeded.isNotEmpty()) {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, permissionsNeeded.toTypedArray(), PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE)
        } else {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(
        requestCode: Int,
        permissions: Array<out String>,
        grantResults: IntArray
    ) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE) {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    private fun onPermissionsGranted() {
        showWelcomeMessage()
        setupDock()
    }

    private fun showWelcomeMessage() {
        Toast.makeText(this, "✨ Welcome to DiXie! ✨", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
    }

    private fun setupDock() {
        dock = MacOSDock(this)
        val dockParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            dpToPx(72)
        ).apply {
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.BOTTOM
            bottomMargin = dpToPx(8)
        }
        rootContainer.addView(dock, dockParams)
        
        // Add apps to dock
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_edit, "Notes") {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Notes app coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery, "Photos") {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Photos app coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_call, "Phone") {

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.*

class MenuBarView(context: Context) : LinearLayout(context) {

    private val leftSection = LinearLayout(context)
    private val rightSection = LinearLayout(context)
    private val clockView = TextView(context)
    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private lateinit var timeRunnable: Runnable

    init {
        orientation = HORIZONTAL
        gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
        setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#CC1A1A2E"))
        setPadding(dpToPx(16), 0, dpToPx(16), 0)
        
        setupSections()
        setupClock()
        setupMenuItems()
    }

    private fun setupSections() {
        leftSection.layoutParams = LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 1f)
        rightSection.layoutParams = LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 1f)
        rightSection.gravity = Gravity.END
        
        addView(leftSection)
        addView(rightSection)
    }

    private fun setupClock() {
        clockView.apply {
            textSize = 13f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(12), 0, 0, 0)
        }
        rightSection.addView(clockView)
        
        timeRunnable = object : Runnable {
            override fun run() {
                val sdf = SimpleDateFormat("EEE MMM d  h:mm a", Locale.getDefault())
                clockView.text = sdf.format(Date())
                handler.postDelayed(this, 1000)
            }
        }
        handler.post(timeRunnable)
    }

    private fun setupMenuItems() {
        // Apple logo
        val appleLogo = TextView(context).apply {
            text = ""
            textSize = 18f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(16), 0, dpToPx(16), 0)
            setOnClickListener {
                android.widget.Toast.makeText(context, "DiXie Menu", android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
        leftSection.addView(appleLogo)
        
        // Menu items
        val menuItems = listOf("Finder", "File", "Edit", "View", "Window", "Help")
        menuItems.forEach { item ->
            val menuItem = TextView(context).apply {
                text = item
                textSize = 13f
                setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                setPadding(dpToPx(12), 0, dpToPx(12), 0)
                setOnClickListener {
                    android.widget.Toast.makeText(context, "$item menu", android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
            leftSection.addView(menuItem)
        }
    }

    fun addRightView(view: View) {
        rightSection.addView(view, rightSection.childCount - 1)
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat

class DixieActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    companion object {
        private const val PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE = 1001
    }

    private lateinit var rootContainer: FrameLayout
    private lateinit var dock: MacOSDock
    private lateinit var menuBar: MenuBarView

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        
        // Full screen immersive mode
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS
        )
        
        // Create root container
        rootContainer = FrameLayout(this)
        rootContainer.setBackgroundColor(android.graphics.Color.parseColor("#1A1A2E"))
        setContentView(rootContainer)
        
        checkPermissions()
    }

    private fun checkPermissions() {
        val permissionsNeeded = mutableListOf<String>()

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
            if (!Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
                permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW)
            }
        }

        if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
        }

        if (permissionsNeeded.isNotEmpty()) {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, permissionsNeeded.toTypedArray(), PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE)
        } else {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(
        requestCode: Int,
        permissions: Array<out String>,
        grantResults: IntArray
    ) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE) {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    private fun onPermissionsGranted() {
        showWelcomeMessage()
        setupMenuBar()
        setupDock()
    }

    private fun showWelcomeMessage() {
        Toast.makeText(this, "✨ Welcome to DiXie! ✨", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
    }

    private fun setupMenuBar() {
        menuBar = MenuBarView(this)
        val menuParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            dpToPx(32)
        ).apply {
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.TOP
        }
        rootContainer.addView(menuBar, menuParams)
    }

    private fun setupDock() {
        dock = MacOSDock(this)
        val dockParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            dpToPx(72)
        ).apply {
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.BOTTOM
            bottomMargin = dpToPx(8)
        }
        rootContainer.addView(dock, dockParams)
        
        // Add apps to dock
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_edit, "Notes") {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Notes app coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery, "Photos") {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Photos app coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_call, "Phone") {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Phone app coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_send, "Messages") {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Messages app coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_preferences, "Settings") {
            startActivity(android.content.Intent(android.provider.Settings.ACTION_SETTINGS))
        }
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.animation.ValueAnimator
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.view.animation.AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView

class MacOSDock(context: Context) : LinearLayout(context) {

    private val dockItems = mutableListOf<DockItem>()
    private val animators = mutableMapOf<View, ValueAnimator>()

    data class DockItem(
        val icon: Int,
        val label: String,
        val onClick: () -> Unit
    )

    init {
        orientation = HORIZONTAL
        gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(6), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(6))
        
        // Frosted glass background
        background = GradientDrawable().apply {
            setColor(Color.parseColor("#CC1A1A2E"))
            cornerRadius = dpToPx(28).toFloat()
        }
        
        elevation = dpToPx(12).toFloat()
        
        setupMagnificationEffect()
    }

    private fun setupMagnificationEffect() {
        setOnTouchListener(object : View.OnTouchListener {
            private var hoverView: View? = null

            override fun onTouch(v: View?, event: MotionEvent?): Boolean {
                when (event?.action) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                        for (i in 0 until childCount) {
                            val child = getChildAt(i)
                            val location = IntArray(2)
                            child.getLocationOnScreen(location)
                            val childRect = android.graphics.Rect(
                                location[0],
                                location[1],
                                location[0] + child.width,
                                location[1] + child.height
                            )
                            
                            if (childRect.contains(event.rawX.toInt(), event.rawY.toInt())) {
                                if (hoverView != child) {
                                    hoverView?.let { animateIconScale(it, false) }
                                    hoverView = child
                                    animateIconScale(child, true)
                                }
                                return true
                            }
                        }
                        hoverView?.let { 
                            animateIconScale(it, false)
                            hoverView = null
                        }
                    }
                }
                return false
            }
        })
    }

    private fun animateIconScale(view: View, magnify: Boolean) {
        val targetScale = if (magnify) 1.2f else 1.0f
        
        val animator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(view.scaleX, targetScale).apply {
            duration = 150
            interpolator = AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator()
            addUpdateListener {
                val scale = it.animatedValue as Float
                view.scaleX = scale
                view.scaleY = scale
                view.elevation = if (magnify) dpToPx(16).toFloat() else dpToPx(4).toFloat()
            }
            start()
        }
        
        animators[view]?.cancel()
        animators[view] = animator
    }

    fun addApp(iconRes: Int, label: String, onClick: () -> Unit) {
        val container = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setPadding(dpToPx(6), dpToPx(4), dpToPx(6), dpToPx(4))
            setOnClickListener { onClick() }
        }
        
        // Smaller icon size (36dp instead of 48dp)
        val iconView = ImageView(context).apply {
            setImageResource(iconRes)
            setColorFilter(Color.WHITE)
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(dpToPx(36), dpToPx(36))
        }
        
        val labelView = TextView(context).apply {
            text = label
            textSize = 9f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            visibility = GONE
            alpha = 0f
        }
        
        container.addView(iconView)
        container.addView(labelView)
        
        // Show label on hover
        container.setOnHoverListener { _, event ->
            when (event.action) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_ENTER -> {
                    labelView.visibility = VISIBLE
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(1f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .start()
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_EXIT -> {
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(0f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .withEndAction {
                            labelView.visibility = GONE
                        }
                        .start()
                }
            }
            false
        }
        
        addView(container)
        dockItems.add(DockItem(iconRes, label, onClick))
    }

    fun clear() {
        removeAllViews()
        dockItems.clear()
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

    private fun showFinderMenu() {
        Toast.makeText(context, "Finder - File Manager coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()

    private fun showFileMenu() {
        val popup = PopupMenu(context, leftSection)
        popup.menu.add("New Folder")
        popup.menu.add("New File")
        popup.menu.add("Open")
        popup.menu.add("Close Window")

        }

    }

    private fun showEditMenu() {
        val popup = PopupMenu(context, leftSection)
        popup.menu.add("Undo")
        popup.menu.add("Redo")
        popup.menu.add("Cut")
        popup.menu.add("Copy")
        popup.menu.add("Paste")

            true
        }
        popup.show()
    }

        popup.menu.add("Show Dock")
        popup.menu.add("Show Menu Bar")
        popup.menu.add("Enter Full Screen")

            true
        }

    private fun showWindowMenu() {

        popup.menu.add("Minimize")
        popup.menu.add("Zoom")
        popup.menu.add("Cycle Through Windows")
        popup.setOnMenuItemClickListener { item ->
            Toast.makeText(context, "${item.title} coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            true
        }
        popup.show()
    }

    private fun showHelpMenu() {
        val popup = PopupMenu(context, leftSection)
        popup.menu.add("DiXie Help")
        popup.menu.add("Keyboard Shortcuts")
        popup.menu.add("Report an Issue")
        popup.setOnMenuItemClickListener { item ->
            Toast.makeText(context, "${item.title} coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            true
        }
        popup.show()
    }

    private fun showAboutDialog() {
        android.app.AlertDialog.Builder(context)
            .setTitle("About DiXie")
            .setMessage("""
                DiXie v1.0
                
                Desktop + X factor + Friendly
                
                "DeX + Bixby. One app."
                
                Desktop mode and voice commands
                for ANY Android phone.
            """.trimIndent())
            .setPositiveButton("OK", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun openSystemSettings() {
        val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_SETTINGS)
        context.startActivity(intent)
    }

    private fun lockScreen() {
        val devicePolicyManager = context.getSystemService(Context.DEVICE_POLICY_SERVICE) as android.app.admin.DevicePolicyManager
        devicePolicyManager.lockNow()
    }

    fun addRightView(view: View) {
        rightSection.addView(view, rightSection.childCount - 1)
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

Step 2: Create MacOSDock.kt

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.animation.ValueAnimator
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.view.animation.AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat

class MacOSDock(context: Context) : LinearLayout(context) {

    private val dockItems = mutableListOf<DockItem>()
    private val animators = mutableMapOf<View, ValueAnimator>()

    data class DockItem(
        val icon: Int,
        val label: String,
        val onClick: () -> Unit
    )

    init {
        orientation = HORIZONTAL
        gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8))
        setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.dock_background)
        elevation = dpToPx(8).toFloat()
        
        setupMagnificationEffect()
    }

    private fun setupMagnificationEffect() {
        setOnTouchListener(object : View.OnTouchListener {
            private var hoverView: View? = null

            override fun onTouch(v: View?, event: MotionEvent?): Boolean {
                when (event?.action) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                        for (i in 0 until childCount) {
                            val child = getChildAt(i)
                            val location = IntArray(2)
                            child.getLocationOnScreen(location)
                            val childRect = android.graphics.Rect(
                                location[0],
                                location[1],
                                location[0] + child.width,
                                location[1] + child.height
                            )
                            
                            if (childRect.contains(event.rawX.toInt(), event.rawY.toInt())) {
                                if (hoverView != child) {
                                    hoverView?.let { animateIconScale(it, false) }
                                    hoverView = child
                                    animateIconScale(child, true)
                                }
                                return true
                            }
                        }
                        hoverView?.let { 
                            animateIconScale(it, false)
                            hoverView = null
                        }
                    }
                }
                return false
            }
        })
    }

    private fun animateIconScale(view: View, magnify: Boolean) {
        val targetScale = if (magnify) 1.3f else 1.0f
        
        val animator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(view.scaleX, targetScale).apply {
            duration = 150
            interpolator = AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator()
            addUpdateListener {
                val scale = it.animatedValue as Float
                view.scaleX = scale
                view.scaleY = scale
                view.elevation = if (magnify) dpToPx(16).toFloat() else dpToPx(4).toFloat()
            }
            start()
        }
        
        animators[view]?.cancel()
        animators[view] = animator
    }

    fun addApp(iconRes: Int, label: String, onClick: () -> Unit) {
        val container = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setPadding(dpToPx(8), dpToPx(4), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(4))
            setOnClickListener { onClick() }
        }
        
        val iconView = ImageView(context).apply {
            setImageResource(iconRes)
            setColorFilter(Color.WHITE)
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(dpToPx(48), dpToPx(48))
        }
        
        val labelView = TextView(context).apply {
            text = label
            textSize = 10f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            visibility = GONE
            alpha = 0f
        }
        
        container.addView(iconView)
        container.addView(labelView)
        
        // Show label on hover
        container.setOnHoverListener { _, event ->
            when (event.action) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_ENTER -> {
                    labelView.visibility = VISIBLE
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(1f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .start()
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_EXIT -> {
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(0f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .withEndAction {
                            labelView.visibility = GONE
                        }
                        .start()
                }
            }
            false
        }
        
        addView(container)
        dockItems.add(DockItem(iconRes, label, onClick))
    }

    fun clear() {
        removeAllViews()
        dockItems.clear()
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}
Step 3: Update DixieActivity.kt
Location: C:\DiXie\app\src\main\java\com\dixi\launcher\DixieActivity.kt

Replace the entire file:

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat

class DixieActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    companion object {
        private const val PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE = 1001
    }

    private lateinit var rootContainer: FrameLayout
    private lateinit var dock: MacOSDock

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        
        // Full screen immersive mode
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS
        )
        
        // Create root container
        rootContainer = FrameLayout(this)
        rootContainer.setBackgroundColor(android.graphics.Color.parseColor("#1A1A2E"))
        setContentView(rootContainer)
        
        checkPermissions()
    }

    private fun checkPermissions() {
        val permissionsNeeded = mutableListOf<String>()

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
            if (!Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
                permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW)
            }
        }

        if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
        }

        if (permissionsNeeded.isNotEmpty()) {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, permissionsNeeded.toTypedArray(), PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE)
        } else {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(
        requestCode: Int,
        permissions: Array<out String>,
        grantResults: IntArray
    ) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE) {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    private fun onPermissionsGranted() {
        showWelcomeMessage()
        setupDock()
    }

    private fun showWelcomeMessage() {
        Toast.makeText(this, "✨ Welcome to DiXie! ✨", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
    }

    private fun setupDock() {
        dock = MacOSDock(this)
        val dockParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            dpToPx(72)
        ).apply {
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.BOTTOM
            bottomMargin = dpToPx(8)
        }
        rootContainer.addView(dock, dockParams)
        
        // Add apps to dock
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_edit, "Notes") {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Notes app coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery, "Photos") {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Photos app coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_call, "Phone") {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Phone app coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_send, "Messages") {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Messages app coming soon", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_preferences, "Settings") {
            startActivity(android.content.Intent(android.provider.Settings.ACTION_SETTINGS))
        }
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

Create file: Right-click on com.dixi.launcher → New → Kotlin Class → Name: MenuBarView

Paste this:

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.*

class MenuBarView(context: Context) : LinearLayout(context) {

    private val leftSection = LinearLayout(context)
    private val rightSection = LinearLayout(context)
    private val clockView = TextView(context)
    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private lateinit var timeRunnable: Runnable

    init {
        orientation = HORIZONTAL
        gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
        setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#CC1A1A2E"))
        setPadding(dpToPx(16), 0, dpToPx(16), 0)
        
        setupSections()
        setupClock()
        setupMenuItems()
    }

    private fun setupSections() {
        leftSection.layoutParams = LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 1f)
        rightSection.layoutParams = LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 1f)
        rightSection.gravity = Gravity.END
        
        addView(leftSection)
        addView(rightSection)
    }

    private fun setupClock() {
        clockView.apply {
            textSize = 13f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(12), 0, 0, 0)
        }
        rightSection.addView(clockView)
        
        timeRunnable = object : Runnable {
            override fun run() {
                val sdf = SimpleDateFormat("EEE MMM d  h:mm a", Locale.getDefault())
                clockView.text = sdf.format(Date())
                handler.postDelayed(this, 1000)
            }
        }
        handler.post(timeRunnable)
    }

    private fun setupMenuItems() {
        // Apple logo
        val appleLogo = TextView(context).apply {
            text = ""
            textSize = 18f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(16), 0, dpToPx(16), 0)
            setOnClickListener {
                android.widget.Toast.makeText(context, "DiXie Menu", android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        }
        leftSection.addView(appleLogo)
        
        // Menu items
        val menuItems = listOf("Finder", "File", "Edit", "View", "Window", "Help")
        menuItems.forEach { item ->
            val menuItem = TextView(context).apply {
                text = item
                textSize = 13f
                setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                setPadding(dpToPx(12), 0, dpToPx(12), 0)
                setOnClickListener {
                    android.widget.Toast.makeText(context, "$item menu", android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
            leftSection.addView(menuItem)
        }
    }

    fun addRightView(view: View) {
        rightSection.addView(view, rightSection.childCount - 1)
    }

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.animation.ValueAnimator
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.view.animation.AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView

class MacOSDock(context: Context) : LinearLayout(context) {

    private val dockItems = mutableListOf<DockItem>()
    private val animators = mutableMapOf<View, ValueAnimator>()

    data class DockItem(
        val icon: Int,
        val label: String,
        val onClick: () -> Unit
    )

    init {
        orientation = HORIZONTAL
        gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(6), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(6))
        
        // Frosted glass background
        background = GradientDrawable().apply {
            setColor(Color.parseColor("#CC1A1A2E"))
            cornerRadius = dpToPx(28).toFloat()
        }
        
        elevation = dpToPx(12).toFloat()
        
        setupMagnificationEffect()
    }

    private fun setupMagnificationEffect() {
        setOnTouchListener(object : View.OnTouchListener {
            private var hoverView: View? = null

            override fun onTouch(v: View?, event: MotionEvent?): Boolean {
                when (event?.action) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                        for (i in 0 until childCount) {
                            val child = getChildAt(i)
                            val location = IntArray(2)
                            child.getLocationOnScreen(location)
                            val childRect = android.graphics.Rect(
                                location[0],
                                location[1],
                                location[0] + child.width,
                                location[1] + child.height
                            )
                            
                            if (childRect.contains(event.rawX.toInt(), event.rawY.toInt())) {
                                if (hoverView != child) {
                                    hoverView?.let { animateIconScale(it, false) }
                                    hoverView = child
                                    animateIconScale(child, true)
                                }
                                return true
                            }
                        }
                        hoverView?.let { 
                            animateIconScale(it, false)
                            hoverView = null
                        }
                    }
                }
                return false
            }
        })
    }

    private fun animateIconScale(view: View, magnify: Boolean) {
        val targetScale = if (magnify) 1.2f else 1.0f
        
        val animator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(view.scaleX, targetScale).apply {
            duration = 150
            interpolator = AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator()
            addUpdateListener {
                val scale = it.animatedValue as Float
                view.scaleX = scale
                view.scaleY = scale
                view.elevation = if (magnify) dpToPx(16).toFloat() else dpToPx(4).toFloat()
            }
            start()
        }
        
        animators[view]?.cancel()
        animators[view] = animator
    }

    fun addApp(iconRes: Int, label: String, onClick: () -> Unit) {
        val container = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setPadding(dpToPx(6), dpToPx(4), dpToPx(6), dpToPx(4))
            setOnClickListener { onClick() }
        }
        
        // Smaller icon size (36dp instead of 48dp)
        val iconView = ImageView(context).apply {
            setImageResource(iconRes)
            setColorFilter(Color.WHITE)
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(dpToPx(36), dpToPx(36))
        }
        
        val labelView = TextView(context).apply {
            text = label
            textSize = 9f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            visibility = GONE
            alpha = 0f
        }
        
        container.addView(iconView)
        container.addView(labelView)
        
        // Show label on hover
        container.setOnHoverListener { _, event ->
            when (event.action) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_ENTER -> {
                    labelView.visibility = VISIBLE
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(1f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .start()
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_EXIT -> {
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(0f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .withEndAction {
                            labelView.visibility = GONE
                        }
                        .start()
                }
            }
            false
        }
        
        addView(container)
        dockItems.add(DockItem(iconRes, label, onClick))
    }

    fun clear() {
        removeAllViews()
        dockItems.clear()
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.PopupMenu
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.*

class MenuBarView(context: Context) : LinearLayout(context) {

    private val leftSection = LinearLayout(context)
    private val rightSection = LinearLayout(context)
    private val clockView = TextView(context)
    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private lateinit var timeRunnable: Runnable

    init {
        orientation = HORIZONTAL
        gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
        setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#CC1A1A2E"))
        setPadding(dpToPx(16), 0, dpToPx(16), 0)
        
        setupSections()
        setupClock()
        setupMenuItems()
    }

    private fun setupSections() {
        leftSection.layoutParams = LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 1f)
        rightSection.layoutParams = LayoutParams(0, LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, 1f)
        rightSection.gravity = Gravity.END
        
        addView(leftSection)
        addView(rightSection)
    }

    private fun setupClock() {
        clockView.apply {
            textSize = 13f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(12), 0, 0, 0)
        }
        rightSection.addView(clockView)
        
        timeRunnable = object : Runnable {
            override fun run() {
                val sdf = SimpleDateFormat("EEE MMM d  h:mm a", Locale.getDefault())
                clockView.text = sdf.format(Date())
                handler.postDelayed(this, 1000)
            }
        }
        handler.post(timeRunnable)
    }

    private fun setupMenuItems() {
        // Apple logo with popup menu
        val appleLogo = TextView(context).apply {
            text = ""
            textSize = 18f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(16), 0, dpToPx(16), 0)
            setOnClickListener { showAppleMenu() }
        }

        // Finder

            text = "Finder"
            textSize = 13f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(12), 0, dpToPx(12), 0)
            setOnClickListener { showFinderMenu() }
        }
        leftSection.addView(finder)
        
        // File
        val file = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "File"
            textSize = 13f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(12), 0, dpToPx(12), 0)
            setOnClickListener { showFileMenu() }
        }
        leftSection.addView(file)
        
        // Edit
        val edit = TextView(context).apply {
            text = "Edit"
            textSize = 13f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(12), 0, dpToPx(12), 0)
            setOnClickListener { showEditMenu() }
        }
        leftSection.addView(edit)
        
        // View

            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)

            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            setPadding(dpToPx(12), 0, dpToPx(12), 0)
            setOnClickListener { showHelpMenu() }
        }
        leftSection.addView(help)
    }

    private fun showAppleMenu() {
        val popup = PopupMenu(context, leftSection.getChildAt(0))
        popup.menu.add("About DiXie")
        popup.menu.add("System Settings")
        popup.menu.add("Lock Screen")

    }

    fun addRightView(view: View) {
        rightSection.addView(view, rightSection.childCount - 1)
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.animation.ValueAnimator
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.view.animation.AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView

class MacOSDock(context: Context) : LinearLayout(context) {

    private val dockItems = mutableListOf<DockItem>()
    private val animators = mutableMapOf<View, ValueAnimator>()

    data class DockItem(
        val icon: Int,
        val label: String,
        val onClick: () -> Unit
    )

    init {
        orientation = HORIZONTAL
        gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        setPadding(dpToPx(20), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(20), dpToPx(8))
        
        // Frosted glass effect with visible color (semi-transparent white/blue)
        background = GradientDrawable().apply {
            setColor(Color.parseColor("#CC3B4252"))  // Lighter than background
            cornerRadius = dpToPx(32).toFloat()
        }
        
        // Add a subtle border to make dock visible
        setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.dock_background)
        
        elevation = dpToPx(16).toFloat()
        
        setupMagnificationEffect()
    }

    private fun setupMagnificationEffect() {
        setOnTouchListener(object : View.OnTouchListener {
            private var hoverView: View? = null

            override fun onTouch(v: View?, event: MotionEvent?): Boolean {
                when (event?.action) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                        for (i in 0 until childCount) {
                            val child = getChildAt(i)
                            val location = IntArray(2)
                            child.getLocationOnScreen(location)
                            val childRect = android.graphics.Rect(
                                location[0],
                                location[1],
                                location[0] + child.width,
                                location[1] + child.height
                            )
                            
                            if (childRect.contains(event.rawX.toInt(), event.rawY.toInt())) {
                                if (hoverView != child) {
                                    hoverView?.let { animateIconScale(it, false) }
                                    hoverView = child
                                    animateIconScale(child, true)
                                }
                                return true
                            }
                        }
                        hoverView?.let { 
                            animateIconScale(it, false)
                            hoverView = null
                        }
                    }
                }
                return false
            }
        })
    }

    private fun animateIconScale(view: View, magnify: Boolean) {
        val targetScale = if (magnify) 1.25f else 1.0f
        
        val animator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(view.scaleX, targetScale).apply {
            duration = 150
            interpolator = AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator()
            addUpdateListener {
                val scale = it.animatedValue as Float
                view.scaleX = scale
                view.scaleY = scale
                view.elevation = if (magnify) dpToPx(20).toFloat() else dpToPx(4).toFloat()
            }
            start()
        }
        
        animators[view]?.cancel()
        animators[view] = animator
    }

    fun addApp(iconRes: Int, label: String, onClick: () -> Unit) {
        val container = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setPadding(dpToPx(8), dpToPx(4), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(4))
            setOnClickListener { onClick() }
        }
        
        val iconView = ImageView(context).apply {
            setImageResource(iconRes)
            setColorFilter(Color.WHITE)
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(dpToPx(40), dpToPx(40))
        }
        
        val labelView = TextView(context).apply {
            text = label
            textSize = 10f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            visibility = GONE
            alpha = 0f
        }
        
        container.addView(iconView)
        container.addView(labelView)
        
        // Show label on hover
        container.setOnHoverListener { _, event ->
            when (event.action) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_ENTER -> {
                    labelView.visibility = VISIBLE
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(1f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .start()
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_EXIT -> {
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(0f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .withEndAction {
                            labelView.visibility = GONE
                        }
                        .start()
                }
            }
            false
        }
        
        addView(container)
        dockItems.add(DockItem(iconRes, label, onClick))
    }

    fun clear() {
        removeAllViews()
        dockItems.clear()
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.content.res.Configuration
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat

class DixieActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    companion object {
        private const val PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE = 1001
    }

    private lateinit var rootContainer: FrameLayout
    private lateinit var dock: MacOSDock
    private lateinit var menuBar: MenuBarView

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        
        // Force landscape orientation
        requestedOrientation = android.content.pm.ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
        
        // FULL SCREEN IMMERSIVE - Hides status bar and navigation bar
        hideSystemUI()
        
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS
        )
        
        // Create root container
        rootContainer = FrameLayout(this)
        rootContainer.setBackgroundColor(android.graphics.Color.parseColor("#1A1A2E"))
        setContentView(rootContainer)
        
        checkPermissions()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        hideSystemUI()
    }

    private fun hideSystemUI() {
        window.decorView.systemUiVisibility = (
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE or
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN or
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_FULLSCREEN or
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
        )
    }

    override fun onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus: Boolean) {
        super.onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus)
        if (hasFocus) {
            hideSystemUI()
        }
    }

    private fun checkPermissions() {
        val permissionsNeeded = mutableListOf<String>()

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
            if (!Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
                permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW)
            }
        }

        if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
        }

        if (permissionsNeeded.isNotEmpty()) {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, permissionsNeeded.toTypedArray(), PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE)
        } else {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(
        requestCode: Int,
        permissions: Array<out String>,
        grantResults: IntArray
    ) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE) {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    private fun onPermissionsGranted() {
        showWelcomeMessage()
        setupMenuBar()
        setupDock()
    }

    private fun showWelcomeMessage() {
        Toast.makeText(this, "✨ Welcome to DiXie! ✨", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
    }

    private fun setupMenuBar() {
        menuBar = MenuBarView(this)
        val menuParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            dpToPx(36)
        ).apply {
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.TOP
        }
        rootContainer.addView(menuBar, menuParams)
    }

    private fun setupDock() {
        dock = MacOSDock(this)
        val dockParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            dpToPx(68)
        ).apply {
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.BOTTOM
            bottomMargin = dpToPx(12)
        }
        rootContainer.addView(dock, dockParams)
        
        // Add apps to dock
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_edit, "Notes") {
            launchApp("com.google.android.keep")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery, "Photos") {
            launchApp("com.google.android.apps.photos")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_call, "Phone") {
            launchApp("com.android.dialer")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_send, "Messages") {
            launchApp("com.google.android.apps.messaging")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_preferences, "Settings") {
            startActivity(android.content.Intent(android.provider.Settings.ACTION_SETTINGS))
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_search, "Chrome") {
            launchApp("com.android.chrome")
        }
    }

    private fun launchApp(packageName: String) {
        try {
            val intent = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
            if (intent != null) {
                startActivity(intent)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "App not installed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Cannot open app", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

class MacOSDock(context: Context) : LinearLayout(context) {

        }

        setOnTouchListener(object : View.OnTouchListener {
            private var hoverView: View? = null

            override fun onTouch(v: View?, event: MotionEvent?): Boolean {
                when (event?.action) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {

                view.scaleY = scale

        val container = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL

        addView(container)
        dockItems.add(DockItem(iconRes, label, onClick))

    }
