kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import android.view.WindowInsetsController
import android.view.WindowInsets

class DixieActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    companion object {
        private const val PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE = 1001
    }

    private lateinit var rootContainer: FrameLayout
    private lateinit var dock: MacOSDock
    private lateinit var menuBar: MenuBarView
    private lateinit var dockWrapper: LinearLayout

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        
        // Force landscape orientation
        requestedOrientation = android.content.pm.ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
        
        // Make full screen - remove any window decorations
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN
        )
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS
        )
        
        // Remove the action bar if any
        supportActionBar?.hide()
        
        // Create root container - MATCH_PARENT to fill entire screen
        rootContainer = FrameLayout(this)
        rootContainer.layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
        )
        rootContainer.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#1A1A2E"))
        setContentView(rootContainer)
        
        // Hide system UI after content is set
        hideSystemUI()
        
        checkPermissions()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        hideSystemUI()
    }

    private fun hideSystemUI() {
        // Modern way to hide system bars (Android 11+)
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            window.insetsController?.hide(WindowInsets.Type.statusBars() or WindowInsets.Type.navigationBars())
            window.insetsController?.systemBarsBehavior = WindowInsetsController.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE
        } else {
            // Legacy way
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            window.decorView.systemUiVisibility = (
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
            )
        }
    }

    override fun onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus: Boolean) {
        super.onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus)
        if (hasFocus) {
            hideSystemUI()
        }
    }

    private fun checkPermissions() {
        val permissionsNeeded = mutableListOf<String>()

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
            if (!Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
                permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW)
            }
        }

        if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
        }

        if (permissionsNeeded.isNotEmpty()) {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, permissionsNeeded.toTypedArray(), PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE)
        } else {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(
        requestCode: Int,
        permissions: Array<out String>,
        grantResults: IntArray
    ) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE) {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    private fun onPermissionsGranted() {
        showWelcomeMessage()
        setupMenuBar()
        setupDock()
    }

    private fun showWelcomeMessage() {
        Toast.makeText(this, "✨ Welcome to DiXie! ✨", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
    }

    private fun setupMenuBar() {
        menuBar = MenuBarView(this)
        val menuParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            dpToPx(32)
        ).apply {
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.TOP
        }
        rootContainer.addView(menuBar, menuParams)
    }

    private fun setupDock() {
        // Create a wrapper to center the dock horizontally
        dockWrapper = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
            ).apply {
                gravity = android.view.Gravity.BOTTOM
                bottomMargin = dpToPx(12)
            }
        }
        
        dock = MacOSDock(this)
        dockWrapper.addView(dock)
        rootContainer.addView(dockWrapper)
        
        // Add apps to dock
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_edit, "Notes") {
            launchApp("com.google.android.keep")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery, "Photos") {
            launchApp("com.google.android.apps.photos")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_call, "Phone") {
            launchApp("com.android.dialer")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_send, "Messages") {
            launchApp("com.google.android.apps.messaging")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_preferences, "Settings") {
            startActivity(android.content.Intent(android.provider.Settings.ACTION_SETTINGS))
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_search, "Chrome") {
            launchApp("com.android.chrome")
        }
    }

    private fun launchApp(packageName: String) {
        try {
            val intent = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
            if (intent != null) {
                startActivity(intent)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "App not installed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Cannot open app", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

    override fun onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus: Boolean) {
        super.onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus)
        if (hasFocus) {
            hideSystemUI()
        }
    }

    private fun checkPermissions() {
        val permissionsNeeded = mutableListOf<String>()

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
            if (!Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
                permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW)
            }
        }

        if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
        }

        if (permissionsNeeded.isNotEmpty()) {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, permissionsNeeded.toTypedArray(), PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE)
        } else {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(
        requestCode: Int,
        permissions: Array<out String>,
        grantResults: IntArray
    ) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE) {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    private fun onPermissionsGranted() {
        showWelcomeMessage()
        setupMenuBar()
        setupDock()
    }

    private fun showWelcomeMessage() {
        Toast.makeText(this, "✨ Welcome to DiXie! ✨", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
    }

    private fun setupMenuBar() {
        menuBar = MenuBarView(this)
        val menuParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            dpToPx(32)
        ).apply {
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.TOP
        }
        rootContainer.addView(menuBar, menuParams)
    }

    private fun setupDock() {
        // Create a wrapper to center the dock horizontally
        dockWrapper = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
            ).apply {
                gravity = android.view.Gravity.BOTTOM
                bottomMargin = dpToPx(16)
            }
        }
        
        dock = MacOSDock(this)
        dockWrapper.addView(dock)
        rootContainer.addView(dockWrapper)
        
        // Add apps to dock
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_edit, "Notes") {
            launchApp("com.google.android.keep")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery, "Photos") {
            launchApp("com.google.android.apps.photos")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_call, "Phone") {
            launchApp("com.android.dialer")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_send, "Messages") {
            launchApp("com.google.android.apps.messaging")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_preferences, "Settings") {
            startActivity(android.content.Intent(android.provider.Settings.ACTION_SETTINGS))
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_search, "Chrome") {
            launchApp("com.android.chrome")
        }
    }

    private fun launchApp(packageName: String) {
        try {
            val intent = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
            if (intent != null) {
                startActivity(intent)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "App not installed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Cannot open app", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

package com.dixi.launcher

import android.animation.ValueAnimator
import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.view.animation.AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView

class MacOSDock(context: Context) : LinearLayout(context) {

    private val dockItems = mutableListOf<DockItem>()
    private val animators = mutableMapOf<View, ValueAnimator>()

    data class DockItem(
        val icon: Int,
        val label: String,
        val onClick: () -> Unit
    )

    init {
        orientation = HORIZONTAL
        gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        setPadding(dpToPx(12), dpToPx(6), dpToPx(12), dpToPx(6))
        
        // Frosted glass background
        val gradientDrawable = GradientDrawable()
        gradientDrawable.setColor(Color.parseColor("#801A1A2E"))
        gradientDrawable.cornerRadius = dpToPx(24).toFloat()
        background = gradientDrawable
        
        elevation = dpToPx(12).toFloat()
        
        // Make dock wrap content width
        layoutParams = LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
            LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
        ).apply {
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
        }
        
        setupMagnificationEffect()
    }

    private fun setupMagnificationEffect() {
        setOnTouchListener(object : View.OnTouchListener {
            private var hoverView: View? = null

            override fun onTouch(v: View?, event: MotionEvent?): Boolean {
                when (event?.action) {
                    MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                        for (i in 0 until childCount) {
                            val child = getChildAt(i)
                            val location = IntArray(2)
                            child.getLocationOnScreen(location)
                            val childRect = android.graphics.Rect(
                                location[0],
                                location[1],
                                location[0] + child.width,
                                location[1] + child.height
                            )
                            
                            if (childRect.contains(event.rawX.toInt(), event.rawY.toInt())) {
                                if (hoverView != child) {
                                    hoverView?.let { animateIconScale(it, false) }
                                    hoverView = child
                                    animateIconScale(child, true)
                                }
                                return true
                            }
                        }
                        hoverView?.let { 
                            animateIconScale(it, false)
                            hoverView = null
                        }
                    }
                }
                return false
            }
        })
    }

    private fun animateIconScale(view: View, magnify: Boolean) {
        val targetScale = if (magnify) 1.2f else 1.0f
        
        val animator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(view.scaleX, targetScale).apply {
            duration = 150
            interpolator = AccelerateDecelerateInterpolator()
            addUpdateListener {
                val scale = it.animatedValue as Float
                view.scaleX = scale
                view.scaleY = scale
                view.elevation = if (magnify) dpToPx(12).toFloat() else dpToPx(4).toFloat()
            }
            start()
        }
        
        animators[view]?.cancel()
        animators[view] = animator
    }

    fun addApp(iconRes: Int, label: String, onClick: () -> Unit) {
        val container = LinearLayout(context).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setPadding(dpToPx(6), dpToPx(4), dpToPx(6), dpToPx(4))
            setOnClickListener { onClick() }
        }
        
        // Icon size 32dp
        val iconView = ImageView(context).apply {
            setImageResource(iconRes)
            setColorFilter(Color.WHITE)
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(dpToPx(32), dpToPx(32))
        }
        
        val labelView = TextView(context).apply {
            text = label
            textSize = 9f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            visibility = GONE
            alpha = 0f
        }
        
        container.addView(iconView)
        container.addView(labelView)
        
        // Show label on hover
        container.setOnHoverListener { _, event ->
            when (event.action) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_ENTER -> {
                    labelView.visibility = VISIBLE
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(1f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .start()
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_EXIT -> {
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(0f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .withEndAction {
                            labelView.visibility = GONE
                        }
                        .start()
                }
            }
            false
        }
        
        addView(container)
        dockItems.add(DockItem(iconRes, label, onClick))
    }

    fun clear() {
        removeAllViews()
        dockItems.clear()
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat

class DixieActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    companion object {
        private const val PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE = 1001
    }

    private lateinit var rootContainer: FrameLayout
    private lateinit var dock: MacOSDock
    private lateinit var menuBar: MenuBarView
    private lateinit var dockWrapper: LinearLayout

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        
        // Force landscape orientation
        requestedOrientation = android.content.pm.ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
        
        // Make full screen - remove any window decorations
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN
        )
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS
        )
        
        // Remove the action bar
        supportActionBar?.hide()
        
        // Set content view with geometric background
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_desktop)
        
        // Get root container
        rootContainer = findViewById(R.id.desktop_root)
        
        // Hide system UI
        hideSystemUI()
        
        checkPermissions()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        hideSystemUI()
    }

    private fun hideSystemUI() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            window.insetsController?.hide(android.view.WindowInsets.Type.statusBars() or android.view.WindowInsets.Type.navigationBars())
            window.insetsController?.systemBarsBehavior = android.view.WindowInsetsController.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            window.decorView.systemUiVisibility = (
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
            )
        }
    }

    override fun onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus: Boolean) {
        super.onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus)
        if (hasFocus) {
            hideSystemUI()
        }
    }

    private fun checkPermissions() {
        val permissionsNeeded = mutableListOf<String>()

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
            if (!Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
                permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW)
            }
        }

        if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
        }

        if (permissionsNeeded.isNotEmpty()) {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, permissionsNeeded.toTypedArray(), PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE)
        } else {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(
        requestCode: Int,
        permissions: Array<out String>,
        grantResults: IntArray
    ) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE) {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    private fun onPermissionsGranted() {
        showWelcomeMessage()
        setupMenuBar()
        setupDock()
    }

    private fun showWelcomeMessage() {
        Toast.makeText(this, "✨ Welcome to DiXie! ✨", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
    }

    private fun setupMenuBar() {
        menuBar = MenuBarView(this)
        val menuParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            dpToPx(32)
        ).apply {
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.TOP
        }
        rootContainer.addView(menuBar, menuParams)
    }

    private fun setupDock() {
        // Create a wrapper to center the dock horizontally
        dockWrapper = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
            ).apply {
                gravity = android.view.Gravity.BOTTOM
                bottomMargin = dpToPx(16)
            }
        }
        
        dock = MacOSDock(this)
        dockWrapper.addView(dock)
        rootContainer.addView(dockWrapper)
        
        // Add apps to dock
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_edit, "Notes") {
            launchApp("com.google.android.keep")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery, "Photos") {
            launchApp("com.google.android.apps.photos")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_call, "Phone") {
            launchApp("com.android.dialer")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_send, "Messages") {
            launchApp("com.google.android.apps.messaging")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_preferences, "Settings") {
            startActivity(android.content.Intent(android.provider.Settings.ACTION_SETTINGS))
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_search, "Chrome") {
            launchApp("com.android.chrome")
        }
    }

    private fun launchApp(packageName: String) {
        try {
            val intent = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
            if (intent != null) {
                startActivity(intent)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "App not installed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Cannot open app", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

            setPadding(dpToPx(6), dpToPx(4), dpToPx(6), dpToPx(4))
            setOnClickListener { onClick() }
        }
        
        // Icon size 32dp
        val iconView = ImageView(context).apply {
            setImageResource(iconRes)
            setColorFilter(Color.WHITE)
            layoutParams = LayoutParams(dpToPx(32), dpToPx(32))
        }
        
        val labelView = TextView(context).apply {
            text = label
            textSize = 9f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            visibility = GONE
            alpha = 0f
        }
        
        container.addView(iconView)
        container.addView(labelView)
        
        // Show label on hover
        container.setOnHoverListener { _, event ->
            when (event.action) {
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_ENTER -> {
                    labelView.visibility = VISIBLE
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(1f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .start()
                }
                MotionEvent.ACTION_HOVER_EXIT -> {
                    labelView.animate()
                        .alpha(0f)
                        .setDuration(150)
                        .withEndAction {
                            labelView.visibility = GONE
                        }
                        .start()
                }
            }
            false
        }
        
        addView(container)
        dockItems.add(DockItem(iconRes, label, onClick))
    }

    fun clear() {
        removeAllViews()
        dockItems.clear()
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import android.view.WindowInsetsController
import android.view.WindowInsets

class DixieActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    companion object {
        private const val PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE = 1001
    }

    private lateinit var rootContainer: FrameLayout
    private lateinit var dock: MacOSDock
    private lateinit var menuBar: MenuBarView
    private lateinit var dockWrapper: LinearLayout

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        
        // Force landscape orientation
        requestedOrientation = android.content.pm.ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
        
        // Remove status bar and make full screen FIRST
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            window.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(false)
            window.insetsController?.hide(WindowInsets.Type.statusBars() or WindowInsets.Type.navigationBars())
            window.insetsController?.systemBarsBehavior = WindowInsetsController.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            window.decorView.systemUiVisibility = (
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
            )
        }
        
        // Set content view BEFORE checking permissions
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_desktop)
        
        // Get root container
        rootContainer = findViewById(R.id.desktop_root)
        
        // Make sure root container fills the window
        rootContainer.systemUiVisibility = View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN
        rootContainer.fitsSystemWindows = false
        
        checkPermissions()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        hideSystemUI()
    }

    private fun hideSystemUI() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            window.insetsController?.hide(WindowInsets.Type.statusBars() or WindowInsets.Type.navigationBars())
            window.insetsController?.systemBarsBehavior = WindowInsetsController.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            window.decorView.systemUiVisibility = (
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
            )
        }
    }

    override fun onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus: Boolean) {
        super.onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus)
        if (hasFocus) {
            hideSystemUI()
        }
    }

    private fun checkPermissions() {
        val permissionsNeeded = mutableListOf<String>()

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
            if (!Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
                permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW)
            }
        }

        if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
        }

        if (permissionsNeeded.isNotEmpty()) {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, permissionsNeeded.toTypedArray(), PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE)
        } else {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(
        requestCode: Int,
        permissions: Array<out String>,
        grantResults: IntArray
    ) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE) {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    private fun onPermissionsGranted() {
        showWelcomeMessage()
        setupMenuBar()
        setupDock()
    }

    private fun showWelcomeMessage() {
        Toast.makeText(this, "✨ Welcome to DiXie! ✨", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
    }

    private fun setupMenuBar() {
        menuBar = MenuBarView(this)
        val menuParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            dpToPx(32)
        ).apply {
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.TOP
        }
        rootContainer.addView(menuBar, menuParams)
    }

    private fun setupDock() {
        // Create a wrapper to center the dock horizontally
        dockWrapper = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
            ).apply {
                gravity = android.view.Gravity.BOTTOM
                bottomMargin = dpToPx(16)
            }
        }
        
        dock = MacOSDock(this)
        dockWrapper.addView(dock)
        rootContainer.addView(dockWrapper)
        
        // Add apps to dock
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_edit, "Notes") {
            launchApp("com.google.android.keep")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery, "Photos") {
            launchApp("com.google.android.apps.photos")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_call, "Phone") {
            launchApp("com.android.dialer")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_send, "Messages") {
            launchApp("com.google.android.apps.messaging")
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_preferences, "Settings") {
            startActivity(android.content.Intent(android.provider.Settings.ACTION_SETTINGS))
        }
        dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_search, "Chrome") {
            launchApp("com.android.chrome")
        }
    }

    private fun launchApp(packageName: String) {
        try {
            val intent = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
            if (intent != null) {
                startActivity(intent)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "App not installed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Cannot open app", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

    private fun showWallpaperPickerOption() {
        // Show a toast提示 on first launch
        Toast.makeText(this, "Long press desktop to change wallpaper", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        
        // Add long press listener to root container
        rootContainer.setOnLongClickListener {
            openWallpaperPicker()
            true
        }
    }

    private fun openWallpaperPicker() {
        val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_PICK, MediaStore.Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI)
        startActivityForResult(intent, PICK_IMAGE_REQUEST)
    }

    override fun onActivityResult(requestCode: Int, resultCode: Int, data: Intent?) {
        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data)
        if (requestCode == PICK_IMAGE_REQUEST && resultCode == RESULT_OK) {
            val selectedImageUri = data?.data
            selectedImageUri?.let { setWallpaper(it) }
        }
    }

    private fun setWallpaper(imageUri: Uri) {
        try {
            val inputStream = contentResolver.openInputStream(imageUri)
            val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(inputStream)
            wallpaperImageView.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
            
            // Save the wallpaper URI for next time
            val prefs = getSharedPreferences("dixie_settings", MODE_PRIVATE)
            prefs.edit().putString("wallpaper_uri", imageUri.toString()).apply()
            
            Toast.makeText(this, "Wallpaper changed!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        } catch (e: IOException) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Failed to set wallpaper", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun loadSavedWallpaper() {
        val prefs = getSharedPreferences("dixie_settings", MODE_PRIVATE)
        val uriString = prefs.getString("wallpaper_uri", null)
        if (uriString != null) {
            try {
                val imageUri = Uri.parse(uriString)
                val inputStream = contentResolver.openInputStream(imageUri)
                val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(inputStream)
                wallpaperImageView.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // Failed to load saved wallpaper, use default
            }
        }
    }

    private fun launchApp(packageName: String) {
        try {
            val intent = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
            if (intent != null) {
                startActivity(intent)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "App not installed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Cannot open app", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import android.view.WindowInsetsController
import android.view.WindowInsets

class DixieActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    companion object {
        private const val PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE = 1001
    }

    private lateinit var rootContainer: FrameLayout
    private lateinit var dock: MacOSDock
    private lateinit var menuBar: MenuBarView
    private lateinit var dockWrapper: LinearLayout

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        
        try {
            // Force landscape orientation
            requestedOrientation = android.content.pm.ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
            
            // Remove status bar and make full screen
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
                window.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(false)
                window.insetsController?.hide(WindowInsets.Type.statusBars() or WindowInsets.Type.navigationBars())
                window.insetsController?.systemBarsBehavior = WindowInsetsController.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE
            } else {
                @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                window.decorView.systemUiVisibility = (
                    View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE or
                    View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                    View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN or
                    View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                    View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_FULLSCREEN or
                    View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
                )
            }
            
            // Create root container
            rootContainer = FrameLayout(this)
            rootContainer.layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
            )
            rootContainer.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#1A1A2E"))
            rootContainer.fitsSystemWindows = false
            setContentView(rootContainer)
            
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            finish()
            return
        }
        
        checkPermissions()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        hideSystemUI()
    }

    private fun hideSystemUI() {
        try {
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
                window.insetsController?.hide(WindowInsets.Type.statusBars() or WindowInsets.Type.navigationBars())
                window.insetsController?.systemBarsBehavior = WindowInsetsController.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE
            } else {
                @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                window.decorView.systemUiVisibility = (
                    View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE or
                    View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                    View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN or
                    View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                    View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_FULLSCREEN or
                    View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
                )
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }

    override fun onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus: Boolean) {
        super.onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus)
        if (hasFocus) {
            hideSystemUI()
        }
    }

    private fun checkPermissions() {
        val permissionsNeeded = mutableListOf<String>()

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.M) {
            if (!Settings.canDrawOverlays(this)) {
                permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW)
            }
        }

        if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
            != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            permissionsNeeded.add(android.Manifest.permission.RECORD_AUDIO)
        }

        if (permissionsNeeded.isNotEmpty()) {
            ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, permissionsNeeded.toTypedArray(), PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE)
        } else {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(
        requestCode: Int,
        permissions: Array<out String>,
        grantResults: IntArray
    ) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE) {
            onPermissionsGranted()
        }
    }

    private fun onPermissionsGranted() {
        try {
            showWelcomeMessage()
            setupMenuBar()
            setupDock()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Error setting up UI: ${e.message}", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }

    private fun showWelcomeMessage() {
        Toast.makeText(this, "✨ Welcome to DiXie! ✨", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
    }

    private fun setupMenuBar() {
        try {
            menuBar = MenuBarView(this)
            val menuParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                dpToPx(32)
            ).apply {
                gravity = android.view.Gravity.TOP
            }
            rootContainer.addView(menuBar, menuParams)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }

    private fun setupDock() {
        try {
            // Create a wrapper to center the dock horizontally
            dockWrapper = LinearLayout(this).apply {
                orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
                gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
                layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                    FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                    FrameLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
                ).apply {
                    gravity = android.view.Gravity.BOTTOM
                    bottomMargin = dpToPx(16)
                }
            }
            
            dock = MacOSDock(this)
            dockWrapper.addView(dock)
            rootContainer.addView(dockWrapper)
            
            // Add apps to dock - using only system icons that always exist
            dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_edit, "Notes") {
                launchApp("com.google.android.keep")
            }
            dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_gallery, "Photos") {
                launchApp("com.google.android.apps.photos")
            }
            dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_call, "Phone") {
                launchApp("com.android.dialer")
            }
            dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_send, "Messages") {
                launchApp("com.google.android.apps.messaging")
            }
            dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_preferences, "Settings") {
                startActivity(android.content.Intent(android.provider.Settings.ACTION_SETTINGS))
            }
            dock.addApp(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_search, "Chrome") {
                launchApp("com.android.chrome")
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }

    private fun launchApp(packageName: String) {
        try {
            val intent = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
            if (intent != null) {
                startActivity(intent)
            } else {
                Toast.makeText(this, "App not installed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Cannot open app", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity

class DixieActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var rootContainer: FrameLayout

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        
        // Force landscape
        requestedOrientation = android.content.pm.ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
        
        // Full screen
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN
        )
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS
        )
        
        // Root container
        rootContainer = FrameLayout(this)
        rootContainer.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#1A1A2E"))
        setContentView(rootContainer)
        
        // Simple Dock at bottom
        setupSimpleDock()
        
        // Simple Menu Bar at top
        setupSimpleMenuBar()
    }

    private fun setupSimpleMenuBar() {
        val menuBar = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#CC1A1A2E"))
            setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8))
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                dpToPx(40)
            ).apply {
                gravity = Gravity.TOP
            }
        }
        
        val title = TextView(this).apply {
            text = " DiXie"
            textSize = 16f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
        }
        menuBar.addView(title)
        
        rootContainer.addView(menuBar)
    }

    private fun setupSimpleDock() {
        val dockWrapper = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
            ).apply {
                gravity = Gravity.BOTTOM
                bottomMargin = dpToPx(16)
            }
        }
        
        val dock = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#801A1A2E"))
            setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8))
        }
        
        // App buttons
        val apps = listOf("📝", "🖼️", "📞", "✉️", "⚙️", "🌐")
        apps.forEach { icon ->
            val btn = TextView(this).apply {
                text = icon
                textSize = 24f
                setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                setPadding(dpToPx(12), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(12), dpToPx(8))
                setOnClickListener {
                    android.widget.Toast.makeText(this@DixieActivity, "$icon clicked", android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
            dock.addView(btn)
        }
        
        dockWrapper.addView(dock)
        rootContainer.addView(dockWrapper)
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowInsets
import android.view.WindowInsetsController
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity

class DixieActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    private lateinit var rootContainer: FrameLayout

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        
        // Force landscape
        requestedOrientation = android.content.pm.ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
        
        // Make FULL SCREEN - hide status bar and navigation bar
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            // Android 11+
            window.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(false)
            window.insetsController?.hide(WindowInsets.Type.statusBars() or WindowInsets.Type.navigationBars())
            window.insetsController?.systemBarsBehavior = WindowInsetsController.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE
        } else {
            // Older Android
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            window.decorView.systemUiVisibility = (
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
            )
        }
        
        // Remove any window decorations
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN
        )
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS
        )
        
        // Ignore notch/cutout area
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
            window.attributes.layoutInDisplayCutoutMode = WindowManager.LayoutParams.LAYOUT_IN_DISPLAY_CUTOUT_MODE_SHORT_EDGES
        }
        
        // Root container
        rootContainer = FrameLayout(this)
        rootContainer.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#1A1A2E"))
        rootContainer.fitsSystemWindows = false
        setContentView(rootContainer)
        
        // Simple Dock at bottom
        setupSimpleDock()
        
        // Simple Menu Bar at top
        setupSimpleMenuBar()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        hideSystemUI()
    }

    private fun hideSystemUI() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            window.insetsController?.hide(WindowInsets.Type.statusBars() or WindowInsets.Type.navigationBars())
            window.insetsController?.systemBarsBehavior = WindowInsetsController.BEHAVIOR_SHOW_TRANSIENT_BARS_BY_SWIPE
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            window.decorView.systemUiVisibility = (
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
            )
        }
    }

    override fun onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus: Boolean) {
        super.onWindowFocusChanged(hasFocus)
        if (hasFocus) {
            hideSystemUI()
        }
    }

    private fun setupSimpleMenuBar() {
        val menuBar = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#CC1A1A2E"))
            setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8))
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                dpToPx(40)
            ).apply {
                gravity = Gravity.TOP
            }
        }
        
        val title = TextView(this).apply {
            text = " DiXie"
            textSize = 16f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
        }
        menuBar.addView(title)
        
        rootContainer.addView(menuBar)
    }

    private fun setupSimpleDock() {
        val dockWrapper = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
            ).apply {
                gravity = Gravity.BOTTOM
                bottomMargin = dpToPx(16)
            }
        }
        
        val dock = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#801A1A2E"))
            setPadding(dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(16), dpToPx(8))
        }
        
        // App buttons
        val apps = listOf("📝", "🖼️", "📞", "✉️", "⚙️", "🌐")
        apps.forEach { icon ->
            val btn = TextView(this).apply {
                text = icon
                textSize = 24f
                setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                setPadding(dpToPx(12), dpToPx(8), dpToPx(12), dpToPx(8))
                setOnClickListener {
                    android.widget.Toast.makeText(this@DixieActivity, "$icon clicked", android.widget.Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
            dock.addView(btn)
        }
        
        dockWrapper.addView(dock)
        rootContainer.addView(dockWrapper)
    }

    private fun dpToPx(dp: Int): Int = (dp * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity

class DixieActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        
        // Force landscape
        requestedOrientation = android.content.pm.ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
        
        // Make status bar transparent - content draws under it
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.LOLLIPOP) {
            window.clearFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_TRANSLUCENT_STATUS)
            window.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_DRAWS_SYSTEM_BAR_BACKGROUNDS)
            window.statusBarColor = Color.TRANSPARENT
            window.decorView.systemUiVisibility = View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE or View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN
        }
        
        // Root container
        val root = FrameLayout(this)
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#1A1A2E"))
        // Make root draw under status bar
        root.fitsSystemWindows = false
        
        // ===== MENU BAR AT TOP =====
        val menuBar = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#CC1A1A2E"))
            setPadding(20, getStatusBarHeight() + 10, 20, 10)
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                60
            ).apply {
                gravity = Gravity.TOP
            }
        }
        
        val menuText = TextView(this).apply {
            text = " DiXie"
            textSize = 18f
            setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
        }
        menuBar.addView(menuText)
        root.addView(menuBar)
        
        // ===== CENTER TEXT =====
        val centerText = TextView(this).apply {
            text = "◇ DiXie ◇\n\nDesktop + X factor + Friendly\n\nTap icons below"
            textSize = 28f
            setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#FF6B35"))
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        }
        root.addView(centerText)
        
        // ===== DOCK AT BOTTOM =====
        val dock = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER
            setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#801A1A2E"))
            setPadding(20, 10, 20, 10)
            layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
                FrameLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
                90
            ).apply {
                gravity = Gravity.BOTTOM
            }
        }
        
        // Dock icons
        val icons = listOf("📝", "🖼️", "📞", "✉️", "⚙️", "🌐")
        val iconNames = listOf("Notes", "Photos", "Phone", "Messages", "Settings", "Chrome")
        
        icons.forEachIndexed { index, icon ->
            val btn = TextView(this).apply {
                text = icon
                textSize = 32f
                setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
                setPadding(25, 10, 25, 10)
                setOnClickListener {
                    Toast.makeText(this@DixieActivity, "Opening ${iconNames[index]}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }
            }
            dock.addView(btn)
        }
        
        root.addView(dock)
        setContentView(root)
    }
    
    private fun getStatusBarHeight(): Int {
        var result = 0
        val resourceId = resources.getIdentifier("status_bar_height", "dimen", "android")
        if (resourceId > 0) {
            result = resources.getDimensionPixelSize(resourceId)
        }
        return result
    }
}

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.graphics.Color
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity

class DixieActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        
        // Force landscape
        requestedOrientation = android.content.pm.ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
        
        // FULL SCREEN - hide everything
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            window.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(false)
            window.insetsController?.hide(android.view.WindowInsets.Type.statusBars() or android.view.WindowInsets.Type.navigationBars())
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            window.decorView.systemUiVisibility = (
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
            )
        }
        
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN
        )
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS
        )
        
        // IGNORE NOTCH/CUTOUT - THIS IS THE KEY FOR THE LEFT BLACK BAR
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
            window.attributes.layoutInDisplayCutoutMode = WindowManager.LayoutParams.LAYOUT_IN_DISPLAY_CUTOUT_MODE_SHORT_EDGES
        }
        
        // Root container
        val root = FrameLayout(this)
        root.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#1A1A2E"))
        root.fitsSystemWindows = false
        
        // ===== MENU BAR AT TOP =====
        val menuBar = LinearLayout(this).apply {
            orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
            gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL

kotlin
package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.Intent
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.provider.MediaStore
import android.provider.Settings
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.ImageView
import android.widget.LinearLayout
import android.widget.TextView
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import java.io.IOException

class DixieActivity : AppCompatActivity() {

    companion object {
        private const val PICK_IMAGE_REQUEST = 1001
    }
    
    private lateinit var root: FrameLayout
    private lateinit var wallpaperImageView: ImageView
    private lateinit var dock: LinearLayout

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        
        // Force landscape
        requestedOrientation = android.content.pm.ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE
        
        // MAKE STATUS BAR TRANSPARENT
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.LOLLIPOP) {
            window.clearFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_TRANSLUCENT_STATUS)
            window.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_DRAWS_SYSTEM_BAR_BACKGROUNDS)
            window.statusBarColor = Color.TRANSPARENT
        }
        
        // Full screen flags
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN
        )
        window.setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_NO_LIMITS
        )
        
        // Hide system UI
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            window.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(false)
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            window.decorView.systemUiVisibility = (
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_FULLSCREEN or
                View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY
            )
        }
        
        // Make root view draw under status bar
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.LOLLIPOP) {
            window.decorView.systemUiVisibility = window.decorView.systemUiVisibility or
                    View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE or
                    View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN
        }
        
        // Ignore notch
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
            window.attributes.layoutInDisplayCutoutMode = WindowManager.LayoutParams.LAYOUT_IN_DISPLAY_CUTOUT_MODE_SHORT_EDGES
        }
        
        // Root container
        root = FrameLayout(this)
        root.fitsSystemWindows = false
        
        // Wallpaper ImageView (background)
        wallpaperImageView = ImageView(this)
        wallpaperImageView.scaleType = ImageView.ScaleType.CENTER_CROP
        wallpaperImageView.layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
        )
        root.addView(wallpaperImageView)
        
        // Load saved wallpaper or use default sky blue
        loadSavedWallpaper()
        
        // ===== MENU BAR - TRANSPARENT =====
        val menuBar = LinearLayout(this)
        menuBar.orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
        menuBar.gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
        menuBar.setBackgroundColor(Color.TRANSPARENT)
        menuBar.setPadding(20, 20, 20, 10)
        menuBar.layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            70
        )
        
        val menuText = TextView(this)
        menuText.text = " DiXie"
        menuText.textSize = 18f
        menuText.setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
        menuText.setShadowLayer(2f, 0f, 1f, Color.BLACK)  // Shadow for visibility
        menuBar.addView(menuText)
        
        // Settings button in menu bar
        val settingsBtn = TextView(this)
        settingsBtn.text = "⚙️"
        settingsBtn.textSize = 18f
        settingsBtn.setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
        settingsBtn.setPadding(20, 0, 0, 0)
        settingsBtn.setShadowLayer(2f, 0f, 1f, Color.BLACK)
        settingsBtn.setOnClickListener {
            openWallpaperPicker()
        }
        menuBar.addView(settingsBtn)
        
        // ===== CENTER TEXT =====
        val centerText = TextView(this)
        centerText.text = "◇ DiXie ◇\n\nDesktop + X factor + Friendly\n\nTap icons below\n\n⚙️ Click gear to change wallpaper"
        centerText.textSize = 24f
        centerText.setTextColor(Color.WHITE)
        centerText.setShadowLayer(2f, 0f, 1f, Color.BLACK)
        centerText.gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        centerText.layoutParams = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT
        )
        
        // ===== DOCK - FROSTED GLASS =====
        dock = LinearLayout(this)
        dock.orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
        dock.gravity = Gravity.CENTER
        
        val dockLayout = FrameLayout.LayoutParams(
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
            ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT
        )
        dockLayout.gravity = Gravity.BOTTOM or Gravity.CENTER_HORIZONTAL
        dockLayout.bottomMargin = 50
        dock.layoutParams = dockLayout
        
        // Create frosted glass effect
        val glassBackground = GradientDrawable()
        glassBackground.setColor(Color.parseColor("#66FFFFFF"))
        glassBackground.cornerRadius = 100f
        dock.background = glassBackground
        dock.setPadding(30, 15, 30, 15)
        
        // Add icons
        val icons = listOf("📝", "🖼️", "📞", "✉️", "⚙️", "🌐")
        val iconNames = listOf("Notes", "Photos", "Phone", "Messages", "Settings", "Chrome")
        
        icons.forEachIndexed { index, icon ->
            val btn = TextView(this)
            btn.text = icon
            btn.textSize = 28f
            btn.setTextColor(Color.parseColor("#1A1A2E"))
            btn.setPadding(20, 8, 20, 8)
            btn.setOnClickListener {
                Toast.makeText(this, "Opening ${iconNames[index]}", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }
            dock.addView(btn)
        }
        
        // Add everything to root
        root.addView(centerText)
        root.addView(menuBar)
        root.addView(dock)
        
        setContentView(root)
        
        // Show tip on first launch
        showWallpaperTip()
    }
    
    private fun openWallpaperPicker() {
        val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_PICK, MediaStore.Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI)
        startActivityForResult(intent, PICK_IMAGE_REQUEST)
    }
    
    override fun onActivityResult(requestCode: Int, resultCode: Int, data: Intent?) {
        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data)
        if (requestCode == PICK_IMAGE_REQUEST && resultCode == RESULT_OK) {
            val selectedImageUri = data?.data
            selectedImageUri?.let { setWallpaper(it) }
        }
    }
    
    private fun setWallpaper(imageUri: Uri) {
        try {
            val inputStream = contentResolver.openInputStream(imageUri)
            val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(inputStream)
            wallpaperImageView.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
            
            // Save the wallpaper URI for next time
            val prefs = getSharedPreferences("dixie_settings", MODE_PRIVATE)
            prefs.edit().putString("wallpaper_uri", imageUri.toString()).apply()
            
            Toast.makeText(this, "Wallpaper changed!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        } catch (e: IOException) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Failed to set wallpaper", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }
    
    private fun loadSavedWallpaper() {
        val prefs = getSharedPreferences("dixie_settings", MODE_PRIVATE)
        val uriString = prefs.getString("wallpaper_uri", null)
        if (uriString != null) {
            try {
                val imageUri = Uri.parse(uriString)
                val inputStream = contentResolver.openInputStream(imageUri)
                val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(inputStream)
                wallpaperImageView.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                // Failed to load saved wallpaper, use default (sky blue background)
                wallpaperImageView.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#87CEEB"))
            }
        } else {
            // Default sky blue background
            wallpaperImageView.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#87CEEB"))
        }
    }
    
    private fun showWallpaperTip() {
        val prefs = getSharedPreferences("dixie_settings", MODE_PRIVATE)
        val hasSeenTip = prefs.getBoolean("wallpaper_tip_shown", false)
        if (!hasSeenTip) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "💡 Tip: Click ⚙️ in top bar to change wallpaper", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            prefs.edit().putBoolean("wallpaper_tip_shown", true).apply()
        }
    }
}

    private fun openWallpaperPicker() {
        val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_PICK, MediaStore.Images.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI)
        startActivityForResult(intent, PICK_IMAGE_REQUEST)
    }
    
    override fun onActivityResult(requestCode: Int, resultCode: Int, data: Intent?) {
        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data)
        if (requestCode == PICK_IMAGE_REQUEST && resultCode == RESULT_OK) {
            val selectedImageUri = data?.data
            selectedImageUri?.let { setWallpaper(it) }
        }
    }
    
    private fun setWallpaper(imageUri: Uri) {
        try {
            val inputStream = contentResolver.openInputStream(imageUri)
            val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(inputStream)
            wallpaperImageView.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
            
            // Save the wallpaper URI for next time
            val prefs = getSharedPreferences("dixie_settings", MODE_PRIVATE)
            prefs.edit().putString("wallpaper_uri", imageUri.toString()).apply()
            
            Toast.makeText(this, "Wallpaper changed!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        } catch (e: IOException) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            Toast.makeText(this, "Failed to set wallpaper", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }
    
    private fun loadSavedWallpaper() {
        val prefs = getSharedPreferences("dixie_settings", MODE_PRIVATE)
        val uriString = prefs.getString("wallpaper_uri", null)
        if (uriString != null) {
            try {
                val imageUri = Uri.parse(uriString)
                val inputStream = contentResolver.openInputStream(imageUri)
                val bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(inputStream)
                wallpaperImageView.setImageBitmap(bitmap)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                wallpaperImageView.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#87CEEB"))
            }
        } else {
            wallpaperImageView.setBackgroundColor(Color.parseColor("#87CEEB"))
        }
    }
    
    private fun showWallpaperTip() {
        val prefs = getSharedPreferences("dixie_settings", MODE_PRIVATE)
        val hasSeenTip = prefs.getBoolean("wallpaper_tip_shown", false)
        if (!hasSeenTip) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "💡 Tip: Click ⚙️ in top bar to change wallpaper", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            prefs.edit().putBoolean("wallpaper_tip_shown", true).apply()
        }
    }
}

package com.dixi.launcher

import android.content.Intent
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.graphics.BitmapFactory
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.drawable.BitmapDrawable
import android.graphics.drawable.GradientDrawable
