import React, { useState } from 'react';

interface DockItem {
  id: string;
  icon: string;
  label: string;
}

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (item: DockItem) => void;
}

const defaultApps: DockItem[] = [
  { id: 'notes', icon: '📝', label: 'Notes' },
  { id: 'photos', icon: '🖼️', label: 'Photos' },
  { id: 'phone', icon: '📞', label: 'Phone' },
  { id: 'messages', icon: '✉️', label: 'Messages' },
  { id: 'settings', icon: '⚙️', label: 'Settings' },
  { id: 'chrome', icon: '🌐', label: 'Chrome' },
];

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [hoveredId, setHoveredId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  return (
    <div className="fixed bottom-4 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-50">
      <div className="glass-pill-blur px-3 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-1 shadow-2xl">
        {defaultApps.map((app) => (
          <button
            key={app.id}
            onClick={() => onItemClick(app)}
            onMouseEnter={() => setHoveredId(app.id)}
            onMouseLeave={() => setHoveredId(null)}
            className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all duration-200 hover:scale-110 active:scale-95"
          >
            <span className="text-2xl">{app.icon}</span>
            <span
              className={`text-[9px] text-white mt-1 transition-opacity duration-150 ${
                hoveredId === app.id ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0'
              }`}
            >
              {app.label}
            </span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Dock;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Settings, Apple } from 'lucide-react';

interface MenuBarProps {
  onSettingsClick: () => void;
}

const MenuBar: React.FC<MenuBarProps> = ({ onSettingsClick }) => {
  const [time, setTime] = useState<string>('');
  const [date, setDate] = useState<string>('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const updateTime = () => {
      const now = new Date();
      setTime(now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }));
      setDate(now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }));
    };
    updateTime();
    const interval = setInterval(updateTime, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 h-10 bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-between px-6 z-50 border-b border-white/10">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-6">
        <Apple size={16} className="text-white" />
        <div className="flex gap-6 text-white text-[13px] font-medium">

  { name: 'Drive', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.docs', icon: '📁' },
  { name: 'Maps', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.maps', icon: '🗺️' },
  { name: 'Calendar', packageName: 'com.google.android.calendar', icon: '📅' },

  { name: 'WhatsApp', packageName: 'com.whatsapp', icon: '💚' },
];

const AppDrawer: React.FC<AppDrawerProps> = ({ isOpen, onClose }) => {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [apps, setApps] = useState<AppInfo[]>(mockApps);
  const [filteredApps, setFilteredApps] = useState<AppInfo[]>(mockApps);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (searchTerm.trim() === '') {
      setFilteredApps(apps);
    } else {
      const filtered = apps.filter(app =>
        app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
      );
      setFilteredApps(filtered);
    }
  }, [searchTerm, apps]);

  const handleAppClick = (app: AppInfo) => {
    alert(`Opening ${app.name} (would launch in Android app)`);
    onClose();
  };

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm">
      <div className="bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-2xl w-[90%] max-w-2xl h-[80%] max-h-[600px] flex flex-col overflow-hidden border border-white/20 shadow-2xl">
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-white/20">

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="text-white/70 hover:text-white transition-colors"
          >
            <X size={24} />
          </button>
        </div>
        
        {/* Search Bar */}
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-white/20">
          <div className="relative">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 text-white/50" size={18} />
            <input
              type="text"
              placeholder="Search apps..."
              value={searchTerm}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full bg-white/10 border border-white/20 rounded-lg py-2 pl-10 pr-4 text-white placeholder-white/50 focus:outline-none focus:border-white/40"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        
        {/* Apps Grid */}
        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-4 sm:grid-cols-5 md:grid-cols-6 gap-4">
            {filteredApps.map((app) => (
              <button
                key={app.packageName}
                onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
                className="flex flex-col items-center p-3 rounded-xl hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors"
              >
                <span className="text-4xl mb-2">{app.icon}</span>
                <span className="text-white text-xs text-center truncate w-full">{app.name}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          
          {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
            <div className="text-center text-white/50 py-10">
              No apps found matching "{searchTerm}"
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import AppDrawer from '../components/AppDrawer';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);
  const [isAppDrawerOpen, setIsAppDrawerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isSearchDrawerOpen, setIsSearchDrawerOpen] = useState(false);

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const fakeImageUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (fakeImageUrl) {
      setWallpaper(fakeImageUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleCloseCard = () => {
    setShowWelcomeCard(false);
  };

  const handleMenuClick = () => {
    setIsAppDrawerOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSearchClick = () => {
    setIsSearchDrawerOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCloseDrawer = () => {
    setIsAppDrawerOpen(false);
    setIsSearchDrawerOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div className="relative w-full h-full">
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {/* Welcome Card */}
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div className="absolute top-1/2 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-40">
            <div className="relative bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-2xl border border-white/20 shadow-2xl p-8 min-w-[320px] max-w-[400px]">
              <button
                onClick={handleCloseCard}
                className="absolute top-3 right-3 text-white/70 hover:text-white transition-colors duration-200 text-xl"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div className="text-center mt-2">
                <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-white drop-shadow-lg mb-3">◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p className="text-white/80 text-base mb-4">Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-white/70 text-sm mb-5">
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  className="px-5 py-2 bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-lg text-white text-sm hover:bg-white/30 transition-all duration-200"
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        <Dock onMenuClick={handleMenuClick} onSearchClick={handleSearchClick} />
        
        {/* App Drawer */}
        <AppDrawer isOpen={isAppDrawerOpen} onClose={handleCloseDrawer} />
      </div>
    </Wallpaper>
  );
};

export default Desktop;

@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Google+Sans:wght@400;500;700&display=swap');

@tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;

@layer base {
  * {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  html, body, #root {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
  }

  body {
    font-family: 'Google Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
  }
}

@layer utilities {
  .glass-effect {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  }

  .glass-pill-blur {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border-radius: 100px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
  }
}

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

const DEFAULT_WALLPAPER = 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1506744038136-46273834b3fb?q=80&w=3870&auto=format';

export const useWallpaper = () => {
  const [wallpaperUrl, setWallpaperUrl] = useState<string>(DEFAULT_WALLPAPER);

  const loadSavedWallpaper = () => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('dixie_wallpaper');
    if (saved) {
      setWallpaperUrl(saved);
    }
  };

  const setWallpaper = (url: string) => {
    setWallpaperUrl(url);

  }, []);

import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);
  const [isAppDrawerOpen, setIsAppDrawerOpen] = useState(false);

    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

    setIsAppDrawerOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSearchClick = () => {
    setIsAppDrawerOpen(true);
  };

  return (

            <div className="relative bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-2xl border border-white/20 shadow-2xl p-8 min-w-[320px] max-w-[400px]">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                className="absolute top-3 right-3 text-white/70 hover:text-white transition-colors text-xl"
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div className="text-center mt-2">
                <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold text-white drop-shadow-lg mb-3">◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p className="text-white/80 text-base mb-4">Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-white/70 text-sm mb-5">
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  className="px-5 py-2 bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-lg text-white text-sm hover:bg-white/30 transition"
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        <Dock onMenuClick={handleMenuClick} onSearchClick={handleSearchClick} />
        
        <AppDrawer isOpen={isAppDrawerOpen} onClose={() => setIsAppDrawerOpen(false)} />
      </div>
    </Wallpaper>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Settings } from 'lucide-react';

interface MenuBarProps {

}

const MenuBar: React.FC<MenuBarProps> = ({ onSettingsClick }) => {
  const [time, setTime] = useState<string>('');
  const [date, setDate] = useState<string>('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const updateTime = () => {
      const now = new Date();
      setTime(now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }));
      setDate(now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }));
    };
    updateTime();
    const interval = setInterval(updateTime, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 h-10 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-end px-6 z-50">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-white text-[13px]">
        <Settings size={14} className="cursor-pointer hover:text-gray-300 transition" onClick={onSettingsClick} />
        <span>{date}</span>
        <span>{time}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

interface MenuBarProps {
  onSettingsClick: () => void;
}

const MenuBar: React.FC<MenuBarProps> = ({ onSettingsClick }) => {
  const [time, setTime] = useState<string>('');
  const [date, setDate] = useState<string>('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const updateTime = () => {
      const now = new Date();
      setTime(now.toLocaleTimeString('en-US', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }));
      setDate(now.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { weekday: 'short', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }));
    };
    updateTime();
    const interval = setInterval(updateTime, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-xl flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-1 z-50 border-b border-white/20">
      {/* LEFT SIDE - Menu Items */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
        <span className="cursor-pointer hover:text-gray-500 transition text-gray-700 text-xs">Finder</span>
        <span className="cursor-pointer hover:text-gray-500 transition text-gray-700 text-xs">File</span>
        <span className="cursor-pointer hover:text-gray-500 transition text-gray-700 text-xs">Edit</span>
        <span className="cursor-pointer hover:text-gray-500 transition text-gray-700 text-xs">View</span>
        <span className="cursor-pointer hover:text-gray-500 transition text-gray-700 text-xs">Window</span>
        <span className="cursor-pointer hover:text-gray-500 transition text-gray-700 text-xs">Help</span>
      </div>
      
      {/* RIGHT SIDE - Settings, Date, Time */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <Settings size={12} className="cursor-pointer hover:text-gray-500 transition text-gray-700" onClick={onSettingsClick} />
        <span className="text-gray-700 text-xs">{date}</span>
        <span className="text-gray-700 text-xs">{time}</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (item: string) => {
    alert(`Opening ${item}`);
  };

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        <Dock onItemClick={handleDockItemClick} />
      </div>
    </Wallpaper>
  );
};

now i want my phones app icon on the dock not the ones you provided
I understand. You want the actual apps installed on your phone to appear in the dock, not the mock emoji icons.

Since we're in a web development environment (React + Vite), we cannot directly access the list of installed apps on your Android phone. This requires Capacitor native plugin access.

Let me show you the correct way to do this for the final Android APK.

✅ Step 1: Install Capacitor App Plugin
bash
npm install @capacitor/app
✅ Step 2: Update src/components/Dock.tsx to fetch real apps
tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

interface AppInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  icon: string;
  packageName: string;
}

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: AppInfo) => void;
}

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [apps, setApps] = useState<AppInfo[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Check if running on Android with Capacitor
    const isNative = window.hasOwnProperty('Capacitor');
    
    if (isNative) {
      // This would call the native plugin to get installed apps
      // For now, we'll use mock data
      fetchInstalledApps();
    } else {
      // Web fallback - show demo apps
      setApps([
        { id: '1', name: 'Chrome', icon: '🌐', packageName: 'com.android.chrome' },
        { id: '2', name: 'Gmail', icon: '📧', packageName: 'com.google.android.gm' },
        { id: '3', name: 'Messages', icon: '💬', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.messaging' },
        { id: '4', name: 'Photos', icon: '🖼️', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.photos' },
        { id: '5', name: 'Settings', icon: '⚙️', packageName: 'com.android.settings' },
        { id: '6', name: 'Play Store', icon: '📦', packageName: 'com.android.vending' },
      ]);
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const fetchInstalledApps = async () => {
    // This will be implemented when building the native Android app
    // For now, use fallback
    setApps([
      { id: '1', name: 'Chrome', icon: '🌐', packageName: 'com.android.chrome' },
      { id: '2', name: 'Gmail', icon: '📧', packageName: 'com.google.android.gm' },
      { id: '3', name: 'Messages', icon: '💬', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.messaging' },
      { id: '4', name: 'Photos', icon: '🖼️', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.photos' },
      { id: '5', name: 'Settings', icon: '⚙️', packageName: 'com.android.settings' },
      { id: '6', name: 'Play Store', icon: '📦', packageName: 'com.android.vending' },
    ]);
    setLoading(false);
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: 'fixed',
      bottom: '8px',
      left: '50%',
      transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
      zIndex: 50
    }}>
      <div style={{
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '2px 8px',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: '2px',
        boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)'
      }}>
        {apps.map((app) => (
          <button
            key={app.id}
            onClick={() => onItemClick(app)}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
              padding: '2px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none'
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>{app.icon}</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '7px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginTop: '2px' }}>{app.name}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';

interface AppInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  icon: string;
  packageName: string;
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: AppInfo) => {
    alert(`Opening ${app.name} (${app.packageName})`);
    // In the actual Android app, this would launch the app
  };

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        <Dock onItemClick={handleDockItemClick} />
      </div>
    </Wallpaper>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

interface AppInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  icon: string;
  packageName: string;
}

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: AppInfo) => void;
}

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [apps, setApps] = useState<AppInfo[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Mock apps for web preview
    // In the Android APK, this will fetch real installed apps
    setApps([
      { id: '1', name: 'Chrome', icon: '🌐', packageName: 'com.android.chrome' },
      { id: '2', name: 'Gmail', icon: '📧', packageName: 'com.google.android.gm' },
      { id: '3', name: 'Messages', icon: '💬', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.messaging' },
      { id: '4', name: 'Photos', icon: '🖼️', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.photos' },
      { id: '5', name: 'Settings', icon: '⚙️', packageName: 'com.android.settings' },
      { id: '6', name: 'Play Store', icon: '📦', packageName: 'com.android.vending' },
    ]);
    setLoading(false);
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: 'fixed',
      bottom: '8px',
      left: '50%',
      transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
      zIndex: 50
    }}>
      <div style={{
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '2px 8px',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: '2px',
        boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)'
      }}>
        {apps.map((app) => (
          <button
            key={app.id}
            onClick={() => onItemClick(app)}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
              padding: '2px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none'
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>{app.icon}</span>
            <span style={{ fontSize: '7px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginTop: '2px' }}>{app.name}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

package com.dixie.launcher;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;

import com.getcapacitor.BridgeActivity;

public class MainActivity extends BridgeActivity {
    @Override
    public void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        
        // Hide status bar
        getWindow().setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN

        // Hide navigation bar

            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN
        );
    }
}

  getInstalledApps(): Promise<{ apps: InstalledApp[] }>;

✅ Step 3: Create the native plugin
In Android Studio, create a new Java file:

Path: android/app/src/main/java/com/dixie/launcher/InstalledAppsPlugin.java

java
package com.dixie.launcher;

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.Base64;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONException;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.List;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "InstalledApps")
public class InstalledAppsPlugin extends Plugin {

    @PluginMethod
    public void getInstalledApps(PluginCall call) {
        try {
            PackageManager pm = getContext().getPackageManager();
            List<ApplicationInfo> packages = pm.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA);
            
            JSONArray appsArray = new JSONArray();
            
            for (ApplicationInfo appInfo : packages) {
                // Skip system apps
                if ((appInfo.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                String name = pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString();
                String packageName = appInfo.packageName;
                String iconBase64 = getIconBase64(pm, appInfo);
                
                JSONObject app = new JSONObject();
                app.put("name", name);
                app.put("packageName", packageName);
                app.put("icon", iconBase64);
                
                appsArray.put(app);
            }
            
            JSObject result = new JSObject();
            result.put("apps", appsArray);
            call.resolve(result);
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            call.reject("Failed to get apps", e);
        }
    }
    
    private String getIconBase64(PackageManager pm, ApplicationInfo appInfo) {
        try {
            Drawable icon = pm.getApplicationIcon(appInfo);
            Bitmap bitmap = drawableToBitmap(icon);
            ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, baos);
            byte[] imageBytes = baos.toByteArray();
            return Base64.encodeToString(imageBytes, Base64.DEFAULT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }
    
    private Bitmap drawableToBitmap(Drawable drawable) {
        if (drawable == null) return null;
        
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(
            drawable.getIntrinsicWidth(),
            drawable.getIntrinsicHeight(),
            Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888
        );
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(bitmap);
        drawable.setBounds(0, 0, canvas.getWidth(), canvas.getHeight());
        drawable.draw(canvas);
        return bitmap;
    }
}

tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [apps, setApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8)); // Show first 8 apps
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: 'fixed',
      bottom: '8px',
      left: '50%',
      transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
      zIndex: 50
    }}>
      <div style={{
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '2px 8px',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: '2px',
        boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)'
      }}>
        {apps.map((app) => (
          <button
            key={app.packageName}
            onClick={() => onItemClick(app)}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
              padding: '2px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none'
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            {app.icon ? (
              <img 
                src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                alt={app.name}
                style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
              />
            ) : (
              <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>📱</span>
            )}
            <span style={{ fontSize: '7px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginTop: '2px' }}>{app.name}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Dock;

package com.dixie.launcher;

import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;

}

tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [apps, setApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: 'fixed',
      bottom: '8px',
      left: '50%',
      transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
      zIndex: 50
    }}>
      <div style={{
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '2px 8px',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: '2px',
        boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)'
      }}>
        {apps.map((app) => (
          <button
            key={app.packageName}
            onClick={() => onItemClick(app)}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
              padding: '2px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none'
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            {app.icon ? (
              <img 
                src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                alt={app.name}
                style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
              />
            ) : (
              <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>📱</span>
            )}
            <span style={{ fontSize: '7px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginTop: '2px' }}>{app.name}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Dock;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';
import { InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    alert(`Opening ${app.name} (${app.packageName})`);
    // Real app launching will be added next
  };

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        <Dock onItemClick={handleDockItemClick} />
      </div>
    </Wallpaper>
  );
};

export default Desktop;

package com.dixie.launcher;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.view.WindowManager;
import com.getcapacitor.BridgeActivity;

public class MainActivity extends BridgeActivity {
    @Override
    public void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        
        // Register the plugin
        registerPlugin(InstalledAppsPlugin.class);
        
        getWindow().setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN
        );
        
        getWindow().getDecorView().setSystemUiVisibility(
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN
        );
    }
}

    <style name="AppTheme" parent="Theme.AppCompat.Light.NoActionBar">
        <item name="android:windowFullscreen">true</item>
        <item name="android:windowContentOverlay">@null</item>
        <item name="android:windowNoTitle">true</item>

        <item name="android:windowTranslucentStatus">true</item>

import com.getcapacitor.BridgeActivity;

public class MainActivity extends BridgeActivity {
    @Override
    public void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        
        getWindow().setFlags(
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN
        );
        
        getWindow().getDecorView().setSystemUiVisibility(
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN
        );
    }
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

interface AppInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  packageName: string;
  icon: string;
}

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: AppInfo) => void;
}

// Mock apps for web preview (will be replaced by real apps on device)
const mockApps: AppInfo[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Chrome', icon: '🌐', packageName: 'com.android.chrome' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Gmail', icon: '📧', packageName: 'com.google.android.gm' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Messages', icon: '💬', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.messaging' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Photos', icon: '🖼️', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.photos' },
  { id: '5', name: 'Settings', icon: '⚙️', packageName: 'com.android.settings' },
  { id: '6', name: 'Play Store', icon: '📦', packageName: 'com.android.vending' },
];

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [apps, setApps] = useState<AppInfo[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Check if running on Android device
    const isAndroid = window.hasOwnProperty('Capacitor');
    
    if (isAndroid) {
      // On real device, fetch installed apps
      fetchInstalledApps();
    } else {
      // Web preview - use mock apps
      setApps(mockApps);
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const fetchInstalledApps = async () => {
    try {
      // @ts-ignore - Capacitor plugin will be available on device
      const { InstalledApps } = await import('../capacitor');
      const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
      setApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      setApps(mockApps);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: 'fixed',
      bottom: '8px',
      left: '50%',
      transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
      zIndex: 50
    }}>
      <div style={{
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '2px 8px',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: '2px',
        boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)'
      }}>
        {apps.map((app) => (
          <button
            key={app.packageName}
            onClick={() => onItemClick(app)}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
              padding: '2px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none'
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            {app.icon.startsWith('data:') || app.icon.includes('base64') ? (
              <img 
                src={app.icon} 
                alt={app.name}
                style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
              />
            ) : (
              <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>{app.icon}</span>
            )}
            <span style={{ fontSize: '7px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginTop: '2px' }}>{app.name}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Dock;

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';

interface AppInfo {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  packageName: string;
  icon: string;
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: AppInfo) => {
    alert(`Opening ${app.name} (${app.packageName})`);
    // Real app launching will be added next
  };

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        <Dock onItemClick={handleDockItemClick} />
      </div>
    </Wallpaper>
  );
};

export default Desktop;

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const mockApps: InstalledApp[] = [
  { name: 'Chrome', icon: '🌐', packageName: 'com.android.chrome' },
  { name: 'Gmail', icon: '📧', packageName: 'com.google.android.gm' },
  { name: 'Messages', icon: '💬', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.messaging' },
  { name: 'Photos', icon: '🖼️', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.photos' },
  { name: 'Settings', icon: '⚙️', packageName: 'com.android.settings' },
  { name: 'Play Store', icon: '📦', packageName: 'com.android.vending' },
];

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [apps, setApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        if (result.apps && result.apps.length > 0) {
          setApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        } else {
          setApps(mockApps);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
        setApps(mockApps);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div style={{
      position: 'fixed',
      bottom: '8px',
      left: '50%',
      transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
      zIndex: 50
    }}>
      <div style={{
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '2px 8px',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: '2px',
        boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)'
      }}>
        {apps.map((app) => (
          <button
            key={app.packageName}
            onClick={() => onItemClick(app)}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
              padding: '2px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',

package com.dixie.launcher;

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.Base64;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.List;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "InstalledApps")
public class InstalledAppsPlugin extends Plugin {

    @PluginMethod
    public void getInstalledApps(PluginCall call) {
        try {
            PackageManager pm = getContext().getPackageManager();
            List<ApplicationInfo> packages = pm.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA);
            
            JSONArray appsArray = new JSONArray();
            int count = 0;
            
            for (ApplicationInfo appInfo : packages) {
                // Skip system apps
                if ((appInfo.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                if (count >= 20) break; // Limit to 20 apps
                
                String name = pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString();
                String packageName = appInfo.packageName;
                String iconBase64 = getIconBase64(pm, appInfo);
                
                JSONObject app = new JSONObject();
                app.put("name", name);
                app.put("packageName", packageName);
                app.put("icon", iconBase64);
                
                appsArray.put(app);
                count++;
            }
            
            JSObject result = new JSObject();
            result.put("apps", appsArray);
            call.resolve(result);
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            call.reject("Failed to get apps: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
    
    private String getIconBase64(PackageManager pm, ApplicationInfo appInfo) {
        try {
            Drawable icon = pm.getApplicationIcon(appInfo);
            Bitmap bitmap = drawableToBitmap(icon);
            ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, baos);
            byte[] imageBytes = baos.toByteArray();
            return Base64.encodeToString(imageBytes, Base64.DEFAULT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }
    
    private Bitmap drawableToBitmap(Drawable drawable) {
        if (drawable == null) return null;
        
        int width = drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
        int height = drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();
        
        if (width <= 0) width = 100;
        if (height <= 0) height = 100;
        
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(bitmap);
        drawable.setBounds(0, 0, canvas.getWidth(), canvas.getHeight());
        drawable.draw(canvas);
        return bitmap;
    }
}

            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN,
            WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_FULLSCREEN
        );
        
        getWindow().getDecorView().setSystemUiVisibility(
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_HIDE_NAVIGATION |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_IMMERSIVE_STICKY |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_STABLE |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_HIDE_NAVIGATION |
            View.SYSTEM_UI_FLAG_LAYOUT_FULLSCREEN
        );
    }
}
Important change: registerPlugin is now called BEFORE super.onCreate(savedInstanceState).

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const mockApps: InstalledApp[] = [
  { name: 'Chrome', icon: '🌐', packageName: 'com.android.chrome' },
  { name: 'Gmail', icon: '📧', packageName: 'com.google.android.gm' },
  { name: 'Messages', icon: '💬', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.messaging' },
  { name: 'Photos', icon: '🖼️', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.photos' },
  { name: 'Settings', icon: '⚙️', packageName: 'com.android.settings' },
  { name: 'Play Store', icon: '📦', packageName: 'com.android.vending' },
];

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [apps, setApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        if (result.apps && result.apps.length > 0) {
          setApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        } else {
          setApps(mockApps);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
        setApps(mockApps);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(true);
    alert('Edit Mode: Tap an app to remove, long press again to exit');
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      // Remove app from dock
      setApps(apps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
      if (apps.length <= 1) {
        setIsEditMode(false);
      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addApp = () => {
    // This will show a list of all available apps to add
    alert('Add app feature - coming soon');
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div 
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        zIndex: 50
      }}
      onContextMenu={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleLongPress();
      }}
    >
      <div style={{
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '2px 8px',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: '2px',
        boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
        position: 'relative'
      }}>
        {apps.map((app) => (
          <button
            key={app.packageName}
            onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
              padding: '2px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: isEditMode ? 'rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.3)' : 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              position: 'relative'
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => {
              if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
            }}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => {
              if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            }}
          >
            {isEditMode && (
              <span style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                top: '-6px',
                right: '-6px',
                backgroundColor: 'red',
                color: 'white',
                borderRadius: '50%',
                width: '16px',
                height: '16px',
                fontSize: '10px',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center'
              }}>−</span>
            )}
            {app.icon && (app.icon.startsWith('data:') || app.icon.length > 100) ? (
              <img 
                src={app.icon.startsWith('data:') ? app.icon : `data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                alt={app.name}
                style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
              />
            ) : (
              <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>📱</span>
            )}
            <span style={{ fontSize: '7px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginTop: '2px' }}>{app.name}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
        
        {/* Add button */}
        <button
          onClick={addApp}
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            alignItems: 'center',
            padding: '2px 8px',
            borderRadius: '8px',
            transition: 'all 0.2s',
            cursor: 'pointer',
            background: 'transparent',
            border: 'none',
            opacity: 0.7
          }}
          onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
          onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
        >
          <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>➕</span>
          <span style={{ fontSize: '7px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginTop: '2px' }}>Add</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';
import { InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    alert(`Opening ${app.name}`);
  };

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        <Dock onItemClick={handleDockItemClick} />
      </div>
    </Wallpaper>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        if (result.apps && result.apps.length > 0) {
          setAllApps(result.apps);
          
          // Load saved dock apps or use first 8
          const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
          if (saved) {
            const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
            setDockApps(savedApps);
          } else {
            setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
          }
        } else {
          const mockApps: InstalledApp[] = [
            { name: 'Chrome', icon: '🌐', packageName: 'com.android.chrome' },
            { name: 'Gmail', icon: '📧', packageName: 'com.google.android.gm' },
            { name: 'Messages', icon: '💬', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.messaging' },
            { name: 'Photos', icon: '🖼️', packageName: 'com.google.android.apps.photos' },
            { name: 'Settings', icon: '⚙️', packageName: 'com.android.settings' },
            { name: 'Play Store', icon: '📦', packageName: 'com.android.vending' },
          ];
          setAllApps(mockApps);
          const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
          if (saved) {
            setDockApps(JSON.parse(saved));
          } else {
            setDockApps(mockApps);
          }
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  // Save dock apps whenever they change
  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
      setDockApps(newDockApps);
      // Exit edit mode if dock becomes empty
      if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
        setIsEditMode(false);
      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addApp = () => {
    // Get apps not already in dock
    const availableApps = allApps.filter(
      availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
    );
    
    if (availableApps.length === 0) {
      alert('No more apps to add');
      return;
    }
    
    const appNames = availableApps.map(app => app.name);
    
    // Simple prompt for now - we'll make a proper modal later
    const appName = prompt('Select app to add:\n\n' + appNames.join('\n'));
    if (appName) {
      const selectedApp = availableApps.find(app => app.name === appName);
      if (selectedApp) {
        setDockApps([...dockApps, selectedApp]);
      }
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div 
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        zIndex: 50
      }}
      onContextMenu={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        handleLongPress();
      }}
    >
      <div style={{
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '2px 8px',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: '2px',
        boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
        border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
        position: 'relative'
      }}>
        {dockApps.map((app) => (
          <button
            key={app.packageName}
            onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              position: 'relative'
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => {
              if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
            }}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => {
              if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            }}
          >
            {isEditMode && (
              <span style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                top: '-4px',
                right: '-4px',
                backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                color: 'white',
                borderRadius: '50%',
                width: '18px',
                height: '18px',
                fontSize: '12px',
                fontWeight: 'bold',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                zIndex: 10
              }}>−</span>
            )}
            {app.icon && (app.icon.startsWith('data:') || app.icon.length > 100) ? (
              <img 
                src={app.icon.startsWith('data:') ? app.icon : `data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                alt={app.name}
                style={{ width: '24px', height: '24px' }}
              />
            ) : (
              <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>📱</span>
            )}
          </button>
        ))}
        
        {/* Add button */}
        <button
          onClick={addApp}
          style={{
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            padding: '4px 8px',
            borderRadius: '8px',
            transition: 'all 0.2s',
            cursor: 'pointer',

            border: 'none',

          }}
          onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
          onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
        >
          <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>➕</span>
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {

      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

      setDockApps(newDockApps);
      if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
        setIsEditMode(false);
      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
          borderRadius: '100px',
          padding: '2px 8px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: '2px',
          boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
          position: 'relative'
        }}>
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';

            >

                  height: '18px',

                  fontWeight: 'bold',

            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>➕</span>

      </div>

          <div style={{

            {/* Header */}
            <div style={{
              padding: '16px',
              borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',

            }}>
              <h3 style={{ color: 'white', margin: 0, fontWeight: 'normal' }}>Add to Dock</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)} style={{
                background: 'none',

                  outline: 'none'

                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
