java
package com.dixie.launcher;

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.Base64;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.List;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "InstalledApps")
public class InstalledAppsPlugin extends Plugin {

    @PluginMethod
    public void getInstalledApps(PluginCall call) {
        try {
            PackageManager pm = getContext().getPackageManager();
            List<ApplicationInfo> packages = pm.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA);
            
            JSONArray appsArray = new JSONArray();
            
            for (ApplicationInfo appInfo : packages) {
                // Skip system apps and DiXie itself
                boolean isSystemApp = (appInfo.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0;
                boolean isUpdatedSystemApp = (appInfo.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_UPDATED_SYSTEM_APP) != 0;
                
                if (isSystemApp || isUpdatedSystemApp) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                // Also skip DiXie itself
                if (appInfo.packageName.equals("com.dixie.launcher")) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                String name = pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString();
                String packageName = appInfo.packageName;
                String iconBase64 = getIconBase64(pm, appInfo);
                
                JSONObject app = new JSONObject();
                app.put("name", name);
                app.put("packageName", packageName);
                app.put("icon", iconBase64);
                
                appsArray.put(app);
            }
            
            JSObject result = new JSObject();
            result.put("apps", appsArray);
            call.resolve(result);
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            call.reject("Failed to get apps: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
    
    private String getIconBase64(PackageManager pm, ApplicationInfo appInfo) {
        try {
            Drawable icon = pm.getApplicationIcon(appInfo);
            Bitmap bitmap = drawableToBitmap(icon);
            ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, baos);
            byte[] imageBytes = baos.toByteArray();
            return Base64.encodeToString(imageBytes, Base64.DEFAULT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }
    
    private Bitmap drawableToBitmap(Drawable drawable) {
        if (drawable == null) return null;
        
        int width = drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
        int height = drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();
        
        if (width <= 0) width = 100;
        if (height <= 0) height = 100;
        
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(bitmap);
        drawable.setBounds(0, 0, canvas.getWidth(), canvas.getHeight());
        drawable.draw(canvas);
        return bitmap;
    }
}

package com.dixie.launcher;

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.Base64;
import android.util.Log;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.List;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "InstalledApps")
public class InstalledAppsPlugin extends Plugin {

    private static final String TAG = "InstalledAppsPlugin";

    @PluginMethod
    public void getInstalledApps(PluginCall call) {
        try {
            PackageManager pm = getContext().getPackageManager();
            List<ApplicationInfo> packages = pm.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA);
            
            JSONArray appsArray = new JSONArray();
            
            for (ApplicationInfo appInfo : packages) {
                // Get all apps including system, then filter in JS
                String name = pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString();
                String packageName = appInfo.packageName;
                boolean isSystemApp = (appInfo.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0;
                String iconBase64 = getIconBase64(pm, appInfo);
                
                JSONObject app = new JSONObject();
                app.put("name", name);
                app.put("packageName", packageName);
                app.put("icon", iconBase64);
                app.put("isSystemApp", isSystemApp);
                
                appsArray.put(app);
            }
            
            JSObject result = new JSObject();
            result.put("apps", appsArray);
            call.resolve(result);
            Log.d(TAG, "Found " + packages.size() + " total apps");
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error getting apps: " + e.getMessage());
            call.reject("Failed to get apps: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
    
    private String getIconBase64(PackageManager pm, ApplicationInfo appInfo) {
        try {
            Drawable icon = pm.getApplicationIcon(appInfo);
            Bitmap bitmap = drawableToBitmap(icon);
            ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, baos);
            byte[] imageBytes = baos.toByteArray();
            return Base64.encodeToString(imageBytes, Base64.DEFAULT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error getting icon for " + appInfo.packageName + ": " + e.getMessage());
            return "";
        }
    }
    
    private Bitmap drawableToBitmap(Drawable drawable) {
        if (drawable == null) return null;
        
        int width = drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
        int height = drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();
        
        if (width <= 0) width = 100;
        if (height <= 0) height = 100;
        
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(bitmap);
        drawable.setBounds(0, 0, canvas.getWidth(), canvas.getHeight());
        drawable.draw(canvas);
        return bitmap;
    }
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        console.log('Apps received:', result.apps.length);
        
        // Filter out DiXie itself
        const userApps = result.apps.filter(app => 
          app.packageName !== 'com.dixie.launcher'
        );
        
        console.log('User apps:', userApps.length);
        setAllApps(userApps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);

      if (newDockApps.length === 0) {

        }}
        onContextMenu={(e) => {

package com.dixie.launcher;

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.Base64;
import android.util.Log;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.List;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "InstalledApps")
public class InstalledAppsPlugin extends Plugin {

    private static final String TAG = "InstalledAppsPlugin";

    @PluginMethod
    public void getInstalledApps(PluginCall call) {
        try {
            PackageManager pm = getContext().getPackageManager();
            List<ApplicationInfo> packages = pm.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA);
            
            JSONArray appsArray = new JSONArray();
            
            for (ApplicationInfo appInfo : packages) {
                // Skip system apps - only get user installed apps
                boolean isSystemApp = (appInfo.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0;
                boolean isUpdatedSystemApp = (appInfo.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_UPDATED_SYSTEM_APP) != 0;
                
                // Only include if it's NOT a system app AND NOT an updated system app
                if (isSystemApp || isUpdatedSystemApp) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                // Skip DiXie itself
                if (appInfo.packageName.equals("com.dixie.launcher")) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                String name = pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString();
                String packageName = appInfo.packageName;
                String iconBase64 = getIconBase64(pm, appInfo);
                
                JSONObject app = new JSONObject();
                app.put("name", name);
                app.put("packageName", packageName);
                app.put("icon", iconBase64);
                
                appsArray.put(app);
                Log.d(TAG, "Added user app: " + name + " (" + packageName + ")");
            }
            
            JSObject result = new JSObject();
            result.put("apps", appsArray);
            call.resolve(result);
            Log.d(TAG, "Total user apps found: " + appsArray.length());
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error getting apps: " + e.getMessage());
            call.reject("Failed to get apps: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
    
    private String getIconBase64(PackageManager pm, ApplicationInfo appInfo) {
        try {
            Drawable icon = pm.getApplicationIcon(appInfo);
            Bitmap bitmap = drawableToBitmap(icon);
            ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, baos);
            byte[] imageBytes = baos.toByteArray();
            return Base64.encodeToString(imageBytes, Base64.DEFAULT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error getting icon for " + appInfo.packageName + ": " + e.getMessage());
            return "";
        }
    }
    
    private Bitmap drawableToBitmap(Drawable drawable) {
        if (drawable == null) return null;
        
        int width = drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
        int height = drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();
        
        if (width <= 0) width = 100;
        if (height <= 0) height = 100;
        
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(bitmap);
        drawable.setBounds(0, 0, canvas.getWidth(), canvas.getHeight());
        drawable.draw(canvas);
        return bitmap;
    }
}

package com.dixie.launcher;

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.Base64;
import android.util.Log;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.List;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "InstalledApps")
public class InstalledAppsPlugin extends Plugin {

    private static final String TAG = "InstalledAppsPlugin";

    @PluginMethod
    public void getInstalledApps(PluginCall call) {
        try {
            PackageManager pm = getContext().getPackageManager();
            List<ApplicationInfo> packages = pm.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA);
            
            JSONArray appsArray = new JSONArray();
            
            for (ApplicationInfo appInfo : packages) {
                // Skip DiXie itself
                if (appInfo.packageName.equals("com.dixie.launcher")) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                // Get app name
                String name = pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString();
                String packageName = appInfo.packageName;
                String iconBase64 = getIconBase64(pm, appInfo);
                
                JSONObject app = new JSONObject();
                app.put("name", name);
                app.put("packageName", packageName);
                app.put("icon", iconBase64);
                
                appsArray.put(app);
                Log.d(TAG, "Added app: " + name);
            }
            
            JSObject result = new JSObject();
            result.put("apps", appsArray);
            call.resolve(result);
            Log.d(TAG, "Total apps sent: " + appsArray.length());
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error: " + e.getMessage());
            call.reject("Failed to get apps: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
    
    private String getIconBase64(PackageManager pm, ApplicationInfo appInfo) {
        try {
            Drawable icon = pm.getApplicationIcon(appInfo);
            Bitmap bitmap = drawableToBitmap(icon);
            ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, baos);
            byte[] imageBytes = baos.toByteArray();
            return Base64.encodeToString(imageBytes, Base64.DEFAULT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Icon error for " + appInfo.packageName + ": " + e.getMessage());
            return "";
        }
    }
    
    private Bitmap drawableToBitmap(Drawable drawable) {
        if (drawable == null) return null;
        
        int width = drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
        int height = drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();
        
        if (width <= 0) width = 100;
        if (height <= 0) height = 100;
        
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(bitmap);
        drawable.setBounds(0, 0, canvas.getWidth(), canvas.getHeight());
        drawable.draw(canvas);
        return bitmap;
    }
}

package com.dixie.launcher;

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.Base64;
import android.util.Log;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.List;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "InstalledApps")
public class InstalledAppsPlugin extends Plugin {

    private static final String TAG = "InstalledAppsPlugin";

    @PluginMethod
    public void getInstalledApps(PluginCall call) {
        try {
            PackageManager pm = getContext().getPackageManager();
            List<ApplicationInfo> packages = pm.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA);
            
            JSONArray appsArray = new JSONArray();
            
            for (ApplicationInfo appInfo : packages) {
                // Skip DiXie itself
                if (appInfo.packageName.equals("com.dixie.launcher")) {
                    continue;
                }
                
                // Check if this is a user-installed app (not system)
                boolean isSystemApp = (appInfo.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0;
                boolean isUpdatedSystemApp = (appInfo.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_UPDATED_SYSTEM_APP) != 0;
                
                // Only include if it's NOT a system app
                if (isSystemApp && !isUpdatedSystemApp) {
                    continue; // Skip pure system apps
                }
                
                // For updated system apps, still include them (like Chrome, Gmail)
                // But we want to exclude real system apps like Bluetooth, Android System, etc.
                String packageNameLower = appInfo.packageName.toLowerCase();
                if (packageNameLower.contains("android") && !packageNameLower.contains("instagram") && 
                    !packageNameLower.contains("whatsapp") && !packageNameLower.contains("facebook")) {
                    // Skip generic Android packages
                    if (packageNameLower.startsWith("android.") || 
                        packageNameLower.contains("com.android.") && !packageNameLower.contains("chrome") &&
                        !packageNameLower.contains("gmail") && !packageNameLower.contains("photos")) {
                        continue;
                    }
                }
                
                String name = pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString();
                String packageName = appInfo.packageName;
                String iconBase64 = getIconBase64(pm, appInfo);
                
                JSONObject app = new JSONObject();
                app.put("name", name);
                app.put("packageName", packageName);
                app.put("icon", iconBase64);
                
                appsArray.put(app);
                Log.d(TAG, "Added user app: " + name);
            }
            
            JSObject result = new JSObject();
            result.put("apps", appsArray);
            call.resolve(result);
            Log.d(TAG, "Total user apps sent: " + appsArray.length());
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error: " + e.getMessage());
            call.reject("Failed to get apps: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
    
    private String getIconBase64(PackageManager pm, ApplicationInfo appInfo) {
        try {
            Drawable icon = pm.getApplicationIcon(appInfo);
            Bitmap bitmap = drawableToBitmap(icon);
            ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, baos);
            byte[] imageBytes = baos.toByteArray();
            return Base64.encodeToString(imageBytes, Base64.DEFAULT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Icon error: " + e.getMessage());
            return "";
        }
    }
    
    private Bitmap drawableToBitmap(Drawable drawable) {
        if (drawable == null) return null;
        
        int width = drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
        int height = drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();
        
        if (width <= 0) width = 100;
        if (height <= 0) height = 100;
        
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(bitmap);
        drawable.setBounds(0, 0, canvas.getWidth(), canvas.getHeight());
        drawable.draw(canvas);
        return bitmap;
    }
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        alert('Total apps found: ' + result.apps.length);
        
        // List of system packages to exclude
        const excludePackages = [
          'com.android',
          'android',
          'com.samsung',
          'com.sec',
          'com.google.android.gms',
          'com.google.android.gsf',
          'com.google.android.inputmethod',
          'com.google.android.syncadapters',
          'com.samsung.android',
          'com.sec.android',
          'com.microsoft.skydrive',
          'com.microsoft.appmanager',
          'com.microsoft.office'
        ];
        
        // Keep only user apps (not system)
        const userApps = result.apps.filter((app: InstalledApp) => {
          const packageName = app.packageName.toLowerCase();
          const isSystemApp = excludePackages.some(exclude => packageName.includes(exclude.toLowerCase()));
          return !isSystemApp && app.packageName !== 'com.dixie.launcher';
        });
        
        alert('User apps filtered: ' + userApps.length);
        
        setAllApps(userApps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (userApps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(userApps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        alert('Error: ' + error);
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
      setDockApps(newDockApps);
      if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
        setIsEditMode(false);
      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: '50%',
          transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
          zIndex: 50
        }}
        onContextMenu={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          handleLongPress();
        }}
      >
        <div style={{
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
          borderRadius: '100px',
          padding: '2px 8px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: '2px',
          boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
          position: 'relative'
        }}>
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '24px', height: '24px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(true)}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* App Drawer Modal */}
      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          bottom: 0,
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(15px)',
          zIndex: 100,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center'
        }} onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)}>
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '24px',
            width: '90%',
            maxWidth: '500px',
            maxHeight: '80%',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)'
          }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            
            <div style={{
              padding: '20px',
              borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              alignItems: 'center'
            }}>
              <h3 style={{ color: 'white', margin: 0, fontSize: '18px', fontWeight: '500' }}>Add to Dock</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)} style={{
                background: 'none',
                border: 'none',
                color: 'white',
                fontSize: '24px',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                opacity: 0.7
              }}>✕</button>
            </div>
            
            <div style={{ padding: '16px 20px' }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search apps..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '12px 16px',
                  borderRadius: '12px',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                  background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '14px',
                  outline: 'none'
                }}
              />
            </div>
            
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '0 20px 20px 20px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)',
              gap: '16px'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    padding: '12px 8px',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
                    border: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)'}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '44px', height: '44px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '36px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                  <span style={{
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '11px',
                    marginTop: '8px',
                    textAlign: 'center'
                  }}>{app.name}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)',
                  padding: '60px 20px'
                }}>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

const loadApps = async () => {
  try {
    const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
    alert('Total apps found: ' + result.apps.length);
    
    // List of package patterns that indicate USER apps (keep these)
    // These are common apps users actually install
    const userAppPatterns = [
      'instagram', 'whatsapp', 'facebook', 'twitter', 'snapchat', 
      'tiktok', 'telegram', 'discord', 'reddit', 'netflix', 
      'spotify', 'youtube', 'prime', 'disney', 'hulu',
      'pinterest', 'linkedin', 'messenger', 'signal', 'viber',
      'zoom', 'teams', 'slack', 'outlook', 'keep',
      'drive', 'docs', 'sheets', 'slides', 'calendar',
      'tasks', 'keep', 'translate', 'maps', 'gmail',
      'chrome', 'firefox', 'opera', 'edge', 'brave',
      'bank', 'banking', 'paypal', 'venmo', 'cashapp',
      'uber', 'lyft', 'doordash', 'grubhub', 'amazon',
      'walmart', 'target', 'ebay', 'etsy', 'aliexpress',
      'games', 'game', 'play', 'studio', 'mobile'
    ];
    
    // Also include common package prefixes for user apps
    const userPackagePrefixes = [
      'com.instagram', 'com.whatsapp', 'com.facebook', 'com.twitter',
      'com.snapchat', 'com.tiktok', 'org.telegram', 'com.discord',
      'com.reddit', 'com.netflix', 'com.spotify', 'com.google.android.apps',
      'com.google.android.gm', 'com.android.chrome', 'org.mozilla',
      'com.microsoft', 'com.slack', 'com.zoom', 'com.amazon'
    ];
    
    // Filter: Keep apps that match user patterns OR have been installed by user
    const userApps = result.apps.filter((app: InstalledApp) => {
      const packageLower = app.packageName.toLowerCase();
      const nameLower = app.name.toLowerCase();
      
      // Check if it matches user app patterns
      const matchesPattern = userAppPatterns.some(pattern => 
        nameLower.includes(pattern) || packageLower.includes(pattern)
      );
      
      // Check if it matches package prefix
      const matchesPrefix = userPackagePrefixes.some(prefix => 
        packageLower.startsWith(prefix)
      );
      
      // Also keep apps that are NOT system (based on common system indicators)
      const isNotSystem = !packageLower.includes('android') || 
                          packageLower.includes('chrome') ||
                          packageLower.includes('gmail');
      
      return (matchesPattern || matchesPrefix) && isNotSystem;
    });
    
    alert('User apps found: ' + userApps.length);
    
    setAllApps(userApps);
    
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (saved) {
      const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
      setDockApps(savedApps);
    } else if (userApps.length > 0) {
      setDockApps(userApps.slice(0, 8));
    }
  } catch (error) {
    alert('Error: ' + error);
    console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
  } finally {
    setLoading(false);
  }
};

  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);

  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        alert('Total apps found: ' + result.apps.length);
        
        // List of package patterns that indicate USER apps (keep these)
        const userAppPatterns = [
          'instagram', 'whatsapp', 'facebook', 'twitter', 'snapchat', 
          'tiktok', 'telegram', 'discord', 'reddit', 'netflix', 
          'spotify', 'youtube', 'prime', 'disney', 'hulu',
          'pinterest', 'linkedin', 'messenger', 'signal', 'viber',
          'zoom', 'teams', 'slack', 'outlook', 'keep',
          'drive', 'docs', 'sheets', 'slides', 'calendar',
          'tasks', 'translate', 'maps', 'gmail', 'chrome', 
          'firefox', 'opera', 'edge', 'brave', 'bank', 'banking', 
          'paypal', 'venmo', 'cashapp', 'uber', 'lyft', 'doordash', 
          'grubhub', 'amazon', 'walmart', 'target', 'ebay', 'etsy', 
          'aliexpress', 'games', 'game', 'play', 'studio', 'mobile',
          'dixie', 'launcher'
        ];
        
        // Also include common package prefixes for user apps
        const userPackagePrefixes = [
          'com.instagram', 'com.whatsapp', 'com.facebook', 'com.twitter',
          'com.snapchat', 'com.tiktok', 'org.telegram', 'com.discord',
          'com.reddit', 'com.netflix', 'com.spotify', 'com.google.android.apps',
          'com.google.android.gm', 'com.android.chrome', 'org.mozilla',
          'com.microsoft', 'com.slack', 'com.zoom', 'com.amazon',
          'com.dixie'
        ];
        
        // Filter: Keep apps that match user patterns
        const userApps = result.apps.filter((app: InstalledApp) => {
          const packageLower = app.packageName.toLowerCase();
          const nameLower = app.name.toLowerCase();
          
          const matchesPattern = userAppPatterns.some(pattern => 
            nameLower.includes(pattern) || packageLower.includes(pattern)
          );
          
          const matchesPrefix = userPackagePrefixes.some(prefix =>

          );
          
          return (matchesPattern || matchesPrefix);
        });
        
        alert('User apps found: ' + userApps.length);
        
        setAllApps(userApps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (userApps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(userApps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        alert('Error: ' + error);
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
      setDockApps(newDockApps);
      if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
        setIsEditMode(false);
      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);

    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(

  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>

  );

  if (loading) {

        position: 'fixed',

        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',

        }}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        
        // Filter out system apps - keep only user installed apps
        const userApps = result.apps.filter((app: InstalledApp) => {
          const packageName = app.packageName.toLowerCase();
          // Skip DiXie itself
          if (packageName === 'com.dixie.launcher') return false;
          // Skip Android system packages
          if (packageName.startsWith('android.')) return false;
          if (packageName.startsWith('com.android.')) return false;
          if (packageName.startsWith('com.google.android.')) return false;
          if (packageName.startsWith('com.samsung.')) return false;
          if (packageName.startsWith('com.sec.')) return false;
          if (packageName.includes('.module')) return false;
          if (packageName.includes('.service')) return false;
          if (packageName.includes('.provider')) return false;
          // Keep everything else (user apps)
          return true;
        });
        
        setAllApps(userApps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (userApps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(userApps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
      setDockApps(newDockApps);
      if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
        setIsEditMode(false);
      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: '50%',
          transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
          zIndex: 50
        }}
        onContextMenu={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          handleLongPress();
        }}
      >
        <div style={{
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
          borderRadius: '100px',
          padding: '2px 8px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: '2px',
          boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
          position: 'relative'
        }}>
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '24px', height: '24px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(true)}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          bottom: 0,
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
          zIndex: 100,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center'
        }} onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)}>
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
            borderRadius: '20px',
            width: '90%',
            maxWidth: '500px',
            maxHeight: '80%',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column'
          }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            
            <div style={{
              padding: '16px 20px',
              borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              alignItems: 'center'
            }}>
              <h3 style={{ color: 'white', margin: 0 }}>Add to Dock</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)} style={{
                background: 'none',
                border: 'none',
                color: 'white',
                fontSize: '24px',
                cursor: 'pointer'
              }}>✕</button>
            </div>
            
            <div style={{ padding: '16px 20px', position: 'relative' }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search apps..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '10px 35px 10px 12px',
                  borderRadius: '10px',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                  background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '14px',
                  outline: 'none'
                }}
              />
              {searchTerm && (
                <button
                  onClick={clearSearch}
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    right: '28px',
                    top: '50%',
                    transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                    fontSize: '16px',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '0 16px 16px 16px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)',
              gap: '12px'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    padding: '12px',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
                    border: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)'}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '40px', height: '40px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '32px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                  <span style={{
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '11px',
                    marginTop: '8px',
                    textAlign: 'center'
                  }}>{app.name}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)',
                  padding: '40px'
                }}>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        alert('Total apps found: ' + result.apps.length);
        
        // Show ALL apps without filtering first to see what we have
        // Just remove DiXie itself
        const allExceptSelf = result.apps.filter((app: InstalledApp) => 
          app.packageName !== 'com.dixie.launcher'
        );
        
        alert('All apps (except DiXie): ' + allExceptSelf.length);
        
        setAllApps(allExceptSelf);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (allExceptSelf.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(allExceptSelf.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        alert('Error: ' + error);
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
      setDockApps(newDockApps);
      if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
        setIsEditMode(false);
      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: '50%',
          transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
          zIndex: 50
        }}
        onContextMenu={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          handleLongPress();
        }}
      >
        <div style={{
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
          borderRadius: '100px',
          padding: '2px 8px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: '2px',
          boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
          position: 'relative'
        }}>
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '24px', height: '24px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(true)}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          bottom: 0,
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
          zIndex: 100,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center'
        }} onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)}>
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
            borderRadius: '20px',
            width: '90%',
            maxWidth: '500px',
            maxHeight: '80%',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column'
          }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            
            <div style={{
              padding: '16px 20px',
              borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              alignItems: 'center'
            }}>
              <h3 style={{ color: 'white', margin: 0 }}>Add to Dock</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)} style={{
                background: 'none',
                border: 'none',
                color: 'white',
                fontSize: '24px',
                cursor: 'pointer'
              }}>✕</button>
            </div>
            
            <div style={{ padding: '16px 20px', position: 'relative' }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search apps..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '10px 35px 10px 12px',
                  borderRadius: '10px',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                  background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '14px',
                  outline: 'none'
                }}
              />
              {searchTerm && (
                <button
                  onClick={clearSearch}
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    right: '28px',
                    top: '50%',
                    transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                    fontSize: '16px',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '0 16px 16px 16px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)',
              gap: '12px'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    padding: '12px',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
                    border: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)'}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '40px', height: '40px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '32px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                  <span style={{
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '11px',
                    marginTop: '8px',
                    textAlign: 'center'
                  }}>{app.name}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)',
                  padding: '40px'
                }}>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

Now I can see the issue from the Logcat. All the apps listed are system apps (Samsung, Android, Google services). Your actual user apps like Instagram, WhatsApp, etc. are NOT appearing in the list.

This means the plugin is only returning system apps. The issue is in the native Android plugin - it's not filtering correctly on Samsung devices.

Let me fix the plugin to return ALL apps (including user-installed ones).

✅ Complete File: android/app/src/main/java/com/dixie/launcher/InstalledAppsPlugin.java
java
package com.dixie.launcher;

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.Base64;
import android.util.Log;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.List;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "InstalledApps")
public class InstalledAppsPlugin extends Plugin {

    private static final String TAG = "InstalledAppsPlugin";

    @PluginMethod
    public void getInstalledApps(PluginCall call) {
        try {
            PackageManager pm = getContext().getPackageManager();
            List<ApplicationInfo> packages = pm.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA);
            
            JSONArray appsArray = new JSONArray();
            
            for (ApplicationInfo appInfo : packages) {
                // Don't skip anything - return ALL apps including system
                // We'll filter in JavaScript
                
                String name = pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString();
                String packageName = appInfo.packageName;
                boolean isSystemApp = (appInfo.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0;
                String iconBase64 = getIconBase64(pm, appInfo);
                
                JSONObject app = new JSONObject();
                app.put("name", name);
                app.put("packageName", packageName);
                app.put("icon", iconBase64);
                app.put("isSystemApp", isSystemApp);
                
                appsArray.put(app);
                Log.d(TAG, "App: " + name + " - System: " + isSystemApp);
            }
            
            JSObject result = new JSObject();
            result.put("apps", appsArray);
            call.resolve(result);
            Log.d(TAG, "Total apps sent: " + appsArray.length());
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error: " + e.getMessage());
            call.reject("Failed to get apps: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
    
    private String getIconBase64(PackageManager pm, ApplicationInfo appInfo) {
        try {
            Drawable icon = pm.getApplicationIcon(appInfo);
            Bitmap bitmap = drawableToBitmap(icon);
            ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, baos);
            byte[] imageBytes = baos.toByteArray();
            return Base64.encodeToString(imageBytes, Base64.DEFAULT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Icon error: " + e.getMessage());
            return "";
        }
    }
    
    private Bitmap drawableToBitmap(Drawable drawable) {
        if (drawable == null) return null;
        
        int width = drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
        int height = drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();
        
        if (width <= 0) width = 100;
        if (height <= 0) height = 100;
        
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(bitmap);
        drawable.setBounds(0, 0, canvas.getWidth(), canvas.getHeight());
        drawable.draw(canvas);
        return bitmap;
    }
}

package com.dixie.launcher;

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.Base64;
import android.util.Log;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.List;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "InstalledApps")
public class InstalledAppsPlugin extends Plugin {

    private static final String TAG = "InstalledAppsPlugin";

    @PluginMethod
    public void getInstalledApps(PluginCall call) {
        try {
            PackageManager pm = getContext().getPackageManager();
            List<ApplicationInfo> packages = pm.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA);
            
            JSONArray appsArray = new JSONArray();
            
            for (ApplicationInfo appInfo : packages) {
                String name = pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString();
                String packageName = appInfo.packageName;
                boolean isSystemApp = (appInfo.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0;
                String iconBase64 = getIconBase64(pm, appInfo);
                
                JSONObject app = new JSONObject();
                app.put("name", name);
                app.put("packageName", packageName);
                app.put("icon", iconBase64);
                app.put("isSystemApp", isSystemApp);
                
                appsArray.put(app);
                Log.d(TAG, "App: " + name + " - Package: " + packageName + " - System: " + isSystemApp);
            }
            
            JSObject result = new JSObject();
            result.put("apps", appsArray);
            call.resolve(result);
            Log.d(TAG, "Total apps sent: " + appsArray.length());
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error: " + e.getMessage());
            call.reject("Failed to get apps: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
    
    private String getIconBase64(PackageManager pm, ApplicationInfo appInfo) {
        try {
            Drawable icon = pm.getApplicationIcon(appInfo);
            Bitmap bitmap = drawableToBitmap(icon);
            ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, baos);
            byte[] imageBytes = baos.toByteArray();
            return Base64.encodeToString(imageBytes, Base64.DEFAULT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Icon error for " + appInfo.packageName + ": " + e.getMessage());
            return "";
        }
    }
    
    private Bitmap drawableToBitmap(Drawable drawable) {
        if (drawable == null) return null;
        
        int width = drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
        int height = drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();
        
        if (width <= 0) width = 100;
        if (height <= 0) height = 100;
        
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(bitmap);
        drawable.setBounds(0, 0, canvas.getWidth(), canvas.getHeight());
        drawable.draw(canvas);
        return bitmap;
    }
}
