import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        
        // Exclude patterns for system apps
        const excludePatterns = [
          'android', 'google.android.gms', 'google.android.gsf', 'google.android.inputmethod',
          'samsung', 'sec.android', 'knox', 'bixby', 'shell', 'settings', 'systemui',
          'wallpaper', 'keychain', 'bluetooth', 'nfc', 'sim toolkit', 'wifi', 'call',
          'phone services', 'package installer', 'permission controller', 'storage',
          'device care', 'digital wellbeing', 'emergency', 'find my mobile',
          'nearby', 'quick share', 'smart things', 'galaxy', 'one ui'
        ];
        
        const userApps = result.apps.filter((app: any) => {
          const nameLower = app.name.toLowerCase();
          const packageLower = app.packageName.toLowerCase();
          
          if (packageLower === 'com.dixie.launcher') return false;
          
          const isSystem = excludePatterns.some(pattern => 
            nameLower.includes(pattern) || packageLower.includes(pattern)
          );
          
          return !isSystem;
        });
        
        setAllApps(userApps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (userApps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(userApps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
      setDockApps(newDockApps);
      if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
        setIsEditMode(false);
      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: '50%',
          transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
          zIndex: 50
        }}
        onContextMenu={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          handleLongPress();
        }}
      >
        <div style={{
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
          borderRadius: '100px',
          padding: '2px 8px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: '2px',
          boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
          position: 'relative'
        }}>
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '24px', height: '24px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(true)}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          bottom: 0,
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
          zIndex: 100,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center'
        }} onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)}>
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
            borderRadius: '20px',
            width: '90%',
            maxWidth: '500px',
            maxHeight: '80%',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column'
          }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            
            <div style={{
              padding: '16px 20px',
              borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              alignItems: 'center'
            }}>
              <h3 style={{ color: 'white', margin: 0 }}>Add to Dock</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)} style={{
                background: 'none',
                border: 'none',
                color: 'white',
                fontSize: '24px',
                cursor: 'pointer'
              }}>✕</button>
            </div>
            
            <div style={{ padding: '16px 20px', position: 'relative' }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search apps..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '10px 35px 10px 12px',
                  borderRadius: '10px',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                  background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '14px',
                  outline: 'none'
                }}
              />
              {searchTerm && (
                <button
                  onClick={clearSearch}
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    right: '28px',
                    top: '50%',
                    transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                    fontSize: '16px',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '0 16px 16px 16px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)',
              gap: '12px'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    padding: '12px',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
                    border: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)'}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '40px', height: '40px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '32px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                  <span style={{
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '11px',
                    marginTop: '8px',
                    textAlign: 'center'
                  }}>{app.name}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)',
                  padding: '40px'
                }}>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default Dock;

✅ Complete File: android/app/src/main/java/com/dixie/launcher/InstalledAppsPlugin.java
java
package com.dixie.launcher;

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.Base64;
import android.util.Log;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.List;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "InstalledApps")
public class InstalledAppsPlugin extends Plugin {

    private static final String TAG = "InstalledAppsPlugin";

    @PluginMethod
    public void getInstalledApps(PluginCall call) {
        try {
            PackageManager pm = getContext().getPackageManager();
            List<ApplicationInfo> packages = pm.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA);
            
            JSONArray appsArray = new JSONArray();
            
            for (ApplicationInfo appInfo : packages) {
                // Don't skip anything - send ALL apps
                String name = pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString();
                String packageName = appInfo.packageName;
                String iconBase64 = getIconBase64(pm, appInfo);
                
                JSONObject app = new JSONObject();
                app.put("name", name);
                app.put("packageName", packageName);
                app.put("icon", iconBase64);
                
                appsArray.put(app);
                Log.d(TAG, "App: " + name + " | " + packageName);
            }
            
            JSObject result = new JSObject();
            result.put("apps", appsArray);
            call.resolve(result);
            Log.d(TAG, "TOTAL APPS SENT: " + appsArray.length());
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error: " + e.getMessage());
            call.reject("Failed to get apps: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
    
    private String getIconBase64(PackageManager pm, ApplicationInfo appInfo) {
        try {
            Drawable icon = pm.getApplicationIcon(appInfo);
            Bitmap bitmap = drawableToBitmap(icon);
            ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, baos);
            byte[] imageBytes = baos.toByteArray();
            return Base64.encodeToString(imageBytes, Base64.DEFAULT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Icon error for " + appInfo.packageName + ": " + e.getMessage());
            return "";
        }
    }
    
    private Bitmap drawableToBitmap(Drawable drawable) {
        if (drawable == null) return null;
        
        int width = drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
        int height = drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();
        
        if (width <= 0) width = 100;
        if (height <= 0) height = 100;
        
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(bitmap);
        drawable.setBounds(0, 0, canvas.getWidth(), canvas.getHeight());
        drawable.draw(canvas);
        return bitmap;
    }
}

  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        
        console.log('=== ALL APPS ===');
        result.apps.forEach((app: any, i: number) => {
          console.log(`${i + 1}. ${app.name} - ${app.packageName}`);
        });
        
        alert(`Total apps detected: ${result.apps.length}`);
        
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
        alert('Error: ' + error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
      setDockApps(newDockApps);
      if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
        setIsEditMode(false);
      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: '50%',
          transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
          zIndex: 50
        }}
        onContextMenu={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          handleLongPress();
        }}
      >
        <div style={{
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
          borderRadius: '100px',
          padding: '2px 8px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: '2px',
          boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
          position: 'relative'
        }}>
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '24px', height: '24px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(true)}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          bottom: 0,
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
          zIndex: 100,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center'
        }} onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)}>
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
            borderRadius: '20px',
            width: '90%',
            maxWidth: '500px',
            maxHeight: '80%',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column'
          }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            
            <div style={{
              padding: '16px 20px',
              borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              alignItems: 'center'
            }}>
              <h3 style={{ color: 'white', margin: 0 }}>Add to Dock</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)} style={{
                background: 'none',
                border: 'none',
                color: 'white',
                fontSize: '24px',
                cursor: 'pointer'
              }}>✕</button>
            </div>
            
            <div style={{ padding: '16px 20px', position: 'relative' }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search apps..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '10px 35px 10px 12px',
                  borderRadius: '10px',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                  background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '14px',
                  outline: 'none'
                }}
              />
              {searchTerm && (
                <button
                  onClick={clearSearch}
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    right: '28px',
                    top: '50%',
                    transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                    fontSize: '16px',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '0 16px 16px 16px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)',
              gap: '12px'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    padding: '12px',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
                    border: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)'}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '40px', height: '40px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '32px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                  <span style={{
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '11px',
                    marginTop: '8px',
                    textAlign: 'center'
                  }}>{app.name}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)',
                  padding: '40px'
                }}>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

package com.dixie.launcher;

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.Base64;
import android.util.Log;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.List;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "InstalledApps")
public class InstalledAppsPlugin extends Plugin {

    private static final String TAG = "InstalledAppsPlugin";

    @PluginMethod
    public void getInstalledApps(PluginCall call) {
        try {
            PackageManager pm = getContext().getPackageManager();
            
            // Use GET_ACTIVITIES flag to get all launchable apps
            List<ApplicationInfo> packages = pm.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA | PackageManager.GET_ACTIVITIES);
            
            JSONArray appsArray = new JSONArray();
            
            for (ApplicationInfo appInfo : packages) {
                // Check if app has launcher icon (user can open it)
                boolean hasLauncherIcon = pm.getLaunchIntentForPackage(appInfo.packageName) != null;
                
                // Include app if it has a launcher icon or is not a system app
                if (hasLauncherIcon || (appInfo.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) == 0) {
                    String name = pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString();
                    String packageName = appInfo.packageName;
                    String iconBase64 = getIconBase64(pm, appInfo);
                    
                    JSONObject app = new JSONObject();
                    app.put("name", name);
                    app.put("packageName", packageName);
                    app.put("icon", iconBase64);
                    
                    appsArray.put(app);
                    Log.d(TAG, "User app: " + name + " - " + packageName);
                } else {
                    Log.d(TAG, "Skipped system app: " + appInfo.packageName);
                }
            }
            
            JSObject result = new JSObject();
            result.put("apps", appsArray);
            call.resolve(result);
            Log.d(TAG, "TOTAL USER APPS: " + appsArray.length());
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error: " + e.getMessage());
            call.reject("Failed to get apps: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
    
    private String getIconBase64(PackageManager pm, ApplicationInfo appInfo) {
        try {
            Drawable icon = pm.getApplicationIcon(appInfo);
            Bitmap bitmap = drawableToBitmap(icon);
            ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, baos);
            byte[] imageBytes = baos.toByteArray();
            return Base64.encodeToString(imageBytes, Base64.DEFAULT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Icon error for " + appInfo.packageName + ": " + e.getMessage());
            return "";
        }
    }
    
    private Bitmap drawableToBitmap(Drawable drawable) {
        if (drawable == null) return null;
        
        int width = drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
        int height = drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();
        
        if (width <= 0) width = 100;
        if (height <= 0) height = 100;
        
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(bitmap);
        drawable.setBounds(0, 0, canvas.getWidth(), canvas.getHeight());
        drawable.draw(canvas);
        return bitmap;
    }
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        
        // Show first 20 app names in an alert
        const first20Names = result.apps.slice(0, 20).map((app: any) => app.name).join('\n');
        alert('First 20 apps from plugin:\n\n' + first20Names);
        
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
        alert('Error: ' + error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
      setDockApps(newDockApps);
      if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
        setIsEditMode(false);
      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const filteredApps = allApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',

        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'

        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );

      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: '50%',
          transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
          zIndex: 50
        }}
        onContextMenu={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          handleLongPress();
        }}
      >
        <div style={{
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
          borderRadius: '100px',
          padding: '2px 8px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: '2px',
          boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
          position: 'relative'
        }}>
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10

                  style={{ width: '24px', height: '24px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>

The problem is that the plugin is not detecting all user apps. This is a known issue with Samsung's PackageManager - it requires specific queries to get all apps.

Let me update the plugin to use PM.GET_ACTIVITIES flag to get ALL launchable apps.

✅ Complete File: android/app/src/main/java/com/dixie/launcher/InstalledAppsPlugin.java

package com.dixie.launcher;

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.Base64;
import android.util.Log;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.List;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "InstalledApps")
public class InstalledAppsPlugin extends Plugin {

    private static final String TAG = "InstalledAppsPlugin";

    @PluginMethod
    public void getInstalledApps(PluginCall call) {
        try {
            PackageManager pm = getContext().getPackageManager();
            
            // Use GET_ACTIVITIES to get all apps that have activities (launchable apps)
            List<ApplicationInfo> packages = pm.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA | PackageManager.GET_ACTIVITIES);
            
            JSONArray appsArray = new JSONArray();
            int userAppCount = 0;
            
            for (ApplicationInfo appInfo : packages) {
                // Get all apps that have a launch intent (user can open them)
                if (pm.getLaunchIntentForPackage(appInfo.packageName) != null) {
                    userAppCount++;
                    String name = pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString();
                    String packageName = appInfo.packageName;
                    String iconBase64 = getIconBase64(pm, appInfo);
                    
                    JSONObject app = new JSONObject();
                    app.put("name", name);
                    app.put("packageName", packageName);
                    app.put("icon", iconBase64);
                    
                    appsArray.put(app);
                    Log.d(TAG, "Launchable app: " + name + " | " + packageName);
                }
            }
            
            JSObject result = new JSObject();
            result.put("apps", appsArray);
            call.resolve(result);
            Log.d(TAG, "TOTAL LAUNCHABLE APPS: " + appsArray.length());
            
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Error: " + e.getMessage());
            call.reject("Failed to get apps: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
    
    private String getIconBase64(PackageManager pm, ApplicationInfo appInfo) {
        try {
            Drawable icon = pm.getApplicationIcon(appInfo);
            Bitmap bitmap = drawableToBitmap(icon);
            ByteArrayOutputStream baos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, baos);
            byte[] imageBytes = baos.toByteArray();
            return Base64.encodeToString(imageBytes, Base64.DEFAULT);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Log.e(TAG, "Icon error for " + appInfo.packageName + ": " + e.getMessage());
            return "";
        }
    }
    
    private Bitmap drawableToBitmap(Drawable drawable) {
        if (drawable == null) return null;
        
        int width = drawable.getIntrinsicWidth();
        int height = drawable.getIntrinsicHeight();
        
        if (width <= 0) width = 100;
        if (height <= 0) height = 100;
        
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(width, height, Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888);
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(bitmap);
        drawable.setBounds(0, 0, canvas.getWidth(), canvas.getHeight());
        drawable.draw(canvas);
        return bitmap;
    }
}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
      setDockApps(newDockApps);
      if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
        setIsEditMode(false);
      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const filteredApps = allApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: '50%',
          transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
          zIndex: 50
        }}
        onContextMenu={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          handleLongPress();
        }}
      >
        <div style={{
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
          borderRadius: '100px',
          padding: '2px 8px',
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          gap: '2px',
          boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
          border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
          position: 'relative'
        }}>
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '24px', height: '24px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(true)}
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',

            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          bottom: 0,
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)',
          zIndex: 100,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center'
        }} onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)}>
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
            borderRadius: '20px',
            width: '90%',
            maxWidth: '500px',
            maxHeight: '80%',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column'
          }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            
            <div style={{
              padding: '16px 20px',
              borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              alignItems: 'center'
            }}>
              <h3 style={{ color: 'white', margin: 0 }}>Add to Dock</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)} style={{
                background: 'none',
                border: 'none',
                color: 'white',
                fontSize: '24px',
                cursor: 'pointer'
              }}>✕</button>
            </div>
            
            <div style={{ padding: '16px 20px', position: 'relative' }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search apps..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '10px 35px 10px 12px',
                  borderRadius: '10px',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                  background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '14px',
                  outline: 'none'
                }}
              />
              {searchTerm && (
                <button
                  onClick={clearSearch}
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    right: '28px',
                    top: '50%',
                    transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                    fontSize: '16px',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '0 16px 16px 16px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)',
              gap: '12px'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',

                    position: 'absolute',
                    right: '28px',
                    top: '50%',
                    transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                    fontSize: '16px',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >

            </div>

              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '0 16px 16px 16px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)',
              gap: '12px'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    padding: '12px',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
                    border: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)'}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '40px', height: '40px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '32px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                  <span style={{
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '11px',
                    marginTop: '8px',
                    textAlign: 'center'
                  }}>{app.name}</span>

                }}>

          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
      setDockApps(newDockApps);
      if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
        setIsEditMode(false);
      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 50,
          pointerEvents: 'none'
        }}
      >
        <div 
          ref={scrollRef}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '100px',
            padding: '4px 12px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '4px',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            overflowX: 'auto',
            overflowY: 'hidden',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            maxWidth: '90%',
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
            scrollbarWidth: 'thin'
          }}
          onContextMenu={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleLongPress();
          }}
        >
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative',
                flexShrink: 0
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '24px', height: '24px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(true)}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7,
              flexShrink: 0
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          bottom: 0,
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(15px)',
          zIndex: 100,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center'
        }} onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)}>
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '20px',
            width: '90%',
            maxWidth: '500px',
            maxHeight: '80%',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)'
          }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            
            <div style={{
              padding: '16px 20px',
              borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              alignItems: 'center'
            }}>
              <h3 style={{ color: 'white', margin: 0, fontWeight: 'normal' }}>Add to Dock</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)} style={{
                background: 'none',
                border: 'none',
                color: 'white',
                fontSize: '24px',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                opacity: 0.7
              }}>✕</button>
            </div>
            
            <div style={{ padding: '16px 20px', position: 'relative' }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search apps..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '10px 35px 10px 12px',
                  borderRadius: '10px',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                  background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '14px',
                  outline: 'none'
                }}
              />
              {searchTerm && (
                <button
                  onClick={clearSearch}
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    right: '28px',
                    top: '50%',
                    transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                    fontSize: '16px',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '0 16px 16px 16px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4, 1fr)',
              gap: '12px'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    padding: '12px',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
                    border: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)'}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '44px', height: '44px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '32px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)',
                  padding: '40px'
                }}>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
      setDockApps(newDockApps);
      if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
        setIsEditMode(false);
      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 50,
          pointerEvents: 'none'
        }}
      >
        <div 
          ref={scrollRef}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '100px',
            padding: '4px 12px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '4px',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            overflowX: 'auto',
            overflowY: 'hidden',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            maxWidth: '90%',
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
            scrollbarWidth: 'thin'
          }}
          onContextMenu={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleLongPress();
          }}
        >
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative',
                flexShrink: 0
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '24px', height: '24px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(true)}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7,
              flexShrink: 0
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '20px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          top: 0,
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          bottom: 0,
          backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)',
          backdropFilter: 'blur(15px)',
          zIndex: 100,
          display: 'flex',
          alignItems: 'center',
          justifyContent: 'center'
        }} onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)}>
          <div style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '20px',
            width: '90%',
            maxWidth: '600px',
            maxHeight: '80%',
            overflow: 'hidden',
            display: 'flex',
            flexDirection: 'column',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)'
          }} onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
            
            {/* Apps Grid - 7 per row */}
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '16px 16px 0 16px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(7, 1fr)',
              gap: '8px'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    padding: '8px 4px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'transparent',
                    border: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.05)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '40px', height: '40px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '32px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)',
                  padding: '40px'
                }}>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {/* Search Bar - at bottom */}
            <div style={{ padding: '16px 20px', position: 'relative', borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)' }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search apps..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '10px 35px 10px 12px',
                  borderRadius: '10px',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                  background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '14px',
                  outline: 'none'
                }}
              />
              {searchTerm && (
                <button
                  onClick={clearSearch}
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    right: '28px',
                    top: '50%',
                    transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                    fontSize: '16px',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {/* Close button */}
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowAppDrawer(false)}
              style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                top: '8px',
                right: '8px',
                background: 'none',
                border: 'none',
                color: 'white',
                fontSize: '20px',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                opacity: 0.5
              }}
            >
              ✕
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {

            handleLongPress();

        >

              <input

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
      setDockApps(newDockApps);
      if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
        setIsEditMode(false);
      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
