        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 50,
          pointerEvents: 'none'
        }}
      >
        <div 
          ref={scrollRef}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '100px',
            padding: '4px 12px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '4px',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            overflowX: 'auto',
            overflowY: 'hidden',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            maxWidth: '90%',
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
            scrollbarWidth: 'thin'
          }}
          onContextMenu={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleLongPress();
          }}
        >
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',

              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {

              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {

                  style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}

        >

          <div

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [animation, setAnimation] = useState('');
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const modalRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const closeTimeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
      setDockApps(newDockApps);
      if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
        setIsEditMode(false);
      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
    }
    closeDrawer();
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const openDrawer = () => {
    setShowAppDrawer(true);
    setAnimation('bounceIn');
    setTimeout(() => setAnimation(''), 350);
  };

  const closeDrawer = () => {
    if (closeTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(closeTimeoutRef.current);
    setAnimation('bounceOut');
    closeTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setShowAppDrawer(false);
      setAnimation('');
    }, 250);
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 50,
          pointerEvents: 'none'
        }}
      >
        <div 
          ref={scrollRef}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '100px',
            padding: '4px 12px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '4px',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            overflowX: 'auto',
            overflowY: 'hidden',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            maxWidth: '90%',
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
            scrollbarWidth: 'thin'
          }}
          onContextMenu={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleLongPress();
          }}
        >
          {dockApps.map((app) => (

              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',

      }
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
    }
    closeDrawer();
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const openDrawer = () => {
    setShowAppDrawer(true);
    setAnimation('bounceIn');
    setTimeout(() => setAnimation(''), 350);
  };

  const closeDrawer = () => {
    if (closeTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(closeTimeoutRef.current);
    setAnimation('bounceOut');
    closeTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setShowAppDrawer(false);
      setAnimation('');
      closeTimeoutRef.current = null;
    }, 250);
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',

        borderRadius: '100px',

  return (
    <>
      <div

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [animation, setAnimation] = useState('');
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const modalRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const closeTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));

      }

  }, [dockApps]);

      }

  );

  if (loading) {

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';
import { InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface FloatingWindow {
  id: string;
  app: InstalledApp;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);
  const [floatingWindows, setFloatingWindows] = useState<FloatingWindow[]>([]);
  const [draggedWindow, setDraggedWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOffset, setDragOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [resizingWindow, setResizingWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0 });

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    // Create new floating window
    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id));
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
    }
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, isTitleBar: boolean) => {
    if (!isTitleBar) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,
      y: e.clientY - window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (draggedWindow) {
      const newWindows = floatingWindows.map(w => {
        if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
          return {
            ...w,
            x: Math.max(0, Math.min(e.clientX - dragOffset.x, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
            y: Math.max(0, Math.min(e.clientY - dragOffset.y, window.innerHeight - 100))
          };
        }
        return w;
      });
      setFloatingWindows(newWindows);
    } else if (resizingWindow) {
      const newWindows = floatingWindows.map(w => {
        if (w.id === resizingWindow) {

          return {

            width: newWidth,
            height: newHeight
          };
        }
        return w;
      });
      setFloatingWindows(newWindows);
    }
  };

  const handleMouseUp = () => {
    setDraggedWindow(null);
    setResizingWindow(null);
  };

  React.useEffect(() => {
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
  }, []);

  return (

export default Desktop;
✅ What this does:
Tap any app in the dock → Creates a floating window

Floating windows are draggable - Drag by the title bar

Resizable - Drag the bottom-right corner

Close button - X button in top-right of each window

Click to front - Clicking a window brings it to the front

Multiple windows - Each new window offsets slightly

✅ Rebuild
bash
npm run build
npx cap sync android
npx cap run android
Now when you tap any app in the dock, it opens as a draggable, resizable floating window! 🚀

The issue is that the onMouseMove listener is on the desktop container, but you need to track mouse movement globally. Let me fix it.

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';
import { InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface FloatingWindow {
  id: string;
  app: InstalledApp;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);
  const [floatingWindows, setFloatingWindows] = useState<FloatingWindow[]>([]);
  const [draggedWindow, setDraggedWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOffset, setDragOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [resizingWindow, setResizingWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0 });

  // Use refs for mouse tracking to avoid stale closures
  const mouseMoveRef = useRef<((e: MouseEvent) => void) | null>(null);
  const mouseUpRef = useRef<((e: MouseEvent) => void) | null>(null);

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    // Create new floating window
    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id));
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
    }
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,
      y: e.clientY - window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  // Global mouse move handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = e.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = e.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      } else if (resizingWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            const newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + (e.clientX - resizeStart.x));
            const newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + (e.clientY - resizeStart.y));
            return {
              ...w,
              width: newWidth,
              height: newHeight
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  // Also handle touch for mobile
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = touch.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = touch.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (resizingWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            const newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + (touch.clientX - resizeStart.x));
            const newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + (touch.clientY - resizeStart.y));
            return {
              ...w,
              width: newWidth,
              height: newHeight
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    };

    const handleTouchEnd = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove);
      window.removeEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {/* Floating Windows */}
        {floatingWindows.map((window) => (
          <div
            key={window.id}
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              left: window.x,
              top: window.y,
              width: window.width,
              height: window.height,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
              borderRadius: '12px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              zIndex: floatingWindows.indexOf(window) + 50
            }}
          >
            {/* Title Bar */}
            <div
              style={{
                height: '36px',
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                padding: '0 12px',
                cursor: 'move'
              }}
              onMouseDown={(e) => handleMouseDown(e, window.id)}
              onTouchStart={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const touch = e.touches[0];
                setDraggedWindow(window.id);
                setDragOffset({
                  x: touch.clientX - window.x,
                  y: touch.clientY - window.y
                });
                bringToFront(window.id);
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                  <img 
                    src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                    alt={window.app.name}
                    style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '16px' }}>📱</span>
                )}
                <span style={{ color: 'white', fontSize: '12px' }}>{window.app.name}</span>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => closeWindow(window.id)}
                style={{
                  background: 'none',
                  border: 'none',
                  color: 'white',

                  cursor: 'pointer',

                }}

            <div
              style={{

                justifyContent: 'center',
                color: 'white',

                    />

                    border: 'none',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',

                  }}
                >
                  Launch App

                });
                bringToFront(window.id);

            />

        ))}

  const [resizingWindow, setResizingWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0 });
  const [activeResizeCorner, setActiveResizeCorner] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400,
      showResizeHandle: false
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id));
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
    }
  };

  const showResizeHandles = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
      ...w,
      showResizeHandle: w.id === id ? true : false
    })));
    // Hide after 3 seconds
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
        ...w,
        showResizeHandle: false
      })));
    }, 3000);
  };

  const handleTitleBarClick = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    showResizeHandles(id);
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleTitleBarTouch = (id: string) => {
    showResizeHandles(id);
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,
      y: e.clientY - window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, corner: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setActiveResizeCorner(corner);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  // Global mouse move handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = e.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = e.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 80))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      } else if (resizingWindow && activeResizeCorner) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = w.x;
            let newY = w.y;

            switch (activeResizeCorner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(250, resizeStart.width + (e.clientX - resizeStart.x));
                newHeight = Math.max(200, resizeStart.height + (e.clientY - resizeStart.y));
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(250, resizeStart.width - (e.clientX - resizeStart.x));
                newHeight = Math.max(200, resizeStart.height + (e.clientY - resizeStart.y));
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(250, resizeStart.width + (e.clientX - resizeStart.x));
                newHeight = Math.max(200, resizeStart.height - (e.clientY - resizeStart.y));
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(250, resizeStart.width - (e.clientX - resizeStart.x));
                newHeight = Math.max(200, resizeStart.height - (e.clientY - resizeStart.y));
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
            }
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, newX),
              y: Math.max(0, newY),
              width: Math.min(newWidth, window.innerWidth - newX),
              height: Math.min(newHeight, window.innerHeight - newY - 50)
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
      setActiveResizeCorner(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, activeResizeCorner, resizeStart]);

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {/* Floating Windows */}
        {floatingWindows.map((window) => (
          <div
            key={window.id}
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              left: window.x,
              top: window.y,
              width: window.width,
              height: window.height,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
              borderRadius: '12px',
              border: window.showResizeHandle ? '2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)' : '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: window.showResizeHandle ? '0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)' : '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              zIndex: floatingWindows.indexOf(window) + 50,
              cursor: 'default',
              transition: window.showResizeHandle ? 'box-shadow 0.1s ease' : 'none'
            }}
          >
            {/* Title Bar - Click to show resize handles */}
            <div
              style={{
                height: '36px',
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                padding: '0 12px',
                cursor: 'move'
              }}
              onMouseDown={(e) => handleMouseDown(e, window.id)}
              onClick={(e) => handleTitleBarClick(e, window.id)}
              onTouchStart={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const touch = e.touches[0];
                setDraggedWindow(window.id);
                setDragOffset({
                  x: touch.clientX - window.x,
                  y: touch.clientY - window.y
                });
                bringToFront(window.id);
              }}
              onTouchEnd={() => handleTitleBarTouch(window.id)}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                  <img 
                    src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                    alt={window.app.name}
                    style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '16px' }}>📱</span>
                )}
                <span style={{ color: 'white', fontSize: '12px' }}>{window.app.name}</span>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  closeWindow(window.id);
                }}
                style={{
                  background: 'none',
                  border: 'none',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '16px',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  opacity: 0.7,
                  width: '24px',
                  height: '24px',
                  borderRadius: '4px'
                }}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)'}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = 'transparent'}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>
            
            {/* Content */}
            <div
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                color: 'white',
                fontSize: '14px',
                textAlign: 'center',
                padding: '16px'
              }}
            >
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '32px', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
                  {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                      alt={window.app.name}
                      style={{ width: '48px', height: '48px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span>📱</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p>{window.app.name}</p>
                <p style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                  {window.app.packageName}
                </p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => alert(`Launching ${window.app.name} (${window.app.packageName})`)}
                  style={{
                    marginTop: '16px',
                    padding: '8px 16px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    border: 'none',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  Launch App
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Resize Handles - Show only when active */}
            {window.showResizeHandle && (
              <>
                {/* Top-Left Handle */}
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: -6,
                    left: -6,
                    width: '16px',
                    height: '16px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: 'white',
                    border: '2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
                    cursor: 'nw-resize',
                    zIndex: 200
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'top-left')}
                />
                
                {/* Top-Right Handle */}
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: -6,
                    right: -6,
                    width: '16px',
                    height: '16px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: 'white',
                    border: '2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
                    cursor: 'ne-resize',
                    zIndex: 200
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'top-right')}
                />
                
                {/* Bottom-Left Handle */}
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: -6,
                    left: -6,
                    width: '16px',
                    height: '16px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: 'white',
                    border: '2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
                    cursor: 'sw-resize',
                    zIndex: 200
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'bottom-left')}
                />
                
                {/* Bottom-Right Handle */}
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: -6,
                    right: -6,
                    width: '16px',
                    height: '16px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: 'white',
                    border: '2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
                    cursor: 'se-resize',
                    zIndex: 200
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'bottom-right')}
                />
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
        
        <Dock onItemClick={handleDockItemClick} />
      </div>
    </Wallpaper>
  );
};

export default Desktop;
✅ What this adds:
Click the title bar → Shows 4 circular resize handles at the corners

Visual indicator - White circles at each corner when active

Outline effect - The window gets a thicker border and outer glow

Handles auto-hide - After 3 seconds of inactivity

All 4 corners can resize - Top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right

npm run build
npx cap sync android
npx cap run android

interface FloatingWindow {
  id: string;
  app: InstalledApp;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  showResizeHandles: boolean;
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {

  const [resizingWindow, setResizingWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0 });
  const [activeResizeCorner, setActiveResizeCorner] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activeWindowId, setActiveWindowId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const hideTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400,
      showResizeHandles: false
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
    setActiveWindowId(newWindow.id);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id));
    if (activeWindowId === id) setActiveWindowId(null);
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
      setActiveWindowId(id);
    }
  };

  const showResizeHandles = (id: string) => {
    // Clear existing timeout
    if (hideTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(hideTimeoutRef.current);
    
    setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
      ...w,
      showResizeHandles: w.id === id
    })));
    
    // Hide after 3 seconds
    hideTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
        ...w,
        showResizeHandles: false
      })));
    }, 3000);
  };

  const handleTitleBarClick = (id: string) => {
    showResizeHandles(id);
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,
      y: e.clientY - window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, corner: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setActiveResizeCorner(corner);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  // Global mouse move handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = e.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = e.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 80))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      } else if (resizingWindow && activeResizeCorner) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = w.x;
            let newY = w.y;

            switch (activeResizeCorner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(250, resizeStart.width + (e.clientX - resizeStart.x));
                newHeight = Math.max(200, resizeStart.height + (e.clientY - resizeStart.y));
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(250, resizeStart.width - (e.clientX - resizeStart.x));
                newHeight = Math.max(200, resizeStart.height + (e.clientY - resizeStart.y));
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(250, resizeStart.width + (e.clientX - resizeStart.x));
                newHeight = Math.max(200, resizeStart.height - (e.clientY - resizeStart.y));
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(250, resizeStart.width - (e.clientX - resizeStart.x));
                newHeight = Math.max(200, resizeStart.height - (e.clientY - resizeStart.y));
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
            }
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, newX),
              y: Math.max(0, newY),
              width: Math.min(newWidth, window.innerWidth - newX),
              height: Math.min(newHeight, window.innerHeight - newY - 50)
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
      setActiveResizeCorner(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, activeResizeCorner, resizeStart]);

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {/* Floating Windows */}
        {floatingWindows.map((window) => (
          <div
            key={window.id}
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              left: window.x,
              top: window.y,
              width: window.width,
              height: window.height,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
              borderRadius: '12px',
              border: activeWindowId === window.id ? '2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)' : '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: activeWindowId === window.id ? '0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)' : '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              zIndex: floatingWindows.indexOf(window) + 50,
              cursor: 'default'
            }}
            onClick={() => {
              bringToFront(window.id);
              showResizeHandles(window.id);
            }}
          >
            {/* Title Bar */}
            <div
              style={{
                height: '36px',
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                padding: '0 12px',
                cursor: 'move'
              }}
              onMouseDown={(e) => handleMouseDown(e, window.id)}
              onTouchStart={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const touch = e.touches[0];
                setDraggedWindow(window.id);
                setDragOffset({
                  x: touch.clientX - window.x,
                  y: touch.clientY - window.y
                });
                bringToFront(window.id);
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                  <img 
                    src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                    alt={window.app.name}
                    style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '16px' }}>📱</span>
                )}
                <span style={{ color: 'white', fontSize: '12px' }}>{window.app.name}</span>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={(e) => {
                  e.stopPropagation();
                  closeWindow(window.id);
                }}
                style={{
                  background: 'none',
                  border: 'none',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '16px',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  opacity: 0.7,
                  width: '24px',
                  height: '24px',
                  borderRadius: '4px'
                }}
                onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)'}
                onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.backgroundColor = 'transparent'}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>
            
            {/* Content */}
            <div
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                color: 'white',
                fontSize: '14px',
                textAlign: 'center',
                padding: '16px'
              }}
            >
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '32px', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
                  {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                      alt={window.app.name}
                      style={{ width: '48px', height: '48px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span>📱</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p>{window.app.name}</p>
                <p style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                  {window.app.packageName}
                </p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => alert(`Launching ${window.app.name} (${window.app.packageName})`)}
                  style={{
                    marginTop: '16px',
                    padding: '8px 16px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    border: 'none',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  Launch App
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Resize Handles */}
            {window.showResizeHandles && (
              <>
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: -8,
                    left: -8,
                    width: '16px',
                    height: '16px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: 'white',
                    border: '2px solid #rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
                    cursor: 'nw-resize',
                    zIndex: 200
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'top-left')}
                />
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: -8,
                    right: -8,
                    width: '16px',
                    height: '16px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: 'white',
                    border: '2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
                    cursor: 'ne-resize',
                    zIndex: 200
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'top-right')}
                />
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: -8,
                    left: -8,
                    width: '16px',
                    height: '16px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: 'white',
                    border: '2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
                    cursor: 'sw-resize',
                    zIndex: 200
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'bottom-left')}
                />
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: -8,
                    right: -8,
                    width: '16px',
                    height: '16px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: 'white',
                    border: '2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
                    cursor: 'se-resize',
                    zIndex: 200
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'bottom-right')}
                />
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
        
        <Dock onItemClick={handleDockItemClick} />
      </div>
    </Wallpaper>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';
import { InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface FloatingWindow {
  id: string;
  app: InstalledApp;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  showResizeHandles: boolean;
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();

  const [floatingWindows, setFloatingWindows] = useState<FloatingWindow[]>([]);

  const longPressTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }

    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),

      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400,
      showResizeHandles: false
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
    setActiveWindowId(newWindow.id);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id));
    if (activeWindowId === id) setActiveWindowId(null);
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
      setActiveWindowId(id);
    }
  };

  const showResizeHandles = (id: string) => {
    if (hideTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(hideTimeoutRef.current);
    
    setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
      ...w,
      showResizeHandles: w.id === id
    })));
    
    hideTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
        ...w,
        showResizeHandles: false
      })));
    }, 3000);
  };

  // Long press on window to show resize handles
  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, isTitleBar: boolean) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    if (isTitleBar) {
      // Title bar - start drag immediately
      const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
      if (!window) return;
      
      setDraggedWindow(id);
      setDragOffset({
        x: e.clientX - window.x,
        y: e.clientY - window.y
      });
      bringToFront(id);
    } else {
      // Content area - long press to show resize handles
      if (longPressTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(longPressTimerRef.current);
      
      longPressTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        showResizeHandles(id);
        bringToFront(id);
        longPressTimerRef.current = null;
      }, 500);
    }
  };

  const handleMouseUp = () => {
    if (longPressTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(longPressTimerRef.current);
      longPressTimerRef.current = null;
    }
  };

  const handleTitleBarClick = (id: string) => {
    showResizeHandles(id);
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, corner: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setActiveResizeCorner(corner);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  // Global mouse move handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = e.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = e.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 80))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      } else if (resizingWindow && activeResizeCorner) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = w.x;
            let newY = w.y;

            switch (activeResizeCorner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(250, resizeStart.width + (e.clientX - resizeStart.x));
                newHeight = Math.max(200, resizeStart.height + (e.clientY - resizeStart.y));
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(250, resizeStart.width - (e.clientX - resizeStart.x));
                newHeight = Math.max(200, resizeStart.height + (e.clientY - resizeStart.y));
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(250, resizeStart.width + (e.clientX - resizeStart.x));
                newHeight = Math.max(200, resizeStart.height - (e.clientY - resizeStart.y));
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(250, resizeStart.width - (e.clientX - resizeStart.x));
                newHeight = Math.max(200, resizeStart.height - (e.clientY - resizeStart.y));
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
            }
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, newX),
              y: Math.max(0, newY),
              width: Math.min(newWidth, window.innerWidth - newX),
              height: Math.min(newHeight, window.innerHeight - newY - 50)
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      }
    };

    const handleGlobalMouseUp = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
      setActiveResizeCorner(null);
      handleMouseUp();
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleGlobalMouseUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleGlobalMouseUp);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, activeResizeCorner, resizeStart]);
