import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';
import { InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface FloatingWindow {
  id: string;
  app: InstalledApp;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  showResizeHandles: boolean;
  cornerHovered: string | null;
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);
  const [floatingWindows, setFloatingWindows] = useState<FloatingWindow[]>([]);
  const [draggedWindow, setDraggedWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOffset, setDragOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [resizingWindow, setResizingWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0, corner: '' });
  const [activeWindowId, setActiveWindowId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const hideTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const longPressTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const hoverTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400,
      showResizeHandles: false,
      cornerHovered: null
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
    setActiveWindowId(newWindow.id);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id));
    if (activeWindowId === id) setActiveWindowId(null);
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
      setActiveWindowId(id);
    }
  };

  const showResizeHandles = (id: string, show: boolean = true) => {
    if (hideTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(hideTimeoutRef.current);
    
    setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
      ...w,
      showResizeHandles: w.id === id ? show : false
    })));
    
    if (show) {
      hideTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
          ...w,
          showResizeHandles: false
        })));
      }, 3000);
    }
  };

  const handleCornerHover = (id: string, corner: string | null) => {
    if (hoverTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(hoverTimerRef.current);
    
    if (corner) {
      hoverTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        showResizeHandles(id, true);
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
          ...w,
          cornerHovered: w.id === id ? corner : null
        })));
        hoverTimerRef.current = null;
      }, 150);
    } else {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
        ...w,
        cornerHovered: null
      })));
    }
  };

  const handleCornerLeave = (id: string) => {
    if (hoverTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(hoverTimerRef.current);
      hoverTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
      ...w,
      cornerHovered: null
    })));
  };

  // Long press on content to show resize handles
  const handleContentMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    if (longPressTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(longPressTimerRef.current);
    
    longPressTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      showResizeHandles(id, true);
      bringToFront(id);
      longPressTimerRef.current = null;
    }, 500);
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,
      y: e.clientY - window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, corner: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height,
      corner: corner
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  // Global mouse move handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = e.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = e.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      } else if (resizingWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = w.x;
            let newY = w.y;
            
            const deltaX = e.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = e.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
            }
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, newX),
              y: Math.max(0, newY),
              width: Math.min(newWidth, window.innerWidth - newX),
              height: Math.min(newHeight, window.innerHeight - newY - 50)
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  // Also handle touch for mobile
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = touch.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = touch.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (resizingWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = w.x;
            let newY = w.y;
            
            const deltaX = touch.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = touch.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
            }
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, newX),
              y: Math.max(0, newY),
              width: Math.min(newWidth, window.innerWidth - newX),
              height: Math.min(newHeight, window.innerHeight - newY - 50)
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    };

    const handleTouchEnd = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
      if (longPressTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(longPressTimerRef.current);
        longPressTimerRef.current = null;
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove);
      window.removeEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {floatingWindows.map((window) => (
          <div
            key={window.id}
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              left: window.x,
              top: window.y,
              width: window.width,
              height: window.height,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
              borderRadius: '12px',
              border: activeWindowId === window.id ? '2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)' : '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              zIndex: floatingWindows.indexOf(window) + 50
            }}
          >
            {/* Title Bar */}
            <div
              style={{
                height: '36px',
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                padding: '0 12px',
                cursor: 'move'
              }}
              onMouseDown={(e) => handleMouseDown(e, window.id)}
              onTouchStart={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const touch = e.touches[0];
                setDraggedWindow(window.id);
                setDragOffset({
                  x: touch.clientX - window.x,
                  y: touch.clientY - window.y
                });
                bringToFront(window.id);
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                  <img 
                    src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                    alt={window.app.name}
                    style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '16px' }}>📱</span>
                )}
                <span style={{ color: 'white', fontSize: '12px' }}>{window.app.name}</span>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => closeWindow(window.id)}
                style={{
                  background: 'none',
                  border: 'none',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '16px',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  opacity: 0.7
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>
            
            {/* Content - Long press for resize handles */}
            <div
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                color: 'white',
                fontSize: '14px',
                textAlign: 'center',
                padding: '16px'
              }}
              onMouseDown={(e) => handleContentMouseDown(e, window.id)}
            >
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '32px', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
                  {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                      alt={window.app.name}
                      style={{ width: '48px', height: '48px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span>📱</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p>{window.app.name}</p>
                <p style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                  {window.app.packageName}
                </p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => alert(`Launching ${window.app.name} (${window.app.packageName})`)}
                  style={{
                    marginTop: '16px',
                    padding: '8px 16px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    border: 'none',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  Launch App
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Resize Handles - Show on hover OR long press */}
            {(window.showResizeHandles || window.cornerHovered) && (
              <>
                {/* Top-Left Handle */}
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: -12,
                    left: -12,
                    width: 24,
                    height: 24,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: window.cornerHovered === 'top-left' ? '#5E81AC' : '#ffffff',
                    border: window.cornerHovered === 'top-left' ? '3px solid #ffffff' : '3px solid #5E81AC',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
                    cursor: 'nw-resize',
                    zIndex: 200,
                    transition: 'all 0.1s ease'
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'top-left')}
                  onMouseEnter={() => handleCornerHover(window.id, 'top-left')}
                  onMouseLeave={() => handleCornerLeave(window.id)}
                  onTouchStart={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const touch = e.touches[0];
                    setResizingWindow(window.id);
                    setResizeStart({
                      x: touch.clientX,
                      y: touch.clientY,
                      width: window.width,
                      height: window.height,
                      corner: 'top-left'
                    });
                    bringToFront(window.id);
                  }}
                />
                {/* Top-Right Handle */}
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: -12,
                    right: -12,
                    width: 24,
                    height: 24,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: window.cornerHovered === 'top-right' ? '#5E81AC' : '#ffffff',
                    border: window.cornerHovered === 'top-right' ? '3px solid #ffffff' : '3px solid #5E81AC',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
                    cursor: 'ne-resize',
                    zIndex: 200,
                    transition: 'all 0.1s ease'
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'top-right')}
                  onMouseEnter={() => handleCornerHover(window.id, 'top-right')}
                  onMouseLeave={() => handleCornerLeave(window.id)}
                  onTouchStart={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const touch = e.touches[0];
                    setResizingWindow(window.id);
                    setResizeStart({
                      x: touch.clientX,
                      y: touch.clientY,
                      width: window.width,
                      height: window.height,
                      corner: 'top-right'
                    });
                    bringToFront(window.id);
                  }}
                />
                {/* Bottom-Left Handle */}
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: -12,
                    left: -12,
                    width: 24,
                    height: 24,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: window.cornerHovered === 'bottom-left' ? '#5E81AC' : '#ffffff',
                    border: window.cornerHovered === 'bottom-left' ? '3px solid #ffffff' : '3px solid #5E81AC',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
                    cursor: 'sw-resize',
                    zIndex: 200,
                    transition: 'all 0.1s ease'
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'bottom-left')}
                  onMouseEnter={() => handleCornerHover(window.id, 'bottom-left')}
                  onMouseLeave={() => handleCornerLeave(window.id)}
                  onTouchStart={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const touch = e.touches[0];
                    setResizingWindow(window.id);
                    setResizeStart({
                      x: touch.clientX,
                      y: touch.clientY,
                      width: window.width,
                      height: window.height,
                      corner: 'bottom-left'
                    });
                    bringToFront(window.id);
                  }}
                />
                {/* Bottom-Right Handle */}
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: -12,
                    right: -12,
                    width: 24,
                    height: 24,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: window.cornerHovered === 'bottom-right' ? '#5E81AC' : '#ffffff',
                    border: window.cornerHovered === 'bottom-right' ? '3px solid #ffffff' : '3px solid #5E81AC',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
                    cursor: 'se-resize',
                    zIndex: 200,
                    transition: 'all 0.1s ease'
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'bottom-right')}
                  onMouseEnter={() => handleCornerHover(window.id, 'bottom-right')}
                  onMouseLeave={() => handleCornerLeave(window.id)}
                  onTouchStart={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const touch = e.touches[0];
                    setResizingWindow(window.id);
                    setResizeStart({
                      x: touch.clientX,
                      y: touch.clientY,
                      width: window.width,
                      height: window.height,
                      corner: 'bottom-right'
                    });
                    bringToFront(window.id);
                  }}
                />
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
        
        <Dock onItemClick={handleDockItemClick} />
      </div>
    </Wallpaper>
  );
};

export default Desktop;

Long press content → Shows handles (for touch devices)

Auto-hide → Handles disappear after 3 seconds of no interaction

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';
import { InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface FloatingWindow {
  id: string;
  app: InstalledApp;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  showResizeHandles: boolean;
  cornerHovered: string | null;
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);
  const [floatingWindows, setFloatingWindows] = useState<FloatingWindow[]>([]);
  const [draggedWindow, setDraggedWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOffset, setDragOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [resizingWindow, setResizingWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0, corner: '' });
  const [activeWindowId, setActiveWindowId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const hideTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const longPressTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const hoverTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400,
      showResizeHandles: false,
      cornerHovered: null
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
    setActiveWindowId(newWindow.id);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id));
    if (activeWindowId === id) setActiveWindowId(null);
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
      setActiveWindowId(id);
    }
  };

  const showResizeHandles = (id: string, show: boolean = true) => {
    if (hideTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(hideTimeoutRef.current);
    
    setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
      ...w,
      showResizeHandles: w.id === id ? show : false
    })));
    
    if (show) {
      hideTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
          ...w,
          showResizeHandles: false
        })));
      }, 3000);
    }
  };

  const handleCornerHover = (id: string, corner: string | null) => {
    if (hoverTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(hoverTimerRef.current);
    
    if (corner) {
      hoverTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        showResizeHandles(id, true);
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
          ...w,
          cornerHovered: w.id === id ? corner : null
        })));
        hoverTimerRef.current = null;
      }, 150);
    } else {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
        ...w,
        cornerHovered: null
      })));
    }
  };

  const handleCornerLeave = () => {
    if (hoverTimerRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(hoverTimerRef.current);
      hoverTimerRef.current = null;
    }
    setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
      ...w,
      cornerHovered: null
    })));
  };

  // Long press on content to show resize handles
  const handleContentMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    if (longPressTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(longPressTimerRef.current);
    
    longPressTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      showResizeHandles(id, true);
      bringToFront(id);
      longPressTimerRef.current = null;
    }, 500);
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,
      y: e.clientY - window.y
    });

  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, corner: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,

            let newX = w.x;
            let newY = w.y;
            
            const deltaX = e.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = e.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
            }
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, newX),
              y: Math.max(0, newY),
              width: Math.min(newWidth, window.innerWidth - newX),
              height: Math.min(newHeight, window.innerHeight - newY - 50)
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

            const newY = touch.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))

          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (resizingWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {

          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = w.x;
            let newY = w.y;
            
            const deltaX = touch.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = touch.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
            }
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, newX),
              y: Math.max(0, newY),
              width: Math.min(newWidth, window.innerWidth - newX),
              height: Math.min(newHeight, window.innerHeight - newY - 50)
            };
          }

    };

    const handleTouchEnd = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);

    window.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove);
      window.removeEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {floatingWindows.map((window) => (
          <div
            key={window.id}
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              left: window.x,
              top: window.y,
              width: window.width,
              height: window.height,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
              borderRadius: '12px',
              border: activeWindowId === window.id ? '2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)' : '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              zIndex: floatingWindows.indexOf(window) + 50
            }}
          >
            {/* Title Bar */}
            <div
              style={{
                height: '36px',
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                padding: '0 12px',
                cursor: 'move'
              }}
              onMouseDown={(e) => handleMouseDown(e, window.id)}
              onTouchStart={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const touch = e.touches[0];
                setDraggedWindow(window.id);
                setDragOffset({
                  x: touch.clientX - window.x,
                  y: touch.clientY - window.y
                });
                bringToFront(window.id);
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                  <img 
                    src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                    alt={window.app.name}
                    style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '16px' }}>📱</span>
                )}
                <span style={{ color: 'white', fontSize: '12px' }}>{window.app.name}</span>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => closeWindow(window.id)}
                style={{
                  background: 'none',
                  border: 'none',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '16px',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  opacity: 0.7
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>
            
            {/* Content - Long press for resize handles */}
            <div
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                color: 'white',
                fontSize: '14px',
                textAlign: 'center',
                padding: '16px'
              }}
              onMouseDown={(e) => handleContentMouseDown(e, window.id)}
            >
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '32px', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
                  {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                      alt={window.app.name}
                      style={{ width: '48px', height: '48px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span>📱</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p>{window.app.name}</p>
                <p style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                  {window.app.packageName}
                </p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => alert(`Launching ${window.app.name} (${window.app.packageName})`)}
                  style={{
                    marginTop: '16px',
                    padding: '8px 16px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    border: 'none',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  Launch App
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Resize Handles - Show on hover OR long press */}
            {(window.showResizeHandles || window.cornerHovered) && (
              <>
                {/* Top-Left Handle */}
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: -12,
                    left: -12,
                    width: 24,
                    height: 24,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: window.cornerHovered === 'top-left' ? '#5E81AC' : '#ffffff',
                    border: window.cornerHovered === 'top-left' ? '3px solid #ffffff' : '3px solid #5E81AC',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
                    cursor: 'nw-resize',
                    zIndex: 200,
                    transition: 'all 0.1s ease'
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'top-left')}
                  onMouseEnter={() => handleCornerHover(window.id, 'top-left')}
                  onMouseLeave={handleCornerLeave}
                  onTouchStart={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const touch = e.touches[0];
                    setResizingWindow(window.id);
                    setResizeStart({
                      x: touch.clientX,
                      y: touch.clientY,
                      width: window.width,
                      height: window.height,
                      corner: 'top-left'
                    });
                    bringToFront(window.id);
                  }}
                />
                {/* Top-Right Handle */}
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    top: -12,
                    right: -12,
                    width: 24,
                    height: 24,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: window.cornerHovered === 'top-right' ? '#5E81AC' : '#ffffff',
                    border: window.cornerHovered === 'top-right' ? '3px solid #ffffff' : '3px solid #5E81AC',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
                    cursor: 'ne-resize',
                    zIndex: 200,
                    transition: 'all 0.1s ease'
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'top-right')}
                  onMouseEnter={() => handleCornerHover(window.id, 'top-right')}
                  onMouseLeave={handleCornerLeave}
                  onTouchStart={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const touch = e.touches[0];
                    setResizingWindow(window.id);
                    setResizeStart({
                      x: touch.clientX,
                      y: touch.clientY,
                      width: window.width,
                      height: window.height,
                      corner: 'top-right'
                    });
                    bringToFront(window.id);
                  }}
                />
                {/* Bottom-Left Handle */}
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: -12,
                    left: -12,
                    width: 24,
                    height: 24,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: window.cornerHovered === 'bottom-left' ? '#5E81AC' : '#ffffff',
                    border: window.cornerHovered === 'bottom-left' ? '3px solid #ffffff' : '3px solid #5E81AC',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
                    cursor: 'sw-resize',
                    zIndex: 200,
                    transition: 'all 0.1s ease'
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'bottom-left')}
                  onMouseEnter={() => handleCornerHover(window.id, 'bottom-left')}
                  onMouseLeave={handleCornerLeave}
                  onTouchStart={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const touch = e.touches[0];
                    setResizingWindow(window.id);
                    setResizeStart({
                      x: touch.clientX,
                      y: touch.clientY,
                      width: window.width,
                      height: window.height,
                      corner: 'bottom-left'
                    });
                    bringToFront(window.id);
                  }}
                />
                {/* Bottom-Right Handle */}
                <div
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: -12,
                    right: -12,
                    width: 24,
                    height: 24,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    backgroundColor: window.cornerHovered === 'bottom-right' ? '#5E81AC' : '#ffffff',
                    border: window.cornerHovered === 'bottom-right' ? '3px solid #ffffff' : '3px solid #5E81AC',
                    boxShadow: '0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)',
                    cursor: 'se-resize',
                    zIndex: 200,
                    transition: 'all 0.1s ease'
                  }}
                  onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'bottom-right')}
                  onMouseEnter={() => handleCornerHover(window.id, 'bottom-right')}
                  onMouseLeave={handleCornerLeave}
                  onTouchStart={(e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    const touch = e.touches[0];
                    setResizingWindow(window.id);
                    setResizeStart({
                      x: touch.clientX,
                      y: touch.clientY,
                      width: window.width,
                      height: window.height,
                      corner: 'bottom-right'
                    });
                    bringToFront(window.id);
                  }}
                />
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
        
        <Dock onItemClick={handleDockItemClick} />
      </div>
    </Wallpaper>
  );
};

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';
import { InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface FloatingWindow {
  id: string;
  app: InstalledApp;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  showResizeHandles: boolean;
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);
  const [floatingWindows, setFloatingWindows] = useState<FloatingWindow[]>([]);
  const [draggedWindow, setDraggedWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOffset, setDragOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [resizingWindow, setResizingWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0, corner: '' });
  const [activeWindowId, setActiveWindowId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const hideTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const longPressTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400,
      showResizeHandles: false
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
    setActiveWindowId(newWindow.id);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id));
    if (activeWindowId === id) setActiveWindowId(null);
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
      setActiveWindowId(id);
    }
  };

  const showResizeHandles = (id: string) => {
    if (hideTimeoutRef.current) clearTimeout(hideTimeoutRef.current);
    
    setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
      ...w,
      showResizeHandles: w.id === id
    })));
    
    hideTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => ({
        ...w,
        showResizeHandles: false
      })));
    }, 3000);
  };

  // Long press on content to show resize handles
  const handleContentMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    
    if (longPressTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(longPressTimerRef.current);
    
    longPressTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      showResizeHandles(id);
      bringToFront(id);
      longPressTimerRef.current = null;
    }, 500);
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,
      y: e.clientY - window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, corner: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height,
      corner: corner
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  // Global mouse move handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = e.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = e.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      } else if (resizingWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = w.x;
            let newY = w.y;
            
            const deltaX = e.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = e.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
            }
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, newX),
              y: Math.max(0, newY),
              width: Math.min(newWidth, window.innerWidth - newX),
              height: Math.min(newHeight, window.innerHeight - newY - 50)
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  // Also handle touch for mobile
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = touch.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = touch.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (resizingWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = w.x;
            let newY = w.y;
            
            const deltaX = touch.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = touch.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
            }
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, newX),
              y: Math.max(0, newY),
              width: Math.min(newWidth, window.innerWidth - newX),
              height: Math.min(newHeight, window.innerHeight - newY - 50)
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    };

    const handleTouchEnd = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
      if (longPressTimerRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(longPressTimerRef.current);
        longPressTimerRef.current = null;
      }
    };

    window.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove);
      window.removeEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {floatingWindows.map((window) => (
          <div
            key={window.id}
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              left: window.x,
              top: window.y,
              width: window.width,
              height: window.height,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
              borderRadius: '12px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
              boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              zIndex: floatingWindows.indexOf(window) + 50
            }}
          >
            {/* Title Bar */}
            <div
              style={{
                height: '36px',
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                padding: '0 12px',
                cursor: 'move'
              }}
              onMouseDown={(e) => handleMouseDown(e, window.id)}
              onTouchStart={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const touch = e.touches[0];
                setDraggedWindow(window.id);
                setDragOffset({
                  x: touch.clientX - window.x,
                  y: touch.clientY - window.y
                });
                bringToFront(window.id);
              }}

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';
import { InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface FloatingWindow {
  id: string;
  app: InstalledApp;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);
  const [floatingWindows, setFloatingWindows] = useState<FloatingWindow[]>([]);
  const [draggedWindow, setDraggedWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOffset, setDragOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [resizingWindow, setResizingWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0, corner: '' });

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id));
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
    }
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,
      y: e.clientY - window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, corner: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height,
      corner: corner
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  // Global mouse move handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = e.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = e.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      } else if (resizingWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = w.x;
            let newY = w.y;
            
            const deltaX = e.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = e.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
            }
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, newX),
              y: Math.max(0, newY),
              width: Math.min(newWidth, window.innerWidth - newX),
              height: Math.min(newHeight, window.innerHeight - newY - 50)
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  // Also handle touch for mobile
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = touch.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = touch.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (resizingWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = w.x;
            let newY = w.y;
            
            const deltaX = touch.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = touch.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = w.x + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = w.y + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
            }
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, newX),
              y: Math.max(0, newY),
              width: Math.min(newWidth, window.innerWidth - newX),
              height: Math.min(newHeight, window.innerHeight - newY - 50)
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    };

    const handleTouchEnd = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove);
      window.removeEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {floatingWindows.map((window) => (
          <div
            key={window.id}
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              left: window.x,
              top: window.y,
              width: window.width,
              height: window.height,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
              borderRadius: '12px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
              boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',

            }}
          >
            {/* Title Bar - Drag here */}
            <div
              style={{

                backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                padding: '0 12px',
                cursor: 'move'
              }}
              onMouseDown={(e) => handleMouseDown(e, window.id)}
              onTouchStart={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const touch = e.touches[0];
                setDraggedWindow(window.id);
                setDragOffset({
                  x: touch.clientX - window.x,
                  y: touch.clientY - window.y
                });
                bringToFront(window.id);
              }}
            >
              <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                  <img 
                    src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                    alt={window.app.name}
                    style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                  />
                ) : (
                  <span style={{ fontSize: '16px' }}>📱</span>
                )}
                <span style={{ color: 'white', fontSize: '12px' }}>{window.app.name}</span>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => closeWindow(window.id)}
                style={{
                  background: 'none',
                  border: 'none',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '16px',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  opacity: 0.7,
                  width: '24px',
                  height: '24px',
                  borderRadius: '4px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
            </div>
            
            {/* Content */}
            <div
              style={{
                flex: 1,
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                color: 'white',
                fontSize: '14px',
                textAlign: 'center',

              }}
            >
              <div>
                <div style={{ fontSize: '32px', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
                  {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                      alt={window.app.name}
                      style={{ width: '48px', height: '48px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span>📱</span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p>{window.app.name}</p>
                <p style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                  {window.app.packageName}
                </p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => alert(`Launching ${window.app.name} (${window.app.packageName})`)}
                  style={{
                    marginTop: '16px',
                    padding: '8px 16px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    border: 'none',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  Launch App
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Resize Handles - Positioned outside the window to avoid overlap */}
            
            {/* Top-Left Handle */}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';

  const [dragOffset, setDragOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [resizingWindow, setResizingWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0, corner: '', originalX: 0, originalY: 0 });

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,

    };

  };

    if (window) {

      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
    }

    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,

    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height,
      corner: corner,
      originalX: window.x,
      originalY: window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {

            const newX = e.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = e.clientY - dragOffset.y;

              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
