            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = resizeStart.originalX;
            let newY = resizeStart.originalY;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':

                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);

              case 'bottom-left':

        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (resizingWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            const deltaX = touch.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = touch.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = resizeStart.originalX;
            let newY = resizeStart.originalY;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              default:
                break;
            }
            
            newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - newWidth));
            newY = Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100));
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: newX,
              y: newY,
              width: newWidth,
              height: newHeight
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    };

    const handleTouchEnd = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove);
      window.removeEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{

            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40

            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {floatingWindows.map((window) => (
          <div
            key={window.id}
            style={{
              position: 'absolute',
              left: window.x,
              top: window.y,
              width: window.width,
              height: window.height,
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
              borderRadius: '12px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
              boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              zIndex: 50
            }}
          >
            {/* Title Bar - Drag here */}
            <div
              style={{
                height: '36px',
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                display: 'flex',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                padding: '0 12px',
                cursor: 'move'
              }}
              onMouseDown={(e) => handleMouseDown(e, window.id)}
              onTouchStart={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const touch = e.touches[0];
                setDraggedWindow(window.id);
                setDragOffset({
                  x: touch.clientX - window.x,

                <span style={{ color: 'white', fontSize: '12px' }}>{window.app.name}</span>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => closeWindow(window.id)}
                style={{
                  background: 'none',
                  border: 'none',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '16px',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  opacity: 0.7,
                  width: '24px',
                  height: '24px',
                  borderRadius: '4px'
                }}

              }}

              }}

              style={{
                position: 'absolute',

              }}

                e.preventDefault();
                const touch = e.touches[0];
                setResizingWindow(window.id);
                setResizeStart({
                  x: touch.clientX,
                  y: touch.clientY,
                  width: window.width,
                  height: window.height,
                  corner: 'top-right',
                  originalX: window.x,
                  originalY: window.y
                });
                bringToFront(window.id);
              }}
            />
            <div
              style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                bottom: -8,
                left: -8,
                width: 16,
                height: 16,
                borderRadius: '50%',
                backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                border: '2px solid #5E81AC',
                cursor: 'sw-resize',
                zIndex: 200
              }}
              onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'bottom-left')}
              onTouchStart={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const touch = e.touches[0];
                setResizingWindow(window.id);
                setResizeStart({
                  x: touch.clientX,

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';
import { InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface FloatingWindow {
  id: string;
  app: InstalledApp;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  isAnimating?: boolean;
  animationType?: 'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut';
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);
  const [floatingWindows, setFloatingWindows] = useState<FloatingWindow[]>([]);
  const [draggedWindow, setDraggedWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOffset, setDragOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [resizingWindow, setResizingWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0, corner: '', originalX: 0, originalY: 0 });

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400,
      isAnimating: true,
      animationType: 'bounceIn'
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
    
    // Remove animation flag after animation completes
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => 
        w.id === newWindow.id ? { ...w, isAnimating: false, animationType: undefined } : w
      ));
    }, 300);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    // Add bounce out animation
    setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => 
      w.id === id ? { ...w, isAnimating: true, animationType: 'bounceOut' } : w
    ));
    
    // Remove after animation
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.filter(w => w.id !== id));
    }, 250);
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
    }
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,
      y: e.clientY - window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, corner: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height,
      corner: corner,
      originalX: window.x,
      originalY: window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  // Global mouse move handler
  useEffect(() => {

            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))

            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = resizeStart.originalX;
            let newY = resizeStart.originalY;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);

                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              default:
                break;
            }
            
            newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - newWidth));

            return {

          }

        }));
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {

    };

    };

                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              default:
                break;
            }
            
            newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - newWidth));
            newY = Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100));
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: newX,
              y: newY,
              width: newWidth,

            };

    window.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);

    return () => {

    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  return (

        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',

            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',

            <div style={{

                    />
                  ) : (

                <p style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)', marginTop: '8px' }}>

                </p>
                <button
                  onClick={() => alert(`Launching ${window.app.name} (${window.app.packageName})`)}
                  style={{

              }}
              onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'top-left')}
              onTouchStart={(e) => {

                const touch = e.touches[0];
                setResizingWindow(window.id);
                setResizeStart({

            <div
              style={{

                borderRadius: '50%',

            <div

                borderRadius: '50%',

              onTouchStart={(e) => {

                });
                bringToFront(window.id);
              }}
            />
          </div>
        ))}
        
        <Dock onItemClick={handleDockItemClick} />
      </div>
    </Wallpaper>
  );
};

✅ Changes made:
Added animation properties to FloatingWindow interface: isAnimating and animationType

Bounce-in animation when window opens: scales from 0.7 → 1 with elastic easing

Bounce-out animation when closing: scales from 1 → 0.7 and fades out

Animation timing: 250ms for bounce-out, 300ms for bounce-in

CSS transition with cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) for elastic bounce effect

✅ Rebuild
bash
npm run build
npx cap sync android
npx cap run android
Now when you tap an app in the dock, the floating window will bounce in with an elastic effect. When you close it, it will bounce out before disappearing! 🚀

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';
import { InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface FloatingWindow {
  id: string;
  app: InstalledApp;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  isAnimating?: boolean;
  animationType?: 'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut';
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);
  const [floatingWindows, setFloatingWindows] = useState<FloatingWindow[]>([]);
  const [draggedWindow, setDraggedWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOffset, setDragOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [resizingWindow, setResizingWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0, corner: '', originalX: 0, originalY: 0 });

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400,
      isAnimating: true,
      animationType: 'bounceIn'
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => 
        w.id === newWindow.id ? { ...w, isAnimating: false, animationType: undefined } : w
      ));
    }, 600);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => 
      w.id === id ? { ...w, isAnimating: true, animationType: 'bounceOut' } : w
    ));
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.filter(w => w.id !== id));
    }, 500);
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
    }
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,
      y: e.clientY - window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, corner: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height,
      corner: corner,
      originalX: window.x,
      originalY: window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  // Global mouse move handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = e.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = e.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      } else if (resizingWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            const deltaX = e.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = e.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = resizeStart.originalX;
            let newY = resizeStart.originalY;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              default:
                break;
            }
            
            newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - newWidth));
            newY = Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100));
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: newX,
              y: newY,
              width: newWidth,
              height: newHeight
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  // Also handle touch for mobile
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = touch.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = touch.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (resizingWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            const deltaX = touch.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = touch.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = resizeStart.originalX;
            let newY = resizeStart.originalY;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              default:
                break;
            }
            
            newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - newWidth));
            newY = Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100));
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: newX,
              y: newY,
              width: newWidth,
              height: newHeight
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    };

    const handleTouchEnd = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove);
      window.removeEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {floatingWindows.map((window) => {
          // Calculate bounce animation keyframes
          let animationStyle = {};
          if (window.isAnimating && window.animationType === 'bounceIn') {
            animationStyle = {
              animation: 'bounceIn 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) forwards'
            };
          } else if (window.isAnimating && window.animationType === 'bounceOut') {
            animationStyle = {
              animation: 'bounceOut 0.4s ease-in forwards'
            };
          }
          
          return (
            <div
              key={window.id}
              style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                left: window.x,
                top: window.y,
                width: window.width,

                borderRadius: '12px',
                border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',

                      transform: scale(0.3);

                    }
                    70% {
                      transform: scale(0.95);
                    }
                    100% {
                      opacity: 1;
                      transform: scale(1);
                    }
                  }
                  @keyframes bounceOut {
                    0% {

                      transform: scale(1);

                    50% {
                      opacity: 0.5;
                      transform: scale(0.95);
                    }
                    100% {

                      transform: scale(0.3);
                    }

              {/* Title Bar - Drag here */}
              <div

                  const touch = e.touches[0];
                  setDraggedWindow(window.id);
                  setDragOffset({

                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '16px' }}>📱</span>

                </div>
                <button

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';
import { InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface FloatingWindow {
  id: string;
  app: InstalledApp;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  isAnimating?: boolean;
  animationType?: 'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut';
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);
  const [floatingWindows, setFloatingWindows] = useState<FloatingWindow[]>([]);
  const [draggedWindow, setDraggedWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOffset, setDragOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [resizingWindow, setResizingWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0, corner: '', originalX: 0, originalY: 0 });

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400,
      isAnimating: true,
      animationType: 'bounceIn'
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => 
        w.id === newWindow.id ? { ...w, isAnimating: false, animationType: undefined } : w
      ));
    }, 500);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => 
      w.id === id ? { ...w, isAnimating: true, animationType: 'bounceOut' } : w
    ));
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.filter(w => w.id !== id));
    }, 500);
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
    }
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,
      y: e.clientY - window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, corner: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height,
      corner: corner,
      originalX: window.x,
      originalY: window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  // Global mouse move handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = e.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = e.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      } else if (resizingWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            const deltaX = e.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = e.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = resizeStart.originalX;
            let newY = resizeStart.originalY;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              default:
                break;
            }
            
            newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - newWidth));
            newY = Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100));
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: newX,
              y: newY,
              width: newWidth,
              height: newHeight
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  // Also handle touch for mobile
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = touch.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = touch.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (resizingWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            const deltaX = touch.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = touch.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = resizeStart.originalX;
            let newY = resizeStart.originalY;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              default:
                break;
            }
            
            newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - newWidth));
            newY = Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100));
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: newX,
              y: newY,
              width: newWidth,
              height: newHeight
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    };

    const handleTouchEnd = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove);
      window.removeEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {floatingWindows.map((window) => {
          let animationStyle = {};
          if (window.isAnimating && window.animationType === 'bounceIn') {
            animationStyle = {
              animation: 'bounceIn 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) forwards'
            };
          } else if (window.isAnimating && window.animationType === 'bounceOut') {
            animationStyle = {
              animation: 'bounceOut 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) forwards'
            };
          }
          
          return (
            <div
              key={window.id}
              style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                left: window.x,
                top: window.y,
                width: window.width,
                height: window.height,
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
                borderRadius: '12px',
                border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                zIndex: 50,
                ...animationStyle
              }}
            >
              <style>
                {`
                  @keyframes bounceIn {
                    0% {
                      opacity: 0;
                      transform: scale(0.3);
                    }
                    50% {
                      opacity: 1;
                      transform: scale(1.05);
                    }
                    70% {
                      transform: scale(0.95);
                    }
                    100% {
                      opacity: 1;
                      transform: scale(1);
                    }
                  }
                  @keyframes bounceOut {
                    0% {
                      opacity: 1;
                      transform: scale(1);
                    }
                    30% {
                      transform: scale(1.05);
                    }
                    50% {
                      opacity: 1;
                      transform: scale(0.95);
                    }
                    100% {
                      opacity: 0;
                      transform: scale(0.3);
                    }
                  }
                `}
              </style>
              
              {/* Title Bar - Drag here */}
              <div
                style={{
                  height: '36px',
                  backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'space-between',
                  padding: '0 12px',
                  cursor: 'move'
                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => handleMouseDown(e, window.id)}
                onTouchStart={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  const touch = e.touches[0];
                  setDraggedWindow(window.id);
                  setDragOffset({
                    x: touch.clientX - window.x,
                    y: touch.clientY - window.y
                  });
                  bringToFront(window.id);
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                  {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                      alt={window.app.name}
                      style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '16px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                  <span style={{ color: 'white', fontSize: '12px' }}>{window.app.name}</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => closeWindow(window.id)}
                  style={{
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '16px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',

                }}
              >
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '32px', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
                    {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (

                  <p>{window.app.name}</p>

                  <button

  height: number;

}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);
  const [floatingWindows, setFloatingWindows] = useState<FloatingWindow[]>([]);

  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0, corner: '', originalX: 0, originalY: 0 });

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400,
      isAnimating: true,
      animationType: 'bounceIn'
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => 
        w.id === newWindow.id ? { ...w, isAnimating: false, animationType: undefined } : w
      ));
    }, 600);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => 
      w.id === id ? { ...w, isAnimating: true, animationType: 'bounceOut' } : w
    ));
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.filter(w => w.id !== id));
    }, 600);
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
    }
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,
      y: e.clientY - window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, corner: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height,
      corner: corner,
      originalX: window.x,
      originalY: window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  // Global mouse move handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = e.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = e.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      } else if (resizingWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            const deltaX = e.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = e.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = resizeStart.originalX;
            let newY = resizeStart.originalY;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              default:
                break;
            }
            
            newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - newWidth));
            newY = Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100));
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: newX,
              y: newY,
              width: newWidth,
              height: newHeight
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  // Also handle touch for mobile
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = touch.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = touch.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (resizingWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            const deltaX = touch.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = touch.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = resizeStart.originalX;
            let newY = resizeStart.originalY;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              default:
                break;
            }
            
            newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - newWidth));
            newY = Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100));
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: newX,
              y: newY,
              width: newWidth,
              height: newHeight
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    };

    const handleTouchEnd = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove);
      window.removeEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {floatingWindows.map((window) => {
          let animationStyle = {};
          if (window.isAnimating && window.animationType === 'bounceIn') {
            animationStyle = {
              animation: 'bounceIn 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards'
            };
          } else if (window.isAnimating && window.animationType === 'bounceOut') {
            animationStyle = {
              animation: 'bounceOut 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards'
            };
          }
          
          return (
            <div
              key={window.id}
              style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                left: window.x,
                top: window.y,
                width: window.width,
                height: window.height,
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
                borderRadius: '12px',
                border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                zIndex: 50,
                ...animationStyle
              }}
            >
              <style>
                {`
                  @keyframes bounceIn {
                    0% {
                      opacity: 0;
                      transform: scale(0.7) translateY(20px);
                    }
                    40% {
                      opacity: 1;
                      transform: scale(1.02) translateY(-5px);
                    }
                    70% {
                      transform: scale(0.98) translateY(2px);
                    }
                    100% {
                      opacity: 1;
                      transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
                    }
                  }
                  @keyframes bounceOut {
                    0% {
                      opacity: 1;
                      transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
                    }
                    30% {
                      transform: scale(1.02) translateY(-5px);
                    }
                    60% {
                      opacity: 1;
                      transform: scale(0.98) translateY(2px);
                    }
                    100% {
                      opacity: 0;
                      transform: scale(0.7) translateY(20px);
                    }
                  }
                `}
              </style>
              
              {/* Title Bar - Drag here */}
              <div
                style={{
                  height: '36px',
                  backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'space-between',
                  padding: '0 12px',
                  cursor: 'move'
                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => handleMouseDown(e, window.id)}
                onTouchStart={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  const touch = e.touches[0];
                  setDraggedWindow(window.id);
                  setDragOffset({
                    x: touch.clientX - window.x,
                    y: touch.clientY - window.y
                  });
                  bringToFront(window.id);
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                  {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                      alt={window.app.name}
                      style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '16px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                  <span style={{ color: 'white', fontSize: '12px' }}>{window.app.name}</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => closeWindow(window.id)}
                  style={{
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '16px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    opacity: 0.7,
                    width: '24px',
                    height: '24px',
                    borderRadius: '4px'
                  }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>
              
              {/* Content */}
              <div
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '14px',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  padding: '16px'
                }}
              >
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '32px', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
                    {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                      <img 
                        src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                        alt={window.app.name}
                        style={{ width: '48px', height: '48px' }}
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <span>📱</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <p>{window.app.name}</p>
                  <p style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                    {window.app.packageName}
                  </p>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => alert(`Launching ${window.app.name} (${window.app.packageName})`)}
                    style={{
                      marginTop: '16px',
                      padding: '8px 16px',
                      backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                      border: 'none',
                      borderRadius: '8px',
                      color: 'white',
                      cursor: 'pointer'
                    }}
                  >
                    Launch App
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              {/* Resize Handles */}
              <div
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: -8,
                  left: -8,
                  width: 16,
                  height: 16,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                  border: '2px solid #5E81AC',
                  cursor: 'nw-resize',
                  zIndex: 200
                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'top-left')}
                onTouchStart={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  const touch = e.touches[0];
                  setResizingWindow(window.id);
                  setResizeStart({
                    x: touch.clientX,
                    y: touch.clientY,
                    width: window.width,
                    height: window.height,
                    corner: 'top-left',
                    originalX: window.x,
                    originalY: window.y
                  });
                  bringToFront(window.id);
                }}
              />
              <div
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: -8,
                  right: -8,
                  width: 16,
                  height: 16,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                  border: '2px solid #5E81AC',
                  cursor: 'ne-resize',
                  zIndex: 200
                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'top-right')}
                onTouchStart={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  const touch = e.touches[0];
                  setResizingWindow(window.id);
                  setResizeStart({
                    x: touch.clientX,
                    y: touch.clientY,
                    width: window.width,
                    height: window.height,
                    corner: 'top-right',
                    originalX: window.x,
                    originalY: window.y
                  });
                  bringToFront(window.id);
                }}
              />
              <div
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  bottom: -8,
                  left: -8,
                  width: 16,
                  height: 16,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                  border: '2px solid #5E81AC',
                  cursor: 'sw-resize',
                  zIndex: 200
                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'bottom-left')}
                onTouchStart={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  const touch = e.touches[0];
                  setResizingWindow(window.id);
                  setResizeStart({
                    x: touch.clientX,
                    y: touch.clientY,
                    width: window.width,
                    height: window.height,
                    corner: 'bottom-left',
                    originalX: window.x,
                    originalY: window.y
                  });
                  bringToFront(window.id);
                }}
              />
              <div
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  bottom: -8,
                  right: -8,
                  width: 16,
                  height: 16,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                  border: '2px solid #5E81AC',
                  cursor: 'se-resize',
                  zIndex: 200
                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'bottom-right')}
                onTouchStart={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  const touch = e.touches[0];
                  setResizingWindow(window.id);
                  setResizeStart({
                    x: touch.clientX,
                    y: touch.clientY,
                    width: window.width,
                    height: window.height,
                    corner: 'bottom-right',
                    originalX: window.x,
                    originalY: window.y
                  });
                  bringToFront(window.id);
                }}
              />
            </div>
          );
        })}
        
        <Dock onItemClick={handleDockItemClick} />
      </div>
    </Wallpaper>
  );
};

export default Desktop;
✅ Changes for smoother animation:
Smoother easing curve - Changed to cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) which creates a more natural spring effect

Added Y-axis translation - Windows now also move slightly up/down during bounce (more organic)

Gentler scaling - Changed from 0.3 → 1 to 0.7 → 1 (less jarring)

Better timing - 0.6s for bounce-in, 0.5s for bounce-out

More subtle overshoot - 1.02 instead of 1.05

✅ Rebuild
bash
npm run build
npx cap sync android
npx cap run android
Now the animation should feel much smoother and more natural! 🚀
