import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';
import { InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface FloatingWindow {
  id: string;
  app: InstalledApp;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  isAnimating?: boolean;
  animationType?: 'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut';
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);
  const [floatingWindows, setFloatingWindows] = useState<FloatingWindow[]>([]);
  const [draggedWindow, setDraggedWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOffset, setDragOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [resizingWindow, setResizingWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0, corner: '', originalX: 0, originalY: 0 });

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400,
      isAnimating: true,
      animationType: 'bounceIn'
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => 
        w.id === newWindow.id ? { ...w, isAnimating: false, animationType: undefined } : w
      ));
    }, 600);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => 
      w.id === id ? { ...w, isAnimating: true, animationType: 'bounceOut' } : w
    ));
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.filter(w => w.id !== id));
    }, 600);
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
    }
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,
      y: e.clientY - window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, corner: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height,
      corner: corner,
      originalX: window.x,
      originalY: window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  // Global mouse move handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = e.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = e.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      } else if (resizingWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            const deltaX = e.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = e.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = resizeStart.originalX;
            let newY = resizeStart.originalY;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              default:
                break;
            }
            
            newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - newWidth));
            newY = Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100));
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: newX,
              y: newY,
              width: newWidth,
              height: newHeight
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  // Also handle touch for mobile
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = touch.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = touch.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (resizingWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            const deltaX = touch.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = touch.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = resizeStart.originalX;
            let newY = resizeStart.originalY;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              default:
                break;
            }
            
            newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - newWidth));
            newY = Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100));
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: newX,
              y: newY,
              width: newWidth,
              height: newHeight
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    };

    const handleTouchEnd = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove);
      window.removeEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',

                  right: '12px',

                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          if (window.isAnimating && window.animationType === 'bounceIn') {
            animationStyle = {

            };
          } else if (window.isAnimating && window.animationType === 'bounceOut') {
            animationStyle = {
              animation: 'bounceOut 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards'
            };
          }
          
          return (
            <div
              key={window.id}
              style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                left: window.x,
                top: window.y,
                width: window.width,
                height: window.height,
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',

                boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                zIndex: 50,
                ...animationStyle
              }}
            >
              <style>
                {`
                  @keyframes bounceIn {
                    0% {
                      opacity: 0;
                      transform: scale(0.9) translateY(10px);
                    }
                    60% {
                      opacity: 1;
                      transform: scale(1.01) translateY(-2px);
                    }
                    100% {
                      opacity: 1;
                      transform: scale(1) translateY(0);

                  }
                  @keyframes bounceOut {

                      transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
                    }
                    40% {

                    100% {

              <div

                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => handleMouseDown(e, window.id)}
                onTouchStart={(e) => {

                  });

                }}
              >

                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => closeWindow(window.id)}

                    ) : (
                      <span>📱</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <p>{window.app.name}</p>
                  <p style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)', marginTop: '8px' }}>

                    style={{

                      border: 'none',
                      borderRadius: '8px',
                      color: 'white',
                      cursor: 'pointer'
                    }}
                  >
                    Launch App
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              {/* Resize Handles */}
              <div
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',

                  zIndex: 200
                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'top-left')}
                onTouchStart={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  const touch = e.touches[0];
                  setResizingWindow(window.id);
                  setResizeStart({
                    x: touch.clientX,
                    y: touch.clientY,
                    width: window.width,
                    height: window.height,

                  height: 16,
                  borderRadius: '50%',

                  border: '2px solid #5E81AC',

                onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'bottom-left')}
                onTouchStart={(e) => {

                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',

        <Dock onItemClick={handleDockItemClick} />

Close: 1 → 0.98 → 0.9

Subtle Y-axis movement - 10px up/down for natural bounce

No jarring scale jumps - Minimal scale change from 1 to 0.9

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';
import { InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface FloatingWindow {
  id: string;
  app: InstalledApp;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  isAnimating?: boolean;
  animationType?: 'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut';
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);
  const [floatingWindows, setFloatingWindows] = useState<FloatingWindow[]>([]);
  const [draggedWindow, setDraggedWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOffset, setDragOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [resizingWindow, setResizingWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0, corner: '', originalX: 0, originalY: 0 });

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400,
      isAnimating: true,
      animationType: 'bounceIn'
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => 
        w.id === newWindow.id ? { ...w, isAnimating: false, animationType: undefined } : w
      ));
    }, 500);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => 
      w.id === id ? { ...w, isAnimating: true, animationType: 'bounceOut' } : w
    ));
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.filter(w => w.id !== id));
    }, 500);
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
    }
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,
      y: e.clientY - window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, corner: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height,
      corner: corner,
      originalX: window.x,
      originalY: window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  // Global mouse move handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = e.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = e.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      } else if (resizingWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            const deltaX = e.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = e.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = resizeStart.originalX;
            let newY = resizeStart.originalY;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              default:
                break;
            }
            
            newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - newWidth));
            newY = Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100));
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: newX,
              y: newY,
              width: newWidth,
              height: newHeight
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  // Also handle touch for mobile
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = touch.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = touch.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (resizingWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            const deltaX = touch.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = touch.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = resizeStart.originalX;
            let newY = resizeStart.originalY;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              default:
                break;
            }
            
            newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - newWidth));
            newY = Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100));
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: newX,
              y: newY,
              width: newWidth,
              height: newHeight
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    };

    const handleTouchEnd = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove);
      window.removeEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {floatingWindows.map((window) => {
          let animationStyle = {};
          if (window.isAnimating && window.animationType === 'bounceIn') {
            animationStyle = {
              animation: 'bounceIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards'
            };
          } else if (window.isAnimating && window.animationType === 'bounceOut') {
            animationStyle = {
              animation: 'bounceOut 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards'
            };
          }
          
          return (
            <div
              key={window.id}
              style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                left: window.x,
                top: window.y,
                width: window.width,
                height: window.height,
                backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.95)',
                borderRadius: '12px',
                border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                boxShadow: '0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
                display: 'flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                overflow: 'hidden',
                zIndex: 50,
                ...animationStyle
              }}
            >
              <style>
                {`
                  @keyframes bounceIn {
                    0% {
                      opacity: 0;
                      transform: scale(0.8);
                    }
                    50% {
                      opacity: 1;
                      transform: scale(1.05);
                    }
                    100% {
                      opacity: 1;
                      transform: scale(1);
                    }
                  }
                  @keyframes bounceOut {
                    0% {
                      opacity: 1;
                      transform: scale(1);
                    }
                    40% {
                      opacity: 1;
                      transform: scale(1.05);
                    }
                    100% {
                      opacity: 0;
                      transform: scale(0.8);
                    }
                  }
                `}
              </style>
              
              {/* Title Bar - Drag here */}
              <div
                style={{
                  height: '36px',
                  backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'space-between',
                  padding: '0 12px',
                  cursor: 'move'
                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => handleMouseDown(e, window.id)}
                onTouchStart={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  const touch = e.touches[0];
                  setDraggedWindow(window.id);
                  setDragOffset({
                    x: touch.clientX - window.x,
                    y: touch.clientY - window.y
                  });
                  bringToFront(window.id);
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px' }}>
                  {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                      alt={window.app.name}
                      style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '16px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                  <span style={{ color: 'white', fontSize: '12px' }}>{window.app.name}</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => closeWindow(window.id)}
                  style={{
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '16px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    opacity: 0.7,
                    width: '24px',
                    height: '24px',
                    borderRadius: '4px'
                  }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>
              
              {/* Content */}
              <div
                style={{
                  flex: 1,
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '14px',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  padding: '16px'
                }}
              >
                <div>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '32px', marginBottom: '12px' }}>
                    {window.app.icon && window.app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                      <img 
                        src={`data:image/png;base64,${window.app.icon}`} 
                        alt={window.app.name}
                        style={{ width: '48px', height: '48px' }}
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <span>📱</span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <p>{window.app.name}</p>
                  <p style={{ fontSize: '11px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                    {window.app.packageName}
                  </p>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => alert(`Launching ${window.app.name} (${window.app.packageName})`)}
                    style={{
                      marginTop: '16px',
                      padding: '8px 16px',
                      backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                      border: 'none',
                      borderRadius: '8px',
                      color: 'white',
                      cursor: 'pointer'
                    }}
                  >
                    Launch App
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              
              {/* Resize Handles */}
              <div
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: -8,
                  left: -8,
                  width: 16,
                  height: 16,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                  border: '2px solid #5E81AC',
                  cursor: 'nw-resize',
                  zIndex: 200
                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'top-left')}
                onTouchStart={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  const touch = e.touches[0];
                  setResizingWindow(window.id);
                  setResizeStart({
                    x: touch.clientX,
                    y: touch.clientY,
                    width: window.width,
                    height: window.height,
                    corner: 'top-left',
                    originalX: window.x,
                    originalY: window.y
                  });
                  bringToFront(window.id);
                }}
              />
              <div
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: -8,
                  right: -8,
                  width: 16,
                  height: 16,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                  border: '2px solid #5E81AC',
                  cursor: 'ne-resize',
                  zIndex: 200
                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'top-right')}
                onTouchStart={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  const touch = e.touches[0];
                  setResizingWindow(window.id);
                  setResizeStart({
                    x: touch.clientX,
                    y: touch.clientY,
                    width: window.width,
                    height: window.height,
                    corner: 'top-right',
                    originalX: window.x,
                    originalY: window.y
                  });
                  bringToFront(window.id);
                }}
              />
              <div
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  bottom: -8,
                  left: -8,
                  width: 16,
                  height: 16,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                  border: '2px solid #5E81AC',
                  cursor: 'sw-resize',
                  zIndex: 200
                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'bottom-left')}
                onTouchStart={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  const touch = e.touches[0];
                  setResizingWindow(window.id);
                  setResizeStart({
                    x: touch.clientX,
                    y: touch.clientY,
                    width: window.width,
                    height: window.height,
                    corner: 'bottom-left',
                    originalX: window.x,
                    originalY: window.y
                  });
                  bringToFront(window.id);
                }}
              />
              <div
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  bottom: -8,
                  right: -8,
                  width: 16,
                  height: 16,
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                  border: '2px solid #5E81AC',
                  cursor: 'se-resize',
                  zIndex: 200
                }}
                onMouseDown={(e) => handleResizeStart(e, window.id, 'bottom-right')}
                onTouchStart={(e) => {
                  e.preventDefault();
                  const touch = e.touches[0];
                  setResizingWindow(window.id);
                  setResizeStart({
                    x: touch.clientX,
                    y: touch.clientY,
                    width: window.width,
                    height: window.height,
                    corner: 'bottom-right',
                    originalX: window.x,
                    originalY: window.y
                  });
                  bringToFront(window.id);
                }}
              />
            </div>
          );
        })}
        
        <Dock onItemClick={handleDockItemClick} />
      </div>
    </Wallpaper>
  );
};

tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [animateApp, setAnimateApp] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [animateRemove, setAnimateRemove] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      // Animate removal
      setAnimateRemove(app.packageName);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
        setDockApps(newDockApps);
        setAnimateRemove(null);
        if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
          setIsEditMode(false);
        }
      }, 300);
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      // Animate addition
      setAnimateApp(app.packageName);
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        setAnimateApp(null);
      }, 300);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const openDrawer = () => {
    setShowAppDrawer(true);
  };

  const closeDrawer = () => {
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <style>
        {`
          @keyframes bounceIn {
            0% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            50% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
          }
          @keyframes bounceOut {
            0% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
            40% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
          }
        `}
      </style>
      
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 50,
          pointerEvents: 'none'
        }}
      >
        <div 
          ref={scrollRef}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '100px',
            padding: '4px 12px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '4px',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            overflowX: 'auto',
            overflowY: 'hidden',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            maxWidth: '90%',
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
            scrollbarWidth: 'thin'
          }}
          onContextMenu={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleLongPress();
          }}
        >
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative',
                flexShrink: 0,
                animation: animateRemove === app.packageName ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={openDrawer}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7,
              flexShrink: 0
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div 
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(15px)',
            zIndex: 100,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            animation: 'bounceIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards'
          }}
          onClick={closeDrawer}
        >
          <div 
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '20px',
              width: 'auto',
              minWidth: '300px',
              maxWidth: '85%',
              maxHeight: '70%',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)'
            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Apps Grid - 8 per row */}
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '20px 20px 0 20px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(8, 1fr)',
              gap: '8px'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    padding: '8px 4px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'transparent',
                    border: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s',
                    animation: animateApp === app.packageName ? 'bounceIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.05)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '36px', height: '36px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '30px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)',
                  padding: '40px'
                }}>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {/* Search Bar - at bottom */}
            <div style={{ padding: '16px 20px', position: 'relative', borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)' }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search apps..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '10px 35px 10px 12px',
                  borderRadius: '10px',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                  background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '14px',
                  outline: 'none'
                }}
              />
              {searchTerm && (
                <button
                  onClick={clearSearch}
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    right: '28px',
                    top: '50%',
                    transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                    fontSize: '16px',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {/* Close button */}
            <button
              onClick={closeDrawer}
              style={{
                position: 'absolute',
                top: '12px',
                right: '12px',
                background: 'none',
                border: 'none',
                color: 'white',
                fontSize: '20px',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                opacity: 0.5
              }}
            >
              ✕
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default Dock;
✅ Changes made to Dock.tsx:
Added bounce animation when adding an app to dock - bounceIn animation

Added bounce animation when removing an app from dock - bounceOut animation

Added bounce animation when opening the app drawer - The entire modal bounces in

All animations use the same easing curve cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1)

Animation duration - 0.3 seconds for all dock animations

✅ Rebuild
bash
npm run build
npx cap sync android
npx cap run android
Now all animations in DiXie will have the same smooth elastic bounce effect:

Floating windows bounce in/out

Adding apps to dock bounces in

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [animateApp, setAnimateApp] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [animateRemove, setAnimateRemove] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      setAnimateRemove(app.packageName);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
        setDockApps(newDockApps);
        setAnimateRemove(null);
        if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
          setIsEditMode(false);
        }
      }, 300);
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setAnimateApp(app.packageName);
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        setAnimateApp(null);
      }, 300);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const openDrawer = () => {
    setShowAppDrawer(true);
  };

  const closeDrawer = () => {
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <style>
        {`
          @keyframes bounceIn {
            0% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            50% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
          }
          @keyframes bounceOut {
            0% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
            40% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
          }
        `}
      </style>
      
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 50,
          pointerEvents: 'none'
        }}
      >
        <div 
          ref={scrollRef}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '100px',
            padding: '4px 12px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '4px',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            overflowX: 'auto',
            overflowY: 'hidden',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            maxWidth: '90%',
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
            scrollbarWidth: 'thin'
          }}
          onContextMenu={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleLongPress();
          }}
        >
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative',
                flexShrink: 0,
                animation: animateRemove === app.packageName ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={openDrawer}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7,
              flexShrink: 0
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div 
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            backgroundColor: 'transparent',
            zIndex: 100,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            animation: 'bounceIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards'
          }}
          onClick={closeDrawer}
        >
          <div 
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '20px',
              width: 'auto',
              minWidth: '300px',
              maxWidth: '85%',
              maxHeight: '70%',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)'
            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Apps Grid - 8 per row */}
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '20px 20px 0 20px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(8, 1fr)',
              gap: '8px'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    padding: '8px 4px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'transparent',
                    border: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s',
                    animation: animateApp === app.packageName ? 'bounceIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.05)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '36px', height: '36px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '30px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)',
                  padding: '40px'
                }}>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {/* Search Bar - at bottom */}
            <div style={{ padding: '16px 20px', position: 'relative', borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)' }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search apps..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '10px 35px 10px 12px',
                  borderRadius: '10px',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                  background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '14px',
                  outline: 'none'
                }}
              />
              {searchTerm && (
                <button
                  onClick={clearSearch}
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    right: '28px',
                    top: '50%',
                    transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                    fontSize: '16px',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default Dock;

Glass blur on container - Already had backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)' and backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)'

Added bounce animation when closing - The drawer now has bounceOut animation when closing, matching the floating window animation

Added animation state management - drawerAnimation state tracks whether to show bounceIn or bounceOut

Same easing curve - cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) for all animations

✅ Rebuild
bash
npm run build
npx cap sync android
npx cap run android
Now the app drawer has a smooth glass blur effect and bounces in when opening AND bounces out when closing (tap outside), matching the floating window animations! 🚀
