import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [animateApp, setAnimateApp] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [animateRemove, setAnimateRemove] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [drawerAnimation, setDrawerAnimation] = useState<'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut' | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      setAnimateRemove(app.packageName);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
        setDockApps(newDockApps);
        setAnimateRemove(null);
        if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
          setIsEditMode(false);
        }
      }, 300);
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setAnimateApp(app.packageName);
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        setAnimateApp(null);
      }, 300);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const openDrawer = () => {
    setShowAppDrawer(true);
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceIn');
  };

  const closeDrawer = () => {
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceOut');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setShowAppDrawer(false);
      setDrawerAnimation(null);
    }, 300);
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <style>
        {`
          @keyframes bounceIn {
            0% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            50% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
          }
          @keyframes bounceOut {
            0% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
            40% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
          }
        `}
      </style>
      
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 50,
          pointerEvents: 'none'
        }}
      >
        <div 
          ref={scrollRef}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '100px',
            padding: '4px 12px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '4px',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)',
            overflowX: 'auto',
            overflowY: 'hidden',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            maxWidth: '90%',
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
            scrollbarWidth: 'thin'
          }}
          onContextMenu={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleLongPress();
          }}
        >
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative',
                flexShrink: 0,
                animation: animateRemove === app.packageName ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={openDrawer}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7,
              flexShrink: 0
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div 
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(8px)',
            zIndex: 100,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            animation: drawerAnimation === 'bounceIn' ? 'bounceIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 
                       drawerAnimation === 'bounceOut' ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
          }}
          onClick={closeDrawer}
        >
          <div 
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.85)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '24px',
              width: 'auto',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '85%',
              maxHeight: '75%',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)'
            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Header */}
            <div style={{
              padding: '16px 20px',
              borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)'
            }}>
              <h3 style={{ color: 'white', margin: 0, fontSize: '18px', fontWeight: '500' }}>Add to Dock</h3>
            </div>
            
            {/* Apps Grid - 8 per row */}
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '20px 20px 0 20px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(8, 1fr)',
              gap: '8px'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    padding: '8px 4px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
                    border: 'none',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s',
                    animation: animateApp === app.packageName ? 'bounceIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.05)';
                  }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                  }}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '40px', height: '40px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '32px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)',
                  padding: '40px'
                }}>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {/* Search Bar - at bottom */}
            <div style={{ padding: '16px 20px', position: 'relative', borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)' }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search apps..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '12px 35px 12px 16px',
                  borderRadius: '12px',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                  background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '14px',
                  outline: 'none'
                }}
              />
              {searchTerm && (
                <button
                  onClick={clearSearch}
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    right: '32px',
                    top: '50%',
                    transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                    fontSize: '16px',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default Dock;
✅ Changes made to make glass blur visible:
Added backdrop blur to the outer overlay - backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3)' + backdropFilter: 'blur(8px)'

Made the container background more opaque - backgroundColor: 'rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.85)' (dark glass)

Added stronger blur - backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)' on the container

Added header - "Add to Dock" title for better visual structure

Increased border opacity - rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) for better visibility

Added hover effects on app icons - rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) background on hover

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [animateApp, setAnimateApp] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [animateRemove, setAnimateRemove] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [drawerAnimation, setDrawerAnimation] = useState<'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut' | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      setAnimateRemove(app.packageName);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
        setDockApps(newDockApps);
        setAnimateRemove(null);
        if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
          setIsEditMode(false);
        }
      }, 300);
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setAnimateApp(app.packageName);
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        setAnimateApp(null);
      }, 300);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const openDrawer = () => {
    setShowAppDrawer(true);
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceIn');
  };

  const closeDrawer = () => {
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceOut');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setShowAppDrawer(false);
      setDrawerAnimation(null);
    }, 300);
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <style>
        {`
          @keyframes bounceIn {
            0% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            50% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
          }
          @keyframes bounceOut {
            0% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
            40% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
          }
        `}
      </style>
      
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 50,
          pointerEvents: 'none'
        }}
      >
        <div 
          ref={scrollRef}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '100px',
            padding: '4px 12px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '4px',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            overflowX: 'auto',
            overflowY: 'hidden',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            maxWidth: '90%',
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
            scrollbarWidth: 'thin'
          }}
          onContextMenu={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleLongPress();
          }}
        >
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative',
                flexShrink: 0,
                animation: animateRemove === app.packageName ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={openDrawer}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7,
              flexShrink: 0
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div 
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)',
            zIndex: 100,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            animation: drawerAnimation === 'bounceIn' ? 'bounceIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 
                       drawerAnimation === 'bounceOut' ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
          }}
          onClick={closeDrawer}
        >
          <div 
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '20px',
              width: 'auto',
              minWidth: '300px',
              maxWidth: '85%',
              maxHeight: '70%',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)'
            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Apps Grid - 8 per row */}
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '20px 20px 0 20px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(8, 1fr)',
              gap: '8px'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    padding: '8px 4px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'transparent',
                    border: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s',
                    animation: animateApp === app.packageName ? 'bounceIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.05)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '36px', height: '36px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '30px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)',
                  padding: '40px'
                }}>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {/* Search Bar - at bottom */}
            <div style={{ padding: '16px 20px', position: 'relative', borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)' }}>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="Search apps..."
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  width: '100%',
                  padding: '10px 35px 10px 12px',
                  borderRadius: '10px',
                  border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                  background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '14px',
                  outline: 'none'
                }}
              />
              {searchTerm && (
                <button
                  onClick={clearSearch}
                  style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    right: '28px',
                    top: '50%',
                    transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                    background: 'none',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                    fontSize: '16px',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default Dock;
✅ Key features of this version:
No backdrop - backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' (completely transparent)

Glass blur on container - backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)' + backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)'

Bounce animation when opening - bounceIn animation

Bounce animation when closing - bounceOut animation (tap outside to close)

Bounce animations for adding/removing apps from dock

Same easing curve for all animations

✅ Rebuild
bash
npm run build
npx cap sync android
npx cap run android
Now the app drawer has a clean glass blur container with no backdrop behind it, and bounces in/out smoothly! 🚀

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [animateApp, setAnimateApp] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [animateRemove, setAnimateRemove] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [drawerAnimation, setDrawerAnimation] = useState<'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut' | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      setAnimateRemove(app.packageName);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
        setDockApps(newDockApps);
        setAnimateRemove(null);
        if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
          setIsEditMode(false);
        }
      }, 300);
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {

      setAnimateApp(app.packageName);

      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
      
      setTimeout(() => {

    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);

Looking at your DiXie project needs, I'll help you implement the glass blur effect for your app drawer and fix the app detection logic. The key is using native macOS frameworks correctly.

Glass Blur Effect for App Drawer
The dock's beautiful blur effect comes from NSVisualEffectView - Apple's native component for translucency and vibrancy . Here's how to implement it in your app drawer:

SwiftUI Implementation
swift
import SwiftUI
import AppKit

struct AppDrawerView: View {
    var body: some View {
        VisualEffectBlurView(material: .hudWindow, blendingMode: .behindWindow)
            .frame(width: 600, height: 400)
            .cornerRadius(20)
            .overlay(
                // Your app icons and content here
                AppGridContent()
            )
    }
}

// NSViewRepresentable wrapper for NSVisualEffectView
struct VisualEffectBlurView: NSViewRepresentable {
    let material: NSVisualEffectView.Material
    let blendingMode: NSVisualEffectView.BlendingMode
    
    func makeNSView(context: Context) -> NSVisualEffectView {
        let visualEffectView = NSVisualEffectView()
        visualEffectView.material = material
        visualEffectView.blendingMode = blendingMode
        visualEffectView.state = .active
        visualEffectView.wantsLayer = true
        return visualEffectView
    }
    
    func updateNSView(_ nsView: NSVisualEffectView, context: Context) {
        nsView.material = material
        nsView.blendingMode = blendingMode
    }
}
Material Options for Different Effects
Choose based on your desired appearance:

Material	Best For
.hudWindow	Floating panels, similar to dock
.sidebar	Sidebar panels
.popover	Popover menus
.menu	Menu-like appearance
.underWindowBackground	Strong blur behind content
.headerView	Title bar areas 
For your app drawer to match the dock, use .hudWindow or .popover with .behindWindow blending mode .

Fixing App Detection to Show User Apps
Apple recommends using NSWorkspace APIs rather than scanning the filesystem . Here's a robust solution:

Swift Implementation for Detecting User Apps
swift
import Cocoa

class AppDetector {
    
    /// Get all user-installed applications (excluding system apps)
    func getUserInstalledApps() -> [AppInfo] {
        var apps: [AppInfo] = []
        
        // Get apps from standard locations
        let appPaths = [
            "/Applications",                    // System-wide apps
            FileManager.default.homeDirectoryForCurrentUser
                .appendingPathComponent("Applications").path  // User apps
        ]
        
        for path in appPaths {
            let appURLs = getAppURLsFromDirectory(path)
            apps.append(contentsOf: appURLs.compactMap { getAppInfo(from: $0) })
        }
        
        // Filter system apps that users typically don't want to see
        let systemAppIdentifiers = [
            "com.apple.",
            "com.microsoft.",  // System Microsoft components
            "com.apple.dt.Xcode",  // Developer tools users might want to keep
        ]
        
        return apps.filter { app in
            // Show apps that are NOT system apps
            let isSystemApp = systemAppIdentifiers.contains { identifier in
                app.bundleIdentifier?.hasPrefix(identifier) ?? false
            }
            return !isSystemApp
        }
        .sorted { $0.displayName.localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare($1.displayName) == .orderedAscending }
    }
    
    private func getAppURLsFromDirectory(_ path: String) -> [URL] {
        let fileManager = FileManager.default
        let appURL = URL(fileURLWithPath: path)
        
        guard let contents = try? fileManager.contentsOfDirectory(
            at: appURL,
            includingPropertiesForKeys: nil
        ) else { return [] }
        
        return contents.filter { $0.pathExtension == "app" }
    }
    
    private func getAppInfo(from url: URL) -> AppInfo? {
        let bundle = Bundle(url: url)
        
        guard let bundleIdentifier = bundle?.bundleIdentifier,
              let displayName = bundle?.object(forInfoDictionaryKey: "CFBundleDisplayName") as? String ??
                                bundle?.object(forInfoDictionaryKey: "CFBundleName") as? String ??
                                url.deletingPathExtension().lastPathComponent else {
            return nil
        }
        
        let icon = NSWorkspace.shared.icon(forFile: url.path)
        
        return AppInfo(
            name: displayName,
            bundleIdentifier: bundleIdentifier,
            icon: icon,
            path: url
        )
    }
}

struct AppInfo {
    let name: String
    let bundleIdentifier: String
    let icon: NSImage
    let path: URL
}
Using NSWorkspace for More Reliable Detection
For even more accurate detection, use NSWorkspace's Launch Services database :

swift
func getAllUserAppsUsingWorkspace() -> [AppInfo] {
    var apps: [AppInfo] = []
    
    // Get all apps registered with Launch Services
    let workspace = NSWorkspace.shared
    let appURLs = workspace.urlsForApplications(to: .all)
    
    for appURL in appURLs {
        if let appInfo = getAppInfo(from: appURL) {
            // Filter out system apps based on bundle identifier
            if !appInfo.bundleIdentifier.hasPrefix("com.apple.") {
                apps.append(appInfo)
            }
        }
    }
    
    return apps
}

Complete Integration Example
swift
struct DiXieAppDrawer: View {
    @State private var userApps: [AppInfo] = []
    
    var body: some View {
        VisualEffectBlurView(material: .hudWindow, blendingMode: .behindWindow)
            .frame(width: 700, height: 500)
            .cornerRadius(16)
            .overlay(
                ScrollView {
                    LazyVGrid(columns: Array(repeating: GridItem(.flexible()), count: 5)) {
                        ForEach(userApps, id: \.bundleIdentifier) { app in
                            AppIconView(app: app)
                        }
                    }
                    .padding()
                }
            )
            .onAppear {
                userApps = AppDetector().getUserInstalledApps()
            }
    }
}

struct AppIconView: View {
    let app: AppInfo
    
    var body: some View {
        VStack {
            Image(nsImage: app.icon)
                .resizable()
                .frame(width: 60, height: 60)
                .cornerRadius(12)
            Text(app.name)
                .font(.caption)
                .lineLimit(1)
                .foregroundColor(.white)
        }
        .onTapGesture {
            NSWorkspace.shared.open(app.path)
        }
    }
}
Important Notes
Vibrancy: For best results with glass effects, use Apple's standard label colors (primary, secondary, etc.) rather than custom colors 

Performance: The app detection runs once on drawer open. For live updates, consider adding a refresh mechanism or using NSWorkspace.didActivateApplicationNotification

System Apps: The filtering logic above excludes most Apple apps but includes apps like Instagram, Chrome, Spotify, etc. Adjust the system identifiers based on your needs

Multiple Installations: NSWorkspace.urlsForApplications(to: .all) will find apps even if installed outside standard Applications folders

This implementation will give you a beautiful glass-morphism app drawer that matches macOS design language while correctly showing only user-installed applications.

2. App Detection for Android (Capacitor Plugin)
You need a custom Capacitor plugin to access Android's package manager:

Step 1: Create the plugin

typescript
// src/plugins/app-detector.ts
import { registerPlugin } from '@capacitor/core';

export interface AppDetectorPlugin {
  getUserApps(): Promise<{ apps: AppInfo[] }>;
  launchApp(options: { packageName: string }): Promise<void>;
}

export interface AppInfo {
  name: string;
  packageName: string;
  icon: string; // base64 or file URI
  isSystemApp: boolean;
}

const AppDetector = registerPlugin<AppDetectorPlugin>('AppDetector');

export default AppDetector;
Step 2: Android native implementation

java
// android/app/src/main/java/com/dixie/react/plugins/AppDetectorPlugin.java
package com.dixie.react.plugins;

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Canvas;
import android.graphics.drawable.Drawable;
import android.util.Base64;
import com.getcapacitor.JSObject;
import com.getcapacitor.Plugin;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginCall;
import com.getcapacitor.PluginMethod;
import com.getcapacitor.annotation.CapacitorPlugin;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

@CapacitorPlugin(name = "AppDetector")
public class AppDetectorPlugin extends Plugin {
    
    @PluginMethod
    public void getUserApps(PluginCall call) {
        PackageManager pm = bridge.getContext().getPackageManager();
        List<ApplicationInfo> packages = pm.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA);
        
        List<JSObject> appsList = new ArrayList<>();
        
        for (ApplicationInfo appInfo : packages) {
            // Filter out system apps
            if ((appInfo.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0) {
                continue; // Skip system apps
            }
            
            JSObject app = new JSObject();
            app.put("name", pm.getApplicationLabel(appInfo).toString());
            app.put("packageName", appInfo.packageName);
            app.put("isSystemApp", (appInfo.flags & ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM) != 0);
            
            // Get app icon as base64
            Drawable icon = appInfo.loadIcon(pm);
            String iconBase64 = drawableToBase64(icon);
            app.put("icon", iconBase64);
            
            appsList.add(app);
        }
        
        JSObject result = new JSObject();
        result.put("apps", appsList);
        call.resolve(result);
    }
    
    @PluginMethod
    public void launchApp(PluginCall call) {
        String packageName = call.getString("packageName");
        PackageManager pm = bridge.getContext().getPackageManager();
        
        try {
            android.content.Intent intent = pm.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName);
            if (intent != null) {
                bridge.getContext().startActivity(intent);
                call.resolve();
            } else {
                call.reject("App not found or cannot be launched");
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
            call.reject("Failed to launch app: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }
    
    private String drawableToBase64(Drawable drawable) {
        Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(
            drawable.getIntrinsicWidth(),
            drawable.getIntrinsicHeight(),
            Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888
        );
        Canvas canvas = new Canvas(bitmap);
        drawable.setBounds(0, 0, canvas.getWidth(), canvas.getHeight());
        drawable.draw(canvas);
        
        ByteArrayOutputStream byteArrayOutputStream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, byteArrayOutputStream);
        byte[] byteArray = byteArrayOutputStream.toByteArray();
        return Base64.encodeToString(byteArray, Base64.DEFAULT);
    }
}
Step 3: Register the plugin

}});

// src/components/AppDrawer.tsx
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import AppDetector, { AppInfo } from '../plugins/app-detector';

export const AppDrawer: React.FC = () => {
  const [apps, setApps] = useState<AppInfo[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  const loadApps = async () => {
    try {
      const result = await AppDetector.getUserApps();
      setApps(result.apps);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const launchApp = async (packageName: string) => {
    await AppDetector.launchApp({ packageName });
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center">
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/50" />
      
      <div className="relative w-[90%] max-w-md max-h-[80vh] rounded-3xl overflow-hidden">
        {/* Glass effect */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/10" />
        <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-3xl border border-white/20" />
        
        {/* Content */}
        <div className="relative z-10 p-4">
          <h2 className="text-white text-xl font-semibold mb-4">Apps</h2>
          
          {loading ? (
            <div className="text-white text-center">Loading apps...</div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-4 max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto">
              {apps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => launchApp(app.packageName)}
                  className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-xl active:bg-white/10 transition"
                >
                  <img 
                    src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`}
                    alt={app.name}
                    className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl"
                  />
                  <span className="text-white text-xs text-center truncate w-full">
                    {app.name}
                  </span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [animateApp, setAnimateApp] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [animateRemove, setAnimateRemove] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [drawerAnimation, setDrawerAnimation] = useState<'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut' | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      setAnimateRemove(app.packageName);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
        setDockApps(newDockApps);
        setAnimateRemove(null);
        if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
          setIsEditMode(false);
        }
      }, 300);
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setAnimateApp(app.packageName);
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        setAnimateApp(null);
      }, 300);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const openDrawer = () => {
    setShowAppDrawer(true);
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceIn');
  };

  const closeDrawer = () => {
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceOut');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setShowAppDrawer(false);
      setDrawerAnimation(null);
    }, 300);
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <style>
        {`
          @keyframes bounceIn {
            0% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            50% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
          }
          @keyframes bounceOut {
            0% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
            40% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
          }
        `}
      </style>
      
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 50,
          pointerEvents: 'none'
        }}
      >
        <div 
          ref={scrollRef}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '100px',
            padding: '4px 12px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '4px',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            overflowX: 'auto',
            overflowY: 'hidden',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            maxWidth: '90%',
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
            scrollbarWidth: 'thin'
          }}
          onContextMenu={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleLongPress();
          }}
        >
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative',
                flexShrink: 0,
                animation: animateRemove === app.packageName ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';

            >
              {isEditMode && (

MenuBar.tsx >>> import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

interface MenuBarProps {

}

const MenuBar: React.FC<MenuBarProps> = ({ onSettingsClick }) => {
  const [time, setTime] = useState<string>('');

Desktop.tsx >>> import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import MenuBar from '../components/MenuBar';
import Dock from '../components/Dock';
import Wallpaper from '../components/Wallpaper';
import { useWallpaper } from '../hooks/useWallpaper';
import { InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface FloatingWindow {
  id: string;
  app: InstalledApp;
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
  isAnimating?: boolean;
  animationType?: 'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut';
}

const Desktop: React.FC = () => {
  const { wallpaperUrl, setWallpaper, resetWallpaper } = useWallpaper();
  const [showWelcomeCard, setShowWelcomeCard] = useState(true);
  const [floatingWindows, setFloatingWindows] = useState<FloatingWindow[]>([]);
  const [draggedWindow, setDraggedWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [dragOffset, setDragOffset] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 });
  const [resizingWindow, setResizingWindow] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [resizeStart, setResizeStart] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0, corner: '', originalX: 0, originalY: 0 });

  const handleSettingsClick = () => {
    const newUrl = prompt('Enter image URL for wallpaper:', wallpaperUrl);
    if (newUrl) {
      setWallpaper(newUrl);
    }
  };

  const handleDockItemClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    const newWindow: FloatingWindow = {
      id: Date.now().toString() + Math.random(),
      app: app,
      x: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      y: 100 + floatingWindows.length * 30,
      width: 320,
      height: 400,
      isAnimating: true,
      animationType: 'bounceIn'
    };
    setFloatingWindows([...floatingWindows, newWindow]);
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => 
        w.id === newWindow.id ? { ...w, isAnimating: false, animationType: undefined } : w
      ));
    }, 500);
  };

  const closeWindow = (id: string) => {
    setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => 
      w.id === id ? { ...w, isAnimating: true, animationType: 'bounceOut' } : w
    ));
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.filter(w => w.id !== id));
    }, 500);
  };

  const bringToFront = (id: string) => {
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (window) {
      const others = floatingWindows.filter(w => w.id !== id);
      setFloatingWindows([...others, window]);
    }
  };

  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setDraggedWindow(id);
    setDragOffset({
      x: e.clientX - window.x,
      y: e.clientY - window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  const handleResizeStart = (e: React.MouseEvent, id: string, corner: string) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopPropagation();
    const window = floatingWindows.find(w => w.id === id);
    if (!window) return;
    
    setResizingWindow(id);
    setResizeStart({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      width: window.width,
      height: window.height,
      corner: corner,
      originalX: window.x,
      originalY: window.y
    });
    bringToFront(id);
  };

  // Global mouse move handler
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = e.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = e.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      } else if (resizingWindow) {
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            const deltaX = e.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = e.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = resizeStart.originalX;
            let newY = resizeStart.originalY;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              default:
                break;
            }
            
            newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - newWidth));
            newY = Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100));
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: newX,
              y: newY,
              width: newWidth,
              height: newHeight
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  // Also handle touch for mobile
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleTouchMove = (e: TouchEvent) => {
      if (draggedWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === draggedWindow) {
            const newX = touch.clientX - dragOffset.x;
            const newY = touch.clientY - dragOffset.y;
            return {
              ...w,
              x: Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - w.width)),
              y: Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100))
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      } else if (resizingWindow && e.touches.length > 0) {
        const touch = e.touches[0];
        setFloatingWindows(prev => prev.map(w => {
          if (w.id === resizingWindow) {
            const deltaX = touch.clientX - resizeStart.x;
            const deltaY = touch.clientY - resizeStart.y;
            
            let newWidth = resizeStart.width;
            let newHeight = resizeStart.height;
            let newX = resizeStart.originalX;
            let newY = resizeStart.originalY;
            
            switch (resizeStart.corner) {
              case 'bottom-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                break;
              case 'bottom-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height + deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                break;
              case 'top-right':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width + deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              case 'top-left':
                newWidth = Math.max(200, resizeStart.width - deltaX);
                newHeight = Math.max(150, resizeStart.height - deltaY);
                newX = resizeStart.originalX + (resizeStart.width - newWidth);
                newY = resizeStart.originalY + (resizeStart.height - newHeight);
                break;
              default:
                break;
            }
            
            newX = Math.max(0, Math.min(newX, window.innerWidth - newWidth));
            newY = Math.max(0, Math.min(newY, window.innerHeight - 100));
            
            return {
              ...w,
              x: newX,
              y: newY,
              width: newWidth,
              height: newHeight
            };
          }
          return w;
        }));
        e.preventDefault();
      }
    };

    const handleTouchEnd = () => {
      setDraggedWindow(null);
      setResizingWindow(null);
    };

    window.addEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);

    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('touchmove', handleTouchMove);
      window.removeEventListener('touchend', handleTouchEnd);
    };
  }, [draggedWindow, dragOffset, resizingWindow, resizeStart]);

  return (
    <Wallpaper imageUrl={wallpaperUrl}>
      <div style={{ position: 'relative', width: '100%', height: '100%' }}>
        <MenuBar onSettingsClick={handleSettingsClick} />
        
        {showWelcomeCard && (
          <div style={{
            position: 'absolute',
            top: '50%',
            left: '50%',
            transform: 'translate(-50%, -50%)',
            zIndex: 40
          }}>
            <div style={{
              position: 'relative',
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
              borderRadius: '16px',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
              padding: '32px',
              minWidth: '320px',
              maxWidth: '400px'
            }}>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowWelcomeCard(false)}
                style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '12px',
                  right: '12px',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)',
                  background: 'transparent',
                  border: 'none',
                  cursor: 'pointer',
                  fontSize: '20px'
                }}
              >
                ✕
              </button>
              
              <div style={{ textAlign: 'center', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <h1 style={{ fontSize: '36px', fontWeight: 'bold', color: 'white', marginBottom: '12px' }}>◇ DiXie ◇</h1>
                <p style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)', marginBottom: '16px' }}>Desktop + X factor + Friendly</p>
                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7)', marginBottom: '20px' }}>
                  <span>⚙️</span>
                  <span>Click gear in top bar to change wallpaper</span>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={resetWallpaper}
                  style={{
                    padding: '8px 20px',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)',
                    borderRadius: '8px',
                    color: 'white',
                    border: 'none',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    fontSize: '14px'
                  }}
                >
                  Reset Wallpaper
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        
        {floatingWindows.map((window) => {
          let animationStyle = {};
          if (window.isAnimating && window.animationType === 'bounceIn') {
            animationStyle = {
              animation: 'bounceIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards'
            };
          } else if (window.isAnimating && window.animationType === 'bounceOut') {
            animationStyle = {
              animation: 'bounceOut 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards'

          }
          
          return (
