import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [animateApp, setAnimateApp] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [animateRemove, setAnimateRemove] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [drawerAnimation, setDrawerAnimation] = useState<'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut' | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      setAnimateRemove(app.packageName);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
        setDockApps(newDockApps);
        setAnimateRemove(null);
        if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
          setIsEditMode(false);
        }
      }, 300);
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setAnimateApp(app.packageName);
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        setAnimateApp(null);
      }, 300);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const openDrawer = () => {
    setShowAppDrawer(true);
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceIn');
  };

  const closeDrawer = () => {
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceOut');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setShowAppDrawer(false);
      setDrawerAnimation(null);
    }, 300);
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <style>
        {`
          @keyframes bounceIn {
            0% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            50% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
          }
          @keyframes bounceOut {
            0% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
            40% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
          }
          @keyframes fadeIn {
            from {
              opacity: 0;
            }
            to {
              opacity: 1;
            }
          }
          @keyframes slideUp {
            from {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: translateY(20px);
            }
            to {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: translateY(0);
            }
          }
        `}
      </style>
      
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 50,
          pointerEvents: 'none'
        }}
      >
        <div 
          ref={scrollRef}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '100px',
            padding: '4px 12px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '4px',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            overflowX: 'auto',
            overflowY: 'hidden',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            maxWidth: '90%',
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
            scrollbarWidth: 'thin'
          }}
          onContextMenu={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleLongPress();
          }}
        >
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative',
                flexShrink: 0,
                animation: animateRemove === app.packageName ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={openDrawer}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7,
              flexShrink: 0
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* REVISED APP DRAWER WITH PROPER GLASS BLUR - MATCHING DOCK STYLE */}
      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div 
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)', // Darker backdrop for better contrast
            zIndex: 100,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)', // Subtle blur on backdrop too
            animation: drawerAnimation === 'bounceIn' ? 'fadeIn 0.2s ease-out forwards' : 
                       drawerAnimation === 'bounceOut' ? 'fadeOut 0.2s ease-out forwards' : 'none'
          }}
          onClick={closeDrawer}
        >
          <div 
            style={{
              // MAIN GLASS EFFECT - MATCHING DOCK EXACTLY
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)', // Same as dock
              backdropFilter: 'blur(25px)', // Slightly stronger than dock for drawer
              WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(25px)', // Safari support
              borderRadius: '24px', // Slightly more rounded than dock
              width: 'auto',
              minWidth: '340px',
              maxWidth: '85%',
              maxHeight: '70%',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)', // Slightly more visible border
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              animation: drawerAnimation === 'bounceIn' ? 'slideUp 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 
                         drawerAnimation === 'bounceOut' ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Header with glass effect */}
            <div style={{
              padding: '20px 20px 8px 20px',
              borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              position: 'relative'
            }}>
              <div style={{
                display: 'flex',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                alignItems: 'center',
                marginBottom: '12px'
              }}>
                <h3 style={{
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '18px',
                  fontWeight: '600',
                  letterSpacing: '-0.3px',
                  margin: 0,
                  textShadow: '0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)'
                }}>
                  Add to Dock
                </h3>
                <button
                  onClick={closeDrawer}
                  style={{
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '14px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    width: '28px',
                    height: '28px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)'}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>
              
              {/* Search input with glass styling */}
              <div style={{ position: 'relative', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Search apps..."
                  value={searchTerm}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    padding: '10px 35px 10px 14px',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(10px)',
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '14px',
                    outline: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onFocus={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)';
                  }}
                  onBlur={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
                  }}
                />
                {searchTerm && (
                  <button
                    onClick={clearSearch}
                    style={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      right: '12px',
                      top: '50%',
                      transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                      background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                      border: 'none',
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                      width: '20px',
                      height: '20px',
                      color: 'white',
                      fontSize: '12px',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'center'
                    }}
                  >
                    ✕
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Apps Grid - Glass style with better visuals */}
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '16px 20px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(70px, 1fr))',
              gap: '12px',
              // Custom scrollbar styling
              scrollbarWidth: 'thin',
              scrollbarColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3) transparent'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: '6px',
                    padding: '10px 4px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
                    border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                    borderRadius: '14px',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1)',
                    animation: animateApp === app.packageName ? 'bounceIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(5px)'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'translateY(-2px) scale(1.02)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)';
                  }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'translateY(0) scale(1)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)';
                  }}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '44px', height: '44px', borderRadius: '12px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '36px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                  <span style={{
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '10px',
                    fontWeight: '500',
                    textAlign: 'center',
                    wordBreak: 'break-word',
                    maxWidth: '100%',
                    textShadow: '0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)'
                  }}>
                    {app.name.length > 20 ? app.name.substring(0, 18) + '...' : app.name}
                  </span>
                  
                  {/* Add indicator */}
                  <div style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: 8,
                    right: 8,
                    width: 20,
                    height: 20,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    background: 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.9)',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    fontSize: '12px',
                    fontWeight: 'bold',
                    color: 'white',
                    boxShadow: '0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)'
                  }}>
                    +
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                  padding: '48px 20px',
                  fontSize: '14px'
                }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '48px', marginBottom: '12px', opacity: 0.5 }}>📭</div>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {/* Footer with app count */}
            <div style={{ 
              padding: '12px 20px', 
              borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              alignItems: 'center'
            }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)', fontSize: '11px' }}>
                {filteredApps.length} app{filteredApps.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} available
              </span>
              <span style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)', fontSize: '10px' }}>
                Click + to add to dock
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default Dock;
Key Changes Made:
1. Glass Blur Matching the Dock
tsx
// Changed from dark rgba(30, 30, 46, 0.85) to:
backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'
backdropFilter: 'blur(25px)'
2. Better Backdrop
tsx
// Outer overlay now has blur too
backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)'
backdropFilter: 'blur(4px)'
3. Glass App Cards
Each app button now has its own subtle glass effect:

tsx
background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)'
backdropFilter: 'blur(5px)'
border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'
4. Visual Enhancements
Added slide-up animation for smoother opening

Green + indicator on each app card

Better hover effects with translateY

Improved scrollbar styling

App count footer

Rounded corners (24px vs 20px)

5. Safari Support
Added WebkitBackdropFilter for iOS Safari compatibility.

The drawer now has the ex same glass aesthetic as your dock - light, translucent, with subtle borders and shadows that match macOS design language perfectly.

  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');

  const [drawerAnimation, setDrawerAnimation] = useState<'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut' | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();

      if (scrollRef.current) {

      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');

    setDrawerAnimation('bounceIn');
  };

  const closeDrawer = () => {
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceOut');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setShowAppDrawer(false);
      setDrawerAnimation(null);
    }, 300);
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <style>
        {`

            gap: '4px',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            overflowX: 'auto',
            overflowY: 'hidden',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',

                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative',
                flexShrink: 0,
                animation: animateRemove === app.packageName ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={openDrawer}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7,
              flexShrink: 0
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* APP DRAWER - NO BACKDROP, JUST GLASS */}
      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div 
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            zIndex: 100,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            pointerEvents: 'none' // Allow clicking through to wallpaper
          }}
          onClick={closeDrawer}
        >
          <div 
            style={{
              // GLASS EFFECT - MATCHING DOCK EXACTLY
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(25px)',
              WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(25px)',
              borderRadius: '24px',
              width: 'auto',
              minWidth: '340px',
              maxWidth: '85%',
              maxHeight: '70%',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              animation: drawerAnimation === 'bounceIn' ? 'slideUp 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 
                         drawerAnimation === 'bounceOut' ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none',
              pointerEvents: 'auto' // Make the drawer itself clickable
            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Header */}
            <div style={{
              padding: '20px 20px 8px 20px',
              borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'
            }}>
              <div style={{
                display: 'flex',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                alignItems: 'center',
                marginBottom: '12px'
              }}>
                <h3 style={{
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '18px',
                  fontWeight: '600',
                  letterSpacing: '-0.3px',
                  margin: 0
                }}>
                  Add to Dock
                </h3>
                <button
                  onClick={closeDrawer}
                  style={{
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '14px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    width: '28px',
                    height: '28px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)'}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>
              
              {/* Search input */}
              <div style={{ position: 'relative', marginTop: '8px' }}>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Search apps..."
                  value={searchTerm}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    padding: '10px 35px 10px 14px',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(10px)',
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '14px',
                    outline: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onFocus={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)';
                  }}
                  onBlur={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
                  }}
                />
                {searchTerm && (
                  <button
                    onClick={clearSearch}
                    style={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      right: '12px',
                      top: '50%',
                      transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                      background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                      border: 'none',
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                      width: '20px',
                      height: '20px',
                      color: 'white',
                      fontSize: '12px',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'center'
                    }}
                  >
                    ✕
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Apps Grid */}
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '16px 20px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(70px, 1fr))',
              gap: '12px',
              scrollbarWidth: 'thin',
              scrollbarColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3) transparent'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: '6px',
                    padding: '10px 4px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)',
                    border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
                    borderRadius: '14px',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1)',
                    animation: animateApp === app.packageName ? 'bounceIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(5px)',
                    position: 'relative'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'translateY(-2px) scale(1.02)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)';
                  }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'translateY(0) scale(1)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)';
                  }}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '44px', height: '44px', borderRadius: '12px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '36px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                  <span style={{
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '10px',
                    fontWeight: '500',
                    textAlign: 'center',
                    wordBreak: 'break-word',
                    maxWidth: '100%'
                  }}>
                    {app.name.length > 20 ? app.name.substring(0, 18) + '...' : app.name}
                  </span>
                  
                  {/* Add indicator */}
                  <div style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: 8,
                    right: 8,
                    width: 20,
                    height: 20,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    background: 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.9)',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    fontSize: '12px',
                    fontWeight: 'bold',
                    color: 'white',
                    boxShadow: '0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)'
                  }}>
                    +
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                  padding: '48px 20px',
                  fontSize: '14px'
                }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '48px', marginBottom: '12px', opacity: 0.5 }}>📭</div>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {/* Footer */}
            <div style={{ 
              padding: '12px 20px', 
              borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              display: 'flex',
              justifyContent: 'space-between',
              alignItems: 'center'
            }}>
              <span style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5)', fontSize: '11px' }}>
                {filteredApps.length} app{filteredApps.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''} available
              </span>
              <span style={{ color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)', fontSize: '10px' }}>
                Click + to add to dock
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default Dock;
Key Changes - Backdrop Removed:
Removed the dark overlay background (backgroundColor: 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)')

Removed the backdrop filter blur from the outer div

Removed the fadeIn animation that was tied to the backdrop

Added pointerEvents: 'none' to the outer container so clicks pass through to the wallpaper

Added pointerEvents: 'auto' to the drawer itself so it remains interactive

Now the app drawer is pure glass floating over your wallpaper with no dark backing - just like the dock!

Your rebuild process is right:

bash
npm run build
npx cap sync android
npx cap run android
Breakdown of what each command does:
npm run build - Compiles your React/TypeScript code into static files in the dist/ folder

npx cap sync android - Copies the built files from dist/ to your Android project and syncs any plugin changes

npx cap run android - Builds and runs the app on your connected Android device/emulator

Alternative options:
If you just want to sync and run (no build needed after first time):

bash
npx cap sync android
npx cap run android
If you want to open in Android Studio instead:

bash
npx cap open android
For faster development with live reload:

bash
npm run build
npx cap sync android
npx cap run android --live-reload
After running these commands, your revised app drawer with the glass blur (no backdrop) should be working perfectly on your Android device!

Let me know if you run into any issues during the build or if the glass effect needs further adjustments.

tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [animateApp, setAnimateApp] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [animateRemove, setAnimateRemove] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [drawerAnimation, setDrawerAnimation] = useState<'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut' | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      setAnimateRemove(app.packageName);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
        setDockApps(newDockApps);
        setAnimateRemove(null);
        if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
          setIsEditMode(false);
        }
      }, 300);
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setAnimateApp(app.packageName);
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        setAnimateApp(null);
      }, 300);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const openDrawer = () => {
    setShowAppDrawer(true);
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceIn');
  };

  const closeDrawer = () => {
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceOut');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setShowAppDrawer(false);
      setDrawerAnimation(null);
    }, 300);
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <style>
        {`
          @keyframes bounceIn {
            0% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            50% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
          }
          @keyframes bounceOut {
            0% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
            40% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
          }
          @keyframes slideUp {
            from {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: translateY(20px);
            }
            to {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: translateY(0);
            }
          }
        `}
      </style>
      
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 50,
          pointerEvents: 'none'
        }}
      >
        <div 
          ref={scrollRef}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '100px',
            padding: '4px 12px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '4px',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            overflowX: 'auto',
            overflowY: 'hidden',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            maxWidth: '90%',
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
            scrollbarWidth: 'thin'
          }}
          onContextMenu={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleLongPress();
          }}
        >
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative',
                flexShrink: 0,
                animation: animateRemove === app.packageName ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={openDrawer}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7,
              flexShrink: 0
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* APP DRAWER - GLASS BLUR, NO BACKDROP, SEARCH AT BOTTOM */}
      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div 
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            zIndex: 100,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            pointerEvents: 'none'
          }}
          onClick={closeDrawer}
        >
          <div 
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(25px)',
              WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(25px)',
              borderRadius: '24px',
              width: 'auto',
              minWidth: '340px',
              maxWidth: '85%',
              maxHeight: '70%',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              animation: drawerAnimation === 'bounceIn' ? 'slideUp 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 
                         drawerAnimation === 'bounceOut' ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none',
              pointerEvents: 'auto'
            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Header with title only */}
            <div style={{
              padding: '20px 20px 8px 20px',
              borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'
            }}>
              <div style={{
                display: 'flex',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                alignItems: 'center',
                marginBottom: '4px'
              }}>
                <h3 style={{
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '18px',
                  fontWeight: '600',
                  letterSpacing: '-0.3px',
                  margin: 0
                }}>
                  Add to Dock
                </h3>
                <button
                  onClick={closeDrawer}
                  style={{
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '14px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    width: '28px',
                    height: '28px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)'}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Apps Grid - NO GLASS CARDS, JUST ICONS, NO NAMES */}
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '16px 20px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fill, minmax(60px, 1fr))',
              gap: '16px',
              scrollbarWidth: 'thin',
              scrollbarColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3) transparent'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    padding: '8px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'transparent',
                    border: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1)',
                    animation: animateApp === app.packageName ? 'bounceIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none',
                    position: 'relative'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
                  }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                  }}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '48px', height: '48px', borderRadius: '12px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '40px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                  
                  {/* Green + indicator */}
                  <div style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: 0,
                    right: 0,
                    width: 22,
                    height: 22,
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    background: 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.95)',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    fontSize: '14px',
                    fontWeight: 'bold',
                    color: 'white',
                    boxShadow: '0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)'
                  }}>
                    +
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                  padding: '48px 20px',
                  fontSize: '14px'
                }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '48px', marginBottom: '12px', opacity: 0.5 }}>📭</div>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {/* Search Bar - NOW AT BOTTOM */}
            <div style={{ 
              padding: '16px 20px', 
              borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'
            }}>
              <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Search apps..."
                  value={searchTerm}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    padding: '10px 35px 10px 14px',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(10px)',
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '14px',
                    outline: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onFocus={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)';
                  }}
                  onBlur={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
                  }}
                />
                {searchTerm && (
                  <button
                    onClick={clearSearch}
                    style={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      right: '12px',
                      top: '50%',
                      transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                      background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                      border: 'none',
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                      width: '20px',
                      height: '20px',
                      color: 'white',
                      fontSize: '12px',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'center'
                    }}
                  >
                    ✕
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

✅ Removed footer - No more "22 apps available" text

✅ Green + indicator preserved - Still shows on each app icon

✅ Larger icons - Increased from 44px to 48px since there's no text

✅ Adjusted grid - Changed to minmax(60px, 1fr) for better icon spacing

bash
npm run build

Perfect! Here's the revised Dock.tsx with:

✅ Smaller icons (36px)

✅ 8 icons per row (using grid-template-columns: repeat(8, 1fr))

✅ Bounce animation copied from floating app opening

tsx
import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [animateApp, setAnimateApp] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [animateRemove, setAnimateRemove] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [drawerAnimation, setDrawerAnimation] = useState<'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut' | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      setAnimateRemove(app.packageName);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
        setDockApps(newDockApps);
        setAnimateRemove(null);
        if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
          setIsEditMode(false);
        }
      }, 300);
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setAnimateApp(app.packageName);
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        setAnimateApp(null);
      }, 300);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const openDrawer = () => {
    setShowAppDrawer(true);
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceIn');
  };

  const closeDrawer = () => {
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceOut');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setShowAppDrawer(false);
      setDrawerAnimation(null);
    }, 300);
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <style>
        {`
          @keyframes bounceIn {
            0% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            50% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
          }
          @keyframes bounceOut {
            0% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
            40% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
          }
          @keyframes slideUp {
            from {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: translateY(20px);
            }
            to {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: translateY(0);
            }
          }
          /* Bounce animation for app icons when added to dock - matching floating app */
          @keyframes bounceApp {
            0% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            50% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.2);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
          }
        `}
      </style>
      
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 50,
          pointerEvents: 'none'
        }}
      >
        <div 
          ref={scrollRef}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '100px',
            padding: '4px 12px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '4px',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            overflowX: 'auto',
            overflowY: 'hidden',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            maxWidth: '90%',
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
            scrollbarWidth: 'thin'
          }}
          onContextMenu={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleLongPress();
          }}
        >
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative',
                flexShrink: 0,
                animation: animateRemove === app.packageName ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                if (!isEditMode) e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={openDrawer}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7,
              flexShrink: 0
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* APP DRAWER - GLASS BLUR, NO BACKDROP, SEARCH AT BOTTOM */}
      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div 
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            zIndex: 100,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            pointerEvents: 'none'
          }}
          onClick={closeDrawer}
        >
          <div 
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(25px)',
              WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(25px)',
              borderRadius: '24px',
              width: 'auto',
              minWidth: '340px',
              maxWidth: '85%',
              maxHeight: '70%',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              animation: drawerAnimation === 'bounceIn' ? 'slideUp 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 
                         drawerAnimation === 'bounceOut' ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none',
              pointerEvents: 'auto'
            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Header with title only */}
            <div style={{
              padding: '20px 20px 8px 20px',
              borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'
            }}>
              <div style={{
                display: 'flex',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                alignItems: 'center',
                marginBottom: '4px'
              }}>
                <h3 style={{
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '18px',
                  fontWeight: '600',
                  letterSpacing: '-0.3px',
                  margin: 0
                }}>
                  Add to Dock
                </h3>
                <button
                  onClick={closeDrawer}
                  style={{
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '14px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    width: '28px',
                    height: '28px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)'}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Apps Grid - 8 icons per row, smaller icons (36px) */}
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '20px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(8, 1fr)',
              gap: '8px',
              scrollbarWidth: 'thin',
              scrollbarColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3) transparent'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    padding: '4px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'transparent',
                    border: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1)',
                    animation: animateApp === app.packageName ? 'bounceApp 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none',
                    position: 'relative'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
                  }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                  }}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '36px', height: '36px', borderRadius: '10px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '32px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                  
                  {/* Green + indicator */}
                  <div style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: -2,
                    right: -2,
                    width: '18px',
                    height: '18px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    background: 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.95)',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    fontSize: '12px',
                    fontWeight: 'bold',
                    color: 'white',
                    boxShadow: '0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)'
                  }}>
                    +
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                  padding: '48px 20px',
                  fontSize: '14px'
                }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '48px', marginBottom: '12px', opacity: 0.5 }}>📭</div>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {/* Search Bar - AT BOTTOM */}
            <div style={{ 
              padding: '16px 20px', 
              borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'
            }}>
              <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Search apps..."
                  value={searchTerm}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    padding: '10px 35px 10px 14px',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(10px)',
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '14px',
                    outline: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onFocus={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)';
                  }}
                  onBlur={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
                  }}
                />
                {searchTerm && (
                  <button
                    onClick={clearSearch}
                    style={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      right: '12px',
                      top: '50%',
                      transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                      background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                      border: 'none',
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                      width: '20px',
                      height: '20px',
                      color: 'white',
                      fontSize: '12px',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'center'
                    }}
                  >
                    ✕
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default Dock;
Key Changes:
Smaller icons: 36px x 36px (was 48px) with borderRadius: '10px'

8 icons per row: gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(8, 1fr)'

Bounce animation: Added @keyframes bounceApp that matches the floating app animation:

0%: opacity 0, scale 0.8

50%: opacity 1, scale 1.2 (more exaggerated bounce)

100%: opacity 1, scale 1

Animation timing: 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) - same easing as floating windows

Green + indicator: Slightly smaller (18px) to match smaller icons

Now rebuild:

bash
npm run build
npx cap sync android
npx cap run android

interface DockProps {
