  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [animateApp, setAnimateApp] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [animateRemove, setAnimateRemove] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [drawerAnimation, setDrawerAnimation] = useState<'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut' | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      setAnimateRemove(app.packageName);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
        setDockApps(newDockApps);
        setAnimateRemove(null);
        if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
          setIsEditMode(false);
        }
      }, 300);
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setAnimateApp(app.packageName);
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        setAnimateApp(null);
      }, 300);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const openDrawer = () => {
    setShowAppDrawer(true);
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceIn');
  };

  const closeDrawer = () => {
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceOut');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setShowAppDrawer(false);
      setDrawerAnimation(null);
    }, 300);
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <style>
        {`
          @keyframes bounceIn {
            0% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            50% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
          }
          @keyframes bounceOut {
            0% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
            40% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
          }
          @keyframes bounceApp {
            0% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            50% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.2);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
          }
        `}
      </style>
      
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 50,
          pointerEvents: 'none'
        }}
      >
        <div 
          ref={scrollRef}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '100px',
            padding: '4px 12px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '4px',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            overflowX: 'auto',
            overflowY: 'hidden',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            maxWidth: '90%',
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
            scrollbarWidth: 'thin'
          }}
          onContextMenu={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleLongPress();
          }}
        >
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1)',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative',
                flexShrink: 0,
                animation: animateRemove === app.packageName ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                if (isEditMode) {
                  e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
                } else {
                  e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
                }
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={openDrawer}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7,
              flexShrink: 0
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* APP DRAWER - SAME BOUNCE ANIMATION AS OPENING APPS FROM DOCK */}
      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div 
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            zIndex: 100,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            pointerEvents: 'none'
          }}
          onClick={closeDrawer}
        >
          <div 
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(25px)',
              WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(25px)',
              borderRadius: '24px',
              width: 'auto',
              minWidth: '340px',
              maxWidth: '85%',
              maxHeight: '70%',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              animation: drawerAnimation === 'bounceIn' ? 'bounceIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 
                         drawerAnimation === 'bounceOut' ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none',
              pointerEvents: 'auto'
            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Header with title only */}
            <div style={{
              padding: '20px 20px 8px 20px',
              borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'
            }}>
              <div style={{
                display: 'flex',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                alignItems: 'center',
                marginBottom: '4px'
              }}>
                <h3 style={{
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '18px',
                  fontWeight: '600',
                  letterSpacing: '-0.3px',
                  margin: 0
                }}>
                  Add to Dock
                </h3>
                <button
                  onClick={closeDrawer}
                  style={{
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '14px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    width: '28px',
                    height: '28px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)'}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Apps Grid - 8 icons per row, smaller icons (36px) */}
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '20px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(8, 1fr)',
              gap: '8px',
              scrollbarWidth: 'thin',
              scrollbarColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3) transparent'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    padding: '4px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'transparent',
                    border: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1)',
                    animation: animateApp === app.packageName ? 'bounceApp 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none',
                    position: 'relative'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
                  }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                  }}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '36px', height: '36px', borderRadius: '10px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '32px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                  
                  {/* Green + indicator */}
                  <div style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: -2,
                    right: -2,
                    width: '18px',
                    height: '18px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    background: 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.95)',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    fontSize: '12px',
                    fontWeight: 'bold',
                    color: 'white',
                    boxShadow: '0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)'
                  }}>
                    +
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                  padding: '48px 20px',
                  fontSize: '14px'
                }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '48px', marginBottom: '12px', opacity: 0.5 }}>📭</div>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {/* Search Bar - AT BOTTOM */}
            <div style={{ 
              padding: '16px 20px', 
              borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'
            }}>
              <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Search apps..."
                  value={searchTerm}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    padding: '10px 35px 10px 14px',
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(10px)',
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '14px',
                    outline: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onFocus={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)';
                  }}
                  onBlur={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
                  }}
                />
                {searchTerm && (
                  <button
                    onClick={clearSearch}
                    style={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      right: '12px',
                      top: '50%',
                      transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                      background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                      border: 'none',
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                      width: '20px',
                      height: '20px',
                      color: 'white',
                      fontSize: '12px',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'center'
                    }}
                  >
                    ✕
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default Dock;

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { InstalledApps, InstalledApp } from '../capacitor';

interface DockProps {
  onItemClick: (app: InstalledApp) => void;
}

const STORAGE_KEY = 'dixie_dock_apps';

const Dock: React.FC<DockProps> = ({ onItemClick }) => {
  const [allApps, setAllApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [dockApps, setDockApps] = useState<InstalledApp[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isEditMode, setIsEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [showAppDrawer, setShowAppDrawer] = useState(false);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [animateApp, setAnimateApp] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [animateRemove, setAnimateRemove] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [drawerAnimation, setDrawerAnimation] = useState<'bounceIn' | 'bounceOut' | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadApps = async () => {
      try {
        const result = await InstalledApps.getInstalledApps();
        setAllApps(result.apps);
        
        const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        if (saved) {
          const savedApps = JSON.parse(saved);
          setDockApps(savedApps);
        } else if (result.apps.length > 0) {
          setDockApps(result.apps.slice(0, 8));
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Failed to load apps:', error);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    
    loadApps();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (dockApps.length > 0) {
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(dockApps));
      if (scrollRef.current) {
        scrollRef.current.scrollLeft = scrollRef.current.scrollWidth;
      }
    }
  }, [dockApps]);

  const handleLongPress = () => {
    setIsEditMode(!isEditMode);
  };

  const handleAppClick = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (isEditMode) {
      setAnimateRemove(app.packageName);
      setTimeout(() => {
        const newDockApps = dockApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName);
        setDockApps(newDockApps);
        setAnimateRemove(null);
        if (newDockApps.length === 0) {
          setIsEditMode(false);
        }
      }, 300);
    } else {
      onItemClick(app);
    }
  };

  const addAppToDock = (app: InstalledApp) => {
    if (!dockApps.some(d => d.packageName === app.packageName)) {
      setAnimateApp(app.packageName);
      setDockApps([...dockApps, app]);
      setAllApps(allApps.filter(a => a.packageName !== app.packageName));
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        setAnimateApp(null);
      }, 300);
    }
    setShowAppDrawer(false);
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const clearSearch = () => {
    setSearchTerm('');
  };

  const openDrawer = () => {
    setShowAppDrawer(true);
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceIn');
  };

  const closeDrawer = () => {
    setDrawerAnimation('bounceOut');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setShowAppDrawer(false);
      setDrawerAnimation(null);
    }, 300);
  };

  const availableApps = allApps.filter(
    availableApp => !dockApps.some(dockApp => dockApp.packageName === availableApp.packageName)
  );

  const filteredApps = availableApps.filter(app =>
    app.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())
  );

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        bottom: '8px',
        left: '50%',
        transform: 'translateX(-50%)',
        backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
        borderRadius: '100px',
        padding: '8px 16px',
        color: 'white'
      }}>
        Loading apps...
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <style>
        {`
          @keyframes bounceIn {
            0% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            50% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
          }
          @keyframes bounceOut {
            0% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
            40% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.05);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
          }
          @keyframes bounceApp {
            0% {
              opacity: 0;
              transform: scale(0.8);
            }
            50% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1.2);
            }
            100% {
              opacity: 1;
              transform: scale(1);
            }
          }
        `}
      </style>
      
      <div 
        style={{
          position: 'fixed',
          bottom: '8px',
          left: 0,
          right: 0,
          display: 'flex',
          justifyContent: 'center',
          zIndex: 50,
          pointerEvents: 'none'
        }}
      >
        <div 
          ref={scrollRef}
          style={{
            backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
            backdropFilter: 'blur(20px)',
            borderRadius: '100px',
            padding: '4px 12px',
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            gap: '4px',
            boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)',
            border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
            overflowX: 'auto',
            overflowY: 'hidden',
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
            maxWidth: '90%',
            pointerEvents: 'auto',
            scrollbarWidth: 'thin'
          }}
          onContextMenu={(e) => {
            e.preventDefault();
            handleLongPress();
          }}
        >
          {dockApps.map((app) => (
            <button
              key={app.packageName}
              onClick={() => handleAppClick(app)}
              style={{
                display: 'inline-flex',
                flexDirection: 'column',
                alignItems: 'center',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                padding: '4px 8px',
                borderRadius: '8px',
                transition: 'all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1)',
                cursor: 'pointer',
                background: 'transparent',
                border: 'none',
                position: 'relative',
                flexShrink: 0,
                animation: animateRemove === app.packageName ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none'
              }}
              onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
              }}
              onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
              }}
            >
              {isEditMode && (
                <span style={{
                  position: 'absolute',
                  top: '-4px',
                  right: '-4px',
                  backgroundColor: '#ff0000',
                  color: 'white',
                  borderRadius: '50%',
                  width: '18px',
                  height: '18px',
                  fontSize: '12px',
                  fontWeight: 'bold',
                  display: 'flex',
                  alignItems: 'center',
                  justifyContent: 'center',
                  zIndex: 10
                }}>−</span>
              )}
              {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                <img 
                  src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                  alt={app.name}
                  style={{ width: '20px', height: '20px' }}
                />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>📱</span>
              )}
            </button>
          ))}
          
          <button
            onClick={openDrawer}
            style={{
              display: 'inline-flex',
              alignItems: 'center',
              justifyContent: 'center',
              padding: '4px 8px',
              borderRadius: '8px',
              transition: 'all 0.2s',
              cursor: 'pointer',
              background: 'transparent',
              border: 'none',
              opacity: 0.7,
              flexShrink: 0
            }}
            onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)'}
            onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)'}
          >
            <span style={{ fontSize: '18px' }}>➕</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* APP DRAWER - with smaller icons and shorter search bar */}
      {showAppDrawer && (
        <div 
          style={{
            position: 'fixed',
            top: 0,
            left: 0,
            right: 0,
            bottom: 0,
            zIndex: 100,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            justifyContent: 'center',
            pointerEvents: 'none'
          }}
          onClick={closeDrawer}
        >
          <div 
            style={{
              backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              backdropFilter: 'blur(25px)',
              WebkitBackdropFilter: 'blur(25px)',
              borderRadius: '24px',
              width: 'auto',
              minWidth: '340px',
              maxWidth: '85%',
              maxHeight: '70%',
              overflow: 'hidden',
              display: 'flex',
              flexDirection: 'column',
              border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)',
              boxShadow: '0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)',
              animation: drawerAnimation === 'bounceIn' ? 'bounceIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 
                         drawerAnimation === 'bounceOut' ? 'bounceOut 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none',
              pointerEvents: 'auto'
            }}
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Header with title only */}
            <div style={{
              padding: '20px 20px 8px 20px',
              borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'
            }}>
              <div style={{
                display: 'flex',
                justifyContent: 'space-between',
                alignItems: 'center',
                marginBottom: '4px'
              }}>
                <h3 style={{
                  color: 'white',
                  fontSize: '18px',
                  fontWeight: '600',
                  letterSpacing: '-0.3px',
                  margin: 0
                }}>
                  Add to Dock
                </h3>
                <button
                  onClick={closeDrawer}
                  style={{
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)',
                    border: 'none',
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '14px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    width: '28px',
                    height: '28px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    display: 'flex',

                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)'}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15)'}
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Apps Grid - 8 icons per row, SMALLER ICONS (32px) */}
            <div style={{
              flex: 1,
              overflowY: 'auto',
              padding: '20px',
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(8, 1fr)',
              gap: '6px',
              scrollbarWidth: 'thin',
              scrollbarColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3) transparent'
            }}>
              {filteredApps.map((app) => (
                <button
                  key={app.packageName}
                  onClick={() => addAppToDock(app)}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    flexDirection: 'column',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    padding: '2px',
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    background: 'transparent',
                    border: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1)',
                    animation: animateApp === app.packageName ? 'bounceApp 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.2, 0.64, 1) forwards' : 'none',
                    position: 'relative'
                  }}
                  onMouseEnter={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1.1)';
                  }}
                  onMouseLeave={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                  }}
                >
                  {app.icon && app.icon.length > 100 ? (
                    <img 
                      src={`data:image/png;base64,${app.icon}`} 
                      alt={app.name}
                      style={{ width: '32px', height: '32px', borderRadius: '8px' }}
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <span style={{ fontSize: '28px' }}>📱</span>
                  )}
                  
                  {/* Green + indicator - slightly smaller to match */}
                  <div style={{
                    position: 'absolute',
                    bottom: -2,
                    right: -2,
                    width: '16px',
                    height: '16px',
                    borderRadius: '50%',
                    background: 'rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.95)',
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    justifyContent: 'center',
                    fontSize: '10px',
                    fontWeight: 'bold',
                    color: 'white',
                    boxShadow: '0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)'
                  }}>
                    +
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))}
              
              {filteredApps.length === 0 && (
                <div style={{
                  gridColumn: '1 / -1',
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  color: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)',
                  padding: '48px 20px',
                  fontSize: '14px'
                }}>
                  <div style={{ fontSize: '48px', marginBottom: '12px', opacity: 0.5 }}>📭</div>
                  No apps found
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
            
            {/* Search Bar - SHORTER (reduced padding) */}
            <div style={{ 
              padding: '12px 20px', 
              borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)'
            }}>
              <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="Search apps..."
                  value={searchTerm}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    padding: '6px 35px 6px 14px', // Reduced from 10px to 6px
                    borderRadius: '12px',
                    border: '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                    background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)',
                    backdropFilter: 'blur(10px)',
                    color: 'white',
                    fontSize: '13px', // Slightly smaller font
                    outline: 'none',
                    transition: 'all 0.2s'
                  }}
                  onFocus={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4)';
                  }}
                  onBlur={(e) => {
                    e.currentTarget.style.background = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12)';
                    e.currentTarget.style.border = '1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)';
                  }}
                />
                {searchTerm && (
                  <button
                    onClick={clearSearch}
                    style={{
                      position: 'absolute',
                      right: '12px',
                      top: '50%',
                      transform: 'translateY(-50%)',
                      background: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)',
                      border: 'none',
                      borderRadius: '50%',
                      width: '18px',
                      height: '18px',
                      color: 'white',
                      fontSize: '10px',
                      cursor: 'pointer',
                      display: 'flex',
                      alignItems: 'center',
                      justifyContent: 'center'
                    }}
                  >
                    ✕
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
};

export default Dock;
Changes Made:
1. Smaller Icons
Icon size: 32px x 32px (was 36px)

Border radius: 8px (was 10px)

Fallback emoji: 28px (was 32px)

Grid gap: 6px (was 8px)

Button padding: 2px (was 4px)

2. Shorter Search Bar
Input padding: 6px 35px 6px 14px (was 10px 35px 10px 14px)

Font size: 13px (was 14px)

Container padding: 12px 20px (was 16px 20px)

Clear button size: 18px (was 20px)

3. Green + Indicator Adjusted
Size: 16px x 16px (was 18px)

Font size: 10px (was 12px)

Now rebuild:

bash
npm run build
npx cap sync android
npx cap run android
The app drawer is now more compact and elegant! 🎯
